papers.title: ELSA3D: Elastic Semantic Anchoring for Unified 3D Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Unified 3D foundation models aspire to generate 3D assets and reason about them in language within a single backbone, but their text-3D interaction remains largely implicit. Existing methods concatenate text and 3D tokens into a flat sequence and rely on self-attention, collapsing coarse structural cues and fine geometric details into one undifferentiated representation. We introduce ELSA3D, a unified 3D model that addresses this with elastic semantic anchoring, structuring language and geometric reasoning jointly along matched abstraction scales. ELSA3D represents geometry with a scale-aware octree tokenizer and introduces Anchor Tokens, sparse cross-modal units that select semantic cues, route them to the most relevant 3D scale, retrieve scale-specific geometric evidence, and write the fused signal back into the unified representation, keeping interaction sparse yet precise. A lightweight per-block router makes both computation and reasoning elastic, choosing which text tokens instantiate anchors at which geometric scale so that cross-modal capacity concentrates where alignment is most needed. ELSA3D achieves state-of-the-art performance across image-to-3D generation, text-to-3D generation, and 3D captioning, outperforming the strongest unified baseline while roughly halving FLOPs and inference latency relative to the non-elastic version of the same model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ELSA3D 提出弹性语义锚定 (elastic semantic anchoring) 方法，通过尺度感知的八叉树分词器 (scale-aware octree tokenizer) 和锚点令牌 (Anchor Tokens) 实现文本与3D几何在匹配抽象尺度上的联合结构化推理。在图像到3D生成、文本到3D生成和3D描述任务上达到最先进性能，同时计算量和推理延迟减半。
Motivation: 现有统一3D基础模型将文本与3D令牌拼接成扁平序列并依赖自注意力，导致粗粒度结构线索和细粒度几何细节混为一谈，文本-3D交互隐式且不精确。
Method: 引入弹性语义锚定框架：用尺度感知八叉树分词器表示几何，稀疏跨模态单元 (Anchor Tokens) 选择语义线索、路由到最相关的3D尺度、检索尺度特定几何证据并将融合信号写回统一表示；轻量级逐块路由器决定哪些文本令牌在哪个几何尺度实例化锚点。
Result: 在图像到3D生成、文本到3D生成和3D描述任务上超越最强统一基线，同时相比非弹性版本减少约一半的FLOPs和推理延迟。
Conclusion: ELSA3D展示了通过弹性语义锚定实现稀疏而精确的跨模态交互，在3D理解与生成统一模型中兼顾性能与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization across diverse tasks. However, effective robotic manipulation in physical environments fundamentally requires geometric understanding and spatial reasoning. While some VLA approaches attempt to incorporate 3D information, they are constrained by limited data availability and geometric information loss in current 3D encoding pipelines, and fail to jointly capture 3D geometry and temporally structured actions in dynamic environments. To address these limitations, we introduce Lift3D-VLA, a unified VLA framework that equips models with explicit 3D point cloud reasoning and enables temporally coherent action generation. First, building upon our previous work Lift3D, an enhanced 2D model-lifting strategy is proposed to geometrically align 3D points with pretrained 2D positional embeddings. This design enables direct point-cloud encoding within the VLA vision encoder while minimizing spatial information loss. Based on explicit 3D inputs, we propose Geometry-Centric Masked Autoencoding (GC-MAE), a dual-objective self-supervised framework that reconstructs the current point cloud while predicting its future geometric evolution. This formulation allows the 2D vision encoder to internalize both 3D structure and physical dynamics. To fully exploit 3D representations, we further design layer-wise temporal action modeling, which leverages multiple layers of the LLM to collaboratively predict action chunks, enabling temporally consistent predictions. Across 22 simulated tasks and 8 real-world manipulation tasks, Lift3D-VLA achieves 10.8% and 11.1% higher mean success rates on MetaWorld and RLBench than the best-performing prior VLA methods, and outperforms the strongest real-world baseline by 4 percentage points, while exhibiting stronger generalization to out-of-distribution perturbations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lift3D-VLA，一种统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，通过显式3D点云推理和时序一致动作生成增强机器人操作。该方法基于 Lift3D 的 2D 模型提升策略实现几何对齐，引入几何中心掩码自编码（GC-MAE）同时重建当前点云并预测未来几何演化，并设计分层时序动作建模利用 LLM 多层协同预测动作块。在 22 个模拟任务和 8 个真实操作任务上，Lift3D-VLA 在 MetaWorld 和 RLBench 上的平均成功率分别比先前最佳 VLA 方法高 10.8% 和 11.1%，在真实基线基础上提升 4 个百分点，并展现出对分布外扰动的强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在物理环境中的机器人操作缺乏几何理解和空间推理，虽有部分方法尝试引入 3D 信息，但受限于数据稀缺和当前 3D 编码管线的几何信息损失，无法联合捕捉 3D 几何与动态环境中的时序动作结构。
Method: 基于前期工作 Lift3D 提出增强的 2D 模型提升策略，几何对齐 3D 点与预训练 2D 位置嵌入，实现 VLA 视觉编码器内直接点云编码并最小化空间信息损失。提出几何中心掩码自编码（GC-MAE），一种双目标自监督框架，同时重建当前点云并预测其未来几何演化，使 2D 视觉编码器内化 3D 结构和物理动态。设计分层时序动作建模，利用 LLM 多层协同预测动作块，实现时序一致的动作生成。
Result: 在 22 个模拟任务和 8 个真实操作任务上，Lift3D-VLA 在 MetaWorld 和 RLBench 上分别获得比先前最佳 VLA 方法高 10.8% 和 11.1% 的平均成功率，在真实世界基线基础上提升 4 个百分点，并对分布外扰动表现出更强的泛化能力。
Conclusion: Lift3D-VLA 通过显式 3D 点云推理和时序动作建模提升了 VLA 模型在复杂动态环境中的操作性能与泛化能力，但摘要未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: Vision as Unified Multimodal Generation
papers.abstract_en: We formulate computer vision as unified multimodal generation, where heterogeneous visual tasks are expressed in the native text and image generation spaces of a unified multimodal model, without task-specific architectures. Under this formulation, SenseNova-Vision uses natural-language instructions and optional visual prompts to specify tasks, target regions or views, and decoding conventions, and generates responses as text for symbolic outputs, images for dense spatial predictions, or mixed text-and-image outputs for compositional tasks. To support large-scale training, we convert diverse computer vision annotations into instruction-response examples compatible with these generation spaces, resulting in the SenseNova-Vision Corpus, a computer-vision instruction-response corpus spanning text, image, and mixed targets. Starting from an off-the-shelf pretrained unified multimodal model, SenseNova-Vision is trained primarily on this corpus, with auxiliary multimodal data used as a capability-preserving mixture, and requires no task-specific prediction heads or architectural modifications. The resulting model covers a broad range of vision tasks, including detection, OCR, keypoint estimation, segmentation, depth estimation, surface normal prediction, point maps, and camera pose estimation, while supporting language-defined variants that combine category, color, region, and other visual cues. Experiments show that a single unified model can match leading task-specialized systems across structured visual understanding, dense geometric prediction, segmentation, and multi-view visual geometry. These results suggest unified multimodal generation as a scalable route for integrating computer vision capabilities into general-purpose foundation models. The model and corpus are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将计算机视觉视为统一多模态生成任务，使用SenseNova-Vision模型在文本和图像生成空间中表达异构视觉任务，无需特定任务架构。训练基于SenseNova-Vision语料库，覆盖检测、OCR、分割、深度估计等多种视觉任务。实验表明单个统一模型可匹配专门化系统的性能，为视觉能力集成到通用基础模型提供了可扩展路径。
Motivation: 当前计算机视觉任务依赖特定架构，缺乏统一生成式框架。本文旨在将视觉任务统一到多模态生成空间中，简化模型设计并提升通用性。
Method: 使用自然语言指令和可选视觉提示指定任务，生成文本或图像输出。将视觉标注转换为指令-响应示例，构建SenseNova-Vision语料库，在预训练统一多模态模型上微调，无需任务特定头或架构修改。
Result: 实验表明单个统一模型在结构化视觉理解、密集几何预测、分割和多视角视觉几何等任务上匹配甚至领先专门化系统。
Conclusion: 统一多模态生成为将视觉能力集成到通用基础模型中提供了可扩展的路径，模型和语料库已公开，但论文未提及在降水预报等气象任务上的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProxyPose: 6-DoF Pose Tracking via Video-to-Video Translation
papers.abstract_en: Tracking the six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) pose of objects and surfaces from monocular video is a long-standing problem in computer vision. To tackle this problem, existing methods require inputs beyond the video itself-such as 3D models, depth maps, object masks, or task-specific learned features-and they struggle with textureless, transparent, reflective, or deformable surfaces. Here, we introduce ProxyPose, which recasts 6-DoF pose tracking as video-to-video translation. Given only a video and a single marked pixel in the first frame, a fine-tuned video diffusion model translates the input into a proxy video-a synthetic video depicting a colored polyhedron undergoing the same local rigid-body motion as the surface region at the marked pixel. Because the proxy's geometry and appearance are known by construction, recovering its full 6-DoF trajectory reduces to classical pose estimation with off-the-shelf solvers. This formulation leverages large-scale video pre-training to absorb the hardest aspects of pose tracking-handling challenging materials, occlusions, and deformations-into the translation step, while operating at the pixel level with no assumptions about object identity, boundaries, or global rigidity. ProxyPose achieves state-of-the-art 6-DoF pose tracking accuracy without the additional inputs required by competing methods and after fine-tuning the video model only on synthetic data. We further demonstrate that ProxyPose extends to face tracking, camera pose estimation, and challenging in-the-wild scenes that are beyond the reach of existing approaches. Project page: https://ruihangzhang97.github.io/proxypose/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProxyPose，将 6-DoF 姿态追踪重新定义为视频到视频的翻译问题。通过一个单标记像素和微调的视频扩散模型，将输入视频转换为代理视频（proxy video），即一个彩色多面体在相同局部刚体运动下的合成视频。由于代理的几何和外观已知，其 6-DoF 轨迹可通过经典姿态估计求解器恢复。该方法无需 3D 模型、深度图或物体掩码等额外输入，在合成数据微调后达到 state-of-the-art 精度，并扩展到人脸追踪、相机姿态估计等场景。
Motivation: 现有单目 6-DoF 姿态追踪方法需要额外输入（如 3D 模型、深度图），且难以处理无纹理、透明、反射或可变形表面。
Method: 利用预训练视频扩散模型，以视频和首帧单个标记像素为输入，生成彩色多面体的代理视频，其运动与输入视频中标记区域的局部刚体运动一致。然后使用经典方法从代理视频中恢复 6-DoF 轨迹。
Result: 在 6-DoF 姿态追踪精度上达到 state-of-the-art，无需竞争方法所需的额外输入，且仅在合成数据上微调。此外可推广至人脸追踪、相机姿态估计等场景。
Conclusion: 通过将姿态追踪转化为视频翻译，利用大规模视频预训练替代复杂的手工设计特征和几何推理，适用于多种挑战性材料和环境。

papers.title: From RGB Generation to Dense Field Readout: Pixel-Space Dense Prediction with Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale text-to-image models are attractive backbones for dense prediction because RGB generation pretraining learns rich semantic, structural, and geometric priors. Existing generative and editing approaches reuse these priors by casting dense prediction as target generation: annotations such as depth, normals, alpha mattes, masks, and heatmaps are encoded into an RGB-trained VAE latent space and decoded back as image-like targets. We argue this inherits more of the generative output interface than dense prediction requires: unlike RGB synthesis, dense prediction asks for pixel-correct, task-native fields on the same image plane, not new RGB content to be rendered. Our key observation is that a pretrained DiT already organizes RGB inputs through a patch-to-token-to-patch lattice on the image plane, so each token indexes a fixed output patch whose channels can carry task-native quantities instead of RGB appearance. We instantiate this as ReChannel: we keep the VAE encoder for the DiT's input distribution but drop the target-side decoder, adapt the frozen DiT with task LoRA, and map each token to its p x p x K_t pixel-space patch through a shared token-local linear head--about 33K parameters, no spatial mixing. Using FLUX-Klein, we evaluate on six dense prediction tasks and over a dozen benchmarks. This minimal interface sets new state-of-the-art on trimap-free matting, KITTI depth, and referring segmentation, and stays competitive on normals, saliency, and pose. In a matched 4B setting it is more accurate and 2.48x faster than an edit-plus-latent-decode counterpart--dense perception can benefit from generative pretraining without inheriting its output interface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReChannel方法，利用预训练文本到图像模型（如FLUX-Klein）进行密集预测，通过保留VAE编码器、冻结DiT并添加任务LoRA，以及每个token的局部线性头直接预测像素级任务场，避免了传统生成式方法中解码RGB图像的冗余。在六项密集预测任务上，包括无trimap抠图、KITTI深度和指代分割，取得了新的最佳结果，并在法线、显著性和姿态任务上具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有方法将密集预测视为目标生成任务，将深度、法线等标注编码到VAE潜空间再解码为类图像目标，继承了生成式输出接口的冗余。本文认为密集预测需要的是像素正确的任务原生场，而非新的RGB内容。
Method: ReChannel方法：使用预训练DiT的VAE编码器处理输入，但移除目标端解码器；冻结DiT并用任务LoRA适配；每个token通过共享的token局部线性头（约33K参数，无空间混合）直接映射到p×p×K_t的像素块。
Result: 在6个密集预测任务的数十个基准上：无trimap抠图、KITTI深度、指代分割达到新最佳；法线、显著性、姿态任务有竞争力。在匹配4B参数设置下，比编辑+潜解码方法准确率更高且速度快2.48倍。
Conclusion: 密集感知可以从生成预训练中受益，而无需继承其输出接口。

papers.title: MonoIR-RS: Infrared Remote Sensing Vision-Language Learning with CLIP and VLM Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Infrared remote-sensing imagery captures intensity structure, object-background contrast, and illumination-invariant cues often invisible in RGB imagery. Yet, most remote-sensing vision-language resources and models focus on visible-band semantics, leaving infrared vision-language understanding underexplored. We introduce MonoIR-RS, a large-scale infrared remote-sensing vision-language dataset and benchmark that couples IR-aware data construction with CLIP-style contrastive adaptation and VLM instruction tuning. Built from the same source pool and split as FusionRS, MonoIR-RS retains the infrared image as the model-facing modality, yielding 600,000 synthesized infrared images and 59,032 retained IR-aware caption records. The model experiments use this retained language-supervision subset, whose captions rewrite supervision around grayscale structure and infrared-style contrast instead of RGB appearance. We show that the synthesized infrared imagery is markedly closer to real thermal imagery than a grayscale conversion on the AVIID benchmark. We fine-tune five CLIP backbones and six VLM backbones, and calibrate them against zero-shot behavior: IR-aware adaptation lifts CLIP mean recall by up to 12.8 points and drives VLM captioning IR-cue coverage to 100% while reducing residual RGB-color leakage to near zero. By isolating the infrared modality from RGB-IR dual-modal learning, MonoIR-RS offers a controlled, reproducible testbed for aligning infrared remote-sensing evidence with language.

papers.title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Calcification Classification in Mammography Across Multi-Site Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-based computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems have shown strong performance in breast cancer diagnosis, particularly for classification tasks in mammography. However, domain shifts across multi-site datasets remain a challenge, especially when models are applied to unseen domains. In this work, we proposed a calcification classification framework to improve malignant versus benign breast disease classification across multi-site mammography datasets. The framework consisted of two components: (1) an unsupervised domain adaptation module based on style transfer models (AdaIN and CycleGAN) to generate vendor-specific and technique-specific training samples without additional annotations, and (2) a supervised classification module using Swin Transformer V2 as the backbone. We evaluated the proposed method on three datasets: cross-validation on OPTIMAM (National Health Service, United Kingdom; n=2994), followed by external validation on EMBED (Emory University; n=125), and Duke Calcification Dataset v1 (n=788). These datasets cover multiple vendors and include both full-field digital mammography and synthetic 2D images derived from digital breast tomosynthesis. The proposed framework improved cross-site performance for both EMBED (AUC 0.68 to 0.72) and the Duke Calcification Dataset (AUC 0.68 to 0.73). These findings indicate that domain adaptation can reduce domain shifts and improve the generalization for calcification classification across multi-site datasets.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个无监督域适应框架，用于跨多站点乳腺钼靶钙化分类。框架结合风格迁移（AdaIN和CycleGAN）进行域自适应，并以Swin Transformer V2作为分类骨干。在OPTIMAM、EMBED和Duke钙化数据集上的实验表明，域适应将外部验证集AUC从0.68提升至0.72-0.73。

Result: 在EMBED外部验证集上AUC从0.68提升至0.72，在Duke钙化数据集上从0.68提升至0.73。
Conclusion: 域适应能够减少多站点数据集间的域偏移，提高钙化分类的泛化性能。

papers.title: Graph Convolutional Attention: A Spectral Perspective on Graph Denoising and Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Denoising graphs is a fundamental problem in graph learning and the core operation of graph diffusion models. Attention-based architectures like graph transformers have recently shown promise in denoising graphs. However, our principled understanding of attention-based graph denoising remains limited, making it unclear whether standard attention is the right mechanism for this task. Here we show that, under a denoising objective, linear attention is suboptimal and can only learn an average spectral denoising filter over the training distribution. This creates a fundamental limitation as graphs often vary spectrally across the distribution. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Spectral Attention, which directly utilizes the input graph spectrum and provably outperforms linear attention by a margin governed by the spectral diversity of the distribution. We then derive Graph Convolutional Attention (GCA), a practical and permutation-equivariant realization of this idea that implements spectral denoising through graph-filtered queries and keys. For stochastic block models, GCA provably matches the idealized Spectral Attention mechanism. We further show that the softmax operation, that follows the attention, provides additional denoising by approximately projecting noisy eigenvectors onto the clean eigenspace. Empirically, replacing linear attention with GCA consistently improves graph denoising and diffusion on synthetic and real datasets, with gains strongly correlated with spectral diversity. In DiGress, GCA matches standard graph-transformer performance without computing expensive structural features, and when combined with the recently proposed PEARL positional encodings, avoids explicit eigendecomposition computations resulting in faster inference without degrading quality. The code can be found here: github.com/shervinkhalafi/graph_conv_att
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从谱角度分析图去噪与扩散中的注意力机制，指出现有线性注意力只能学习平均谱去噪滤波器，受限于图谱分布的多样性。为此提出谱注意力（Spectral Attention）及其可实现的图卷积注意力（GCA），通过图滤波的查询和键实现谱去噪，理论证明其优势与谱多样性相关，并结合softmax的投影去噪能力。实验表明GCA在图去噪和扩散任务上一致提升性能，且可避免昂贵的特征分解计算。
Motivation: 现有注意力机制在图去噪中缺乏原理性理解，线性注意力只能学习平均谱滤波器，无法适应图谱在训练分布中的变化，限制了去噪性能。
Method: 提出谱注意力（Spectral Attention）理论，并导出其实用且置换等变的实现——图卷积注意力（GCA），通过图滤波的查询和键进行谱去噪；同时利用softmax对噪声特征向量的近似投影提供额外去噪。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，GCA一致改进了图去噪和扩散性能，增益与谱多样性强相关；在DiGress框架中，GCA无需昂贵结构特征即可匹配标准图Transformer性能，结合PEARL位置编码可避免显式特征分解，加速推理而不降低质量。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了线性注意力在图去噪中的局限性，并通过频谱注意力框架提供了更优的替代方案，理论分析和实验验证了方法的有效性。

papers.title: Rethinking Indic AI from a Lens of Cultural Heritage Preservation
papers.abstract_en: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) makes inroads into different parts of the Indian subcontinent, there is significant interest in studying how AI impacts the linguistic and cultural foundations of this civilization. AI is seen as a ''double-edged sword'' where on the one hand, it can enable access and inclusion for a large population, on the other, it can homogenize worldviews and exclude underrepresented languages and worldviews. In this paper, we try to characterize this problem by addressing the extensive characteristic nature of Indian linguistics and the way they closely connect to cultural practices and worldview. We then perform a longitudinal survey of how Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques have evolved in this space, tracing the historical development of Indic NLP, covering key milestones, methodological shifts, and resource creation efforts. In addition, the paper also examines the structural and sociolinguistic characteristics of Indian languages, such as rich morphology, complex scripts and grammar rules, diglossia, and large dialectal variation, and explains how these create unique challenges for building AI foundation models. We then discuss the growing role of Indic foundation models and analyze how these models address these long-standing resource and representation gaps. Finally, we propose a research direction called 'Culture Sensing', which re-imagines AI based on hermeneutic reasoning. Culture Sensing aims to address open problems such as ensuring equitable performance across low-resource languages and producing outputs that are culturally meaningful. By bringing together past work, current techniques, and emerging trends, this paper outlines research directions that can guide the next phase of Indic NLP and contribute to the development of more robust and inclusive Indic foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从文化遗产保护的角度审视印度人工智能，特别是自然语言处理在印度语言中的应用。论文回顾了Indic NLP的历史发展，分析了印度语言的结构和社会语言学特征带来的独特挑战，讨论了当前Indic基础模型的作用，并提出了基于解释推理的“文化感知”研究方向，旨在确保低资源语言的公平性能和输出文化意义。
Motivation: 随着AI在印度次大陆的渗透，人们关注AI对语言和文化基础的影响。AI可能产生同化世界观和排除代表性不足语言的风险。论文旨在通过分析印度语言的特征和NLP技术演变来表征这一问题。
Method: 首先对Indic NLP进行纵向调查，追溯历史发展，覆盖关键里程碑、方法论转变和资源创建。然后分析印度语言的结构和社会语言学特征，如丰富形态、复杂脚本和语法、双语现象和方言变异。最后提出“文化感知”研究方向，基于解释推理重新构想AI。
Result: 论文没有报告具体实验结果，而是概述了研究方向和现有技术的分析。它强调了Indic基础模型在解决资源缺口方面的作用，并提出了未来方向。
Conclusion: 通过整合过去工作、当前技术和新兴趋势，论文勾勒了指导下一阶段Indic NLP的研究方向，有助于开发更稳健和包容的Indic基础模型。

papers.title: CAIRN: Cross-Room 3D Scene Understanding with Topology-Aware Large Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D scene-grounded Large Language Models (3D-LLMs) focus on answering questions grounded in simplified single-room 3D scenes, lacking the ability to reason over real-world household environments containing multiple interconnected rooms and diverse object categories. We introduce CAIRN, a topology-aware 3D-LLM for multi-room 3D scene understanding. CAIRN aligns transformer attention with scene hierarchy, giving the model explicit awareness of object-level relations and room-level connectivity. It enriches object tokens with room-local relational context via a graph neural network, introduces learned room tokens for room-level abstraction, and applies a hierarchical attention mask with geometric bias to route information according to scene topology. CAIRN is developed on CAIRN-MR, a benchmark we introduce on HM3D for multi-room 3D scene understanding, covering grounding, captioning, and four question-answering tasks that progressively evaluate from intra-room perception to cross-room reasoning. Experiments show that CAIRN outperforms prior 3D-LLMs by a large margin across all CAIRN-MR tasks while remaining competitive on five single-room benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAIRN，一个拓扑感知的大多模态模型，用于多房间3D场景理解。它通过图神经网络编码对象间关系、引入房间标记和层次注意力掩码来对齐场景拓扑，并在新基准CAIRN-MR上大幅超越先前3D-LLM。
Motivation: 现有3D-LLM只能处理单房间简化场景，缺乏对真实多房间环境的推理能力。
Method: 提出拓扑感知的3D-LLM CAIRN：使用图神经网络丰富对象标记的房间关联上下文，引入可学习的房间标记进行房间级抽象，并应用带几何偏置的层次注意力掩码以按场景拓扑路由信息。
Result: 在CAIRN-MR所有任务（包括跨房间推理）上大幅超越先前3D-LLM，同时在五个单房间基准上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: CAIRN证明了拓扑感知对于多房间3D场景理解的有效性，且不牺牲单房间任务性能。

papers.title: GraphBU: MILP Instance Generation with Graph-Native Block Units
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) instances used for solver development are hard to obtain when models come from private or application-specific pipelines. A generator must keep the structure that solvers and learned policies rely on. Existing general generators usually choose their generation unit from a formulation template, summary statistics, local graph edits, or blocks found after recombination. These units do not explicitly record how a local part of the MILP is coupled to the rest of the instance. We propose GraphBU, a graph-native generator whose basic unit is a local subproblem plus its interface. The method promotes coupling nodes into master constraints or boundary variables and uses the resulting block units for compatibility-checked replacement. The analysis focuses on the properties needed by this construction: promotion separates interfaces, replacement can preserve feasibility under an interface-slack condition, and the graph construction is invariant to row-column permutations. On MILP instances generation, this unit keeps graph statistics close to the source family, preserves feasibility on most datasets, and improves downstream Predict-and-Search training. Genrated by GraphBU, The average graph-statistical similarity was approximately 0.934, the average feasibility was approximately 96.7%, and the average increase in the main index of downstream PS was approximately 8.0%.

papers.title: The Large Cancer Assistant (LCA): A Model-Agnostic Orchestration Framework for Scalable Clinical Decision Support in Oncology
papers.abstract_en: - Objective: Multimodal deep learning models in oncology are currently limited by monolithic designs that rigidly couple data ingestion, clinical routing, and artificial intelligence (AI) inference. To address this inflexibility, we propose the Large Cancer Assistant (LCA), a model-agnostic, post-hoc orchestration framework designed for scalable clinical decision support. - Methods: The LCA is mathematically formalized as a 7-tuple architecture grounded in the principle of Algorithmic Impermeability, ensuring the orchestration logic remains strictly independent of underlying black-box AI models. We introduce the Entry Theory, leveraging Geometric Deep Learning (GDL) to standardize multimodal patient data along distinct structural and medical axes. The system dynamically orchestrates data via a Cancer Switching Module and intentionally isolates the core AI execution from volatile hospital IT infrastructures by outputting a Standardized Intermediate Payload (SIP). - Results: A Proof of Concept (PoC) validated the orchestration logic across four technical scenarios. The framework executed a nominal flow with negligible orchestration overhead. It empirically demonstrated algorithmic impermeability by maintaining an invariant routing projection during AI model swaps, and it validated strict failure-safety by achieving a 100\% recall rate in generating targeted Supplementary Data Requests (SDR) under injected data anomalies. Multi-protocol execution capability was also successfully verified. - Conclusion: By structurally decoupling multimodal ingestion from feature inference, the LCA provides a highly adaptable and modular orchestration foundation. The SIP establishes a clear architectural boundary, natively setting the stage for downstream Electronic Medical Record (EMR) interoperability as an independent future paradigm.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables, 9 appendices, 14 references, Elsevier JBI format
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Large Cancer Assistant (LCA)，一种模型无关的后验编排框架，用于可扩展的肿瘤临床决策支持。LCA 形式化为 7 元组架构，基于算法不可渗透性原则，利用几何深度学习 (GDL) 标准化多模态患者数据，并通过癌症切换模块动态编排数据，输出标准化中间载荷 (SIP) 以隔离 AI 执行与医院 IT 基础设施。概念验证显示编排开销可忽略，AI 模型交换时路由投影不变，数据异常下补充数据请求的召回率达 100%，并验证了多协议执行能力。
Motivation: 当前肿瘤学多模态深度学习模型受限于单体设计，数据摄取、临床路由和 AI 推理刚性耦合，缺乏灵活性。本文旨在解决这一不灵活性。
Method: 将编排框架形式化为 7 元组架构，坚持算法不可渗透性原则；引入 Entry Theory，利用几何深度学习标准化多模态患者数据；设计癌症切换模块动态路由数据；通过输出标准化中间载荷 (SIP) 使核心 AI 执行与易变的医院 IT 基础设施解耦。
Result: 概念验证在四个技术场景中执行：名义流程编排开销可忽略；AI 模型替换时路由投影不变，验证算法不可渗透性；注入数据异常时生成针对性补充数据请求的召回率达成 100%，验证严格故障安全性；多协议执行能力也成功验证。
Conclusion: LCA 通过结构解耦多模态摄入与特征推理，提供高度适应性和模块化的编排基础。SIP 建立清晰架构边界，为下游电子病历 (EMR) 互操作性奠定独立后续范式的基础。

papers.title: RSF-GLLM: Bridging the Semantic Gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph QA via Recurrent Soft-Flow and Decoupled LLM Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop Question Answering over Knowledge Graphs faces a critical challenge: traditional retrieve-then-read pipelines break differentiability, preventing the retriever from learning to bridge the semantic gap where intermediate nodes lack lexical overlap with the query. To address this, we propose RSF-GLLM, a framework decoupling differentiable graph reasoning from answer generation. Our Recurrent Soft-Flow (RSF) module employs a GRU-guided query updater to propagate continuous relevance scores, utilizing a dynamic gating mechanism to traverse semantically dissimilar bridge nodes via structural cues. We introduce flow sparsity regularization to theoretically guarantee convergence from soft probabilities to discrete reasoning paths. These paths are extracted and textualized to fine-tune a Large Language Model (LLM), ensuring generation is grounded in factual topology. Experiments on WebQSP and CWQ demonstrate that RSF-GLLM achieves competitive performance with superior inference efficiency compared to LLM based computationally expensive approaches.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in ICML 2026 as a full research paper; 21 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RSF-GLLM框架，通过递归软流（Recurrent Soft-Flow）模块实现可微分图推理，并解耦生成步骤利用LLM。RSF模块采用GRU更新器传播连续相关性分数，通过动态门控机制跨越语义不相似的桥接节点，引入流稀疏正则化保证从软概率收敛到离散推理路径。提取路径并文本化后微调LLM，使生成基于事实拓扑。在WebQSP和CWQ上，该方法与基于LLM的昂贵方法相比取得竞争性能且推理效率更高。
Motivation: 传统多跳知识图谱问答的检索-读取管道不可微分，导致检索器无法学习弥合中间节点与查询之间缺乏词汇重叠的语义鸿沟。
Method: 提出RSF-GLLM框架，包含两个解耦模块：递归软流（RSF）模块使用GRU引导的查询更新器传播连续相关性分数，并通过动态门控机制利用结构线索遍历语义不相似的桥接节点；同时引入流稀疏正则化理论上保证从软概率收敛到离散推理路径。提取这些路径并文本化后微调大语言模型（LLM），确保生成基于事实拓扑。
Result: 在WebQSP和CWQ数据集上，RSF-GLLM取得了与基于LLM的计算昂贵方法相竞争的性能，并具有更优的推理效率。
Conclusion: 论文强调该框架通过解耦可微分图推理和LLM生成，有效弥合了多跳知识图谱问答中的语义鸿沟，并实现了高效推理。

papers.title: DepthWeave-KV: Token-Adaptive Cross-Layer Residual Factorization for Long-Context KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: Long-context language model inference is increasingly limited by the memory bandwidth and capacity required to store key-value caches, yet existing compression methods often apply uniform budgets across layers or tokens and degrade retrieval when lexical cues and semantic states require different preservation. We introduce DepthWeave-KV, a token-adaptive cache compression method that factorizes key and value states across neighboring transformer layers using shared low-rank channel bases while retaining lightweight token-specific residuals where attention behavior is sensitive. DepthWeave-KV combines cross-depth residual factorization with a token-conditional depth router that allocates higher reconstruction rank to instruction-bearing and retrieval-critical tokens, and uses calibration-free online error tracking from attention-output probes to adapt compression during generation without retraining the base model. A fused CUDA implementation jointly performs basis lookup, residual dequantization, and attention projection to reduce decode-time memory traffic. Across LongBench, Needle-in-a-Haystack, L-Eval, and long-form QA and summarization benchmarks, DepthWeave-KV achieves near-full-cache task quality with substantially lower memory use, improving average score and retrieval accuracy over prior compressed caches while reaching 8.3x KV memory reduction and 72.8 tokens per second at 64K context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DepthWeave-KV，一种token自适应的KV缓存压缩方法，通过跨层残差分解和token条件深度路由器，在长上下文推理中显著降低内存使用并保持任务质量。在多个基准上实现8.3倍KV内存减少和64K上下文下72.8 tokens/s。
Motivation: 长上下文语言模型推理受限于KV缓存的内存带宽和容量，现有方法通常对层或token使用统一压缩预算，导致在需要不同保留程度时检索质量下降。
Method: 结合跨深度残差分解与token条件深度路由器，为指令型和检索关键token分配更高重建秩，并使用基于注意力输出探针的无校准在线误差跟踪，在生成过程中自适应压缩。采用融合CUDA实现联合执行基查找、残差反量化和注意力投影。
Result: 在LongBench、Needle-in-a-Haystack、L-Eval等基准上，接近全缓存任务质量，平均分数和检索准确率优于先前压缩缓存，实现8.3x KV内存减少和64K上下文下72.8 tokens/s。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了token自适应跨层残差分解在长上下文KV缓存压缩中的有效性，显著降低内存占用同时保持任务质量。

papers.title: Bridging Physical Reasoning and Task Generalization via Visual Action Outcome Reasoning Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to generalize in interactive physical reasoning, particularly under unseen tasks and environments. Two key failure modes are prominent: hallucinated chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning that contradicts physical reality, and misalignment between the model's reasoning and actions. We present VAORA (Visual Action Outcome Reasoning Alignment), a novel reward design that directly addresses both issues. VAORA introduces two complementary rewards: Visual Alignment Reward, which anchors VLM reasoning to the visual context independent of the agent action itself, and Visual-Action Alignment Reward, which grounds reasoning in the visual outcome induced by the model's action. Together, these rewards suppress hallucinated CoT and reduce the gap between reasoning and behavior. To improve training stability, we further employ smooth, dense rewards by estimating success probabilities using a pre-trained in-domain expert agent. Experiments on PHYRE and Virtual Tool support our performances across novel-task and unseen-environment settings, confirming that grounded and generalizable physical intelligence can be induced through VAORA.
papers.comment: ICML'26 Workshop RLxF: Reinforcement Learning from World Feedback
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VAORA（Visual Action Outcome Reasoning Alignment）方法，通过视觉对齐奖励和视觉-动作对齐奖励来抑制视觉语言模型在交互式物理推理中的幻觉链式推理，并缩小推理与行为之间的差距。实验在PHYRE和Virtual Tool基准上验证了VAORA在新任务和未见环境下的泛化能力。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在交互式物理推理中泛化困难，主要存在两个问题：产生与物理现实矛盾的幻觉链式推理，以及模型推理与动作之间的错位。
Method: VAORA引入两种互补奖励：视觉对齐奖励（Visual Alignment Reward）将VLM推理锚定到视觉上下文，独立于智能体动作；视觉-动作对齐奖励（Visual-Action Alignment Reward）将推理基于模型动作所引发的视觉结果。同时使用预训练领域专家智能体估计成功概率以提供平滑、密集的奖励，提高训练稳定性。
Result: 在PHYRE和Virtual Tool上的实验表明，VAORA在新任务和未见环境下均取得良好性能，证实了通过该方法可以诱导出接地且可泛化的物理智能。
Conclusion: VAORA通过奖励设计解决了幻觉推理和推理-行为错位问题，为构建可泛化的物理推理智能体提供了有效途径。

papers.title: FreqDepthKV: Frequency-Guided Depth Sharing for Robust KV Cache Compression in Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Long-context LLM inference is increasingly limited by the memory and bandwidth cost of KV caches, yet aggressive compression can remove the layer-specific evidence needed for retrieval and multi-step reasoning. We introduce FreqDepthKV, an inference-time cache compression method that factorizes adjacent-layer KV states into shared low-frequency depth components and sparse high-frequency residuals. A lightweight online probe assigns attention heads to shared-depth, residual-depth, or exact cache modes according to their contribution to reconstruction-sensitive attention logits, allowing the compression policy to adapt to prompt structure without retraining. Across long-context question answering, needle retrieval, summarization, and code generation benchmarks, FreqDepthKV preserves task accuracy under substantially smaller cache budgets. With a 32k-token prefill window, FreqDepthKV reaches 58.3 Exact Match, 63.0 F1, 32.5 ROUGE-L, and 48.1 pass@1, closely matching full KV while outperforming prior compressed-cache methods. It also improves decoding throughput to 70.4 tokens/s, reduces TTFT to 2.06 seconds, and lowers peak KV memory to 6.2 GB, achieving a 3.9x effective compression ratio.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FreqDepthKV，一种推理时KV缓存压缩方法，将相邻层的KV状态分解为共享低频深度分量和稀疏高频残差。通过轻量在线探针根据注意力头对重构敏感度分配不同的缓存模式，无需重训练即可适应提示结构。在长上下文问答、检索、摘要和代码生成任务上，FreqDepthKV在较小缓存预算下保持任务准确率，达到58.3 Exact Match、63.0 F1、32.5 ROUGE-L和48.1 pass@1，解码吞吐量70.4 tokens/s，TTFT 2.06秒，峰值KV内存6.2 GB，有效压缩比3.9倍。
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理受限于KV缓存的内存和带宽成本，但激进压缩会丢失层特异性证据，影响检索和多步推理。
Method: 提出FreqDepthKV，将相邻层KV状态分解为共享低频深度分量和稀疏高频残差，通过在线探针根据注意力头对重构敏感注意力logits的贡献分配共享深度、残差深度或精确缓存模式。
Result: 在32k预填窗口下，FreqDepthKV在多个基准上匹配全KV性能，优于先前压缩缓存方法，并实现3.9倍有效压缩比。
Conclusion: FreqDepthKV通过频率引导的深度共享和自适应策略，在不重训练的情况下实现了高效的KV缓存压缩，适用于长上下文推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Point as Skeleton: Accumulated Point Cloud Enhanced Autoregressive Generation for Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) remains challenging, as existing driving simulation methods often trade off closed-loop interactivity (e.g., CARLA) and real-world visual fidelity (e.g., nuScenes). We present \textbf{\emph{Point as Skeleton}}, a generative sensor simulation framework for state-updated autoregressive driving video generation, in which an autoregressive generator synthesizes visual observations from step-wise updated ego states, actor states, scene maps, and point-cloud skeleton conditions. To support closed-loop rollout, we introduce Reset-and-Roll, which adapts rolling diffusion inference to simulation by preventing future-conditioned latent states from being committed across simulation steps. To stabilize error accumulation during step-wise autoregressive rollout, we introduce point-cloud skeletons that decouple foreground and background assets and project them into camera-view painted-point and template-depth conditions, providing appearance and geometric cues. We further implement a nuPlan-based renderer-level closed-loop generative interface for evaluating generation under ego deviations from the original log. Experiments on nuScenes and nuPlan show that \textit{Point as Skeleton} improves autoregressive generation quality during closed-loop rollout, demonstrating its potential for visually faithful closed-loop driving simulation. The code is available at https://github.com/krauwu/point-as-skeleton.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Point as Skeleton 框架，用于闭环自动驾驶仿真中的自回归驾驶视频生成。通过引入点云骨架条件解耦前后景，并设计 Reset-and-Roll 方法适应滚动扩散推理。在 nuScenes 和 nuPlan 上实验表明，该方法在闭环展开期间提升了自回归生成质量。
Motivation: 现有驾驶仿真方法难以同时保证闭环交互性和真实视觉保真度，需要一种能结合两者且支持状态更新的生成式传感器仿真框架。
Method: 提出 Point as Skeleton，使用自回归生成器根据逐步更新的自车状态、参与者状态、场景地图和点云骨架条件合成视觉观察。引入 Reset-and-Roll 将滚动扩散推理适应于仿真，防止未来条件隐状态跨步骤提交。点云骨架提供外观和几何线索，解耦前后景。
Result: 在 nuScenes 和 nuPlan 上的实验表明，该方法在闭环展开期间改进了自回归生成质量，展示了视觉逼真闭环仿真的潜力。
Conclusion: 该方法为闭环驾驶仿真提供了视觉逼真的生成手段，但仅限于仿真领域；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FootsiesGym: A Fighting Game Benchmark for Two-Player Zero-Sum Imperfect-Information Games
papers.abstract_en: We present FootsiesGym, an open-source environment for learning in a non-trivial two-player, zero-sum, imperfect-information game. Built on HiFight's minimalist 2D fighting game Footsies, it isolates the cyclic, non-transitive strategic interactions of fighting game neutral play while remaining simple enough for efficient analysis. We provide a vectorized simulator that enables high-throughput training on standard hardware, making the environment accessible and reproducible. We describe the design of the environment, benchmark several reinforcement learning algorithms, and discuss open research directions it enables. The code is available at https://github.com/como-research/FootsiesGym.
papers.comment: Accepted to the RLC 2026 Reinforcement Learning & Video Games Workshop; 14 pages, 9 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了FootsiesGym，一个基于极简2D格斗游戏Footsies的开源环境，用于研究非平凡的双人零和不完美信息博弈。该环境提供矢量化的模拟器，支持标准硬件上的高吞吐量训练，并基准测试了多种强化学习算法。代码公开可用。
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏非平凡的双人零和不完美信息博弈环境，尤其是能捕获格斗游戏中性循环战略交互的简单基准。
Method: 基于HiFight的极简2D格斗游戏Footsies，构建了矢量化的模拟器，并通过基准测试多种强化学习算法来展示其可用性。
Result: 摘要报告了多种强化学习算法在该环境上的基准性能，并提供了高吞吐量训练的实现。
Conclusion: 该环境为研究非平凡双人零和不完美信息游戏中的战略交互和强化学习算法提供了可复现且高效的平台。

papers.title: Industry Classification of GitHub Repositories Using the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS)
papers.abstract_en: GitHub hosts hundreds of millions of public repositories, but the platform exposes no native mapping from repositories to standardized industry sectors. This gap limits empirical work on the geography of innovation, the industrial composition of open-source production, and the diffusion of new technologies across economic sectors. We present NAICS-GH, a publicly released corpus of 6,588 GitHub repositories drawn from source pools covering the United States, the European Union, and Australia, each labeled with a 2-digit sector from the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS 2022). Labels are produced by a retrieve-and-verify pipeline that combines BAAI/bge-large-en embeddings, FAISS retrieval, and GPT-4.1 rubric scoring. The pipeline narrows about 1.37 million source repositories to 31,178 candidate repository-sector pairs and retains 6,588 high-confidence labels with score at least 8. Re-running the retrieval pipeline end to end reproduces the candidate set to within 0.03 percent. On a 2,421-repository human-validated random sample, the released labels attain 96.98 percent precision, with Wilson 95 percent confidence interval [96.23, 97.59]. We benchmark six pretrained encoders on the released corpus; RoBERTa-large reaches 86.45 percent F1 and 86.35 percent accuracy on a held-out 20 percent test set. The dataset, Croissant metadata, pipeline code, prompts, and fine-tuned checkpoint are released under CC-BY-4.0 and MIT licenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建并发布了一个名为NAICS-GH的数据集，包含6,588个GitHub仓库，每个仓库标注了北美国际行业分类系统(NAICS 2022)的2位数行业代码。数据集通过结合BAAI/bge-large-en嵌入、FAISS检索和GPT-4.1评分流水线从约137万个仓库中筛选得到，在人工验证样本上达到96.98%的精确度。同时基准测试了六种预训练编码器，RoBERTa-large在测试集上达到86.45%的F1分数。
Motivation: GitHub上数亿公共仓库缺乏与标准化行业分类的映射，限制了关于创新地理、开源生产的产业构成以及新技术在经济部门间扩散的实证研究。
Method: 提出一个检索-验证流水线：使用BAAI/bge-large-en嵌入和FAISS进行候选检索，再由GPT-4.1根据评分准则对候选仓库-行业对打分，最终保留得分≥8的高置信度标签。
Result: 从约137万仓库中筛选出31,178个候选对，最终保留6,588个高置信度标签；候选集重建误差仅为0.03%；在2,421个仓库的人工验证样本上，标签精确率为96.98%（Wilson 95%置信区间[96.23, 97.59]）。RoBERTa-large在20%测试集上达到86.45% F1和86.35%准确率。
Conclusion: 数据集及其构建流程已开源，为后续研究提供了标准化的行业分类资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RMISC: A Large-scale Real-world Multivariate Corpus for Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed the emergence of multivariate modeling using time series foundation models (TSFMs), which achieve advanced zero-shot generalization. Modern multivariate TSFMs are predominantly pretrained on multivariate synthetic data, which is easier to scale but may fail to capture the complex temporal dynamics and cross-variable relationships present in real-world time series. This raises a key question: Whether and to what extent the leading TSFMs trained with the real-world corpus perform better than those trained with synthetic data? To answer this, we establish the RMISC corpus, a considerably large-scale, high-quality, openly accessible, real-world, and multivariate time series archive that contains around 200 datasets and 142 billion time points across diverse domains. Furthermore, we pretrain four advanced TSFMs on univariate, synthetic multivariate, and real-world multivariate data and evaluate their zero-shot generalization capabilities on standard in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks. Experimental results show that incorporating real-world multivariate data predominantly improves the generalization performance for both univariate and multivariate TSFMs. These results provide a deeper understanding of how real-world multivariate data contributes to the development of stronger TSFMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了RMISC，一个大规模、高质量、真实世界的多元时间序列语料库，包含约200个数据集和1420亿个时间点，覆盖多个领域。通过在单变量、合成多变量和真实多变量数据上预训练四个先进的时间序列基础模型（TSFM），并评估其零样本泛化能力，实验表明真实多变量数据能显著提升TSFM的泛化性能。
Motivation: 当前多元时间序列基础模型主要通过合成多变量数据预训练，但合成数据可能无法捕捉真实时间序列中复杂的时序动态和跨变量关系。本文旨在探究真实世界多变量语料库相比合成数据是否能带来更好的零样本泛化能力。
Method: 建立RMISC真实世界多变量时间序列语料库，并在四种先进TSFM架构上分别使用单变量数据、合成多变量数据和真实多变量数据进行预训练，然后在分布内和分布外基准上评估零样本泛化性能。
Result: 实验结果表明，引入真实多变量数据显著改进了单变量和多变量TSFM的泛化性能。
Conclusion: 真实世界多变量数据是提升时间序列基础模型泛化能力的关键资源，为开发更强大的TSFM提供了依据。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Doomed from the Start: Early Abort of LLM Agent Episodes via a Recall-Controlled Probe Cascade
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents solving multi-step tasks frequently commit to trajectories that are doomed to fail, yet continue to consume substantial inference compute before the failure becomes observable. We show that failure is predictable early from the agent's internal representations: lightweight per-round probes on hidden activations anticipate eventual episode failure as early as the first interaction round, where scorers reading only the agent's observable behavior are barely better than chance. We turn this signal into a practical abort cascade: one distribution-free calibrated gate per round, with per-round recall budgets jointly searched so that eventually-successful episodes survive all gates at a user-specified global rate; this episode-level guarantee is the one that matters in deployment, since false-abort risk accumulates across gates. Across two agent models on TextCraft, the cascade meets every recall target from 90% to 97% and, at the 90% target, saves 47.1% +/- 10.3% (Qwen-2.5-7B) and 37.2% +/- 8.8% (Llama-3.2-3B) of inference compute, 1.6--1.7x the best single-gate policy. An otherwise-identical cascade reading only behavior saves roughly half as much, and adding behavioral features to the probe yields no further gain: the hidden states capture what behavior reveals. Finally, we characterize the sample complexity of certifying high recall targets, telling practitioners which recall promises their data can, and provably cannot, back. The code will be released soon.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Code will be released soon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种级联式探针（probe cascade）方法，通过 LLM agent 每轮内部隐藏状态预测任务是否注定失败，并在早期中止无效回合以节省推理计算。在 TextCraft 环境中，该方法在 90% 召回率下为 Qwen-2.5-7B 和 Llama-3.2-3B 分别节省 47.1% 和 37.2% 的计算量，且优于仅使用行为特征的策略。
Motivation: LLM agent 在多步任务中常继续执行注定失败的轨迹，消耗大量推理计算资源，但失败信号往往在后期才可见。
Method: 设计一个每轮分布无关的校准门（calibrated gate）构成的级联，联合搜索每轮召回预算，使得最终成功的 episode 以用户指定的全局比率通过所有门，从而在早期中止失败 episode。
Result: 在 TextCraft 上，级联在 90%-97% 召回目标下均达标；90% 目标时，Qwen-2.5-7B 节省 47.1%±10.3%，Llama-3.2-3B 节省 37.2%±8.8%，是单门策略的 1.6-1.7 倍。仅使用行为特征的级联节省约一半，且添加行为特征到探针无增益。
Conclusion: 从 agent 内部表示中预测失败是可行的，级联方法提供可证伪的召回保证，并揭示了需要多少数据才能支持高召回承诺。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EntroPath: Maximum Entropy Path Ensemble Embedding for Manifold Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce EntroPath, a manifold learning method that recovers geodesic geometry from data graphs through ensembles of diffusion paths. Many existing graph-based embeddings rely either on locally normalised random walks or on shortest-path distances. The former can concentrate diffusion in densely sampled regions, while the latter are sensitive to spurious shortcut edges in the graph. EntroPath instead builds its dissimilarities from the maximum entropy random walk (MERW), which aggregates the full ensemble of k-step paths between points rather than relying on any single trajectory. We show that the resulting free-energy dissimilarity converges to squared geodesic distance in the short-time limit, via Varadhan's heat-kernel formula. The diffusion depth k interpolates smoothly between local neighbourhood structure and global manifold geometry, and the symmetrised kernel admits an exact Gram factorisation connecting EntroPath to kernel methods. We further provide scalable extensions via landmark projection and diffusion-potential pseudotime. Across synthetic manifolds and single-cell benchmarks, EntroPath consistently matches or outperforms diffusion- and shortest-path-based methods, while remaining competitive with neighbourhood-preserving embeddings (UMAP, t-SNE) on local-structure metrics. Its gains are most pronounced on manifolds with non-uniform sampling density and well-separated branching trajectories, where path-ensemble diffusion more faithfully preserves the underlying geodesic geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EntroPath 是一种流形学习方法，通过最大熵随机游走 (MERW) 的路径集合来估计数据图中的测地线距离，避免了局部归一化随机游走或最短路径的缺陷。摘要表明该方法在短时间极限下可通过 Varadhan 热核公式收敛到平方测地距离，并在合成流形和单细胞基准上匹配或优于扩散映射和最短路径方法，尤其对非均匀采样和分支轨迹更鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有基于图的嵌入方法（如扩散映射使用局部归一化随机游走，Isomap使用最短路径）分别存在密度集中和捷径边敏感的问题，难以忠实恢复非均匀采样流形上的测地线几何。
Method: EntroPath 基于最大熵随机游走 (MERW) 构建点间所有 k 步路径的集合，利用自由能差异作为相异性度量；通过扩散深度 k 插值局部与全局结构，并利用对称化核的 Gram 分解建立与核方法的联系。
Result: 摘要报告在合成流形和单细胞基准上，EntroPath 在全局结构指标上匹配或优于扩散映射和最短路径方法，在局部结构指标上与 UMAP、t-SNE 竞争，并在非均匀采样密度和分支轨迹场景中表现更优。
Conclusion: EntroPath 通过路径集合扩散更忠实地保持潜在测地线几何，适用于密度不均匀和分支结构的数据。

papers.title: Pitwall: Faithful Natural-Language Race-Strategy Briefings from a Calibrated Real-Time Monte Carlo Engine
papers.abstract_en: Live sports commentary is grounded generation under a deadline: statements concern real, named athletes, the grounding state changes every few seconds, and no reference text exists at generation time. We present Pitwall, a production system that generates natural-language Formula 1 strategy briefings in English, Spanish, and Portuguese, treating faithfulness as an architectural property rather than an aspiration: every published sentence is decomposed into typed factual claims (positions, gaps, tyres, pace, overtakes, race control) and each claim is verified against the probabilistic race state that prompted it. The same verifier gates the fine-tuning data: of 3,045 model-written targets, only the 81.9% whose every claim is state-supported are retained, the rest falling back to a provably faithful template, so the generator never sees an ungrounded target. Verification is meaningful because of the grounding substrate: a vectorized Monte Carlo engine (N=2,000 per-lap race continuations) calibrated on 126 races (2018-2024) and validated on fully held-out 2025-2026 seasons (winner-in-top-3 90.3% over 155 backtests; held-out Brier 0.0745). A recurring finding spans both halves of the system: virtues trade off and must be gated separately. In simulation, calibration-optimal is not decision-optimal; in generation, fine-tuning on richer targets buys vividness that collapses into hallucination when the grounding state is sparse -- a failure a four-base replication traces to base-model instruction adherence, not scale, and that sparse-context auditing removes from the production model. End-to-end operation -- live timing to verified trilingual briefings -- was confirmed at two consecutive live Grands Prix (Austria and Britain, 2026); at Silverstone a timestamped probability trace, committed to disk before the outcome was known, locked onto the eventual winner ten laps before the flag.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Live-deployment results from the 2026 Austrian and British Grands Prix. URL: https://pitwall.jsantillana.com
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Pitwall，一个生产级系统，用于在实时F1赛事中生成多语言（英、西、葡）自然语言策略简报。系统将每句简报分解为类型化事实声明（如位置、差距、轮胎、速度、超车、赛事控制），并通过概率赛车状态验证每项声明。验证器同时用于筛选微调数据，仅保留81.9%的语句（其所有声明均被状态支持），其余回退到可验证的模板。底层蒙特卡洛引擎（每圈2000次模拟）基于126场比赛（2018-2024）校准，并在完全留出的2025-2026赛季中验证（在155次回溯测试中，前三名准确率90.3%，留出Brier分数0.0745）。系统在2026年奥地利和英国大奖赛中进行了端到端实时部署。
Motivation: 体育赛事直播需要基于实时变化的状态生成忠实于事实的评论，但缺乏参考文本，现有方法难以保证事实正确性。
Method: 构建两阶段系统：1）向量化蒙特卡洛引擎（每圈2000次模拟）提供校准的概率赛车状态；2）自然语言生成器通过回溯模板生成声明，并由状态验证器过滤微调数据（仅保留所有声明均受支持的81.9%目标），确保每个句子可验证。
Result: 蒙特卡洛引擎在155次回溯测试中前三名准确率90.3%，留出Brier分数0.0745。生成器通过稀疏上下文审计避免幻觉，端到端系统在2026年两场大奖赛中成功运行，在银石赛道，系统在比赛结束前10圈即锁定最终获胜者。
Conclusion: 系统的核心设计理念是将忠实性作为架构属性，而非事后追求；通过分离验证与生成、使用校准概率状态作为支撑，实现了可验证的实时体育评论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Multi Objective Battery Management in Dairy Farms
papers.abstract_en: The dairy industry in Ireland has a large potential for the integration of renewable energy and the reduction of carbon emissions. However, researchers of distributed generation control are mainly focused on residential and commercial applications. To contribute to the effective integration of renewable energy in the dairy sector, this paper presents a multi-objective optimisation control system based on differential evolution and multi agent Deep Reinforcement Learning. The proposed control is organised in two layers: the upper layer uses dynamic pricing, and the lower layer is based on multi-agent reinforcement learning for battery management. This paper also simulates the electrical response of the proposed control system in a rural distribution circuit. The simulation results show that the proposed control framework can improve profits from energy arbitrage up to 18% compared to using Rule-based models, increase the use of distributed generation without significantly increasing cost, and comply with the Irish grid code in terms of voltage variation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对乳制品农场电池管理问题，提出一种基于差分进化和多智能体深度强化学习的两层多目标优化控制系统：上层使用动态定价策略，下层利用多智能体强化学习进行电池充放电调度。在农村配电电路仿真中，该系统在能源套利利润上相比规则模型提升最高达18%，同时增加了分布式发电利用率，显著降低了成本，并满足爱尔兰电网电压规范要求。
Motivation: 现有分布式发电控制研究主要集中于住宅和商业场景，缺乏针对乳制品行业的具体方案，而该行业具有整合可再生能源和减少碳排放的巨大潜力，因此需要专门的控制方法。
Method: 提出两层控制框架：上层采用差分进化算法优化动态定价，下层基于多智能体深度强化学习（Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning）管理电池充放电，实现多目标优化。
Result: 仿真结果表明，与基于规则的模型相比，能源套利利润可提升18%；分布式发电利用率增加且成本未显著上升；电压波动满足爱尔兰电网规范（Irish grid code）。
Conclusion: 该控制框架能有效将可再生能源集成至乳制品行业，在兼顾经济效益与电网合规性方面具有优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AirflowAttack: Thermal-Airflow Adversarial Perturbations against Infrared Remote-Sensing Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed on infrared (IR) remote sensing imagery in security-critical settings, yet their adversarial robustness remains unexamined. We present AirflowAttack, to our knowledge the first adversarial attack for IR remote-sensing VLMs and the first to weaponize thermal-airflow turbulence as the perturbation prior. A lightweight generator synthesizes a single input-agnostic perturbation regularized toward physically plausible airflow patterns. Optimized on one surrogate CLIP model, it attains a mean zero-shot scene-classification attack success rate (ASR, the fraction of samples whose top-1 class changes) of 48.5% across five diverse CLIP backbones, far exceeding four IR-specific physical baselines (27.7--37.0%). Applied to six state-of-the-art VLMs, it cuts scene-classification accuracy by up to 38.2% relative, yet paradoxically makes some models more confident in their IR analysis, confabulating the perturbation as genuine thermal evidence such as temperature gradients and convection. Ablations show the airflow prior raises physical plausibility at no measurable cost to attack success. Together with a benchmark spanning eleven models and four tasks, these findings expose critical vulnerabilities in the rapidly expanding IR VLM ecosystem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出AirflowAttack，首次针对红外遥感视觉语言模型(VLM)的对抗攻击，利用热气流湍流先验生成与输入无关的扰动。在多个CLIP骨干和六个VLM上实现高攻击成功率，并发现模型会将扰动误判为真实热证据。
Motivation: 红外遥感VLM在安全关键场景中部署增多，但其对抗鲁棒性尚未被研究。
Method: 提出一个轻量生成器，合成单一输入无关的扰动，并通过物理合理的流动模式正则化。在代理CLIP模型上优化，生成扰动用物理先验引导。
Result: 在五个不同CLIP骨干上平均零样本场景分类攻击成功率48.5%，超越四个红外物理基线；在六个VLM上相对精度降低高达38.2%，同时模型对红外分析更自信，将扰动误认为热证据。
Conclusion: 揭示了红外VLM生态系统中的关键脆弱性，现有模型无法区分真实热信号和对抗扰动。

papers.title: Assessing the Operational Impact of Poisoning Attacks over Augmented 3D Point Cloud Public Datasets for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: Poisoning attacks against public datasets lead to major concerns, such as (i) misclassification of perceived objects when the poisoned data is used for training and (ii) embedding of backdoors that may eventually be triggered later on, when specific conditions in the system apply over the learned models. Its impact over data augmentation models is unclear. While data augmentation reduces the likelihood of poisoning attack success, some valid questions remain. Is data augmentation affecting the impact of poisoning attacks? can it increase the number of poisoned samples or injected backdoors? We explore in this paper some of these questions. We assess the effects of augmenting poisoned 3D point cloud datasets and validate that poisoning is able to evade the sanitizing nature of augmentation techniques when using the concrete case of Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) techniques to exemplify the case of data augmentation processing. We also validate that poisoning propagates over the augmented datasets and perturbs the decision made by general-purpose classifiers, in the end. All the experimental material (including tools, datasets, and classifiers) is publicly available, to facilitate reproducibility and to foster further research in the topic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究毒化攻击（poisoning attacks）对增强后的3D点云数据集的真实影响，以自动驾驶公共数据集为例。通过使用GAN进行数据增强实验，发现毒化攻击能够规避数据增强的净化效果，并成功在增强数据集中传播，最终干扰通用分类器的决策。实验材料和工具均已公开。
Motivation: 现有研究对毒化攻击在数据增强模型上的影响尚不明确，需要验证数据增强是否影响毒化攻击的传播及其是否可能增加中毒样本或后门嵌入。
Method: 采用生成对抗网络（GAN）作为数据增强处理的具体案例，对中毒的3D点云数据集进行增强，并评估毒化攻击在增强数据中的传播及其对通用分类器决策的干扰。
Result: 实验验证毒化攻击能够逃避数据增强技术的净化作用，并在增强数据集中持续传播，最终导致分类器误分类。
Conclusion: 毒化攻击对增强后的3D点云数据集构成实际威胁，数据增强无法消除中毒影响，需进一步研究防御机制。

papers.title: Mitigating Domain Shift in Conditioned Floor Plan Generation: Synthetic Pre-training for Data-Efficient Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Robustness to domain shift is a key requirement for floor plan generative models to be applicable beyond the single dataset they were trained on, as floor plans vary widely across regions due to distinct architectural cultures, spatial constraints, and construction practices, while acquiring new annotated datasets remains costly and domain-specific. Yet, no prior work has studied this robustness in the context of conditioned floor plan generation. In this paper, we evaluate state-of-the-art models from two fundamentally different generative paradigms across three public datasets (RPLAN, MagicPlan and Swiss Dwellings) and show that they are highly sensitive to domain shift, with up to an order of magnitude performance degradation when transferred across domains. To mitigate this with minimal target-domain supervision, we introduce a procedural method to generate a large-scale synthetic training dataset that enforces strict physical constraints (non-overlapping rooms, valid door placement, graph consistency) while intentionally sacrificing architectural realism through highly irregular spatial arrangements and aggressive geometric perturbation of room shapes. We show that pre-training on this synthetic data considerably improves zero-shot cross-domain performance, outperforming in-domain training on MagicPlan. Furthermore, it provides a highly effective initialization for fine-tuning, accelerating target domain adaptation and outperforming real-world initialization baselines by up to 40% in a low-data regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了条件楼层平面生成模型在跨数据集领域的鲁棒性，发现现有模型对领域漂移高度敏感，性能下降可达一个数量级。为此，提出了一种过程化生成大规模合成训练数据集的方法，通过强制严格物理约束但牺牲建筑真实性，在合成数据上预训练能显著提升零样本跨领域性能，并作为微调初始化在低数据场景下比真实数据初始化提升高达40%。
Motivation: 楼层平面图在不同地区差异大，获取新标注数据集成本高且领域特定，但尚无工作研究条件楼层平面生成模型对领域漂移的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出过程化生成大规模合成训练数据集的方法，强制执行非重叠房间、有效门放置、图一致性等物理约束，但通过高度不规则的空间排列和对房间形状的激进几何扰动有意牺牲建筑真实性。

Conclusion: 合成预训练能有效缓解条件楼层平面生成中的领域漂移问题，在低标注数据场景下实现高效适应。

papers.title: Data Analysis in the Wild: Benchmarking Large Language Models Against Real-World Data Complexities
papers.abstract_en: Current benchmarks for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) in data analysis often fail to reflect real-world settings. They typically focus on fact retrieval from small tables and overlook the challenges of large multi-tabular datasets, external knowledge integration, and exploratory insight discovery. We introduce DataGovBench, a benchmark derived from governmental open data designed to evaluate LLMs in practical scenarios. The benchmark includes two tasks: Table QA that requires solving complex decomposable questions and producing textual answers or visualizations, and Table Insight that evaluates the ability of models to generate expert-level findings through exploratory data analysis. Comprehensive experiments with state-of-the-art LLMs, both with and without agentic frameworks, reveal significant performance gaps across both tasks. These results suggest that current LLM-based systems remain far from satisfying the demands of real-world data analytics. DataGovBench provides a challenging benchmark for advancing research on LLMs capable of both answering analytical queries and discovering insights from data. Code and sample data are available at https://github.com/SoHasegawa/datagovbench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有LLM数据分析基准无法反映真实场景的问题，提出了DataGovBench基准，包含表格问答和表格洞察两个任务，并使用政府开放数据。实验表明当前LLM在复杂多表数据、外部知识整合和探索性洞察方面存在显著性能差距。
Motivation: 当前LLM数据分析基准过于简单，主要关注小表格的事实检索，忽略了真实世界中的大表格、多表关联、外部知识整合和探索性洞察发现。
Method: 基于政府开放数据构建DataGovBench，设计Table QA（解决复杂可分解问题并输出文本或可视化）和Table Insight（探索性数据分析生成专家级发现）两个任务，对多种LLM（含/不含智能体框架）进行评测。
Result: 实验显示，无论是否使用智能体框架，最先进的LLM在两个任务上均存在较大性能差距，说明当前LLM系统远未满足真实数据分析需求。
Conclusion: DataGovBench为推进能同时回答分析查询和从数据中发现洞察的LLM研究提供了具有挑战性的基准。

papers.title: Prompt-Adapter Context Routing for Parameter-Efficient Multi-Shot Long Video Extrapolation
papers.abstract_en: We present PACR-Video, a parameter-efficient framework for multi-shot long video extrapolation that preserves recurring entities, scene structure, visual style, and causal progression without full generator fine-tuning. PACR-Video keeps a text-to-video diffusion transformer frozen and augments it with low-rank temporal adapters conditioned by learned shot-role prompt tokens. To maintain long-horizon coherence, it builds a recursive prompt bank that stores compact entity, location, action, and style prompts from previous shots, then routes them through adapter gates according to predicted narrative dependencies. A Shot-Local/Story-Global tuning objective combines next-shot reconstruction, cross-shot identity contrast, and prompt sparsity regularization, while an adapter composition schedule balances early-shot visual consistency with later-shot event progression and viewpoint change. Across six multi-shot and long-video benchmarks, PACR-Video outperforms text-to-video, tuning-based, memory-augmented, streaming, and recursive-context baselines on distributional quality, semantic alignment, identity consistency, temporal smoothness, motion stability, transition coherence, and human preference. These results show that compact prompt routing and lightweight temporal adaptation provide sufficient controllable capacity for stable long video extrapolation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PACR-Video，一种参数高效的多镜头长视频外推框架，通过冻结文本到视频扩散Transformer并添加低秩时间适配器和提示路由机制，在多个基准上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 长视频外推中保持实体、场景结构和因果连贯性需要大量参数调优，现有方法效率低且难以扩展。
Method: 冻结视频扩散Transformer，使用低秩时间适配器（low-rank temporal adapters）并引入分镜头提示标记（shot-role prompt tokens）进行条件控制；构建递归提示库存储历史镜头信息，通过适配器门控路由；采用镜头局部/故事全局联合优化目标。
Result: 在六个多镜头和长视频基准上，PACR-Video在分布质量、语义对齐、身份一致性、时间平滑性、运动稳定性、过渡连贯性和人类偏好方面优于文本到视频、基于调优、记忆增强、流式及递归上下文基线。
Conclusion: 紧凑的提示路由和轻量时间适配提供了足够可控的容量用于稳定的长视频外推。

papers.title: A Physics-Informed Neural Network Framework for Elastodynamic Wave Propagation in Bimaterial Systems
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a promising framework for solving partial differential equations while embedding the underlying physical laws directly into the learning process. This study presents a PINN-based framework for modeling transient elastodynamic wave propagation in bimaterial systems governed by the axisymmetric equations of linear elasticity. A steel-aluminum specimen representative of a Split Hopkinson Pressure Bar configuration is considered, and the governing elastodynamic equations, together with the corresponding initial, boundary, and interface conditions, are incorporated directly into the network through a physics-informed loss function. High-fidelity finite-element simulations performed using ANSYS Workbench Explicit Dynamics are used for validation and as supplementary data constraints during training. The proposed framework accurately predicts wave transmission and reflection across the bimaterial interface and reproduces axial and radial displacement histories, face-averaged responses, and the dominant stress and strain evolution with close agreement to the finite-element solutions. The trained network further demonstrates the ability to predict wave responses at previously unseen time instants and for modified material properties without requiring additional finite-element simulations, providing a continuous surrogate model for elastodynamic analysis. Mesh-sensitivity studies confirm numerical robustness, while additional material combinations demonstrate the generality of the proposed methodology. The results show that integrating physics-informed neural networks with explicit finite-element analysis provides an accurate and computationally efficient framework for elastodynamic wave propagation in heterogeneous solids, offering an effective surrogate modeling approach for high-rate solid mechanics and impact engineering applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的框架，用于模拟双材料系统中的瞬态弹性动力波传播。该框架将轴对称线弹性方程及初始、边界、界面条件嵌入网络损失函数，并以高保真有限元模拟结果作为验证和辅助数据约束。在钢-铝试样（类似霍普金森杆配置）上，PINN准确预测了波在界面的透射和反射，以及位移、应力和应变演化，且训练后的网络能在未见时间点和修改材料属性下预测波响应，无需额外有限元模拟。网格敏感性研究和多种材料组合验证了方法的鲁棒性和普适性。
Motivation: 传统有限元方法在高应变率固体力学中计算昂贵，需要一种计算高效且准确的替代模型来处理异质固体中的弹性波传播问题。
Method: 构建一个全连接神经网络，将轴对称线弹性方程、初始条件、边界条件和界面条件作为物理约束加入损失函数，同时利用有限元模拟数据作为监督信号进行混合训练。
Result: PINN预测的波传播结果与ANSYS Workbench Explicit Dynamics有限元解高度吻合，能准确再现轴向和径向位移历史、面平均响应以及主应力和应变演化。训练后模型可在新时间点和修改材料参数下进行推断，无需重新运行有限元模拟。
Conclusion: 将PINN与显式有限元分析结合提供了准确且计算高效的弹性波传播代理模型，适用于高应变率固体力学和冲击工程应用，且泛化能力良好。

papers.title: A VLM-Enhanced Framework for Comprehensive Traffic Sign Condition Assessment Integrating Daytime Visual Performance and Nighttime Retroreflectivity Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Traffic signs are crucial components of road safety, serving as visual tools under all lighting conditions. The Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD) specifies daytime visual factors such as legibility and color contrast, and nighttime retroreflectivity requirements. Traditional assessment methods rely on manual inspections, which the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) notes are subjective, labor-intensive and pose safety concerns, while retroreflectometers are expensive and unaffordable for smaller agencies. Most existing studies focus on either daytime factors or nighttime retroreflectivity but rarely integrate both aspects comprehensively. This study develops a novel framework that systematically evaluates traffic signs through integrated daytime-nighttime assessment. The methodology employs three fine-tuned Vision Language Models (VLMs) for daytime visual performance assessment across four key factors: legibility, color, surface and shape integrity, and surrounding environment conditions. VLM predictions are converted to numerical scores through sentiment analysis and Contrastive Language-Image Pre-Training (CLIP) scoring, while nighttime performance is assessed using LiDAR-derived retroreflectivity following established calibration procedures. The framework integrates these components into a comprehensive Sign Condition Index (SCI) for maintenance guidance. Evaluation results demonstrated that LLaVA and Qwen outperformed InternVL, achieving bidirectional cosine similarity scores of 0.67-0.76 across all factors. Among 462 validated traffic signs, 68 were flagged by the proposed framework as requiring immediate replacement due to inadequate retroreflectivity performance. This research provides a cost-effective alternative to traditional manual inspections for comprehensive traffic sign condition assessment.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Preprint. An earlier version of this work was presented at the 105th Annual Meeting of the Transportation Research Board (TRB), January 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个集成白天视觉表现和夜间反光性能的交通标志状况评估框架，使用三个微调的视觉语言模型（VLM）进行白天评估，利用LiDAR衍生的反光率评估夜间性能，最终整合为交通标志状况指数（SCI）。实验表明LLaVA和Qwen表现较好，在462个标志中识别出68个需要立即更换。
Motivation: 传统交通标志评估依赖人工检查，主观且危险；反光仪昂贵，小机构负担不起。现有研究大多只关注白天或夜间某一方面，缺乏综合评估。
Method: 使用三个微调VLM（LLaVA、Qwen、InternVL）评估白天四个因素（可读性、颜色、表面和形状完整性、周围环境），通过情感分析和CLIP评分将VLM预测转换为数值分数；夜间反光性能使用LiDAR数据经校准流程评估；两者整合为SCI。
Result: LLaVA和Qwen在双向余弦相似度上达到0.67-0.76，优于InternVL；在462个标志中，框架识别出68个因反光性能不足需立即更换。
Conclusion: 该框架为交通标志综合评估提供了经济有效的替代方案，可减少对人工检查的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Provable learning separation for predicting time-evolution of quantum many-body systems
papers.abstract_en: Given that quantum computers are naturally suited to simulate the behavior of quantum many-body systems, an immediate question arises: can one formulate physically motivated quantum machine learning (QML) tasks that exhibit learning separations? We address this problem by studying the learnability of quantum many-body dynamics from the perspective of probably approximately correct (PAC)-learning. Concretely, we devise a supervised learning problem where the training set consists of specifications of randomized stabilizer probe states, evolution times sampled uniformly from a polynomially large time interval $[0,T]$, coupled with expectation values of certain observables evaluated on the resulting time-evolved state under an unknown Hamiltonian. For this learning task, we provide an efficient quantum procedure whose training phase learns the underlying Hamiltonian from short-time training samples, and whose deployment phase combines Hamiltonian simulation with the classical shadows protocol to perform inference on a newly given data point. By contrast, the existence of $O(\mathsf{poly}(n))$-time instances ensures classical hardness: by embedding a $\mathsf{BQP}$-complete computation into the polynomially long time-dynamics of a low-intersection variant of the Feynman-Kitaev clock Hamiltonian construction, we show that, for a certain family of input distributions, no randomized classical polynomial-time algorithm can fulfill our learning condition, unless $\mathsf{BQP}\subseteq\mathsf{P/poly}$. Furthermore, we show that the classically hard instance maintains quantum learnability. We also give an interpretation of our results in learning-assisted certified quantum simulation. Taken together, our results demonstrate a rigorous learning separation for a natural ML task based on Hamiltonian evolution, while building connections between quantum learning theory, quantum simulation, and QML.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究量子多体系统时间演化的可学习性，从PAC学习角度证明量子机器学习（QML）任务存在学习分离。作者构建了一个监督学习问题：训练集包含随机稳定子探针态、从[0,T]均匀采样的演化时间以及未知哈密顿量下时间演化态上特定观测量的期望值。量子程序能高效学习哈密顿量并推理，而经典算法在多项式时间内无法满足学习条件，除非BQP⊆P/poly，从而展示了自然ML任务上的严格学习分离。
Motivation: 量子计算机天然适合模拟量子多体系统，但能否构造出具有物理动机且存在学习分离的量子机器学习任务尚不清楚。本文旨在回答这一问题。
Method: 提出一个监督学习框架，训练集由随机稳定子探针态、均匀采样演化时间及观测值构成。量子程序在训练阶段从短时样本中学习哈密顿量，部署阶段结合哈密顿模拟与经典阴影协议进行推理。经典困难性通过将BQP完备计算嵌入Feynman-Kitaev钟哈密顿量的长时间动力学来证明。
Result: 证明了对于特定输入分布族，不存在随机经典多项式时间算法能完成该学习任务（除非BQP⊆P/poly），而量子算法保持可学习性，从而建立了严格的学习分离。
Conclusion: 结果展示了基于哈密顿演化的自然机器学习任务的学习分离，搭建了量子学习理论、量子模拟与QML之间的桥梁，并在学习辅助的认证量子模拟中有潜在解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EgoPolice: A Benchmark for Egocentric Video Understanding in High-Stakes Police Body-Worn Camera Footage
papers.abstract_en: We introduce EgoPolice, a carefully curated dataset of real, egocentric police-civilian interactions, sourced from publicly available body-worn camera videos. We select police-civilian action labels that are critical for police behavioral research and annotate them at a second-by-second granularity. The videos feature rapid and irregular camera motion, dense human interactions, and rare high-stakes events, making the dataset a challenging benchmark for motion-robust and context-aware egocentric perception. We provide two different tasks, classification and multiple-choice question-answering, and benchmark both open-source and closed-source models. We find that even the best video models like Gemini 2.5 Pro still struggle to accurately predict high-risk actions such as "Weapon Out". Beyond serving as a benchmark, EgoPolice provides a foundation for developing models capable of identifying events of interest in large-scale body-worn camera video repositories, enabling more efficient downstream human review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoPolice，一个来自真实执法记录仪视频的自我中心视角（egocentric）数据集，用于警察-平民互动分析。数据集以秒级粒度标注关键动作，包含快速和异常的相机运动、密集人际交互和罕见高风险事件。基准测试表明，即使是最佳视频模型（如 Gemini 2.5 Pro）也难以准确预测高风险动作（如“Weapon Out”）。EgoPolice 旨在促进大规模执法视频中事件识别模型的开发，以支持更高效的下游人工审查。
Motivation: 警察行为研究需要分析大量执法记录仪视频，但现有数据集缺乏对快速运动、密集互动和高风险事件等挑战的覆盖，且当前模型在预测高风险动作上表现不佳。
Method: 从公开的执法记录仪视频中精选真实警察-平民互动片段，以秒级粒度标注关键动作标签，并提供分类和多选题问答两种任务作为基准。
Result: 即使最好的视频模型（Gemini 2.5 Pro）在预测高风险动作（如“Weapon Out”）上仍表现困难。
Conclusion: EgoPolice 作为基准，为开发能够在大规模执法记录仪视频库中识别事件模型的模型奠定基础，从而支持更高效的下游人工审查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Verification of Dynamic Holographic Behavior in Identity Documents
authors: Ahmad Montaser Awal (1) ((1) IDnow Research Center
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the remote verification of the authenticity of Optically Variable Devices (commonly known as holograms) on identity documents. Typically placed over the cardholder's photo, these devices provide strong and easily verifiable security for human inspection but pose challenges for automated verification. Existing approaches easily cover static frauds (e.g. paper photocopy) and can be evaluated for such, but their capacity to detect real, dynamic fraud cases (e.g. handcrafted hologram) has not been evaluated to date because of the lack of public datasets. Furthermore, they are usually trained to detect known attack types, and few of them can generalize to new, unseen attacks. This work features three contributions to address these limitations: 1) a new public dataset, MIDV-DynAttack, which extends the existing MIDV-Holo dataset with realistic, static and dynamic attacks against identity document specimens, tripling the number of attack samples compared to the original dataset, 2) a novel verification method which can assess the authenticity of a specific hologram thanks to the analysis of its dynamic behavior and appearance, can be trained without dynamic attack samples, and exhibits new state-of-the-art performance, 3) a benchmark of existing approaches which follows a clear evaluation protocol and emphasizes the inability of other approaches to deal with dynamic attacks, as well as new challenging attacks to deal with. Code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/EPITAResearchLab/pouliquen.25.icdar.
papers.comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition (ICDAR 2025)
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 19th International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition (ICDAR) 2025, pp. 323-339
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对身份证件上全息图（Optically Variable Devices）的远程真伪验证问题，提出了一种新的动态行为验证方法。作者贡献包括：1) 新公开数据集 MIDV-DynAttack，扩展了现有 MIDV-Holo 数据集，包含真实静态和动态攻击样本；2) 一种无需动态攻击样本训练即可评估全息图动态行为的新验证方法，达到最先进性能；3) 现有方法的基准测试，揭示了其他方法处理动态攻击的不足。代码和数据集已公开。
Motivation: 现有方法主要针对静态伪造（如纸复印）进行验证，缺乏对真实动态伪造（如手工制作全息图）的检测能力，且缺少公开数据集和评估协议。
Method: 提出一种新的验证方法，通过分析全息图的动态行为和外观来评估真伪，训练时无需动态攻击样本。同时构建了包含静态和动态攻击的扩展数据集 MIDV-DynAttack。
Result: 新方法在动态攻击检测上达到最先进性能，而现有方法无法有效处理动态攻击和新型挑战。
Conclusion: 本文强调了动态行为分析在身份文档全息图验证中的重要性，并提供了公开数据集和基准，以推动该方向的研究。

papers.title: Andha-Dhun: A First Look at Audio Descriptions in Hindi
papers.abstract_en: Audio Descriptions (ADs) narrate visual content for Blind and Low Vision (BLV) audiences during gaps in audiovisual media. There is growing momentum around ADs in movies and TV shows, and with mandates from India's Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC), there is a need to expand ADs beyond English. Yet, there is no work that generates ADs for any Indian language. To address this gap, we present the first systematic study of ADs in Hindi, contributing to aspects such as data, generation, and evaluation. We introduce Andha-Dhun, the first dataset of human-authored Hindi ADs collected from 8 full-length movies. We explore two approaches for generating ADs in Hindi: (i) directly from English dense video descriptions, and (ii) translating English ADs into Hindi. We evaluate these approaches using perplexity and LLM-as-a-judge metrics to assess fluency and quality respectively. We also analyze movies that have both English and Hindi human-authored ADs and find that naive translation introduces artifacts and narrows diversity compared to original Hindi ADs. Direct machine translation fails to adapt cultural references, while human-translated ADs do better but still fall short. Our findings emphasize that the purpose of Hindi ADs is accessibility for Indian BLV audiences, and that this requires adapting content for the audience more than strict fidelity to the source.
papers.comment: Accepted to NCVPRIPG 2026, Download data at https://github.com/katha-ai/AndhaDhun-HindiAD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了印地语音频描述（Audio Descriptions, ADs），包括数据集、生成和评估。作者构建了首个从8部完整电影收集的人工印地语AD数据集Andha-Dhun，并探索了两种生成方案：从英文密集视频描述直接生成和翻译英文AD。评估发现直接翻译会引入伪影并缩小多样性，而人工翻译AD虽更好但仍不足，强调印地语AD应针对印度盲人观众进行文化适应，而非严格忠实于源语言。
Motivation: 尽管印度电影认证委员会要求提供AD，但缺乏针对印度语言的AD研究，现有工作仅覆盖英语。
Method: 收集8部电影的人工印地语AD数据集Andha-Dhun，并比较两种生成方案：从英文密集视频描述直接生成和机器翻译英文AD，使用困惑度和LLM-as-a-judge评估流畅性和质量。
Result: 机器翻译在文化参照上失败，人工翻译AD更好但仍有不足；原始印地语AD在多样性上优于翻译版本。
Conclusion: 印地语AD的目标是印度盲人观众的可访问性，因此需要适应内容而非严格忠实于源语言。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Voting to Agent Collaboration: Answer-Type-Aware LLM Pipelines for BioASQ 14b
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical question answering requires not only accurate extraction of information from scientific literature but also reliable integration of evidence across multiple documents. This study presents a question-type-specific large language model (LLM) framework for BioASQ 14b Task B, designed to improve answer robustness and evidence grounding in biomedical question answering. Rather than applying a single prompting strategy to all questions, the framework selects different inference procedures for yes/no, factoid, and list questions according to their distinct reasoning and evaluation requirements. For yes/no questions, snippet shuffling and self-reflection are used to reduce sensitivity to evidence ordering and improve decision stability. For factoid questions, full-snippet input is combined with chain-of-thought-based in-context learning to support accurate biomedical entity identification. For list questions, a multi-agent architecture is employed, in which evidence extraction, candidate generation, answer verification, and final aggregation are handled collaboratively. Preliminary experiments on BioASQ 13b were used to identify effective inference strategies for each question type, and the resulting framework was subsequently evaluated in the official BioASQ 14b Task B challenge. In the official evaluation, our framework showed competitive performance across multiple batches and achieved first place in the factoid subtask of Batch 4. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining question-type-specific inference, ensemble prediction, and agent-based verification for reliable biomedical question answering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向BioASQ 14b Task B的问题类型特定的大语言模型框架，针对yes/no、factoid和list三类问题分别设计推理流程。yes/no问题使用snippet洗牌和自反思，factoid问题结合全snippet输入与链式思维上下文学习，list问题采用多智能体架构进行证据提取、候选生成、答案验证和聚合。在官方评测中，该框架在多个批次中表现出竞争力，并在批次4的factoid子任务中获得第一名。
Motivation: 生物医学问答需要从科学文献中准确提取信息并跨文档可靠整合证据，现有方法缺乏针对不同问题类型的差异化推理策略。
Method: 构建问题类型特定LLM管线：对yes/no问题使用snippet洗牌和自反思减少对顺序的敏感性；对factoid问题采用全snippet输入加链式思维上下文学习；对list问题使用多智能体架构，包括证据提取、候选生成、答案验证和最终聚合的协作流程。
Result: 在BioASQ 14b Task B官方评测中，框架在多个批次表现有竞争力，并在批次4的factoid子任务中获得第一名。
Conclusion: 问题类型特定的推理、集成预测和基于智能体的验证相结合，能够提升生物医学问答的可靠性和证据接地。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Danus: Orchestrating Mathematical Reasoning Agents with Fact-Graph Memory
papers.abstract_en: Recent LLM-based mathematical reasoning agents have begun to tackle research-level problems and, in several cases, have contributed to the resolution of open problems. However, scaling and orchestrating such agents effectively remains challenging, due to the difficulty of coordinating parallel proof search while keeping intermediate claims organized and reliable. In this paper, we propose Danus, an orchestration system for research-level mathematical reasoning centered on a shared fact graph as a global memory-management mechanism. Danus consists of a main agent that performs planning and coordination, multiple worker agents that carry out proof search in parallel, and a stateless verifier that checks proposed mathematical claims before they are admitted into the fact graph. Each verified fact is stored together with its proof and logical dependencies, allowing the system to build long arguments incrementally while keeping the shared proof state organized. The main agent periodically summarizes the evolving proof state, redirects workers across promising directions, and supports interaction with human mathematicians through progress reports. We evaluate Danus through six research-level case studies in algebraic geometry, singularity theory, and combinatorics, illustrating how the fact-graph memory mechanism enables Danus to construct long, detailed mathematical proofs. Our results suggest that fact-graph-based orchestration provides an effective route toward scaling mathematical reasoning agents for long-horizon research problems. Danus is open source at https://github.com/frenzymath/Danus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Danus，一个面向数学推理的编排系统，核心是共享的事实图谱作为全局内存管理。系统包括主代理（规划和协调）、多个工代理（并行证明搜索）和无状态验证器（检查数学主张）。验证后的事实连同证明和逻辑依赖被存储，支持逐步构建长论证。在代数几何、奇点理论和组合学的六个研究级案例中评估，展示了事实图谱内存机制能有效构建长而详细的数学证明。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的数学推理智能体在扩展和编排方面存在困难，特别是并行证明搜索的协调和中间声明的组织可靠性不足。
Method: 设计Danus系统：主代理进行规划和协调；多个工代理并行执行证明搜索；无状态验证器在事实加入图谱前检查数学主张。每个验证的事实连同其证明和逻辑依赖存储在事实图谱中，主代理定期总结演化状态并重定向工代理，支持人类数学家的交互。
Result: 在代数几何、奇点理论和组合学的六个研究级案例研究中，Danus能够构建长而详细的数学证明，表明事实图谱编排是扩展数学推理智能体用于长期研究问题的有效途径。
Conclusion: 基于事实图谱的编排为长时域研究问题的数学推理智能体扩展提供了有效路径，系统已开源。
