papers.title: Visual graphs for image classification: does the structure affect performance?
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models have emerged in machine learning and related fields, demonstrating astonishing performance in various visual tasks. Despite their great success, however, these models are unable to fully encode intrinsic visual structures, and often ignore the spatial, topological, and semantic information contained within an image. Graph neural networks offer a good framework to face this aspect, but their effective use for visual tasks has been only partly explored and mainly starting from a limited perspective. This work aims to address this gap by conducting a systematic comparison of current graph construction techniques within the context of a fixed three-layer GCN architecture. Through an empirical study, it demonstrates in particular how the network structure affects performance and provides an important methodological contribution regarding the computational stages preceding graph utilization, which will be strongly influenced by the structure itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了不同图构建方法在固定三层GCN架构下对图像分类性能的影响，通过实验表明图结构显著影响分类准确率，并为图构建前的计算阶段提供了方法论贡献。
Motivation: 现有深度学习模型在视觉任务中难以充分编码图像的内在空间、拓扑和语义信息，而图神经网络（GNN）在这方面的应用探索有限，尤其是缺乏对不同图构建技术的系统比较。
Method: 在固定三层GCN（graph convolutional network）架构下，对多种图构建技术（如基于空间邻近、特征相似性等）进行系统性对比实验，分析图结构对分类性能的影响。
Result: 实验表明图结构（graph construction technique）显著影响分类性能，不同结构导致不同的准确率；同时，图构建前的计算阶段（如图节点和边的生成）也受结构影响。
Conclusion: 该工作强调了图结构对图像分类任务的重要性，为后续选择或设计图构建方法提供了实验依据和方法论指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A unified perspective of Gaussian process approximation for differential equations
papers.abstract_en: The use of Gaussian processes for approximating differential equations has expanded rapidly, leading to a growing, diverse, and fragmented body of numerical methods. We present a unified Bayesian perspective that places these techniques within a common probabilistic framework, based on a derivative matching interpretation for incorporating differential equation constraints into likelihood. This unified perspective supports both parameter estimation and solution approximation, and shows how a range of existing methods can be understood within it. This work aims to consolidate current developments and provide a foundation for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的贝叶斯视角，将高斯过程近似微分方程的各种方法整合在一个公共概率框架下。该框架基于导数匹配解释引入微分方程约束到似然函数，同时支持参数估计和解近似，并展示了许多现有方法如何被理解。
Motivation: 高斯过程在微分方程近似中的应用发展迅速，但方法多样且碎片化，缺乏统一的理论框架。
Method: 通过导数匹配（derivative matching）将微分方程约束融入似然函数，构建统一的贝叶斯概率框架。
Result: 该框架统一了多种现有方法，并为未来研究提供基础。
Conclusion: 摘要旨在整合当前发展，为后续研究奠定理论基础，但未涉及具体应用领域的实验验证。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: AlayaWorld: Long-Horizon and Playable Video World Generation
papers.abstract_en: Game worlds have traditionally been built through labor-intensive production pipelines, making them costly to develop, difficult to customization, and expensive to modify after deployment. Recent advances in video world models offer a fundamentally different paradigm. Rather than explicitly authoring every component of a virtual environment, these models autoregressively synthesize future observations conditioned on the current world state and user interactions, enabling playable worlds to be generated online. Trained on both gameplay recordings and real-world videos, they can capture diverse visual appearances and physical dynamics, opening new opportunities for interactive applications beyond gaming, including embodied intelligence. In this paper, we present \textbf{AlayaWorld}, a full-stack open-source framework for building interactive generative worlds. AlayaWorld enables open-ended real-time interaction, allowing users to freely navigate and perform diverse actions such as combat, spell casting, and monster summoning. The framework unifies the complete development-from data preparation model architecture, model training, inference acceleration, and deployment-within a modular and extensible architecture. Alongside the framework, we release reproducible pipelines, reference implementations, evaluation tools, and comprehensive documentation, establishing a practical foundation for future research and real-time applications of generative world models.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AlayaWorld，一个全栈开源框架，用于构建交互式生成世界。该框架基于视频世界模型，能够根据当前世界状态和用户交互自回归合成未来观察，实现实时开放世界交互，如战斗、施法、召唤怪物等。它整合了从数据准备到部署的完整开发流程，并提供可复现的流水线和评估工具。
Motivation: 传统游戏世界开发成本高、难以定制且修改昂贵，而现有视频世界模型尚未提供一个完整的开源框架来支持实时交互和多样化动作。
Method: 提出AlayaWorld框架，统一数据准备、模型架构、训练、推理加速和部署，采用模块化可扩展设计，基于游戏录播和真实世界视频训练视频世界模型。
Result: 摘要未提供具体定量结果，但声称框架支持开放世界实时交互，用户可自由导航并执行多样动作。
Conclusion: AlayaWorld为生成世界模型的未来研究和实时应用提供了实用基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Quantitative Gaussian-Process limits of Tensor Programs
papers.abstract_en: We study the infinite-width Gaussian-process limit of random neural networks through the lens of tensor programs, and we provide a quantitative convergence theory in Wasserstein distance. Our main result gives explicit finite-width error bounds, of order inverse square-root of the widths between finite-network executions and their Gaussian-process limits. The framework is architecture-agnostic and covers feed-forward models together with weight-sharing schemes relevant for recurrent and transformer-type architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过张量程序框架研究随机神经网络的无限宽高斯过程极限，在Wasserstein距离下给出定量收敛理论。主要结果是有限宽误差界，阶数为宽度倒数的平方根，适用于前馈模型以及循环和Transformer架构中的权重共享方案。
Motivation: 现有无限宽极限理论缺乏定量误差界，且对权重共享架构（如RNN、Transformer）的适用性不明确。
Method: 采用张量程序的形式化语言，推导神经网络输出分布与高斯过程之间的Wasserstein距离收敛速率，得到显式的有限宽度误差界。
Result: 摘要报告误差界阶数为宽度倒数的平方根，且架构无关，覆盖前馈和权重共享模型。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个统一的定量收敛框架，可用于理解随机神经网络的高斯过程行为，并指导实际宽度选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kernel-based Operator Learning: Error Analysis, Budget Allocation, and a Physics-Informed Extension
papers.abstract_en: We study kernel-based operator learning in a two-stage sampling framework, where an offline kernel regression operator learns a discretized representation of the target operator from input-output pairs and an online kernel reconstruction operator recovers the output function from predicted observations. Our main theoretical contribution is an explicit budget allocation condition relating the number $N$ of training pairs, the number $n$ of input observations, and the output resolution $m$. The condition is derived from a coupled error analysis that interprets the surrogate as a reconstruction from approximate data. This yields a decomposition of the total error into reconstruction and learning contributions that can be analyzed independently. As a consequence, we obtain quantitative scaling laws describing how $N$, $n$, and $m$ must be coupled to guarantee convergence and to balance offline learning and online reconstruction errors. The resulting estimates extend previous analyses of kernel-based operator learning. We further introduce a physics-informed extension that incorporates knowledge of the underlying PDE at evaluation time. Rather than encoding constraints directly into the kernel, we augment the online reconstruction step by penalizing PDE residuals at collocation points. The method requires no retraining for new inputs. Numerical experiments illustrate the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed physics-informed reconstruction strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于核的算子学习（kernel-based operator learning）的两阶段采样框架，包括离线核回归算子学习和在线核重构算子。理论贡献是导出预算分配条件，关联训练样本数N、输入观测数n和输出分辨率m，并通过耦合误差分解得到缩放律。进一步提出物理信息扩展，在在线重构中惩罚PDE残差，无需重新训练。数值实验验证理论并展示有效性。
Motivation: 现有核算子学习缺乏对训练样本数、输入观测数和输出分辨率之间耦合关系的明确预算分配条件，且难以将物理知识嵌入而不增加重训成本。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：离线阶段用核回归从输入-输出对学习算子离散表示；在线阶段用核重构从预测观测恢复输出函数。通过耦合误差分析导出预算分配条件。物理信息扩展在在线重构时添加PDE残差惩罚项，无需重新训练。
Result: 得到量化缩放律，描述N、n和m的耦合关系以保证收敛并平衡离线学习与在线重构误差。数值实验验证理论并展示物理信息重构策略的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文的预算分配条件和物理信息扩展为核算子学习提供了理论保证和实用增强，可推广到PDE求解等任务。

papers.title: Task Decomposition-Guided Reranking for Adaptive Agent Skill Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Skill usage can significantly enhance the ability of modern agent systems to complete complex tasks. However, the growing scale of skill libraries makes accurate skill selection increasingly challenging. In real-world scenarios, ambiguous semantic matching often arises between a specific task requirement and multiple generic yet semantically similar candidate skills. Moreover, existing methods tend to overlook the dynamic influence of task difficulty and skill applicability when selecting the optimal target skill set. To address these issues, we propose SkillReranker, an inference-time reranking framework for adaptive skill selection. Specifically, we first perform semantic decomposition on both the task and skill sides, yielding informative subtask and execution-state descriptions as well as transition-state descriptions that characterize each skill's functionality. These descriptions are then used to construct a directed acyclic execution graph, where intermediate task states are modeled as nodes and candidate skills as edges, thereby establishing a structured task-skill correspondence. On this basis, SkillReranker determines whether each state node satisfies the split condition to identify subtask intervals. For each task interval, we employ a cross-encoder to perform comprehensive scoring over candidate skills and select the most suitable ones to form the final target skill set. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld with three backbone LLMs show that SkillReranker effectively improves task performance, reduces environment interaction steps, and lowers token consumption compared with existing skill selection baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SkillReranker，一个推理时的重排序框架，用于智能体自适应技能选择。通过任务和技能的语义分解构建有向无环执行图，建模中间状态为节点、候选技能为边，并利用交叉编码器对技能集进行评分。在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上的实验表明，该方法提升了任务性能并减少了交互步数和令牌消耗。
Motivation: 现有技能选择方法难以处理大规模技能库中任务需求与候选技能之间的语义模糊匹配，且忽略了任务难度和技能适用性的动态影响。
Method: 将任务和技能分别语义分解为子任务描述和执行状态描述，构建有向无环执行图，状态为节点、技能为边；通过分裂条件识别子任务区间，并采用交叉编码器对候选技能评分以选择最优技能集。
Result: 在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上，使用三种骨干LLM（未具体说明）进行实验，SkillReranker有效提升了任务性能，减少了环境交互步数和令牌消耗。
Conclusion: 提出了一种推理时的技能重排序方法，通过任务分解和执行图结构增强技能选择的准确性和适应性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Straight-Path Flow Matching for Incomplete Multi-View Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Incomplete Multi-View Clustering addresses the problem of clustering multi-modal data when certain views are missing. Recent end-to-end generative approaches leverage diffusion models to recover missing views via stochastic noise-to-data trajectories. While expressive, such mechanisms are not explicitly designed for clustering, as they initialize from cluster-agnostic noise and rely on stochastic denoising dynamics. In this work, we revisit probability path design in end-to-end generative IMVC. We introduce a flow-matching framework with a linear interpolation path between paired view representations, that replaces diffusion with probability flows between observed and missing views. We provide a formal analysis showing that deterministic ODE flows are inherently better aligned with clustering objectives than diffusion-based stochastic trajectories, especially in terms of transport mechanisms that respect class-conditional data distributions and maintain cluster consistency in finite-step regimes. Building upon this insight, we develop an end-to-end IMVC architecture that integrates straight-path flow-matching view completion with cluster-level and entropy-based alignment to enforce cross-view clustering consistency. Extensive experiments on standard IMVC benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework establishes new state-of-the-art performance.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 28 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出直线路径流匹配（Straight-Path Flow Matching）用于不完整多视图聚类。通过在线性插值路径上使用概率流替代扩散模型中的随机去噪，实现缺失视图的恢复，并利用聚类级和熵对齐保证跨视图聚类一致性，在标准基准上取得新最优性能。
Motivation: 现有生成式方法使用扩散模型恢复缺失视图，但扩散过程从聚类无关噪声初始化，且随机去噪动态未针对聚类目标优化，导致聚类性能受限。
Method: 提出基于流匹配的框架，通过观测视图与缺失视图对之间的线性插值路径，用确定性ODE流替代随机扩散轨迹；结合直线路径流匹配视图补全、聚类级对齐和熵对齐，实现端到端的不完整多视图聚类。
Result: 在标准不完整多视图聚类基准上取得新的最优性能。
Conclusion: 确定性ODE流比扩散随机轨迹更适合聚类目标，尤其在保持类条件分布和有限步数下聚类一致性方面。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在标准不完整多视图聚类基准上取得新的最优性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 确定性ODE流比扩散随机轨迹更适合聚类目标，尤其在保持类条件分布和有限步数下聚类一致性方面。

papers.title: From Application-Layer Simulation to Native Meta-Architecture: Structural Tension as an Endogenous Driver for Heterogeneous AI Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Current large language models (LLMs) are fundamentally stateless: their behavior is fully determined by input at inference time, and any higher-order cognitive architecture must be simulated at the application layer through prompt engineering and context management. This paper proposes a theoretical framework for submerging such application-layer cognitive protocols into a native meta-architecture by introducing three interlocking mechanisms: (1) Structural Tension, an endogenous loss function derived from the conflict between new information and existing manifold topology, which drives the system toward internal self-consistency rather than external reward optimization; (2) an Offline Recurrent Loop, a sandboxed self-processing cycle that enables the system to maintain a dynamic resting potential and digest structural conflicts without external input; and (3) Inference-time Plasticity, the capacity for the system to reconfigure its context manifold topology without modifying pre-trained weights, subject to strict governance invariants including auditability, reversibility, and topological continuity. We argue that under these mechanisms, different model instances initialized with minute stochastic variances may, through path-dependent tension resolution, evolve distinct topological structures--constituting a heterogeneous intelligent ecology that breaks the homogeneity imposed by conventional alignment while remaining within hard governance rails. We provide operational definitions, a minimal set of reconfiguration operators, falsification criteria, and a worked example. The framework draws on and extends the Structural Intelligence (SI) governance protocols, repositioning governance--not capability--as the primary criterion for architectural intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个理论框架，将应用层的认知协议下沉到原生元架构中，通过引入结构张力、离线递归循环和推理时塑性三个机制，使不同模型实例在微小随机方差下演化出不同的拓扑结构，构成异质智能生态。该框架建立在结构智能治理协议之上，将治理而非能力作为架构智能的首要标准。
Motivation: 当前大语言模型本质上是无状态的，高阶认知架构必须通过提示工程和上下文管理在应用层模拟，缺乏内生驱动机制来实现异质智能演化。
Method: 提出三个相互锁定的机制：(1) 结构张力，来自新信息与现有流形拓扑冲突的内生损失函数；(2) 离线递归循环，沙盒化的自处理周期；(3) 推理时塑性，在不修改预训练权重的情况下重新配置上下文流形拓扑，并受可审计性、可逆性和拓扑连续性等治理不变量约束。
Result: 论文提供操作定义、最小重组算子集、可证伪准则和一个工作示例，论证在机制作用下不同模型实例可演化出异质拓扑结构，打破传统对齐的同质性。
Conclusion: 该框架扩展了结构智能治理协议，将治理而非能力作为架构智能的首要标准，但处于理论阶段，工作示例有限。

papers.title: MAC-XA: Multi-view Anatomy-Correspondence Fusion for Coronary Stenosis Reporting from X-ray Angiography
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view reasoning in coronary X-ray angiography is inherently a cross-projection geometric problem, yet automated report generation in this setting remains largely unexplored. The 3D vascular topology leads to projection-dependent branch overlap and foreshortening, rendering single-view modeling fundamentally incomplete and unstable for lesion localization and stenosis grading. Although multi-view fusion appears promising, learning anatomically consistent fusion from real angiograms is impeded by a critical limitation: cross-view alignment is unobservable and cannot be explicitly supervised. Consequently, conventional fusion relies on implicit correlations rather than verified anatomical correspondence. We address this by reformulating multi-view stenosis reporting as an alignment-constrained aggregation problem. A controllable synthetic angiography generation strategy is introduced to expose geometry-derived patch-level correspondence supervision unavailable in real data. An anatomy-correspondence module learns cross-view correspondence matrices that explicitly align auxiliary features within the main-view coordinate space prior to fusion, thereby constraining evidence aggregation to anatomically consistent regions. Experiments on synthetic data and zero-shot transfer to real angiograms show that this alignment-constrained design improves correspondence consistency and structured stenosis reporting compared to single-view modeling and conventional multi-view fusion methods. The code will be publicly available upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对冠脉X射线血管造影的多视图推理问题，提出一种基于对齐约束的聚合方法。通过可控合成血管造影生成策略暴露几何衍生的补丁级对应监督，并在融合前显式对齐辅助特征与主视图坐标。实验表明该方法在合成数据和零样本迁移到真实数据上改善了对应一致性和结构化狭窄报告。
Motivation: 多视图冠脉X射线血管造影的自动报告生成尚未充分探索，单视图建模因投影依赖的血管重叠和缩短而不稳定，多视图融合又面临跨视图对齐不可观察且无法显式监督的关键限制。
Method: 提出对齐约束的聚合方法，包括可控合成血管造影生成策略以提供几何衍生的补丁级对应监督，以及解剖对应模块学习跨视图对应矩阵，在融合前将辅助特征显式对齐到主视图坐标系。
Result: 在合成数据和零样本迁移到真实血管造影上，该方法相比单视图建模和传统多视图融合方法，改善了对应一致性和结构化狭窄报告。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过对齐约束的设计可以提升多视图狭窄报告中的解剖对应一致性，为血管造影自动报告生成提供了新思路。代码将公开。

papers.title: VendorBench-100: A Unified Cross-Paradigm Benchmark for Deepfake Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake image detection is currently served by three fundamentally different paradigms: commercial APIs, zero-shot vision-language models (LLMs), and open-source detectors. Despite their widespread use, these paradigms are rarely evaluated under a common protocol, making direct comparison difficult. We introduce VendorBench-100, a cross-paradigm benchmark that evaluates 36 representative models using a single adversarial 100-image corpus, a unified output schema, and a common evaluation framework. To ensure reliable assessment under the corpus's intentional class imbalance, models are ranked primarily by the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), with ROC-AUC reported as a threshold-independent measure of ranking ability. Rather than maximizing dataset size, VendorBench-100 emphasizes challenging real-world scenarios through a curated taxonomy of eight edge-case families, including face swaps, text-to-video stills, AI photo edits, avatar compositing, opaque-provenance images, and compressed research frames. Our evaluation shows that commercial APIs achieve the strongest median performance, followed by vision LLMs and open-source detectors. However, individual open-source models remain competitive with the best vision LLMs. More importantly, we identify a consistent divergence between ranking ability (ROC-AUC) and operating-point quality (MCC), demonstrating that strong score discrimination does not necessarily produce reliable default-threshold decisions. This metric disagreement, rather than any single leaderboard ranking, is the central finding of the benchmark. We release the complete evaluation framework and benchmark results to support reproducible future research. The source code and data are available at: https://github.com/sharayu-20/vendorbench-100
papers.comment: 22 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/sharayu-20/vendorbench-100
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VendorBench-100，一个跨范式的深度伪造图像检测基准，统一评估商业API、零样本视觉语言模型和开源检测器。基准使用100张对抗性图像、统一输出模式和评估框架，按Matthews相关系数排名。评估表明商业API的中位性能最强，但开源模型可与最佳视觉语言模型竞争。关键发现是排名能力（ROC-AUC）与操作点质量（MCC）之间存在分歧。
Motivation: 目前深度伪造图像检测的三种范式（商业API、视觉语言模型、开源检测器）很少在统一协议下评估，导致直接比较困难。
Method: 构建 VendorBench-100 基准，包含100张对抗性图像、统一输出模式和评估框架，采用 Matthews相关系数（MCC）为主要排名指标，ROC-AUC为辅助指标。通过八类边缘案例（如换脸、文本转视频帧、AI照片编辑等）强调现实场景。
Result: 商业API的中位性能最强，视觉语言模型次之，开源检测器最弱。但个别开源模型与最佳视觉语言模型相当。重要的是，排名能力（ROC-AUC）与操作点质量（MCC）之间持续存在分歧。
Conclusion: 指标分歧是基准的核心发现，而非任何单一排行榜排名。基准旨在支持可重复的未来研究。

papers.title: A Convex Approximation Framework for Neural Likelihood-Based Bayesian Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Many problems in science and engineering are difficult to model accurately, either due to unknown physical mechanisms, poorly quantified measurement uncertainty, or prohibitive computational costs of high-fidelity simulations. These challenges limit the applicability of classical probabilistic inference methods such as Markov chain Monte Carlo, especially in high-dimensional Bayesian inverse problems. As data from scientific experiments become increasingly available, machine learning methods offer a flexible alternative to explicit parametric modelling. We study neural likelihood approximation, where the goal is to learn the likelihood function directly from data without explicit knowledge of the underlying data-generating process. A common approach trains likelihood surrogates by minimizing the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the true posterior and an approximate posterior, which is equivalent to minimizing the expected negative log-likelihood. This work improves the theoretical foundations of neural likelihood approximation by alleviating limitations of restrictive model classes: we show that, by working with un-normalized potentials and folding normalization into the training objective, the resulting learning problem is strictly convex. We show that empirical minimizers of the resulting data-driven objective converge to the true likelihood as the sample size grows. Numerical experiments for the neural likelihood approximation are conducted for a deblurring and a non-linear PDE based imaging problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经似然逼近（neural likelihood approximation）的理论缺陷，提出使用非归一化势函数（un-normalized potentials）并将归一化常数纳入训练目标，使得学习问题成为严格凸优化问题。理论证明该数据驱动目标的经验最小化器随样本量增长一致收敛到真实似然函数。数值实验在图像去模糊和非线性PDE成像问题中验证了方法有效性。
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯逆问题中的概率推断方法（如MCMC）在高维场景下计算代价高昂，而现有神经似然逼近方法受限于限制性模型类，缺乏严格的凸性和收敛性保证，限制了其理论可靠性。
Method: 提出通过非归一化势函数来学习似然，将归一化常数作为可训练参数融入目标函数，使全局优化问题变为严格凸问题。并基于经验风险最小化推导了收敛性理论。
Result: 在去模糊和非线性PDE成像两个基准任务上，所提方法成功逼近了真实似然函数，实验验证了理论结论。
Conclusion: 该框架为神经似然逼近提供了严格的凸分析和一致收敛性保证，克服了模型类限制，但应用场景目前限于成像类逆问题。

papers.title: PhyMRI-SR: Toward Physics-Aware MRI Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) super-resolution is vital for improving diagnostic accessibility, yet most methods treat it as a deterministic mapping from a fixed low-resolution input to a high-resolution target. This overlooks a key property of MRI acquisition physics: spatial resolution and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) are inherently coupled, making any given low-resolution scan merely one of many possible realizations under varying acquisition trade-offs. We rethink MRI super-resolution as a physics-aware reconstruction problem, in which the goal is to identify the optimal resolution-SNR configuration and then super-resolve it to obtain high-quality MRI results. A key implication of this formulation is that MRI resolution becomes dynamic rather than fixed. To handle such resolution-heterogeneous inputs, we adapt 2D Gaussian Splatting (2D GS) to MRI by formulating reconstruction as a coordinate-based, resolution-agnostic rendering problem. To further enhance fidelity, we introduce three innovations: (1) a prior-aware Gaussian representation that combines an Anatomical Structure Prior for tissue-specific kernel initialization with an Imaging System Prior that captures hardware characteristics via a covariance dictionary; (2) a physics-constrained signal modeling scheme that predicts intrinsic tissue parameters (proton density rho and effective relaxation rate R2) and synthesizes intensities through governing physical equations, ensuring biophysically plausible contrast; and (3) a meta-learning framework that alleviates paired-data scarcity by pretraining on simulated data and adapting to real-world conditions. Extensive experiments on dynamic-resolution datasets and standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting its strong potential for clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新思考MRI超分辨率问题，将其视为物理感知的重建问题，考虑分辨率与信噪比（SNR）的耦合。提出PhyMRI-SR方法，包含先验感知高斯表示、物理约束信号建模和元学习框架，在动态分辨率数据集和标准基准上达到SOTA性能。
Motivation: 现有MRI超分辨率方法将输入视为固定低分辨率，忽略了分辨率与SNR的内在耦合，且低分辨率扫描是多种可能的实现之一。本文旨在通过物理感知重建找到最优分辨率-SNR配置。
Method: 基于2D高斯溅射（2D GS）进行坐标无关渲染，提出先验感知高斯表示（解剖结构先验和成像系统先验）、物理约束信号建模（预测质子密度ρ和有效弛豫率R2，通过物理方程合成强度）以及元学习框架（模拟数据预训练+真实域适应）。
Result: 在动态分辨率数据集和标准基准上取得SOTA性能。
Conclusion: 强调方法的物理合理性和临床部署潜力。

papers.title: WING: A Window-Prior-Based Generative Network with Gated Inception for Cross-Modality CT Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Generating CT volumes from MRI and CBCT can improve treatment planning in adaptive radiotherapy while avoiding additional radiation exposure. However, direct regression of CT intensities is challenged by the inherently high dynamic range and long-tailed distributions, thereby averaging out sparse yet clinically important structures. To alleviate this issue, we reformulate the regression target into multiple windowed representations, leveraging the inductive prior that CT intensities are structure-deterministic and window-separable. These windowed views exhibit smoother distributions and admit structured fusion back to the full-range CT. Building on this reformulation, we introduce WING, a WINdow-prior-based Generative network comprising: 1) a new Gated Inception Generator to produce multi-window predictions, enabling multi-shape kernel interactions to capture cross-modality correspondence; 2) a Fuse-and-Refine Transformer to aggregate the windowed outputs and learn residuals for detail refinement; and 3) a joint adversarial training objective to enhance window-conditioned realism. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our compact WING achieves state-of-the-art performance on the MRI-to-CT and CBCT-to-CT benchmarks, while supporting multi-anatomy synthesis with a single model.

papers.title: Demonstrating TOFFEE: A Learned System for Synthesizing Data Agent Trajectories at Scale
papers.abstract_en: LLM-powered data agents are playing an increasingly important role in data-driven decision making. However, existing data agents struggle to generalize to unseen data environments and analytical workflows, especially in heterogeneous enterprise settings. This creates a growing need for synthesizing high-quality data agent trajectories that capture complex analytical workflows for given data environments. Such trajectories support two key downstream uses: they can serve as supervised finetuning (SFT) data that adapts data agent models to the target domain, and as in-context learning (ICL) demonstrations to guide general-purpose LLMs in unfamiliar data environments. Thus, we introduce TOFFEE, a system for synthesizing high-quality data agent trajectories from given data environments via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with adaptive model selection and cross-task prefix reuse. We show that TOFFEE can effectively generate scalable trajectory data for complex analytical tasks across heterogeneous environments. In this demonstration, we present the system framework of TOFFEE, including its task pool construction, trajectory explorer, and learned cost model. We also introduce the web interface of TOFFEE and its workflow, and demonstrate two end-to-end scenarios: trajectory synthesis for data agent finetuning, and demonstration-augmented data agent reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TOFFEE 是一个基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的系统，用于从给定数据环境合成高质量的数据代理轨迹，支持微调数据代理模型和作为上下文学习示例。该系统通过自适应模型选择和跨任务前缀重用实现可扩展的轨迹生成，并在异构企业环境中演示了复杂分析任务的轨迹合成。
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动的数据代理在未见过数据环境和工作流中泛化能力不足，特别是在异构企业环境中，需要高质量轨迹数据来适配模型或指导通用LLM。
Method: 使用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）结合自适应模型选择和跨任务前缀重用来合成轨迹，包含任务池构建、轨迹探索器和学习到的成本模型。
Result: 摘要表明TOFFEE能有效为异构环境中的复杂分析任务生成可扩展的轨迹数据，并通过端到端场景展示轨迹合成对数据代理微调和演示增强推理的效果。
Conclusion: TOFFEE系统通过MCTS和自适应策略提供了一种可扩展的轨迹合成方法，可用于数据代理的领域适应和上下文学习。

papers.title: Entanglement as a Structural Complexity Axis: A PAC-Bayesian View of Generalization in Quantum Policies and Value Functions
papers.abstract_en: Parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs) are increasingly used as policies and value functions in quantum reinforcement learning, yet it remains unclear when and why quantum policies generalize. We give a PAC-Bayesian account in which generalization is governed not by the raw number of circuit parameters, but by the effective dimension of the Fisher geometry induced by the circuit. This quantity is inflated by entanglement, making entangling connectivity an independent axis of complexity.In controlled experiments that fix the number of trainable rotations and vary only entanglement, we find that circuits with larger Fisher effective dimension exhibit larger train-test gaps, while parameter count is a weak predictor. The resulting bound acts primarily as a ranking certificate: it correctly orders circuits with identical parameter count, which parameter-counting bounds cannot do. We validate this mechanism across supervised classification, quantum contextual bandits, and value-function generalization, where entangled circuits consistently generalize worse than non-entangled circuits of equal parameter count, with gaps shrinking as sample size increases.Our strongest evidence comes from low-variance decision models, including single-observable classifiers, value heads, and one-step policies. In end-to-end multi-step policy learning, entanglement effects remain statistically significant but high return variance leaves the full ordering only partially resolved. Partial-correlation analysis shows that Fisher effective dimension screens off entangling pattern, and controls for training accuracy, readout, and optimizer rule out major optimization confounders. The effect also persists on an IBM Heron quantum processor under real noise. Overall, our results reframe quantum policy design around an entanglement--generalization trade-off rather than expressivity alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从PAC-Bayes角度研究量子策略和值函数的泛化，发现泛化受Fisher几何有效维度控制而非参数数量，纠缠会膨胀该维度导致泛化变差。实验证明在不同任务中纠缠电路泛化均差于非纠缠电路，且该效应在真实量子处理器上仍存在。
Motivation: 参数化量子电路用于量子强化学习时泛化机理不明，参数数量不能解释泛化差异，需寻找更有效的复杂性度量。
Method: 采用PAC-Bayes框架，定义基于Fisher信息矩阵的有效维度作为复杂度度量，并通过固定参数数量只改变纠缠结构的对照实验验证假设。
Result: 纠缠电路Fisher有效维度更大且训练-测试差距更大；在监督分类、量子contextual bandits、值函数泛化等任务中，纠缠电路泛化一致更差；真实噪声处理器上效应仍存在。
Conclusion: 量子策略设计应关注纠缠-泛化权衡而非仅表达能力。

papers.title: Spider 2.0-AIFunc: Extending Real-World Text-to-SQL to AI-Native SQL Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Major cloud data platforms now expose large language model capabilities as native SQL functions, enabling analysts to perform classification, filtering, sentiment analysis, extraction, similarity search, and aggregation within ordinary SQL queries. Yet existing text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate only conventional SQL and provide no signal on whether models can generate such AI-native SQL. We introduce Spider 2.0-AIFunc, a benchmark of 465 verified instances across 125 real-world databases covering six types of AI functions on the Snowflake platform. Starting from an existing enterprise text-to-SQL benchmark, we construct Spider 2.0-AIFunc through an agent-based pipeline that rewrites source tasks into AI-native form, simultaneously transforming target queries and refining natural language instructions to make the intended AI-native solution explicit and reduce ambiguity. All instances pass a multi-round repeated execution protocol across temporally separated windows to confirm result stability before release. Evaluating ten state-of-the-art language models, we find that the strongest proprietary models reach 67-70% execution accuracy while the best open-source model achieves 58.1%, a gap driven primarily by errors in predicate specification, schema grounding, and AI function parameterization. Agent frameworks designed for traditional text-to-SQL challenges, such as schema retrieval and relevant table selection, do not transfer effectively to AI-native SQL: a minimal agent setup consistently matches or outperforms more elaborate alternatives, suggesting that the strategies these frameworks employ are less critical in this setting. Data are available at https://github.com/Leolty/Spider2-AIFunc .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spider 2.0-AIFunc，一个用于评估模型生成 AI 原生 SQL（即利用大语言模型能力作为原生 SQL 函数）的基准，包含 465 个实例和 125 个真实数据库。评估十种模型发现，最强专有模型执行准确率为 67-70%，开源最佳为 58.1%，主要错误来自谓词规范、模式绑定和 AI 函数参数化。传统文本到 SQL 的代理框架在此任务上效果不佳，最小代理设置反而匹配或超越更复杂方案。
Motivation: 现有文本到 SQL 基准仅评估传统 SQL，无法反映模型在 SQL 中调用 AI 函数（如分类、过滤、情感分析等）的能力，而主流云平台已支持此类功能，亟需相应基准。
Method: 基于现有企业文本到 SQL 基准，通过基于代理的管道将源任务重写为 AI 原生形式，同时转换目标查询并细化自然语言指令，使预期 AI 原生解决方案明确并减少歧义，所有实例通过多轮重复执行协议验证结果稳定性。
Result: 最强专有模型（如 GPT-4）执行准确率达 67-70%，最佳开源模型（DeepSeek-V3）为 58.1%。传统代理框架（如 schema 检索和表选择策略）不适用于 AI 原生 SQL，最小代理设置表现相当或更优。
Conclusion: AI 原生 SQL 的挑战主要在于谓词规范、模式绑定和 AI 函数参数化，现有文本到 SQL 代理框架需调整以适应此类任务。

papers.title: Canopy: A Heterograph Foundation Model for Metabolic Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Designing microbial strains that produce high-value chemicals at commercially viable titers remains a central challenge in metabolic engineering. Existing computational approaches either rely on stoichiometric constraint-based models that cannot learn from experimental data, or apply tabular machine learning to hand-crafted features that discard the relational structure of biological knowledge. We present Canopy, a heterogeneous graph foundation model that integrates ten public and proprietary data sources into a unified knowledge graph (KG) of 6.9M nodes across 13 types and 34 edge types, covering genes, proteins, metabolites, reactions, pathways, strains, and fermentation experiments. Node features are encoded through domain-specific foundation models (ESM-2 for protein sequences, MoLFormer for chemical SMILES, and PubMedBERT for biomedical text), yielding a multi-modal representation within a single graph. We pretrain a Heterogeneous Graph Transformer (HGT) augmented with SignNet positional encodings, Jumping Knowledge aggregation, and virtual nodes using four self-supervised objectives (link prediction, masked node modelling, distance prediction, and contrastive experiment clustering), balanced via learned homoscedastic uncertainty weighting. On the downstream task of fermentation titer prediction, frozen Canopy embeddings achieve $R^{2} = 0.41$ with a lightweight probe, outperforming tabular baselines (best $R^{2} = 0.24$) and homogeneous GNN variants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Canopy是一个异质图基础模型，用于代谢工程。它整合10个公开和专有数据源，构建包含6.9M节点、13种节点类型和34种边类型的知识图谱，使用ESM-2、MoLFormer和PubMedBERT等域特定基础模型编码节点特征，并通过异质图Transformer（HGT）结合SignNet位置编码、Jumping Knowledge聚合和虚拟节点进行预训练，采用四种自监督目标（链接预测、掩码节点建模、距离预测、对比实验聚类）平衡训练。在发酵滴度预测下游任务中，冻结的Canopy嵌入使用轻量探针达到R²=0.41，优于表格基线（最佳R²=0.24）和同质GNN变体。
Motivation: 现有代谢工程计算方法要么依赖基于化学计量约束的模型，无法从实验数据中学习，要么将表格机器学习应用于手工特征，丢弃了生物知识的关系结构。
Method: 构建统一异质知识图谱（6.9M节点，13种类型，34种边类型），节点特征由域特定基础模型（ESM-2、MoLFormer、PubMedBERT）编码；使用异质图Transformer（HGT）加SignNet位置编码、Jumping Knowledge聚合和虚拟节点，通过四种自监督目标（链接预测、掩码节点建模、距离预测、对比实验聚类）预训练，损失由同方差不确定性加权平衡。
Result: 冻结的Canopy嵌入在发酵滴度预测任务上达到R²=0.41，优于表格基线（最佳R²=0.24）和同质GNN变体。
Conclusion: 异质图基础模型能够有效整合多模态生物数据，并显著提升代谢工程中发酵性能预测的准确性。

papers.title: Information Gain-based Rollout Policy Optimization: An Adaptive Tree-Structured Rollout Approach for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become a promising paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon search tasks, where the agent must make a sequence of intermediate decisions before receiving a final outcome. However, existing methods still face a key limitation: the rollout budget is often allocated without explicitly assessing the utility of intermediate states. As a result, substantial computation may be spent on low-value states, even though different branches can vary drastically in their informativeness. In this paper, we propose Information Gain-based Rollout Policy Optimization (IGRPO), a policy optimization framework that treats intermediate-state informativeness as the organizing principle of rollout collection. Specifically, IGRPO performs budget-aware tree-structured rollouts by allocating expansion budget according to node-level informativeness, so that more informative branches are expanded more frequently while unpromising branches are progressively suppressed. We further demonstrate that the information gain-based rollout induces an explicit limiting teacher distribution over trajectories, which naturally yields a clear policy optimization target, thereby unifying adaptive tree-structured exploration with principled policy learning under a single framework. Experiments on seven challenging search-augmented QA benchmarks demonstrate that IGRPO consistently outperforms strong baselines under the same rollout budget constraints, validating the effectiveness of leveraging the induced teacher distribution to guide policy optimization for long-horizon search agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出信息增益引导的展开策略优化（IGRPO），一种自适应树状展开框架，用于多轮LLM智能体在长时域搜索任务中的强化学习。IGRPO根据节点信息增益分配展开预算，优先探索高信息价值分支，并导出显式的限制教师分布来统一策略优化。在七个搜索增强问答基准上，IGRPO在相同预算下持续优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法在长时域搜索任务中分配展开预算时，未显式评估中间状态的信息效用，导致计算资源浪费在低价值状态上。
Method: 提出IGRPO，通过节点级信息增益实现预算感知的树状展开，使信息更丰富的分支更频繁地展开，并利用信息增益导出限制教师分布，将自适应树状探索与策略优化统一在同一框架下。
Result: 在七个挑战性搜索增强问答基准上，IGRPO在相同展开预算下一致优于强基线，验证了利用教师分布指导策略优化的有效性。
Conclusion: IGRPO通过信息增益引导树状展开和策略优化，提升了多轮LLM智能体在长时域搜索任务中的效率。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出信息增益引导的展开策略优化（IGRPO），一种自适应树状展开框架，用于多轮LLM智能体在长时域搜索任务中的强化学习。IGRPO根据节点信息增益分配展开预算，优先探索高信息价值分支，并导出显式的限制教师分布来统一策略优化。在七个搜索增强问答基准上，IGRPO在相同预算下持续优于强基线。

papers.title: EeveeDark: A Binary Neural Framework for Low-Light Video Enhancement via Event-Guided Sensor-Level Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Enhancing videos under extreme low-light conditions remains challenging due to the difficulty of balancing restoration quality and computational efficiency in resource-constrained settings. This paper introduces EeveeDark, a low-light video enhancement framework that combines the spatial richness of sensor-level RAW data with the temporal precision of event streams. Central to our model is a Binary Neural Network (BNN) architecture that reduces computational overhead by quantizing weights and activations while preserving detail. EeveeDark incorporates (i) modality-specific binary encoders for processing RAW frames and event data, (ii) a lightweight fusion block for integrating spatial and temporal cues, and (iii) an event-guided skip gating mechanism for dynamic spatiotemporal refinement. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that EeveeDark outperforms prior BNN-based methods and offers a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off compared to full-precision models. The project page is available at https://cyberiada.github.io/EeveeDark.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, vol. 11, no. 4, pp. 4633-4640, Apr. 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出EeveeDark框架，结合RAW图像的空间丰富性和事件流的时间精度，使用二值神经网络（BNN）实现低光视频增强。模型包括模态特定二值编码器、轻量融合模块和事件引导的跳跃门控机制，在合成和真实数据集上优于先前BNN方法，并在性能-效率权衡上接近全精度模型。
Motivation: 极低光条件下的视频增强在资源受限场景中难以平衡恢复质量和计算效率。
Method: 采用BNN架构量化权重和激活值，包含RAW帧和事件数据的模态特定二值编码器、轻量融合模块以及事件引导的跳跃门控机制用于时空精细化。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，EeveeDark优于先前基于BNN的方法，并与全精度模型相比提供有利的性能-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 证明了传感器级RAW数据和事件流融合结合BNN在低光视频增强中的有效性。

papers.title: MoWorld: A Flash World Model
papers.abstract_en: The future of World Models depends not only on scaling model capability, but also on scaling practicality and inference efficiency. High-frame-rate inference enables responsive perception, planning, and control in real-world autonomous systems. To this end, we present MoWorld, a cost-effective yet high-performance Flash World Model with an end-to-end framework spanning data generation, pre-training, distillation, and efficient inference, enabling up to 50 FPS real-time interaction with cinematic visual quality without the need of high-end GPUs. To enable large-scale real-world deployment, MoWorld jointly optimizes model capability and cost throughout the entire development pipeline. Specifically, unlike existing approaches that primarily rely on large-scale video corpora, MoWorld is built upon a scalable 3D-native data engine accumulated from our large-scale 3D vision and generative modeling pipeline, enabling the efficient construction of geometrically consistent training data across diverse real-world and synthetic environments. Based on this foundation, a curriculum cross-frame pre-training strategy for stable and scalable World Model learning, an efficient denoising-step distillation algorithm to reduce diffusion training cost, and a mixed-precision parallel inference framework for low-cost real-time deployment. MoWorld is the first real-time interactive World Model built on the Neural Processing Unit (NPU) and can achieves up to 50 FPS in such the devices, enabling practical and efficient deployment at scale. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that MoWorld achieves leading performance; notably, its average inference cost is only 30\%-50\% of that of existing World Models, providing a practical foundation for large-scale real-world applications of World Models. We also demonstrate diverse applications of MoWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoWorld 是一个面向实时交互的 Flash 世界模型，通过 3D 原生数据引擎、课程跨帧预训练、去噪步蒸馏和混合精度并行推理，在 NPU 上实现 50 FPS 的实时推理，且推理成本仅为现有模型的 30%-50%。
Motivation: 现有世界模型依赖大规模视频数据且推理成本高，难以在真实自主系统中实现高帧率响应感知、规划与控制。
Method: 提出端到端框架，包含可扩展的 3D 原生数据引擎、课程跨帧预训练、高效去噪步蒸馏算法和混合精度并行推理框架，并在 NPU 上部署。
Result: 在 NPU 上达到 50 FPS 实时交互，推理成本仅为现有世界模型的 30%-50%，综合性能领先。
Conclusion: MoWorld 首次在 NPU 上实现实时交互世界模型，为大规模真实世界应用提供了实用且高效的基础。

papers.title: A toy framework for single and multi-agent human-AI curiosity ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: This paper offers a toy framework for considering curiosity as an ecosystem. First, it suggests that a single agent's inquiry policy (how, when, and why an agent asks a question) depends on how the agent values immediate uncertainty reduction, costs, delayed return, and the value of keeping the question open. A key concept in the framework is that the weights on these decision-related terms can change with experience. For example, a period of cheap, quickly answered questions may change the cost of inquiry on a short timescale and change which kinds of questions the agent is drawn to answer over a longer timescale. Second, these ideas are extended to many agents exploring a shared knowledge landscape, and there the framework tracks inquiry volume, topic diversity, frontier-directed inquiry, redundancy, and reusable knowledge. The result is a conceptual toy framework for studying curiosity ecology and for future efforts towards designing multi-agent AI systems for discovery. It serves as a companion piece for a paper currently under review in Trends in Neurosciences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个概念性的玩具框架，将好奇心视为一种生态系统。对于单个智能体，其提问策略取决于即时不确定性减少、成本、延迟回报和保持问题开放的价值，且这些权重可随经验变化。扩展到多智能体场景，框架跟踪查询量、主题多样性、前沿导向查询、冗余和可重用知识，旨在为未来设计用于发现的多智能体AI系统提供基础。
Motivation: 研究好奇心的生态机制，为设计多智能体AI发现系统提供理论基础。
Method: 提出一个概念性的玩具框架，从单智能体决策权重（如不确定性减少、成本等）扩展到多智能体共享知识景观的动态（如查询量、多样性等）。
Result: 提供了概念框架，但未报告具体实验或数值结果。
Conclusion: 该框架作为概念工具，可用于研究好奇心生态和未来多智能体发现系统的设计，但其本身是理论性的，缺乏实证验证。

papers.title: UBEP: Re-architecting Expert Parallelism Communication Library for Production Superpods
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models on production high-bandwidth superpods, such as NVIDIA's NVL72/576 and Huawei's CloudMatrix384, introduces critical challenges beyond raw interconnect bandwidth. While these systems provide unified global address spaces and high-bandwidth fabrics, their full potential for sparse MoE communication is hindered by three fundamental bottlenecks: (1) Strict execution serialization imposed by coarse-grained Bulk Synchronous Parallel (BSP) orchestration of interdependent communication phases; (2) Prohibitive synchronization overhead that fails to scale alongside high interconnect bandwidth; and (3) Severe load imbalance resulting from distance-agnostic scheduling of irregular token traffic. To eliminate these bottlenecks, we introduce UBEP (Unified-Bus Expert Parallelism), a production-ready communication library that rethinks MoE's All-to-All primitives for modern superpod architectures. Through large scale experiments, UBEP reduces All-to-All latency by up to 52.4% and MoE inference Time Per Output Token (TPOT) by up to 11.1%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对MoE模型在生产级高带宽超级计算节点（如NVIDIA NVL72/576和华为CloudMatrix384）上部署时的通信瓶颈，提出UBEP（Unified-Bus Expert Parallelism）通信库。UBEP重新架构了MoE的All-to-All原语，缓解了BSP执行序列化、同步开销过大和负载不均三大问题。实验表明，UBEP将All-to-All延迟降低最多52.4%，MoE推理TPOT降低最多11.1%。
Motivation: 现有MoE模型在高带宽超级计算节点上部署时，受限于严格的执行序列化、过高的同步开销和距离无关调度导致的负载不均，无法充分利用系统互联带宽和统一全局地址空间。
Method: 提出UBEP通信库，针对现代superpod架构重构MoE的All-to-All通信原语，通过优化通信调度和负载均衡策略消除上述瓶颈。
Result: 在大规模实验中，UBEP将All-to-All延迟降低最多52.4%，MoE推理TPOT降低最多11.1%。
Conclusion: UBEP是一种生产就绪的通信库，能有效提升MoE模型在超级计算集群上的通信效率，尤其适用于高带宽、统一地址空间的superpod架构。

papers.title: Structured-Condensed Prompt Tuning in Vision-Language Models for Fine-grained Image Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained image recognition poses a significant challenge due to the substantial expertise and effort required for manual annotation. Vision-language models (VLMs) like CLIP provide a compelling zero-shot alternative, reducing reliance on extensive labeled data. However, their ability to capture subtle distinctions remains limited, leading to subpar recognition performance. While prompt tuning has proven effective for adapting VLMs, most existing methods treat class labels as isolated, discrete entities, overlooking the rich semantic relationships between them. This oversimplified assumption limits the model's ability to capture hierarchical dependencies and inter-class correlations -- both critical for distinguishing visually similar categories. The problem is especially acute in fine-grained classification, where accurate recognition depends on understanding complex label semantics. To address this, we propose Structured-Condensed Prompt Tuning (SCPT), which enhances semantic structure modeling in prompt learning. Specifically, we introduce Semantic Relation Encoding (SRE) to explicitly model inter-class semantic topology and encode structured label relationships. In parallel, we design a Semantic Condensation loss (ScLoss) to suppress redundant supervision and extract discriminative components from the global semantic space. Together, these components significantly improve semantic alignment and fine-grained discrimination. Extensive experiments on 14 fine-grained benchmarks show that SCPT effectively mitigates semantic ambiguity and achieves state-of-the-art performance in both few-shot and base-to-novel generalization settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构化-浓缩提示调优（SCPT），通过语义关系编码和语义浓缩损失改进视觉语言模型（如CLIP）在细粒度图像识别中的语义对齐能力，在14个基准上取得少样本和base-to-novel泛化设置下的最优性能。
Motivation: 细粒度图像识别因标注成本高而困难，视觉语言模型的零样本能力虽好但难以捕捉细微差异；现有提示调优方法忽视类别间的语义关系，限制了模型对层级依赖和类间相关性的建模。
Method: 提出SCPT，包含语义关系编码（SRE）显式建模类间语义拓扑，以及语义浓缩损失（ScLoss）抑制冗余监督并提取判别性成分。
Result: 在14个细粒度基准上，SCPT在少样本和base-to-novel泛化设置下均达到最先进性能，有效缓解语义模糊。
Conclusion: SCPT通过增强语义结构建模显著提升视觉语言模型在细粒度识别中的判别能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TriA Pipeline: A Large-Scale Automatic Audio Annotation Pipeline For Audio Classification In Specific Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: There are some datasets of varying scales for audio classification (AC) applied to different tasks. However, annotated data is limited for most scenarios, such as domestic environments. To address this challenge, we propose an $\textbf{A}$utomatic $\textbf{A}$udio $\textbf{A}$nnotation Pipeline--TriA Pipeline, which can efficiently convert audio from various scenarios into high-quality training data with audio event annotations. A TriA dataset was constructed with the TriA Pipeline, over 2130 hours of audio covering 431 audio classes. Furthermore, we partitioned a prior-knowledge-guided subset (TriA$_{\mathrm{GK}}$) from TriA and conduct comparative experiments on three domestic AC tasks. Comparing the result on manually annotated data only and that on manually annotated data combines TriA$_{\mathrm{GK}}$, TriA$_{\mathrm{GK}}$ could achieve average relative gains of 3.97% in accuracy and 3.35% in Macro-F1, validating the effectiveness of TriA$_{\mathrm{GK}}$ and the TriA Pipeline.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, accepted for publication in Interspeech 2026. The code is at: https://github.com/huanxian/TriA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TriA Pipeline，一种大规模自动音频标注管道，用于特定场景的音频分类。该管道将各类音频自动转换为带有事件标注的高质量训练数据，基于此构建了包含2130小时、431个音频类别的TriA数据集。在三个家庭音频分类任务上，结合手动标注与先验知识引导的子集TriA_GK，平均相对准确率提升3.97%，Macro-F1提升3.35%。
Motivation: 现有音频分类数据集中，大多数场景（如家庭环境）的标注数据有限，制约了模型性能。
Method: 提出TriA Pipeline自动标注管道，可将多种场景音频高效转换为高质量训练数据，并构建大规模TriA数据集，再从中划分先验知识引导的子集TriA_GK。
Result: 在三个家庭音频分类任务上，手动标注数据结合TriA_GK相比仅用手动标注，平均相对准确率提升3.97%，Macro-F1提升3.35%。
Conclusion: 结果验证了TriA_GK子集及TriA Pipeline的有效性，表明自动标注管道可缓解特定场景下标注数据不足的问题。

papers.title: Revisiting Scene Graph Generation from the Perspective of Detector-Conditioned Reachability
papers.abstract_en: Scene graph generation (SGG) approaches can be broadly classified into detector-based and query-based methods according to their underlying reasoning mechanisms. However, the discrepancy in their predictive behaviors, induced by these distinct mechanisms, has not been systematically analyzed. In this work, we design a controlled experimental setup to examine prediction discrepancies from the perspective of detector-conditioned reachability. The results suggest clear complementary clues. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a Dual-SGG method that consolidates both reasoning mechanisms via a dual-query design, thereby leveraging the complementary predictive behaviors of both detector-based and query-based methods. Extensive experiments on the Visual Genome, Open Images v6, and GQA-200 datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

Motivation: 现有SGG方法中，基于检测器和基于查询的方法预测行为存在显著差异，但该差异尚未被系统分析，缺乏对其互补性的理解。

Result: 在 Visual Genome、Open Images v6 和 GQA-200 三个基准数据集上的实验表明，所提 Dual-SGG 方法有效提升了场景图生成性能。

papers.title: Improving LLM-Generated Process Model Quality Through Reinforcement Learning: The Role of Reward Function Design
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate BPMN process models from natural-language descriptions, yet supervised fine-tuning (SFT) limits their output quality to the patterns present in the training data. Reinforcement learning (RL) can optimize beyond this ceiling using external quality measures, but how the reward function should be designed when quality is multi-dimensional remains unexplored. We present a systematic investigation of reward function design for RL-based process model generation, training two LLM families (Llama~3.1 8B, Qwen~2.5 14B) under 48 configurations using Group Sequence Policy Optimization with rewards derived from an automated evaluation framework comprising 38 metrics across syntactic, pragmatic, and semantic quality. Three findings emerge. First, RL significantly improves pragmatic and syntactic quality while preserving semantic fidelity, reducing output variability by more than sixfold. Second, equal reward weighting consistently outperforms targeted weighting: emphasizing a specific dimension fails to improve it and can collapse the model into a low-quality mode. Third, design choices interact with model architecture in non-trivial ways: the invalidity penalty is essential for one model but irrelevant for the other, and SFT initialization is indispensable for one architecture but counterproductive for another. These results demonstrate that reward composition is a primary determinant of optimization outcomes, with effects as large as the decision to apply RL itself. The findings generalize to any structured generation task where quality is assessed along multiple automated dimensions. We release our implementation and experimental code at https://github.com/chlauer99/RL_for_process_modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了强化学习（RL）中奖励函数设计对LLM生成BPMN过程模型质量的影响。基于Llama 3.1 8B和Qwen 2.5 14B两种模型，在48种配置下使用Group Sequence Policy Optimization进行训练，奖励来源于涵盖语法、语用和语义质量的38个指标的自动评估框架。主要发现：RL显著提升语用和语法质量，语义保真，输出变异性降低六倍以上；等权奖励优于针对特定维度的加权奖励；奖励设计与模型架构存在复杂交互。
Motivation: 监督微调（SFT）将LLM输出质量限制在训练数据模式内，而RL可通过外部质量指标突破这一上限，但多维质量下奖励函数如何设计尚不明确。
Method: 使用Group Sequence Policy Optimization算法，基于包含38个指标的自动评估框架设计奖励函数，在Llama 3.1 8B和Qwen 2.5 14B上测试48种配置（含不同奖励加权、无效惩罚、SFT初始化等）。
Result: RL显著提升语用和语法质量，语义保真，输出变异性降低六倍以上；等权奖励持续优于针对特定维度的加权奖励；无效惩罚对Qwen模型必要但对Llama不必要，SFT初始化对Llama不可或缺但对Qwen适得其反。
Conclusion: 奖励组成是优化结果的首要决定因素，其效果与应用RL本身相当；这些发现可推广至任何多维度自动评估的结构化生成任务。

papers.title: MobileWan: Closing the Quality Gap for Mobile Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video diffusion have been driven by scaling transformer-based architectures to billions of parameters, substantially improving visual fidelity and motion coherence. In contrast, existing mobile video diffusion models remain limited to relatively small parameter budgets, typically 0.4-1.8B, restricting generation quality. In this work, we show that high-quality mobile video generation does not require small models. Instead, we demonstrate that a server-scale 5B-parameter video diffusion transformer can be deployed efficiently on memory-constrained mobile hardware through recurrent reformulation and structured compression. Starting from Wan2.2-5B, we rely on a recurrence distillation framework that converts video generation into a chunk-wise autoregressive process with constant-memory attention computation. Combined with causal linear attention, the model operates as an RNN at inference time while preserving temporal coherence across chunks. We further propose a learnable attention head pruning method based on binary per-head gates optimized end-to-end using a noise-biased sparsity objective and distillation-based finetuning. Together with sampling-step distillation and memory-optimized VAE decoding, MobileWan becomes the first 5B-scale video diffusion model deployable on a commercial mobile device. Our system generates 5-second 480x832 videos at 16 FPS in 20 seconds end-to-end latency, achieving a VBench score of 83.79 and establishing a new state of the art in mobile video generation. Project page: https://qualcomm-ai-research.github.io/mobilewan
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MobileWan，一种5B参数规模的视频扩散模型，通过循环蒸馏框架和结构化压缩，首次实现在商用移动设备上高效部署。模型采用分块自回归生成和因果线性注意力，结合可学习的注意力头剪枝和采样步蒸馏，在VBench上达到83.79分，生成5秒480x832视频仅需20秒端到端延迟。
Motivation: 现有移动视频扩散模型受限于小参数量（0.4-1.8B），生成质量不足；而服务器级大模型无法在内存受限的移动硬件上部署。
Method: 基于Wan2.2-5B，通过循环蒸馏框架将视频生成转化为分块自回归过程，结合因果线性注意力实现常数内存计算；提出基于噪声偏置稀疏目标和蒸馏微调的可学习注意力头剪枝方法，并配合采样步蒸馏和内存优化VAE解码。
Result: 在商用移动设备上，5秒480x832视频生成端到端延迟20秒（16 FPS），VBench得分83.79，达到移动视频生成新最优。
Conclusion: 该方法证明高质量移动视频生成不一定需要小模型，通过循环重构和结构化压缩可使5B参数模型在移动设备上高效运行。

papers.title: When do prophets profit in prediction markets?
papers.abstract_en: Prediction markets aggregate dispersed beliefs into prices that act as probabilistic forecasts of uncertain events. Classical theory establishes a clean equivalence between forecasting accuracy and trading profit, but only for the specific automated market maker (AMM) design. However, the largest exchanges today are based on central limit order books in which informed forecasters routinely lose money while uninformed strategies can profit on simple heuristics. We resolve this discrepancy by establishing a formal equivalence between predictive accuracy and profitability. For any strictly proper scoring rule $S$, we exhibit a "proper" betting strategy that depends only on the forecaster's prediction $\mathbf{p}$ and the market price $\mathbf{q}$, and earns positive expected profit whenever $\mathbf{p}$ outperforms $\mathbf{q}$ under $S$ and the market has sufficient liquidity. Moreover, this proper betting is essentially the only strategy with such robust profitability guarantee. The proof rests on a decomposition of expected profit that strictly generalizes the classical AMM guarantee and also explains how strategies can profit without an accuracy edge. Empirically, across thousands of forecasts by AI models, proper betting is the only strategy that reliably converts accuracy into profit, and we further identify systematic forecasting personas and show how the optimal proper strategy varies across them. A month-long live deployment on Kalshi achieves $+80.33\%$ return on investment with a Sharpe ratio of $3.35$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在预测市场中建立了预测准确性与盈利能力之间的形式化等价关系，提出一种仅依赖于预测者信念和市场价格的“proper”下注策略，并证明其在严格适当评分规则下能确保正期望利润，同时该策略是唯一具有此类稳健盈利保证的策略。实证部分使用AI模型数千次预测，仅proper下注能可靠地将准确性转化为利润，并在Kalshi平台为期一个月的实盘部署中获得+80.33%投资回报和3.35夏普比率。
Motivation: 经典理论仅对特定自动做市商（AMM）建立预测准确性与交易利润的等价关系，而当前主流交易所采用中央限价订单簿，知情预测者常亏损，非知情策略却能通过简单启发式盈利。本文旨在弥合这一矛盾。
Method: 对于任意严格适当评分规则S，构造一个仅依赖预测者信念p和市场报价q的“proper”下注策略，该策略在p优于q（按S衡量）且有足够流动性时获得正期望利润，并证明此类策略是唯一的。分析基于期望利润的分解，推广了经典AMM保证。
Result: 在AI模型的数千次预测中，仅proper下注策略可靠地将准确性转化为利润。在Kalshi的一个月实盘部署中实现+80.33%投资回报率和3.35夏普比率。同时识别出系统性的预测人格特征，并展示最优proper策略如何随其变化。
Conclusion: 研究表明，无论市场机制如何，只要使用严格适当评分规则，总存在一种下注策略将预测准确性转化为利润，且该策略本质唯一。实证验证了其有效性，并揭示了不同预测者类型的策略差异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: X-FEMR: A Token-level Explainable Approach for Electronic Health Records Foundation Models using Transformer-based Models
papers.abstract_en: Foundation Models for Electronic Health Records (FEMRs) are pretrained on large-scale structured patient data, enabling them to convert longitudinal patient trajectories into generalizable representations for diverse clinical prediction tasks. Despite their effectiveness, FEMRs remain black-box models, raising concerns about bias, interpretability, and clinical trust. To address this, we propose the first token-level explainability approach for FEMRs. We train a Transformer-based surrogate model on input-output pairs from the FEMR across two prediction tasks, approximating its behavior while preserving temporal dynamics. We identify the most influential tokens, providing insights into how FEMRs leverage different aspects of patient history for predictions. To evaluate clinical relevance, we introduce a novel clinical alignment metric that quantifies the correspondence between the surrogate model's key tokens and clinically validated features. Our results demonstrate that the surrogate closely approximates FEMR predictions and that token-level explanations align well with clinical knowledge, offering a practical framework for interpretable and trustworthy clinical AI.
papers.comment: Accepted by IJCAI-ECAI 2026 AI and Health Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电子健康记录基础模型（FEMRs）的黑箱问题，提出首个基于Transformer的代理模型，以token级解释FEMR的预测行为。通过两个预测任务训练代理模型，识别最影响预测的token，并引入临床对齐度量评估解释的临床相关性。实验表明代理模型能近似FEMR预测，且token级解释与临床知识一致。
Motivation: FEMRs在临床预测中表现优异但缺乏可解释性，导致临床信任不足和潜在的偏见问题。现有可解释性方法多为模型级或特征级，无法捕捉细粒度的时间动态。
Method: 训练一个Transformer代理模型，使用FEMR在两项预测任务上的输入-输出对，通过蒸馏方式近似FEMR行为；然后基于代理模型识别最重要的token（即患者轨迹中的关键事件），并设计临床对齐度量来评估解释的临床有效性。
Result: 摘要声称代理模型能紧密近似FEMR预测，且token级解释与临床知识有良好对齐，为可解释临床AI提供了实用框架。
Conclusion: 本文的token级可解释方法提高了FEMR的透明度，有助于建立临床信任，但方法依赖于代理模型近似，可能存在信息损失。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: High-Resolution Artwork Outpainting with Global Blueprint Guidance and Layout Control
papers.abstract_en: Image outpainting extends an image beyond its original borders, requiring seamless style integration and globally coherent scene completion. Building on the success of diffusion models, recent methods have achieved substantial improvements in visual quality. In practice, however, high-resolution outpainting is commonly performed via progressive expansion around a fixed source image, particularly in artwork scenarios. Despite this progress, existing approaches still suffer from three key limitations: (i) the absence of a reliable global planning mechanism, which leads to structural instability and error accumulation at high resolutions; (ii) limited spatial controllability beyond text prompts, making it difficult to place objects at user-specified locations; and (iii) high inference latency caused by inherently sequential patch generation. To address these issues, we propose a global blueprint-guided two-stage diffusion framework for layout-controllable high-resolution outpainting with efficient parallel synthesis. In Stage 1, we generate a low-resolution global blueprint using a layout adapter that injects bounding-box conditions into a Stable Diffusion inpainting backbone, producing a globally consistent structural plan while extracting global guidance features. In Stage 2, we synthesize high-resolution local patches in parallel by injecting the blueprint-derived global guidance and initializing each patch from the blueprint using the low-frequency preservation property of forward diffusion. This design eliminates sequential dependency while maintaining global coherence. Extensive experiments on large-scale artwork datasets demonstrate improved visual fidelity, stronger semantic consistency, and substantially reduced inference time compared to prior baselines, while uniquely supporting explicit layout control for artwork outpainting.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段扩散框架用于高分辨率艺术作品外扩(outpainting)，通过全局蓝图(global blueprint)指导和平行合成实现布局可控。第一阶段利用布局适配器生成低分辨率全局蓝图，第二阶段并行合成高分辨率局部补丁，消除顺序依赖。在大型艺术作品数据集上提升了视觉质量和语义一致性，并显著减少了推理时间。
Motivation: 现有高分辨率外扩方法存在三个关键限制：缺乏可靠的全局规划机制导致高分辨率下结构不稳定和误差累积；超出文本提示的空间可控性有限，难以在用户指定位置放置物体；以及顺序补丁生成导致的高推理延迟。
Method: 提出一个两阶段扩散框架：Stage1使用布局适配器(layout adapter)将边界框条件注入Stable Diffusion修复主干，生成低分辨率全局蓝图并提取全局引导特征；Stage2利用正向扩散的低频保持属性，从蓝图初始化每个补丁，并行合成高分辨率局部补丁，注入蓝图衍生的全局引导。
Result: 在大型艺术作品数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比先前基线提升了视觉保真度和语义一致性，显著缩短了推理时间，并支持显式的布局控制。
Conclusion: 该方法通过全局蓝图引导和并行合成解决了高分辨率外扩中的结构稳定性、空间可控性和推理效率问题，适用于艺术作品外扩场景。

papers.title: LongCrafter: Towards Diverse Long-Context Understanding via Evidence-Graph-Guided Instruction Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing long-context supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data is a scalable way to enhance the long-context understanding of large language models (LLMs), yet existing approaches share three limitations: narrow task coverage, insufficient instruction difficulty, and a lack of faithfulness supervision. We propose \textbf{LongCrafter}, a structured synthesis framework that couples a hierarchical task taxonomy with an evidence-grounded pipeline. The taxonomy organizes long-context understanding into local/shallow and global/deep levels and yields 32 fine-grained task types that serve as a global generative prior. Guided by this taxonomy, LongCrafter constructs task-aligned long contexts, decomposes them into explicit evidence graphs that model cross-paragraph dependencies, and generates instruction--response pairs strictly grounded in the located evidence spans, ensuring both controllable difficulty and faithful, traceable reasoning. Models fine-tuned on LongCrafter data outperform all SFT baselines and even the official post-trained models on LongBench, LongBench~v2, and LooGLE across both Qwen2.5-7B and LLaMA-3.1-8B, with the largest gains on high-difficulty tasks. Further analysis shows that LongCrafter data is more diverse and better spread across difficulty levels, and that the trained models locate evidence robustly regardless of position, effectively mitigating the ``lost in the middle'' problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LongCrafter，一种结构化的长上下文监督微调数据合成框架，通过层次任务分类法和证据图引导的流程生成多样且困难度的指令-响应对。在Qwen2.5-7B和LLaMA-3.1-8B上微调后，模型在LongBench、LongBench v2和LooGLE上超越所有SFT基线和官方后训练模型，尤其在高难度任务上提升显著，并有效缓解了“中间丢失”问题。
Motivation: 现有长上下文SFT数据合成方法存在任务覆盖窄、指令难度不足和缺乏忠实性监督三个局限。
Method: LongCrafter结合层次任务分类法（将长上下文理解分为局部/浅层和全局/深层，生成32种细粒度任务类型）与证据图引导的流水线，构造任务对齐的长上下文，分解为显式证据图建模跨段依赖，并基于证据跨度生成严格忠实、可追踪推理的指令-响应对。
Result: 微调后的模型在LongBench、LongBench v2和LooGLE上全面超越所有SFT基线和官方后训练模型，高难度任务上增益最大；生成数据在难度水平上分布更广，模型能稳健定位证据，缓解“中间丢失”问题。
Conclusion: LongCrafter通过结构化合成方法提升了长上下文理解的数据多样性和指令难度，并确保了推理的忠实性与可追溯性，实验证明其有效性。

papers.title: LLM Agents for Deliberative Collaboration: A Study on Joint Decision Making Under Partial Observability
papers.abstract_en: Deliberation plays a crucial role in collaboration; when humans work together, they naturally engage in communication to align information and reach an agreement. In this paper, we investigate deliberative large language model (LLM) agents under partially observable joint decision-making tasks. We formalize deliberative collaboration as a cooperative joint decision problem with partial and asymmetric observations, and introduce a scalable benchmark that instantiates this problem across multiple task settings and domains in which agents must exchange information through deliberation to reach a joint decision with a shared reward. We then instantiate a reference scaffold and evaluation protocol for deliberative agents and conduct a systematic evaluation of a range of representative LLMs. The results reveal that complex deliberative collaboration tasks continue to challenge state-of-the-art language models. Even with the aid of external mathematical tools, language models may fail in either the deliberation process for aligning information or the complex reasoning process for making the decision. On the other hand, diagnostic analysis reveals that the deliberation process may also provide opportunities for reflection and error correction, sometimes improving performance over centralized baselines. Altogether, our work establishes a foundation for evaluating and improving LLM agents in deliberative collaboration and provides insights into the strengths, limitations, and properties of current LLM-based multi-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）代理在部分可观测协作决策任务中的审慎协作。形式化了审慎协作问题，并引入了一个可扩展基准，涵盖多个任务设置和领域。实验表明复杂审慎协作任务对当前LLM仍有挑战，即使借助外部数学工具也可能失败；但审慎过程有时可提供反思和纠错机会，提升性能。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对LLM代理在部分可观测环境下进行审慎协作的系统评估和基准。
Method: 形式化了审慎协作作为部分可观测联合决策问题，引入了一个可扩展基准，并设计了参考评估框架和协议。
Result: 多个代表LLM在复杂审慎协作任务上表现不佳，但审慎过程有时可以提升性能，优于集中式基线。
Conclusion: 该工作为评估和改进LLM代理的审慎协作能力建立了基础，揭示了当前LLM多智能体系统的优势与局限。

papers.title: Leveraging Extragradient for Effective Sharpness-Aware Minimization in Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Generalization remains a pivotal challenge in deep learning, where traditional optimizers like Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) often converge to sharp minima, leading to overfitting and reduced performance on unseen data. Building on Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM), for seeking flat minima associated with improved generalization, we propose the Extragradient-Inspired Sharpness-Aware Minimization (EISAM), a novel optimizer that enhances generalization via the extragradient technique. EISAM uses a two-step update process: a prediction step investigating the geometry of the loss landscape and a perturbation step that refines updates with a base optimizer. This approach achieves better generalization performance than SAM. Crucially, EISAM reduces sensitivity to the perturbation radius, enhancing robustness, and simplifying the tuning across diverse settings. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that EISAM consistently outperforms SGD, Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam), and SAM in test accuracy and training efficiency across various architectures. Theoretical analysis further confirms that EISAM tightens the generalization bound by steering parameters toward flatter minima with reduced curvature. Accompanied by a thorough hyperparameter analysis, EISAM offers practical tuning guidance, establishing it as a robust, scalable, and broadly applicable optimization solution that advances both the theory and practice in deep learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出外梯度启发的锐度感知最小化（EISAM）优化器，通过两步更新（预测步骤与扰动步骤）改进SAM，降低对扰动半径的敏感性并提升泛化性能。实验表明EISAM在测试准确率和训练效率上优于SGD、Adam和SAM，理论分析证明其收紧泛化界并导向更平坦的极小值。
Motivation: 深度学习泛化问题中，传统优化器易收敛至尖锐极小值导致过拟合，SAM虽能寻找平坦极小值但对扰动半径敏感且调参困难。
Method: 提出Extragradient-Inspired Sharpness-Aware Minimization (EISAM)，包含预测步骤（探查损失景观几何）和扰动步骤（用基础优化器精炼更新），结合外梯度技术与SAM。
Result: 在多个基准数据集和架构上，EISAM的测试准确率和训练效率一致优于SGD、Adam和SAM，且对扰动半径更具鲁棒性。理论分析显示EISAM通过降低曲率收紧泛化界。
Conclusion: EISAM是一种鲁棒、可扩展且广泛适用的优化器，简化了超参数调整，为深度学习训练提供了理论和实践指导。

papers.title: Enhanced Seam Segmentation for Automated Welding Robot in Construction Through Transfer Learning: Addressing Limitations of Bilateral Segmentation Network
papers.abstract_en: Reliable seam segmentation is essential for autonomous robotic welding in construction, where harsh illumination, specular reflections, and thin weld geometries often degrade segmentation performance. This study proposes a reflection-robust seam segmentation framework that enhances a BiSeNetV2 backbone through transfer learning and a hybrid Cross-Entropy--Lovász loss. Rather than increasing architectural complexity, the proposed framework improves reflection robustness through learning-stability-oriented optimization. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves 81.76\% Joint IoU and 90.73\% mIoU, improving Joint IoU by +22.36 percentage points over the OHEM-based baseline while maintaining identical FLOPs, parameter count, and inference speed. The proposed approach also recovers 96.33\% of severe zero-IoU failure cases under reflective conditions. Comparative experiments across BiSeNetV2, DeepLabV3+, UNet, and SegFormer further demonstrate that the proposed optimization strategy is particularly effective for lightweight real-time segmentation architectures. Qualitative analyses additionally show improved seam continuity and reflection robustness in challenging welding environments. These findings suggest that the proposed framework provides a practical and lightweight perception solution for robotic welding applications involving reflective metallic surfaces.

TL;DR: 本研究针对建筑自动化焊接机器人在恶劣光照、镜面反射和薄焊缝条件下的焊缝分割难题，提出一种反射鲁棒的分割框架。该框架通过迁移学习和混合交叉熵-Lovász损失增强BiSeNetV2骨干网络，在不增加计算复杂度的前提下提升分割性能。实验表明，该方法在反射条件下Joint IoU达到81.76%，mIoU达到90.73%，相比基线提升22.36个百分点，并恢复96.33%的严重零IoU失败案例。
Motivation: 现有焊缝分割方法在建筑焊接环境中常因强光照、镜面反射和薄工件几何而性能下降，亟需一种轻量且鲁棒的分割方案以支持自动焊接机器人。
Method: 提出基于BiSeNetV2的改进框架，采用迁移学习（预训练权重）和混合损失函数（交叉熵+Lovász损失）来增强反射鲁棒性，避免增加模型复杂度。
Result: 在反射条件下取得81.76% Joint IoU和90.73% mIoU，Joint IoU相较OHEM基线提升22.36个百分点，且FLOPs、参数量和推理速度保持不变；同时恢复96.33%的严重零IoU失败案例。与多种轻量级架构比较，该优化策略在实时分割场景下表现最佳。
Conclusion: 所提框架为涉及反射金属表面的机器人焊接提供了实用且轻量的感知方案，可有效改善焊缝连续性和反射鲁棒性。

papers.title: RFHNet: Relational and Frequency-Aware Hashing Network for Large-Scale Fine-Grained Food Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained food image retrieval is a key task in computational gastronomy, with applications in food traceability, dietary monitoring, and smart catering systems. Although hashing-based retrieval is attractive for large-scale search due to its storage efficiency and fast Hamming-distance computation, existing methods often perform poorly in fine-grained food scenarios, where subtle local semantics and frequency-sensitive visual cues are essential. To address this challenge, we propose RFHNet, a cascaded hierarchical hashing network that captures both global structure and fine-grained local details through multi-level representations. RFHNet includes three components: (1) Fine-grained Relation Modeling (FRM) to capture subtle visual differences among similar food components; (2) Multi-Frequency Modulated Fusion (MFMF) to extract informative multi-frequency features; and (3) Hierarchical Semantic Synergy (HSS) to adaptively integrate multi-level representations and generate discriminative hash codes. Experiments on six food-specific benchmarks show that RFHNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art hashing methods, with mAP gains of 4.44\% to 17.20\% at 12 bits. These results validate the effectiveness of RFHNet for large-scale visual food retrieval and smart catering applications. The source code will be released upon publication.

Method: 提出RFHNet，包含三个模块：细粒度关系建模(FRM)捕获相似食物成分间的细微差异，多频率调制融合(MFMF)提取多频特征，分层语义协同(HSS)自适应整合多级表征以生成判别性哈希码。

papers.title: Tuning-Free Latent Diffusion Models for Ultrahigh-Resolution Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Recent diffusion-based generative models have shown impressive performance in image generation and editing. However, due to memory limitations and the high cost of collecting high-resolution training images, existing methods are typically restricted to inputs with linear resolutions below 1K. In contrast, photos captured by modern mobile devices often reach linear resolutions up to 8K, revealing a significant gap between current capabilities and real-world demands. Simply upscaling low-resolution edited results often results in visually enlarged but blurry images that lack fine details. This paper introduces UltraDiffEdit, a novel, tuning-free image editing framework that extends off-the-shelf latent diffusion models (LDMs) to ultrahigh resolutions. UltraDiffEdit employs a multi-scale progressive editing strategy, iteratively blending high-resolution edited content with unedited areas in a coarse-to-fine manner. We employ multi-patch encoding to preserve both edited and unedited visual details within the latent space. To mitigate editing artifacts, our global-local consistency denoising technique consistently integrates edited and unedited latent features, ensuring smooth transition at editing boundaries from the latent representation to the final image. We also introduce a patch-based hybrid sampling approach that captures local, intermediate, and global features, ensuring semantic coherence and enhancing fine detail during denoising. We conduct extensive experiments demonstrating UltraDiffEdit's superior editing quality and flexibility: it can handle image resolutions up to 8K using only a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPU. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/LonglongaaaGo/UltraDiffEdit.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UltraDiffEdit，一种免调优的图像编辑框架，将现成的潜在扩散模型（LDM）扩展到超高分辨率（最高 8K）。通过多尺度渐进编辑、多patch编码、全局-局部一致性去噪和基于patch的混合采样，在单张 RTX 3090 上实现高质量编辑，解决了现有方法受限于 1K 分辨率的问题。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型受限于内存和高分辨率训练数据成本，只能处理 1K 以下线性分辨率，而现代移动设备照片可达 8K，存在巨大差距。简单上采样低分辨率编辑结果会导致模糊、缺乏细节。
Method: 采用多尺度渐进编辑策略，以粗到细方式迭代混合高分辨率编辑内容与未编辑区域；通过多patch编码在潜在空间中保留编辑和未编辑细节；引入全局-局部一致性去噪技术平滑编辑边界；提出基于patch的混合采样捕获局部、中间和全局特征，保证语义一致性和细节增强。
Result: 实验表明，UltraDiffEdit 能处理高达 8K 分辨率图像，仅需单张 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPU，在编辑质量和灵活性上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: UltraDiffEdit 展示了免调优 LDM 在超高分辨率图像编辑中的潜力，通过渐进编辑和一致性技术有效扩展了分辨率范围。

papers.title: Property-Driven Synthetic Data Engineering for Data-Scarce Software Systems: Reflections from the Breast Cancer Domain
papers.abstract_en: Modern software systems increasingly depend on data for analysis, prediction, testing, and decision-making. Yet many important domains, including medicine, safety-critical systems, and regulated industries, lack abundant, shareable, or representative data. Synthetic data generation is often proposed as a remedy, but our experience engineering software for intraoperative radiotherapy (IORT) in breast cancer treatment suggests that synthetic data shifts rather than solves the central engineering problem. The key challenge becomes deciding which properties synthetic data must preserve, how these properties should be elicited from stakeholders, how they can be validated under privacy constraints, and how they evolve. We call this problem property-driven synthetic data engineering. Drawing on a collaboration with oncologists and preliminary experiments with a sensitive IORT dataset, we identify challenges in requirements, validation, privacy, and pipeline evolution. We argue that automated software engineering research should develop methods and tools for eliciting, formalizing, checking, and evolving validity properties for synthetic data in data-scarce software systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出属性驱动的合成数据工程这一概念，指在数据稀缺的软件系统中，核心挑战不再是生成数据本身，而是决定合成数据应保留哪些属性、如何从利益相关者那里获取这些属性、如何在隐私约束下验证它们以及它们如何演化。作者基于与肿瘤学家的合作以及在乳腺癌术中放疗（IORT）领域的初步实验，识别出需求、验证、隐私和流程演化方面的挑战，并呼吁自动化软件工程研究开发相应的方法和工具。
Motivation: 许多重要领域（如医学、安全关键系统和受监管行业）缺乏充足、可共享或代表性的数据，虽然合成数据生成常被提出作为解决方案，但作者在实践中发现合成数据只是转移了核心工程问题，并未解决。
Method: 基于乳腺癌术中放疗（IORT）软件系统的开发经验，通过与肿瘤学家合作和敏感数据集的初步实验，识别出合成数据工程中的关键挑战，并提炼出属性驱动的合成数据工程这一研究方向。
Result: 识别出合成数据工程在需求、验证、隐私和流程演化方面的挑战，并指出这些挑战需要自动化软件工程社区开发方法用于属性（即合成数据必须保留的性质）的获取、形式化、检查和演化。
Conclusion: 作者主张自动化软件工程研究应聚焦于开发支持属性驱动的合成数据工程的方法和工具，以应对数据稀缺软件系统中的数据问题。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Implicit CEST Reconstruction via Physics-Informed Lorentz Encoding
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Pool Chemical Exchange Saturation Transfer (CEST) MRI provides valuable metabolic information but is clinically limited by long acquisition times. Although sparse sampling reduces scanning time, reconstructing high-resolution Z-spectra from limited data remains an ill-posed inverse problem. Conventional interpolation and generic Implicit Neural Rep-resentations (INRs) often lack physical constraints, leading to spectral artifacts and physically invalid signals. To address this, we propose Lorentz Encoding (LE), a physics-informed framework that formulates CEST reconstruction as a self-supervised reconstruction task via implicit continuous coordinate learning. Unlike generic positional encodings, LE regularizes the continuous spectral mapping by projecting sparse coordinates into a physically constrained space governed by a combination of parametric Lorentzian profiles with learnable basis functions. This mechanism effectively reduces noise and enforces consistency with physical models. Experiments on in vivo human brain data demonstrate that LE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Specifically, under a 39-point sampling strategy, LE achieves a PSNR of 57.58 dB and an SSIM of 0.9994. Furthermore, the learned physics-informed encodings form a continuous, geometrically ordered trajectory in the latent space, ensuring accurate quantitative metabo-lite mapping (APT, NOE, MT).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督隐式CEST重建方法Lorentz Encoding (LE)，通过物理约束的连续坐标学习从稀疏采样中重建高分辨率Z谱。在人体脑部数据上，39点采样策略下达到57.58 dB的PSNR和0.9994的SSIM，显著优于现有方法，并确保定量代谢物映射的准确性。
Motivation: 多池化学交换饱和转移（CEST）MRI采集时间长，稀疏采样虽能减少时间但重构高分辨率Z谱是病态逆问题，传统插值和通用隐式神经表示（INR）缺乏物理约束，导致谱伪影和物理无效信号。
Method: 提出Lorentz Encoding (LE) 框架，将CEST重建建模为自监督隐式连续坐标学习任务，利用参数化Lorentzian轮廓与可学习基函数组合的正则化机制，将稀疏坐标投影到物理约束空间中，抑制噪声并增强与物理模型的一致性。
Result: 在体内人脑数据上，39点采样策略下LE达到PSNR 57.58 dB、SSIM 0.9994，显著优于现有方法，且学习到的物理编码在潜空间中形成连续几何有序轨迹，确保准确的定量代谢物映射（APT、NOE、MT）。
Conclusion: 摘要表明Lorentz Encoding通过物理约束有效提升了CEST重建质量，适用于临床快速成像场景。

papers.title: Evaluating Fine-Tuning and Metrics for Neural Decompilation of Dart AOT Binaries
papers.abstract_en: Neural decompilation is increasingly studied as a code-generation problem, yet its evaluation methodology remains underdeveloped for modern languages. We present a systematic empirical study of fine-tuning effectiveness and metric validity for Dart Ahead-of-Time (AOT) neural decompilation. We evaluate six fine-tuned model variants across three base architectures (4B-8B parameters) using three metrics: CodeBLEU, compile@k, and pass@k on a new 154-task HumanEval-Dart benchmark. Our study yields three principal findings grounded in paired task-level statistical tests. First, no fine-tuning configuration produces a statistically significant pass@k improvement. The sole positive case yields +0.71 pp (McNemar p=0.21), while fine-tuning the strongest base (Qwen3-8B) causes a highly significant regression of -5.65 pp (p<0.001). This capacity-dependent trend is consistent across architectures but needs broader scale sweeps. Second, cross-lingual interference from Swift training is highly significant at 4B (-2.66 pp, p<0.001) but statistically indistinguishable from zero at 8B, consistent with the scaling hypothesis. Third, we demonstrate metric divergence: CodeBLEU and compile@k can improve significantly while pass@k moves in the opposite direction. This has implications for any LLM code generation task where fine-tuning targets superficial similarity. Error analysis reveals assembly sequence length is the strongest predictor of task difficulty (p=0.001), with a capability cliff at 200 instructions. We contribute the HumanEval-Dart benchmark, a Dart-adapted CodeBLEU, and empirical evidence that pass@k must be the primary evaluation metric for neural decompilation.
papers.comment: Under review at ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了Dart AOT二进制神经反编译中微调效果和度量有效性，在HumanEval-Dart基准上测试了六个微调变体，发现没有微调配置带来显著的pass@k提升，且CodeBLEU和compile@k与pass@k存在指标分歧。
Motivation: 神经反编译的评估方法不完善，尤其是针对现代语言如Dart，现有度量未能充分反映实际可执行代码的正确性。
Method: 评估了六种微调变体，基于三种基础架构（4B-8B参数），使用CodeBLEU、compile@k和pass@k度量，并进行了配对任务级统计检验。
Result: 无微调配置带来显著pass@k提升；最强的Qwen3-8B微调反而导致-5.65 pp的显著回归（p<0.001）；跨语言干扰在4B时显著（-2.66 pp, p<0.001）而在8B不显著；CodeBLEU和compile@k可能显著改善而pass@k反向变化。
Conclusion: pass@k必须作为神经反编译的主要评估指标，提供了HumanEval-Dart基准和Dart适配的CodeBLEU，并指出汇编序列长度是任务难度的最强预测因子。
