papers.title: Static Metrics Are Insufficient: Predicting Java Method Energy Usage with Execution Time
papers.abstract_en: The increasing energy demand of software systems is raising concerns about their environmental impact and associated costs. Reasoning on energy usage early in the development flow has the potential to significantly reduce the overall energy usage of a software system, as it allows developers to make informed design and refactoring decisions before inefficiencies propagate. However, assessing energy usage without repeated profiling and direct measurement is difficult, which limits early reasoning in practice. This study investigates the limits of method-level energy prediction in Java, examining whether static source code metrics complemented with method-level execution time can estimate the energy consumption of Java methods. We profile 2,786 Java methods to extract 33 static features and measure execution time and energy, then train and compare eleven regression models. Our findings show that static source code metrics alone yield poor predictive performance, with average R2 values close to zero. Incorporating execution time as a lightweight dynamic input significantly improves accuracy, raising R2 to as high as 0.46. Execution time, internal method calls, and cyclomatic complexity consistently emerge as the strongest predictors of energy consumption.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 19th International Conference on the Quality of Information and Communications Technology (QUATIC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本研究调查了Java方法级别能耗预测的局限性，使用2786个Java方法的33个静态特征和执行时间来训练11种回归模型。结果表明仅静态指标预测性能差（R²接近0），加入执行时间后R²最高达0.46，执行时间、内部方法调用和圈复杂度是最强预测因子。
Motivation: 软件系统能耗日益受到关注，早期推理能耗有助于降低环境影响和成本，但缺乏简单方法在没有反复剖析的情况下评估能耗。本文研究静态源码度量是否足以预测Java方法能耗，并探索加入执行时间的效果。
Method: 对2786个Java方法进行剖析，提取33个静态特征并测量执行时间和能耗，训练并比较11种回归模型。
Result: 仅静态源码度量预测性能差（平均R²接近0）；加入执行时间后R²最高达0.46，执行时间、内部方法调用和圈复杂度是最强预测因子。
Conclusion: 摘要强调静态度量不足以预测能耗，而执行时间作为轻量级动态输入显著提高预测精度。

papers.title: AEGIS: A Mechanism-Guided Defense against Visual Synonym Jailbreaks in Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved high visual fidelity and broad adoption, but remain vulnerable to safety violations when adversaries exploit them to synthesize illicit content. Existing alignment paradigms, from input sanitization to structural feature pruning, are largely organized around unsafe concepts explicitly exposed during filtering, editing, or localization. This leaves a blind spot for visual synonym attacks (VSA), a jailbreak where benign-looking prompts elicit prohibited imagery through implicit visual associations. As a result, current defenses face a safety-utility dilemma: they may either under-mitigate VSA threats or over-suppress visually similar benign concepts. The core challenge is that VSA hides the unsafe target at the textual surface while revealing it through generation-time visual-semantic convergence. In this work, we therefore shift from static suppression of pre-specified unsafe concepts to dynamic tracing of how unsafe semantics emerge during generation. Our mechanistic analysis shows that VSA and explicit unsafe prompts converge through sparse semantic-injecting attention heads, which serve as inference-time bottlenecks for prohibited visual semantics. Based on this insight, we propose AEGIS (Adaptive Evasion Guard via Identification and Steering), an inference-time defense that applies similarity-aware repulsion only at the identified vulnerable heads. Evaluated against 16 baselines, AEGIS improves both safety and utility. On SD 1.4, it reduces ASR to $\mathbf{0.00}/\mathbf{0.03}$ for in-domain violence/nudity VSA and achieves ASRs $\le \mathbf{0.09}$ on out-of-domain explicit and adversarial attacks. It preserves benign fidelity, avoids suppressing hard-negative concepts, and transfers to SD 2.1 and FLUX.1 after re-identifying the critical heads for each backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像扩散模型中的视觉同义词攻击（Visual Synonym Attacks, VSA），该攻击通过看似良性的提示生成违规图像。作者通过机制分析发现，VSA与显式违规提示在推理时通过稀疏的语义注入注意力头收敛。基于此，提出推理时防御方法AEGIS，仅在识别出的脆弱注意力头上施加相似性感知排斥。在SD 1.4上，将领域内暴力/色情VSA的攻击成功率降至0.00/0.03，并保持良性提示的保真度，且可迁移至SD 2.1和FLUX.1。
Motivation: 现有防御（输入清理、结构特征剪枝等）主要针对显式违规概念，但对视觉同义词攻击（VSA）存在盲区，后者通过隐式视觉关联绕过防御。核心挑战是VSA在文本表面隐藏违规目标，而在生成时通过视觉-语义收敛暴露。
Method: 提出AEGIS（Adaptive Evasion Guard via Identification and Steering），一种推理时防御：首先识别负责语义注入的脆弱注意力头，然后仅在这些头上应用相似性感知排斥，动态追踪不安全语义的生成过程。
Result: 在16个基线对比中，AEGIS在SD 1.4上将领域内暴力/色情VSA的攻击成功率降至0.00/0.03，对领域外显式攻击和对抗攻击的攻击成功率≤0.09；保持良性保真度，避免抑制难负例概念，并迁移至SD 2.1和FLUX.1。
Conclusion: 防御应从静态抑制预设不安全概念转向动态追踪生成过程中不安全语义的涌现；AEGIS通过识别和引导脆弱注意力头实现安全性与实用性的权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WebRetriever: A Large-Scale Comprehensive Benchmark for Efficient Web Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: As web agents increasingly demonstrate capabilities in automated task execution, the development of robust evaluation frameworks for assessing their navigation and task completion performance has emerged as a critical research priority. However, existing benchmarks exhibit fundamental limitations. First, they suffer from insufficient scale and limited domain diversity, constraining comprehensive evaluation of cross-domain generalization. Second, prevailing LLM-as-Judge evaluation methodologies inadequately capture fine-grained interaction semantics, particularly regarding precise query formulation and filtering operations. Third, current benchmarks predominantly emphasize navigation success metrics while neglecting critical requirements for real-world deployment scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce WebRetriever, a large-scale benchmark encompassing 800 websites and 1,550 tasks across diverse domains, including consumer, professional, and enterprise sectors, with comprehensive coverage of user intent patterns. We propose NavEval (Navigation Evaluation), a novel LLM-as-Judge framework that leverages rich interaction context beyond visual screenshots, achieving state-of-the-art alignment with human judgment across multiple evaluation datasets. Furthermore, we establish three complementary evaluation protocols that collectively provide holistic assessment of web agent capabilities: navigation proficiency, knowledge-assisted interaction, and end-to-end task completion with information extraction. Extensive experimental analysis reveals substantial performance disparities across evaluation protocols, demonstrating that navigation success alone is an insufficient predictor of real-world application effectiveness. WebRetriever delivers fine-grained diagnostic insights into agent capabilities and establishes a rigorous foundation for advancing web agent research and development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WebRetriever，一个包含800个网站和1550个任务的大规模基准，用于评估web agent的导航和任务完成能力。同时提出NavEval评估框架，利用丰富交互上下文（而非仅视觉截图）实现与人类判断的最佳对齐，并建立三种互补评估协议：导航熟练度、知识辅助交互和端到端任务完成。实验表明仅导航成功率不足以预测实际应用效果。
Motivation: 现有web agent基准规模小、领域多样性不足，且LLM-as-Judge评估方法无法捕捉细粒度交互语义，尤其缺乏对精确查询和过滤操作的评估。此外，当前基准过度强调导航成功指标，忽视了真实部署场景的关键需求。
Method: 构建涵盖消费、专业和企业领域800个网站、1550个任务的基准WebRetriever，并提出NavEval评估框架，利用丰富交互上下文（包括查询、过滤等）进行判断。建立三种评估协议：导航熟练度、知识辅助交互和端到端任务完成（含信息提取）。
Result: 实验显示不同评估协议下web agent性能差距显著，证明仅导航成功不足以预测实际应用效果。WebRetriever提供细粒度诊断见解。
Conclusion: WebRetriever为web agent研究提供了大规模、多领域的评估基准，并强调需要多维评估协议来全面衡量agent能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 6G Sensing Security: Distributed Game-Theoretic RL for Urban Beamforming and Attacker Detection
papers.abstract_en: In next-generation networks, communication systems will no longer be limited to data transmission and will be expected to acquire awareness of the surrounding environment. This leads to the concept of integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), where the same wireless infrastructure is used for both communication and environmental sensing. Thus, ISAC enables the system to transmit information efficiently and observe and interpret channel variations and user behavior. Motivated by this capability, this work focuses on detecting an active attacker in an urban environment scenario, where the attacker intentionally manipulates beamforming directions to increase interference and mislead the transmitter into allocating the main lobe of beam toward itself instead of legitimate users. We apply game-theoretic approaches to model the interaction between legitimate users and the attacker, and integrate the resulting utility-based formulation into a reinforcement learning (RL) framework. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively addresses security challenges in dynamic 6G ISAC systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对6G集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统中的主动攻击者检测问题，提出一种基于博弈论和强化学习（RL）的框架。攻击者通过操纵波束赋形方向干扰通信，而合法用户通过博弈策略进行对抗。仿真结果验证了该方法在动态城市环境中的有效性。
Motivation: 6G ISAC系统面临安全威胁，攻击者可利用波束赋形操纵干扰，需设计有效检测机制。
Method: 采用博弈论建模合法用户与攻击者的交互，并将基于效用的公式化整合到强化学习框架中。
Result: 仿真结果显示该方法能有效检测主动攻击者，应对动态环境中的安全挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: x-Prediction Is All You Need:Training-Free Accelerated Generation via Endpoint Decodability
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow matching models generate high-quality samples, but their ODE samplers often need tens to hundreds of neural function evaluations (NFEs). This remains a practical challenge for released checkpoints, since many accelerators require additional design choices and training cost through retraining, distillation, or trajectory redesign. We investigate a different route based on $x$-prediction. During sampling, standard affine probability paths already expose $x_0$ information: an intermediate state and its path velocity determine a principled estimate of the clean sample. We formalize this property as \textbf{endpoint decodability} and show that the decoder is the minimum-MSE estimator $\mathbb{E}[x_0\mid x_t]$ under the usual $\ell_2$ objective. This yields \textbf{Truncated Jump Sampling} (TJS): stop the ODE at an early-exit time $t^*$ and return the decoded $x_0$. TJS requires no retraining, distillation, or architecture change. Across SDXL, SD3.5M, Z-Image-Turbo, and three class-conditional benchmarks, it reduces NFEs by 20--70\% with near-matched quality. The analysis also shows why endpoint prediction can work without straightening the trajectory, providing inference acceleration without trajectory redesign.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出截断跳跃采样（Truncated Jump Sampling, TJS），一种无需重新训练、蒸馏或修改架构的扩散/流匹配模型加速方法。TJS利用x预测的端点可解码性（endpoint decodability），在早期退出ODE并返回解码的x0，在多个图像生成模型上减少20-70%的NFE且质量几乎不变。
Motivation: 扩散和流匹配模型的ODE采样器需要大量NFE，现有加速方法需额外训练或轨迹重设计，缺乏训练无关的通用方案。
Method: 形式化端点可解码性，证明标准仿射概率路径下中间状态和速度可提供x0的最小MSE估计，提出TJS：在早停时间t*截断ODE并返回解码的x0，无需训练或架构变更。
Result: 在SDXL、SD3.5M、Z-Image-Turbo及三个类别条件基准上，TJS减少20-70%的NFE，生成质量与全步数采样几乎匹配。
Conclusion: 端点预测无需矫直轨迹即可加速推理，提供一种无需轨迹重设计的训练无关加速方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LLM-Guided Measurement Credibility Correction for Trustworthy Industrial Process Inference
papers.abstract_en: Industrial prediction and soft sensing depend on credible input measurements. In field deployment, a predictor may receive biased, delayed, stale, or derived measurements that still look plausible. Prediction can then fail before the forecasting backbone becomes the main limitation, because the input window no longer represents the real process. Sensor reconstruction, data reconciliation, and fault-tolerant soft sensing reduce this risk, but they often rely on numerical correlation, alarms, fault labels, or explicit process equations. These assumptions are not always available. A correlated variable can also be an unsafe reference when variables share instruments, derived formulas, soft-sensing chains, or control actions. The key issue is to decide before prediction which external measurements can credibly support the current measurement. To address this issue, this article proposes LLM-Guided Measurement Credibility Correction (MCC). MCC converts measurement meanings in process documents into measurement semantics usable by numerical models. It builds independent process references from semantically qualified external measurements and corrects local measurement conflicts before prediction. The predictor therefore receives a more credible input window. Across multiple complex industrial forecasting and soft-sensing tasks, +MCC achieves average relative MAE reductions of 30.7% on real-test protocols and 80.3% on controlled-corruption protocols. It adds only 0.5--2.0k online parameters, with the slowest +MCC inference time at 0.089 ms/step. These results show that measurement semantics can turn process documents into lightweight pre-inference credibility correction and improve prediction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业过程推理中输入测量可信度问题，提出LLM引导的测量可信度校正方法（MCC）。MCC将过程文档中的测量含义转换为数值模型可用的测量语义，从语义合格的外部测量构建独立过程参考，并在预测前校正局部测量冲突。实验表明，在多个复杂工业预测和软测量任务上，MCC在真实测试协议上平均相对MAE降低30.7%，在受控污染协议上降低80.3%，且增加参数极少，推理延迟极低。
Motivation: 工业预测和软测量依赖可信输入测量，但实际部署中测量可能受偏倚、延迟、陈旧或派生影响而看似合理，导致预测失败。现有方法依赖数值相关性、警报、故障标签或过程方程，这些假设常不成立，且相关变量在共享仪器或派生公式时可能成为不可靠参考。需要一种在预测前判断外部测量可信度的方法。
Method: 提出LLM引导的测量可信度校正（MCC），利用LLM将过程文档中的测量含义转换为测量语义，构建独立过程参考，并校正局部测量冲突。该方法在预测前对输入窗口进行轻量化校正，仅增加0.5-2.0k在线参数。
Result: 在多个工业预测和软测量任务中，+MCC在真实测试协议上平均相对MAE降低30.7%，在受控污染协议上降低80.3%，最慢推理时间为0.089 ms/步。
Conclusion: 测量语义可将过程文档转化为轻量级预推理可信度校正，有效提升预测准确性，且计算开销极小。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: RoME: Robust Mixture of Low-Rank Experts against Multiple Adversarial Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Multi-perturbation adversarial training (MAT) aims to achieve robustness against multiple $\ell_p$ perturbations but suffers from robustness trade-offs between different threats. To address this, we employ a mixture of experts (MoE) to route different threats through distinct model pathways. However, naive application of MoE encounters two critical challenges: experts tend to overlook threat-specific features and redundantly capture features shared across threats, and gating networks suffer from threat-agnostic routing where they learn nearly identical routing patterns across threats, thus preventing the construction of threat-specific model pathways. To this end, we propose Robust Mixture of Low-Rank Experts (RoME), where each expert is a low-rank additive update to the shared backbone, allowing it to capture threat-common features while experts focus on threat-specific information. To address threat-agnostic routing, RoME introduces (i) dual-scale gating that exploits threat-discriminative signals from local and global level features, and (ii) threat-guided gating diversification that enforces diverse expert utilization across threats. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RoME outperforms existing state-of-the-art MAT in union robustness and natural accuracy and improves robustness against unseen threats. Codes are available at https://github.com/wkim97/RoME.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出鲁棒混合低秩专家模型（RoME），用于多扰动对抗训练。RoME 通过低秩专家更新共享骨干网络，使专家专注于威胁特定特征，同时引入双尺度门控和威胁引导的门控多样化策略，解决专家冗余和门控路由对威胁不敏感的问题。实验表明 RoME 在多个扰动下的联合鲁棒性和自然准确率上超越了现有方法。
Motivation: 多扰动对抗训练（MAT）在不同 ℓ_p 扰动间存在鲁棒性权衡，而直接应用混合专家模型（MoE）会导致专家忽视威胁特定特征、门控网络学习到几乎相同的路由模式。
Method: RoME 将每个专家作为共享骨干的低秩加性更新，使其捕获威胁共性同时聚焦特异性特征；并采用双尺度门控（利用局部和全局特征中的威胁判别信号）以及威胁引导的门控多样化（强制不同威胁下专家利用率不同）。
Result: 在多个基准上，RoME 在联合鲁棒性和自然准确率上均优于现有最强MAT方法，并提升了对于未见威胁的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: RoME 通过低秩专家和针对性门控机制有效缓解了多扰动对抗训练中的鲁棒性权衡问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EcoVision: AI-Powered Drone Imaging for Salt Marsh Vegetation Monitoring and Dominance Mapping
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution RGB imagery acquired from low-altitude UAV surveys was processed through a modular pipeline incorporating transformer-based semantic segmentation, connected-component vegetation extraction, fine-grained species classification using a ConvNeXt architecture, and grid-based dominance scoring at 2x2m resolution. The framework targeted two ecologically significant halophytic grasses, Spartina maritima and Puccinellia maritima, and was trained using a curated and manually annotated UAV imagery, along with biodiversity imagery sourced from publicly accessible datasets. In order to identify these plants from the imagery, our segmentation yielded reliable species masks (mean IoU = 0.56; pixel-level accuracy = 0.96), while object-level classification achieved very good discrimination (F1 = 0.99). Dominance estimates closely matched quadrat-based field surveys, with mean absolute differences below 8%, preserving fine-scale spatial structure under realistic survey conditions. The developed system, named EcoVision, establishes a practical foundation for scalable, high-resolution salt marsh monitoring, demonstrating how AI-driven workflows can translate pixel-level predictions into ecologically interpretable metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EcoVision，一个基于无人机的AI驱动管道，用于盐沼植被监测和优势种制图。该管道融合了基于Transformer的语义分割、连通组件植被提取、ConvNeXt架构的细粒度物种分类以及2x2m网格优势度评分，针对Spartina maritima和Puccinellia maritima两种盐生草。摘要报告分割平均IoU为0.56，像素精度0.96，目标级分类F1为0.99，优势度估计与实地调查的平均绝对差异低于8%。
Motivation: 传统盐沼植被监测依赖耗时的人工实地调查，难以覆盖大范围和高分辨率。现有遥感方法在物种级分类和生态可解释指标方面存在不足。
Method: 构建模块化管道：使用Transformer进行语义分割，连通组件提取植被区域，ConvNeXt架构进行物种分类，最后通过2x2m网格进行优势度评分，将像素级预测转化为生态指标。
Result: 语义分割平均IoU=0.56，像素精度0.96；目标级物种分类F1=0.99；优势度估计与实地调查的平均绝对差异低于8%，保持了精细空间结构。
Conclusion: EcoVision为可扩展、高分辨率的盐沼监测提供了实用基础，展示了AI工作流将像素预测转化为生态可解释指标的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agents That Teach: Towards Designing Incidental Learning Back into AI-Assisted Software Development
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are rapidly reshaping how software is built, with developers increasingly delegating substantial coding tasks to autonomous agents in pursuit of higher productivity. While these gains are real, they come at the cost of incidental learning. Developers historically acquired informal knowledge through effortful problem-solving, and this has long shaped how software engineering expertise develops. However, with over-reliance on agentic coding, unpracticed skills could atrophy silently over time. As this learning pathway is short-circuited, developers risk silently accruing Knowledge Debt, a developer-level analogue of Technical Debt, where changes the agent executes that the developer cannot fully understand accrue over time. In this paper, we argue that incidental learning will not re-emerge on its own and must be consciously designed back into developer-agent interactions, and propose six design principles to guide such systems. We then present "SHIELD", a multi-agent system grounded in the notion of "agents that teach", that operationalizes these principles by leveraging the AI coding agent's own reasoning to surface contextual, out-of-band learning moments without disrupting developer flow. Through this work, we envision a path toward learning-aware development environments where productivity and learning are complementary, not competing.
papers.comment: 5 pages. To be published in the proceedings of 41st International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE '26), October 12-16, 2026, Munich, Germany (New Ideas and Emerging Results Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨AI编码代理对开发者隐性学习（incidental learning）的负面影响，提出“知识债务”（Knowledge Debt）概念，并设计基于“代理即教师”理念的多代理系统SHIELD，通过利用AI编码代理的推理过程在开发者工作流中嵌入非干扰性学习时刻。
Motivation: 开发者过度依赖AI编码代理完成编码任务，导致通过努力解决问题获取的隐性学习路径被阻断，技能可能逐渐萎缩，累积知识债务。
Method: 提出六个设计原则指导开发者-代理交互，并实现SHIELD系统：一个多代理系统，利用AI编码代理自身的推理能力在适当情境下提供上下文相关的离题学习机会，且不打断开发者工作流。
Result: 论文未报告实验数据或量化结果，仅提出概念框架和系统设计。
Conclusion: 认为隐性学习不会自动恢复，需要有意设计进开发环境；SHIELD系统旨在使生产力与学习互补而非竞争。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PVCap: Towards Accurate 3D Dense Captioning via PseudoCap and VoxelCapNet
papers.abstract_en: 3D dense captioning, an emerging vision-language task, aims to generate descriptive sentences for each object in the 3D scene. Despite the impressive results achieved by previous methods, they suffer from two limitations. First, current research often employs global rigid transformations, such as rotation, to augment scenes without changing their spatial layouts. However, diverse spatial layouts are crucial for training a 3D dense captioning model to describe spatial relations between objects. Second, previous works mainly focus on the design of the caption generation pipeline while utilizing a simple network architecture for other components, i.e., backbone and detection head, which is crucial for extracting rich semantic information for captioning. In this paper, we propose PVCap to alleviate the aforementioned problems. Our PVCap consists of PseudoCap and VoxelCapNet. Specifically, PseudoCap employs a random mixing technique on instances within the dataset, generating numerous pseudo frames with diverse spatial layouts at the instance level. By utilizing a teacher-student framework, PseudoCap obtains pseudo caption labels for these pseudo frames. This data augmentation approach significantly increases the number of training samples and enhances the model's ability to describe the environment effectively. Regarding VoxelCapNet, we introduce a robust caption network that utilizes voxel features and adapts the caption head to the voxel-based network architecture. Our VoxelCapNet can serve as a competitive baseline for future research on 3D dense captioning. Extensive experiments are conducted on two prevalent benchmarks, i.e., ScanRefer and Nr3D. Notably, our method surpasses current state-of-the-art by 11.41% and 13.99% in CIDEr@0.5IoU, respectively. Codes will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PVCap，通过 PseudoCap 数据增强（实例级随机混合生成多样空间布局的伪帧，结合教师-学生框架获取伪字幕标签）和 VoxelCapNet（基于体素特征的字幕网络）来提升3D密集字幕任务的性能。在 ScanRefer 和 Nr3D 基准上，该方法在 CIDEr@0.5IoU 指标上分别超越当前最优方法 11.41% 和 13.99%。
Motivation: 现有3D密集字幕方法存在两个局限：一是数据增强仅采用全局刚性变换，未能提供多样的空间布局来学习物体间空间关系；二是网络结构过于简单，尤其是 backbone 和检测头，限制了语义信息提取。
Method: 提出 PVCap，包含两个组件：PseudoCap 采用实例级随机混合生成伪帧，并通过教师-学生框架获得伪字幕标签，实现数据增强；VoxelCapNet 引入基于体素特征的 caption head 以适应 voxel 网络架构，作为更强的基线。
Result: 在 ScanRefer 和 Nr3D 基准上，CIDEr@0.5IoU 分别提升 11.41% 和 13.99%，超越当前最优方法。
Conclusion: PVCap 通过有效的数据增强和更强大的 caption 网络，显著提升了3D密集字幕的准确性，且 VoxelCapNet 可作为未来研究的竞争性基线。

papers.title: Modeling Normal Is All You Need: Joint Latent Clustering for Anomaly Detection in Multimodal Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Faults on a cyber-physical system (CPS) are too rare and unrepresentative to characterise, or even to select a model on, so detection must instead model normal behaviour; the standard point-adjusted evaluation, however, rewards detectors that never do. CPS normal behaviour is the union of many imbalanced, curved, thin-fringed operating regimes rather than a single blob; we state this structure as ten assumptions (A1-A10), abbreviated Massive, Implicit, Imbalanced Multimodality (MIIM). We model the normal law with a jointly learned latent representation plus explicit Gaussian-mixture mode clustering, scored in the latent rather than by a global density or a reconstruction residual, and evaluate under a deliberately fair protocol: raw point-wise metrics with no point adjustment, a trivial-detector difficulty split, prevalence-matched F1, and train-normal-only calibration. On three real CPS datasets (WADI, HAI, SKAB), the detector wins both the combined column and the difficult correlation/dynamics-fault column on all three, reaching difficult-subset AUROC 0.831 on HAI, 0.726 on WADI, and 0.610 on SKAB. The margin is largest on the two multimodal datasets the MIIM assumptions target and slimmest on the near-unimodal one, tracking multimodality as the thesis predicts, and it holds against three deep detectors (USAD, TranAD, GDN) re-computed with the same raw metrics, all of which collapse on the difficult subset. The methodological contributions are the MIIM assumption set, the difficulty-stratified fair protocol, and a latent-only score that drops reconstruction because a flexible decoder rebuilds the hard faults faithfully.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态信息物理系统(CPS)中的异常检测问题，提出基于联合潜在聚类的方法。作者假设CPS正常行为由多个非均衡、弯曲、薄边缘的运行模态组成（MIIM假设），通过联合学习潜在表示和显式高斯混合聚类来建模正常模式，并在潜在空间中进行异常评分。在WADI、HAI、SKAB三个真实数据集上，采用公平的逐点指标（无点调整、难度分层、匹配F1等）评估，该方法在困难子集上AUROC分别达到0.831、0.726、0.610，优于USAD、TranAD和GDN等深度检测器。
Motivation: 标准异常检测评价中的点调整方法会奖励从不报警的检测器，而CPS的正常行为是多模态的（MIIM），并非单一团块，现有方法难以处理这种结构。
Method: 提出联合潜在表示与显式高斯混合聚类，在潜在空间进行异常评分，放弃重构误差；同时引入MIIM假设集和难度分层的公平评估协议。
Result: 在WADI、HAI、SKAB数据集上，困难子集AUROC分别为0.726、0.831、0.610，且在多模态数据集上优势更显著；对比的USAD、TranAD、GDN在困难子集上均失效。
Conclusion: MIIM假设集、难度分层公平协议和仅潜在评分是主要贡献，丢弃重构因为灵活解码器能忠实重构困难故障，从而削弱检测能力。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Closed-form fractional radial links for elliptical Mahalanobis discriminant analysis
papers.abstract_en: We study binary classification under shared-generator elliptical class-conditional distributions. The log-likelihood ratio is an additive function of the two squared Mahalanobis radii, with radial link $\varphi=\log g$; QDA is recovered only when this link is affine. We derive the Bayes radial-link family from the within-class radius law and estimate it by a finite fractional-power stochastic-polynomial projection instead of tuning a generic spline. The link is identifiable from the radius law, the plug-in estimator is $\sqrt{n}$-consistent and asymptotically normal under finite-moment regularity conditions, and the induced classifier is asymptotically Bayes-optimal in an iterated sieve limit. The structural bridge, GAM membership, and identity-link/affine-generator dichotomy are verified in Lean 4 without unproven placeholders. Against the global Mahalanobis-GAM of Ghosh et al. (2025), reimplemented with mgcv REML splines at equal input budget, the derived link is never significantly worse on three UCI benchmarks and is decisively better on breast_cancer ($[+0.009,+0.021]$ global, $[+0.109,+0.136]$ global+local). Across six real financial series under temporal-dependence-robust validation, it is never significantly worse than the fitted GAM and is significantly better on three of five heavy-tailed series plus the light-tailed control. Relative to QDA, it improves the heaviest-tailed series (oil $[+0.024,+0.070]$, S&P 500 $[+0.038,+0.126]$, JPY/USD $[+0.009,+0.047]$) and ties elsewhere. A closed-form rate simulation corroborates the $\sqrt{n}$ rate and the predicted excess-risk dichotomy between QDA's approximation-limited floor and the derived link's vanishing excess risk. The contribution is no significant loss relative to a tuned global GAM without spline smoothing-parameter selection, plus improved accuracy over QDA where generator curvature matters.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 2 figures. Lean 4/Mathlib formalization of the structural bridge, GAM membership and identity-link/affine-generator dichotomy (0 sorry) and full reproduction code at https://github.com/SZabolotnii/DSGE-MV_Elliptical_LLR-code-supplement
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究二元分类问题，假设共享生成器的椭圆类条件分布，提出了一个闭式分数径向链接方法用于椭圆马氏距离判别分析。通过有限分数幂随机多项式投影来估计径向链接，证明了估计量的√n一致性和渐近正态性，分类器在迭代筛极限下渐近贝叶斯最优。在UCI基准和金融时间序列上，与全局马氏GAM方法相比没有显著劣势，在重尾分布上表现更好。
Motivation: 现有方法如二次判别分析（QDA）仅在径向链接为仿射函数时最优，而更一般的径向链接需要非参数平滑样条估计，存在平滑参数选择问题。
Method: 从类内半径定律导出贝叶斯径向链接族，并通过有限分数幂随机多项式投影进行估计，而非调整通用样条。
Result: 在三个UCI基准上，所提方法从未显著差于全局马氏GAM；在乳腺癌数据集上全局提升0.009-0.021，全局+局部提升0.109-0.136。在六组金融时间序列上，对于重尾序列及轻尾控制序列，显著优于GAM。相对于QDA，在重尾序列如石油、标普500、日元/美元上有显著提升（分别提升0.024-0.070、0.038-0.126、0.009-0.047）。
Conclusion: 该方法无需样条平滑参数选择，与调参的全局GAM相比没有显著损失，且在生成曲率重要时相比QDA提高了精度。

papers.title: MSA-DCNN: A Data-Efficient Multi-Scale Deformable CNN for Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Existing deep learning methods perform well in medical image classification but struggle with multi-scale morphology and limited annotations due to fixed sampling and data-hungry training. Existing approaches address these challenges in isolation: DCN-based models provide adaptive sampling but lack explicit multi-scale attention fusion and label-efficient regularisation; multi-scale architectures typically rely on static fusion; and semi-supervised methods target label scarcity without jointly modelling adaptive cross-scale representations. We propose MSA-DCNN, a scale-consistent deformable attention learning framework that introduces adaptive multi-scale sampling, within-scale saliency refinement, learned cross-scale fusion, and auxiliary self-distillation within a unified optimisation scheme, with potential to generalise to structurally heterogeneous anatomy. We evaluate on three public benchmarks and an external hold-out set for leukaemia. MSA-DCNN demonstrates competitive and often better performance against ViT baselines, CNN baselines, and a MICCAI semi-supervised baseline under distribution shift and label scarcity in accuracy, F1, and AUC (binary), while using fewer parameters. Ablations confirm complementary component contributions, supporting MSA-DCNN as a practical foundation for data-efficient medical image classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MSA-DCNN，一个数据高效的多尺度可变形CNN用于医学图像分类。该方法引入自适应多尺度采样、尺度内显著性精炼、跨尺度融合和辅助自蒸馏。在三个公开基准和一个外部白血病数据集上，与ViT、CNN和半监督基线相比，在分布偏移和标签稀缺下取得了有竞争力或更好的性能，且参数更少。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在医学图像分类中难以处理多尺度形态和有限标注，因为固定采样和数据饥饿训练。现有方法孤立地解决这些问题，缺乏统一方案。
Method: 提出MSA-DCNN，一个尺度一致的可变形注意力学习框架，包括自适应多尺度采样、尺度内显著性精炼、学习的跨尺度融合和辅助自蒸馏，统一优化。
Result: 在三个公开基准和外部白血病数据集上，与ViT、CNN和MICCAI半监督基线相比，在分布偏移和标签稀缺下，在准确率、F1和AUC（二分类）上表现有竞争力或更好，且参数更少。
Conclusion: 消融实验证实各组件互补贡献，MSA-DCNN可作为数据高效医学图像分类的实用基础。

papers.title: From Blueprint to Reality: Modeling and Applying Putnam's Social Capital Theory with LLM-based Multi-agent Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Putnam's Social Capital Theory is a foundational framework for collective action and community prosperity. However, traditional empirical methods face practical limits on control and replication. Meanwhile, LLM-based social simulations are typically behavior-driven and lack theory-aligned environments for modeling Putnam's core propositions. To address these gaps, we introduce SocaSim, an LLM-based multi-agent simulation framework to study Putnam's Social Capital Theory from theoretical blueprint to simulated reality. Specifically, we build an environment integrating social network evolution, trust dynamics, and norm propagation, where agents engage in repeated collective-action experiments, and then apply the three dimensions to analyze adaptation challenges in smart elderly care. Our simulations reproduce Putnam's macro-level patterns and exhibit strong human-agent alignment at the group level. Unlike traditional methods, SocaSim traces micro-level causal pathways of social network, trust, and norms via round-by-round simulations and counterfactual interventions, enabling process-level interpretability. Taken together, these capabilities establish a research paradigm that leverages LLM agents to bridge social science and computer science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SocaSim，一个基于LLM的多智能体模拟框架，用于建模Putnam的社会资本理论。该框架整合了社交网络演化、信任动态和规范传播，代理参与重复集体行动实验，并应用于智慧养老中适应挑战的分析。模拟重现了宏观模式，并在群体层面表现出强人机对齐，同时通过逐轮模拟和反事实干预实现微观因果路径的可解释性。
Motivation: 传统实证方法在控制性和可复制性方面存在实际限制，而LLM社会模拟通常是行为驱动的，缺乏与理论一致的环境来建模Putnam的核心命题。
Method: 构建一个环境，整合社交网络演化、信任动态和规范传播，代理参与重复集体行动实验，并应用三个维度分析智慧养老适应挑战。
Result: 模拟重现Putnam的宏观模式，在群体层面表现出强人机对齐，并能追踪社交网络、信任和规范的微观因果路径。
Conclusion: 这种能力建立了一个利用LLM代理桥接社会科学和计算机科学的研究范式。

papers.title: Scalable Perturbation Learning for Online Self-Supervised Echo State Networks
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent systems should not only solve tasks but also adapt under real-world constraints. Autonomous adaptation via self-supervised learning, sequential adaptation via online learning, and memory-efficient implementation via perturbation-based learning are important requirements for such systems. However, these requirements are generally in tension for high-dimensional systems, because perturbation-based learning suffers from variance that grows with the dimension of the perturbed variables. In this study, we focus on echo state networks (ESNs), where this tension naturally arises in large reservoirs. We propose a perturbation-based learning rule for online self-supervised learning in ESNs. The proposed rule is derived from an orthogonal decomposition of the self-supervised learning cost, which separates an input-dependent component from a redundant component determined by the fixed ESN parameters. By perturbing only the input-dependent component, the effective perturbation dimension is reduced from the reservoir dimension to the input dimension. Thus, the proposed method preserves self-supervised adaptation, online learning, and scalar-feedback perturbation learning, while avoiding reservoir-size-dependent variance growth. This suggests a design principle for scalable and hardware-compatible learning: online learning should be restricted to the dynamically necessary low-dimensional component of the objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对回声状态网络（ESN）在在线自监督学习中因高维扰动导致方差增长的问题，提出了一种可扩展的基于扰动的学习规则。通过正交分解将自监督学习代价分解为输入依赖分量和由固定ESN参数决定的多余分量，仅扰动前者，使有效扰动维度从储层维度降至输入维度。该方法在不牺牲适应性的前提下避免了方差随储层规模增长，适用于硬件兼容的在线学习。
Motivation: 自监督学习、在线学习和基于扰动的学习在高维系统中存在张力：扰动学习的方差随扰动变量维数增长，阻碍可扩展实现；ESN的大规模储层中这一问题尤为突出。
Method: 提出一种基于扰动的学习规则，对自监督学习代价进行正交分解，分离出输入依赖分量和冗余分量；仅扰动输入依赖分量，使有效扰动维度从储层维度降至输入维度。
Result: 该方法在保持自监督适应、在线学习和标量反馈扰动学习的同时，避免了与储层大小相关的方差增长。
Conclusion: 在线学习应限制在动态必要的低维目标分量上，以实现可扩展和硬件兼容的学习。

papers.title: Prompt Coach: An Empirical Evaluation of an Agentic Tutor for Learning Prompt Engineering in Software Development
papers.abstract_en: Prompt engineering has emerged as a critical yet undertaught skill for software developers, one that traditional learning approaches are ill-equipped to support given its evolving, interactive, and context-dependent nature. In this paper, we introduce Prompt Coach (PC), an agentic tutor that helps developers learn how to craft high-quality code-generation prompts through Socratic guidance embedded in-flow within their IDE. PC evaluates prompt quality across multiple dimensions and surfaces targeted questions to guide self-correction, grounded in the developer's codebase and the behavior of the target LLM. We present an early empirical study with 15 professional developers combining quantitative prompt quality scoring with qualitative perception measures. Participants showed statistically significant improvements after a single 60-minute session, with the largest gains across dimensions commonly overlooked by developers. They also reported strong trust, high adoption readiness, and unanimous agreement that PC improved their prompt-writing skills.
papers.comment: 7 pages. To be published in the proceedings of 41st International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE '26), October 12-16, 2026, Munich, Germany (Industry Showcase Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prompt Coach，一个在 IDE 内通过苏格拉底式引导帮助软件开发者学习提示工程 (prompt engineering) 的智能导师系统。摘要报告了 15 名专业开发者的实证研究，显示单次 60 分钟会话后提示质量分数有统计学显著提升，尤其在开发者常忽略的维度上改进最大。参与者表现出高信任度和采用意愿。
Motivation: 提示工程是软件开发中关键但未被充分教授的技能，传统学习方法难以适应其交互性和上下文依赖性。
Method: 提出 Prompt Coach 代理导师，在 IDE 中嵌入苏格拉底式引导，从多个维度评估提示质量，并基于开发者的代码库和目标 LLM 行为提出针对性问题以促进自我修正。
Result: 15 名专业开发者在 60 分钟会话后提示质量评分出现统计学显著进步，最大改进出现在常被忽略的维度；参与者报告强烈信任、高采纳意愿，并一致认为 Prompt Coach 提高了他们的提示编写技能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Prompt Coach 在开发流程中有效支持提示工程学习，参与者表现出强信任和高接受度。

papers.title: Reward-Density Heuristic for Dynamic Multi-Vehicle Routing: Performance and Computational Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: The Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) and its variants represent some of the most practically consequential optimization challenges in modern logistics and urban mobility. In this study, we address a dynamic, online variant combining elements of the VRP and the Orienteering Problem (OP), in which a fleet of vehicles must maximise cumulative reward collected within a fixed time horizon while continuously replanning as new tasks arrive. We propose and evaluate a reward-density heuristic for dynamic multi-vehicle assignment, referred to as the Efficiency heuristic. We evaluate this formulation across two application domains: autonomous drone task allocation and urban taxi dispatch, across multiple fleet sizes and task scales. The proposed method is compared with four classical construction heuristics and three metaheuristic algorithms (Adaptive Large Neighbourhood Search, Genetic Algorithm, and Simulated Annealing), all evaluated under identical conditions. Across all tested configurations, the Efficiency heuristic matches the solution quality of the best metaheuristic algorithms while requiring two to three orders of magnitude less planning time, establishing Pareto dominance over all competing methods on the reward-versus-compute frontier. These findings suggest a practical design principle for real-time allocation and dispatch systems: in dynamic, time-constrained routing environments, carefully designed greedy heuristics can match the output of sophisticated search procedures at a fraction of the computational cost, making them preferable for online deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态多车辆路径问题（结合车辆路径问题和定向问题），提出一种奖励密度启发式（Efficiency heuristic）用于在线任务分配。在自主无人机和城市出租车两个场景中，该启发式在解质量上与自适应大邻域搜索、遗传算法、模拟退火等元启发式相当，但规划时间降低2-3个数量级，在奖励-计算边界上占据Pareto优势。
Motivation: 动态在线VRP中，元启发式算法计算开销大，难以满足实时重规划需求；而简单启发式往往解质量差。需要一种在解质量和计算效率之间平衡的方法。
Method: 提出基于奖励密度（reward-density）的贪心启发式，即每次分配时选择任务奖励与旅行时间比值最高的任务。在动态环境中连续重规划。
Result: 在多种车队规模和任务规模下，该启发式与最优元启发式解质量相当，但计算时间低2-3个数量级。在所有测试配置中实现对所有竞争方法的Pareto支配。
Conclusion: 在动态、时间受限的路径规划环境中，精心设计的贪心启发式可以以极低计算成本匹配复杂搜索过程的输出，适合在线部署。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 在动态、时间受限的路径规划环境中，精心设计的贪心启发式可以以极低计算成本匹配复杂搜索过程的输出，适合在线部署。

papers.title: Determinantal point process sampling for bioacoustic active learning
papers.abstract_en: Eco-acoustic monitoring generates vast volumes of audio data, making active learning a promising approach for reducing annotation effort while efficiently training reliable biodiversity classifiers. This report presents CARE-DPP, a batch active-learning acquisition method submitted to BioDCASE Active Learning for Bioacoustics 2026 challenge. The method combines class-balanced predictive uncertainty with embedding-space novelty, while a determinantal point process (DPP) objective selects a high-quality and non-redundant acquisition batch. The uncertainty-novelty balance is annealed over the annotation budget: early cycles emphasize geometric coverage, whereas later cycles increasingly exploit classifier uncertainty. To mitigate unreliable early scores, the DPP candidate pool mixes top-quality candidates with a decreasing proportion of random exploration. An adaptive acquisition schedule uses smaller batches early and larger batches later. Evaluated over five repeats on the BirdSet HSN, POW and UHH subsets and on ATBFL, CARE-DPP obtains a mean development AULC of 0.50 for macro mAP, compared with 0.46 for the official CoreSet baseline. Ablations identify DPP batch diversification and the adaptive acquisition schedule as the largest contributors.
papers.comment: BioDCASE Challenge 2026 - Task 4 Active learning. Ranked 2/14
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生态声学监测中大量音频数据的标注成本问题，提出CARE-DPP批量主动学习方法，该方法结合类别平衡的预测不确定性和嵌入空间新颖性，并通过行列式点过程(DPP)目标选择高质量、非冗余的采集批次。在BirdSet HSN、POW、UHH子集和ATBFL上的评估显示，平均开发AULC达到0.50（宏mAP），优于官方CoreSet基线的0.46。消融实验表明DPP批次多样化和自适应采集计划贡献最大。
Motivation: 生态声学监测产生海量音频数据，主动学习可减少标注成本，但现有方法在批次选择中易产生冗余或缺乏多样性。
Method: 提出CARE-DPP方法，将类平衡预测不确定性与嵌入空间新颖性结合，通过行列式点过程(DPP)选择高质量、非冗余的采集批次；利用退火策略动态平衡不确定性和新颖性，并采用自适应采集计划（早期小批次、后期大批次）。

Conclusion: CARE-DPP通过DPP多样性和自适应调度有效提升主动学习性能，但方法在生物声学领域验证，通用性有待进一步研究。

papers.title: Separation Capacity of Scattering Networks on Low-Dimensional Datasets
papers.abstract_en: We aim to identify scattering network architectures that maximize the separation capacity on data with low intrinsic dimension. The networks we consider employ a fixed monomial nonlinearity and no pooling, so that the only design variable is the frame generated by the network filters. For data modeled as rectifiable sets, we first characterize and bound the separation capacity of general feature extractors in terms of the geometry of the dataset. We then particularize to scattering networks and obtain two design criteria: (i) the filters should meet the data on sufficiently many frequencies, and (ii) the matrices coupling the frame to the geometry of the data should be well-conditioned.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文旨在识别最大化低维内在维度数据分离能力的散射网络架构。网络采用固定单项非线性且无池化，唯一设计变量是滤波器生成的框架。对于建模为可整流集的数据，作者首先以数据集几何特征刻画并界定了通用特征提取器的分离能力，然后特化到散射网络得到两个设计准则。
Motivation: 实际数据往往具有低维结构，而散射网络传统设计未针对低维数据集优化分离能力。
Method: 将数据建模为可整流集，从几何角度分析特征提取器的分离能力，导出散射网络的滤波器设计准则：滤波器应在足够多的频率上接触数据，以及将框架耦合到数据几何的矩阵应良态。
Result: 给出了通用特征提取器分离能力的几何刻画和界，并为散射网络提出两个具体设计准则。
Conclusion: 该工作为低维数据集上散射网络的结构设计提供了理论指导。

papers.title: REAN: Reconstruction-aware ECG Anonymization Based on Privacy--Utility Orthogonality
papers.abstract_en: A shared electrocardiogram (ECG) is itself a biometric fingerprint that can re-identify a patient and reveal personal information. Recent ECG anonymizers transform the signal before sharing to reduce privacy leakage. However, existing methods still face a privacy--utility trade-off, in which preserving privacy often compromises utility while preserving utility reveals personal information. We propose \emph{REAN} (\emph{RE}construction-aware ECG \emph{AN}onymizer), a raw ECG signal anonymizer, to address this privacy--utility trade-off. REAN reconstructs the signal using a 1-D U-Net trained with losses from frozen privacy and utility classifiers to reduce privacy leakage while preserving utility. The privacy and utility gradients are near-orthogonal ($\approx$93.8$^\circ$), so reducing privacy leakage leaves utility almost unchanged. On four public PhysioNet databases, REAN achieves the strongest privacy--utility balance among raw ECG signal baselines. It drives re-identification to chance (0.96$\to$0.00), keeps arrhythmia macro-AUROC at the clean level (Clean 0.9982 vs.\ REAN 0.9991), and maintains re-identification protection under unseen privacy-classifier architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REAN，一种基于1-D U-Net的心电图（ECG）原始信号匿名化方法，通过冻结隐私和效用分类器的梯度训练，实现隐私与效用的近正交（约93.8°），在四个公共PhysioNet数据库上达到强隐私-效用平衡，将重识别率降至随机水平（0.96→0.00），同时保持心律失常宏AUROC与原始信号相当（Clean 0.9982 vs. REAN 0.9991）。
Motivation: 现有ECG匿名化方法存在隐私-效用权衡，保护隐私常降低效用，而保留效用则泄露个人信息。
Method: 使用1-D U-Net重构信号，训练损失来自冻结的隐私和效用分类器，使隐私和效用梯度近正交，从而在降低隐私泄露时几乎不影响效用。
Result: 在四个PhysioNet数据库上，REAN将重识别率从0.96降至0.00（随机水平），心律失常宏AUROC保持为0.9991（接近原始的0.9982），并能在未见过的隐私分类器架构下保持保护效果。
Conclusion: REAN实现了原始ECG信号匿名化中最强的隐私-效用平衡，且近正交梯度设计为隐私保护提供了可解释性。

papers.title: SplineNet: An Isogeometric Deep Learning Method for Complex Shells
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel isogeometric deep learning method, termed SplineNet, for the seamless design and analysis of shell structures with complex geometries. The proposed approach is built upon watertight spline representations, e.g., analysis-suitable unstructured T-splines, and features exact geometric descriptions of Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models in neural networks. Bézier extraction is used to build the network architecture, where Bernstein polynomials serve as the nonlinear activation functions. SplineNet can be applied in a data-free or data-driven way. In the data-free case, energy-based formulations can be naturally incorporated as loss terms, which fulfill the need of Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) and can be accurately calculated. In particular, the Kirchhoff--Love (KL) model is adopted to solve for the mechanical behaviors of shell structures. This way, CAD and CAE can be tightly integrated in a deep neural network without the time-consuming model/data exchange process. In the data-driven case, SplineNet can be used as the trunk net of Deep Operator Networks (DeepONet) to provide interpretability. Given such a trained network and unseen input data, results can be immediately obtained without retraining the network or repeatedly performing the traditional workflow for analysis. In the end, a variety of numerical examples are studied to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, especially when real-world complex geometries are involved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 SplineNet 的等几何深度学习方法，用于复杂壳体结构的设计与分析。该方法基于水密样条表示（如分析适用的非结构化 T 样条），在神经网络中精确描述 CAD 模型，利用 Bézier 提取构建网络架构，并以 Bernstein 多项式作为非线性激活函数。SplineNet 可以无数据或数据驱动方式应用：无数据时，基于能量的损失函数可自然融入；数据驱动时，可用作深度算子网络（DeepONet）的主干网络。最后通过数值算例验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 传统的壳体结构设计和分析需要在 CAD 和 CAE 之间频繁进行模型和数据交换，效率低下。作者希望开发一种方法，能够将 CAD 和 CAE 紧密集成在深度神经网络中，避免耗时的交换过程。
Method: SplineNet 采用水密样条表示（如分析适用的非结构化 T 样条）作为几何描述，通过 Bézier 提取构建网络架构，使用 Bernstein 多项式作为激活函数。在无数据情况下，采用 Kirchhoff-Love 壳模型将能量表达式作为损失函数；在数据驱动情况下，作为 DeepONet 的主干网络。
Result: 通过多个数值算例证明了 SplineNet 的有效性，特别是在处理真实世界复杂几何形状时表现良好。
Conclusion: SplineNet 能够紧密集成 CAD 和 CAE，避免了传统的工作流中的模型/数据交换，提供了一种可行的等几何深度学习方法。

papers.title: Why does Deep Learning Improve Visual SLAM?
papers.abstract_en: Visual SLAM is a well-established technology utilized in a wide range of real-world applications. However, its performance still degrades under challenging visual conditions, such as low texture, severe motion blur, and poor illumination. Systems based on deep learning outperform classical geometry-based ones and achieve state-of-the-art results by combining learned 2D data association and uncertainty with differentiable geometric optimization in recurrent architectures. Still, it remains unclear exactly which components are fundamentally responsible for this success. In this paper, we ask: Is the superior performance of deep learning-based systems driven primarily by learned 2D data association, the combination of learned 2D data association and uncertainty, or the recurrent architecture itself? We investigate this question empirically by conducting a controlled study. Our findings reveal that the success of DL-based V-SLAM systems hinges on learned 2D data association and uncertainty rather than their recurrent architecture, underscoring the necessity of learning-based paradigms for the design of these components. Upon acceptance, the code will be released as open source.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验探究深度学习提升视觉SLAM性能的关键因素，发现成功主要源于学习型2D数据关联与不确定性，而非循环网络架构本身。作者强调学习范式对这些组件的必要性。
Motivation: 虽然基于深度学习的视觉SLAM系统性能优越，但具体哪些组件（2D数据关联、不确定性、循环架构）真正起作用尚不清楚。
Method: 采用控制实验，分别隔离学习型2D数据关联、不确定性联合学习以及循环网络架构进行比较。
Result: 实验表明，深度学习视觉SLAM的成功依赖于学习型2D数据关联与不确定性，而非循环架构。
Conclusion: 强调学习范式对于设计2D数据关联和不确定性组件是必要的。

papers.title: Stochastic generator of trajectories from record data: application to the fluctuations of a glacier's frontal position from a sample of moraines
papers.abstract_en: The record values theory study elements of a time series that exceed all previous observations, which are of particular interest in fields such as sports or climate science. In this paper, we propose a statistical method based on the construction of a Brownian stochastic simulator to reconstruct entire time series solely from such record values, even in a non-stationary case. We then implement a procedure, which can be compared to a Neural-Based Inference (NBI) procedure, to choose the optimal generator hyper parameters. To illustrate our method and motivate its development, we apply it to a glaciological problem. Understanding the past dynamics of glacier fronts is a major challenge to mitigate related mountain hazards, assess water resources, and evaluate contributions to sea-level rise. Field-visible indicators such as moraines provide spatio-temporal evidence of these front position evolution (refered as trajectories) and can be interpreted as the records of a non-stationary process. As a benchmark case, the two hyper parameters of our NBI approach are tuned from the well documented French alpine Glacier des Bossons. Our purely data-based approach offers new perspectives for challenging and further developing physical models of glacier dynamics and inferring the response of glaciers to climate change on centennial to millenial time scales. Beyond the glacier case, it has potential for the various problems for which record series is the sole available data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于布朗运动随机模拟器的统计方法，仅从记录值（如冰碛垄记录的冰川前端位置极值）重建完整时间序列，并在非平稳情况下适用。通过类似神经推理 (NBI) 的过程选择最优超参数，以法国阿尔卑斯冰川 Bossons 为基准案例验证。该方法为从稀疏记录数据推断冰川长期响应提供了纯数据驱动的新视角。
Motivation: 许多领域（如气候学、体育）中只有记录值（超过所有历史观测的极值）可用，而完整时间序列缺失。现有物理模型需要大量数据，难以直接利用这些稀疏记录。
Method: 构建一个具有可调超参数的布朗运动随机模拟器，生成满足记录值约束的轨迹；采用类似于神经推理 (Neural-Based Inference) 的程序优化超参数，使模拟轨迹的记录统计与观测记录匹配。
Result: 在法国阿尔卑斯冰川 Bossons 的案例中，该方法成功从冰碛垄记录值重建了冰川前端位置的非平稳轨迹，并指出此纯数据方法可用于挑战和改进冰川动力学物理模型。
Conclusion: 该方法为仅拥有记录序列的问题（如古气候重建）提供了新途径，但摘要未讨论在冰川以外的泛化性及不确定性量化。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.method: 构建一个具有可调超参数的布朗运动随机模拟器，生成满足记录值约束的轨迹；采用类似于神经推理 (Neural-Based Inference) 的程序优化超参数，使模拟轨迹的记录统计与观测记录匹配。
summary_sections.result: 在法国阿尔卑斯冰川 Bossons 的案例中，该方法成功从冰碛垄记录值重建了冰川前端位置的非平稳轨迹，并指出此纯数据方法可用于挑战和改进冰川动力学物理模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法为仅拥有记录序列的问题（如古气候重建）提供了新途径，但摘要未讨论在冰川以外的泛化性及不确定性量化。

papers.title: KOAL: Knowledge-Driven Prostate Cancer Grading with Ordinal-Aware Learning
papers.abstract_en: Non-invasive prediction of Gleason Grade Group (GGG) in prostate cancer using multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) is clinically vital for reducing unnecessary biopsies. Existing GGG prediction methods face two major limitations. First, they often overlook non-image information critical for GGG prediction, including age, prostate-specific antigen (PSA), and expert priors embedded in radiology reports. Second, they tend to oversimplify GGG as flat categorical labels, failing to account for its intrinsic hierarchy of primary and secondary Gleason patterns. To this end, we propose a novel Knowledge-Driven Ordinal-Aware Learning (KOAL) framework with three synergistic modules. Specifically, the Clinical-Context Modulation (CCM) module uses clinical variables (e.g., age and PSA) to dynamically modulate discriminative image representations. The Knowledge-Guided Prototype Alignment (KGPA) module leverages an LLM to extract group-specific expert knowledge from training radiology reports and clinical guidelines, producing offline semantic anchors describing grade-specific radiological findings without requiring patient-specific reports at inference. Through prototype contrastive alignment, patient-specific mpMRI representations are matched with these anchors to promote pathology-aligned representation learning. The Hierarchical Ordinal-aware Constraints (HOC) module decouples primary and secondary Gleason pattern prediction and maps their probabilistic outputs to GGG via a Differentiable Bio-logic Mapping Layer (DBML), ensuring pathological grading consistency. Experiments on public PI-CAI and in-house datasets demonstrate that KOAL outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/Gother-GZ/KOAL.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at MICCAI 2026. This is the submitted version prior to peer review. The final authenticated version will be available on SpringerLink
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对前列腺癌Gleason分级预测中非图像信息被忽略以及分级层次性未被充分利用的问题，提出KOAL框架。通过临床上下文调制、知识引导原型对齐和层次序数约束三个模块，实现多参数MRI影像、临床变量和放射学报告知识的融合。在PI-CAI和内部数据集上，该方法在Gleason分级预测上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有Gleason分级预测方法通常忽略年龄、PSA等临床变量和放射报告中的专家先验，且将Gleason分级简化为扁平类别标签，未考虑其内在的初级与次级Gleason模式的层次序数结构。
Method: 提出KOAL框架，包含三个模块：Clinical-Context Modulation (CCM) 利用临床变量动态调制影像表征；Knowledge-Guided Prototype Alignment (KGPA) 利用LLM从训练报告提取分级相关语义锚点，通过原型对比对齐引导病理一致性表征；Hierarchical Ordinal-aware Constraints (HOC) 解耦初级和次级Gleason模式预测，并通过可微分生物逻辑映射层输出最终分级。
Result: 在公开的PI-CAI和内部数据集上，KOAL在Gleason分级预测的准确率和一致性指标上均优于当前最优方法。
Conclusion: 知识驱动和层级序数感知的学习策略能够有效提升前列腺癌Gleason分级的非侵入性预测性能，且无需推理时提供患者个体放射报告。

papers.title: Learning When to Automate: Queue Control in Human-AI Service Systems
papers.abstract_en: We study a human-AI service system in which tasks arrive sequentially and are processed through a two-stage architecture: an automated chatbot followed, when necessary, by a human agent. We consider $T$ sequentially arriving tasks, each belonging to one of $K$ heterogeneous types. For each task the decision maker chooses how many resources to allocate to the chatbot, whose type-dependent success probabilities are initially unknown. Tasks not resolved by the chatbot enter type-dependent human-service queues, where they are processed by a human agent with unknown service rates. This model captures a central tradeoff in hybrid service systems: relying more on automation reduces human congestion but increases chatbot costs, while insufficient automation may overload the human agent. We propose the UCB-DPP policy, which combines Upper Confidence Bounds with Drift-Plus-Penalty control to learn the unknown parameters of the system while making queue-aware decisions. We prove that UCB-DPP achieves regret $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K\sqrt{T})$ and guarantees mean-rate stability of the human-service queues. Simulations on synthetic instances show that the proposed policy outperforms natural baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人机混合服务系统中的任务调度问题，任务依次到达，先由自动聊天机器人处理（可分配不同资源），未解决的任务进入人类代理队列。提出UCB-DPP策略，结合置信上界和漂移加罚控制，在未知类型依赖的成功概率和服务率下学习并做出队列感知决策，实现后悔界$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K\sqrt{T})$和均率稳定性。
Motivation: 混合服务系统中自动化程度影响人类拥堵和成本，现有方法未同时考虑学习未知参数和队列控制。
Method: 提出UCB-DPP策略，使用UCB学习任务类型相关的成功概率和人类服务率，并结合漂移加罚控制动态分配聊天机器人资源以平衡负载。
Result: 理论证明策略达到$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K\sqrt{T})$后悔界并保证人类队列均率稳定；仿真表明优于自然基线。
Conclusion: 该策略有效平衡自动化成本与人工负载，但仅考虑有限时域和离散类型，实际应用需进一步验证。

papers.title: Stability Annealing Selects the Implicit Bias of Smoothed Sign Descent: A Rate-Indexed Barrier Path on Separable Data
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive gradient methods can favor max-margin separators that differ from gradient descent, yet a fixed positive numerical stability constant eventually changes the update geometry again. This paper studies the rate-controlled middle case for full-batch linear classification on separable data. For memoryless stability-annealed smoothed-sign descent with weighted exponential loss, we prove that the normalized iterates converge to the minimizer of a convex Burg-type barrier over a margin slice. The proof rewrites the dynamics exactly as entropic mirror ascent on a concave dual objective, controls the dual gap by a KL recursion, and yields an explicit S_t^{-1/2} normalized-iterate envelope. The static barrier geometry is fully characterized, including KKT conditions and both endpoint limits. Experiments validate the exact dual identities to floating-point error, illustrate the predicted path and rate diagram, and show an empirical fixed-epsilon crossover scaling in cumulative time. We further report robustness and boundary diagnostics for logistic tails, fixed-epsilon crossover, and adaptive-method variants, delineating the scope of the proved smoothed-sign theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究全批量线性可分分类中平滑符号下降（smoothed sign descent）的稳定性退火（stability annealing）过程。作者证明，在加权指数损失下，归一化迭代收敛于一个凸Burg型势垒（Burg-type barrier）在边际切片上的最小化器，并通过熵镜像上升（entropic mirror ascent）重写动力学，给出显式的归一化迭代包络。实验验证了精确对偶恒等式，并展示了固定epsilon交叉缩放等行为。
Motivation: 自适应梯度方法偏好与梯度下降不同的最大间隔分离器，但固定的正数值稳定性常数最终会改变更新几何。本文旨在研究速率控制的中间情况，即稳定性退火平滑符号下降在可分数据上的隐式偏置。
Method: 将动力学精确重写为关于凹对偶目标的熵镜像上升，通过KL递归控制对偶间隙，推导出归一化迭代的S_t^{-1/2}包络，并完全刻画静态势垒几何（包括KKT条件和端点极限）。
Result: 归一化迭代收敛于一个凸Burg型势垒在边际切片上的最小化器；实验验证了精确对偶恒等式至浮点误差，并展示了固定epsilon交叉缩放现象。
Conclusion: 论文阐明了稳定性退火平滑符号下降的隐式偏置，并给出了完整的势垒几何表征，但理论限于全批量线性分类和加权指数损失。

papers.title: Structured Data Extraction from Real Estate Documents using Clustering, Classification, and Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Real estate property listings expose structured metadata through the API. Still, the richest property-level information (i.e., legal status, structural condition, utility supplies, heating systems) sits in attached questionnaire documents that no automated system currently processes at scale. These documents are heterogeneous. Some are digitally generated with selectable text, others are scanned physical forms. There are even more complex layouts that contain checkbox annotations that defeat conventional text extraction. In this paper, we present an end-to-end pipeline for acquiring, classifying, and extracting structured data from selectable text documents. The pipeline was applied to 3965 questionnaire documents collected from a live property platform via reverse-engineered REST APIs. First, we classified each document into one of three structural categories (text_only, scanned, and special_char), then extracted 35 predefined property attributes from eligible documents using DeepSeek R1 as the Large Language Model, prompted to return a structured JSON object. All 2781 submitted documents were processed successfully, producing a final dataset of 2766 unique property records. Downstream validation confirmed the data quality. Cosine similarity matching achieves a Jaccard consistency score of 0.82, and K-Means clustering produces interpretable market segments with a silhouette score of 0.2088. Results show that the proposed extraction from each property document is both feasible and reliable at this scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一套端到端流水线，用于从房地产问卷文档中提取结构化数据。该流水线首先将文档分类为三种结构类型（纯文本、扫描件、特殊字符），然后利用DeepSeek R1大语言模型从符合条件的文档中提取35个预定义属性。在3965份文档上测试，成功处理2781份，生成2766条唯一记录，余弦相似度匹配的Jaccard一致性得分为0.82，K-Means聚类的轮廓系数为0.2088。
Motivation: 房地产列表中的丰富属性信息（如法律状况、结构条件、公用设施等）存在于附件问卷文档中，但目前没有自动化系统能够大规模处理这些异构文档，包括数字生成、扫描件和复杂布局的复选框注释。
Method: 构建端到端流水线：通过逆向工程REST API收集文档，分类为三类（text_only, scanned, special_char），然后使用DeepSeek R1大语言模型提取35个属性，输出结构化JSON。
Result: 在3965份文档中，2781份被成功处理，产生2766条唯一记录。下游验证显示数据质量良好：余弦相似度匹配的Jaccard一致性得分为0.82，K-Means聚类产生可解释的市场细分，轮廓系数为0.2088。
Conclusion: 该流水线能够在规模上从房地产问卷文档中可靠地提取结构化数据，但分类和提取仅针对可选择文本的文档，扫描件和特殊字符文档未处理。

papers.title: Multi-Channel Spread-Spectrum Code Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: Attributing code to the large language model that produced it is essential for provenance, licensing, and misuse accountability, yet no deployed watermark meets this need. Generation-time schemes require access to the producing model and cannot be applied to third-party code, while post-hoc schemes work on any code but carry at most 4 bits of payload, far too few to distinguish the many deployed model configurations. We present multi-channel spread-spectrum watermarking, the first post-hoc, training-free code watermark with a 24-bit payload and formal robustness guarantees. The scheme encodes bits in variable naming conventions and in eight pairs of semantically equivalent code patterns, and a keyed pseudo-random permutation maps every site to a codeword bit so that each bit receives multiple independent votes. Majority voting absorbs distributed corruption, while an outer Reed-Solomon code recovers the identifier when concentrated channel attacks defeat the vote, yielding provable robustness bounds for formatting, syntactic, and structural attacks. Across 1,750 Python files from CodeNet and from GPT-4.1 and Llama-4 generations, the watermark achieves 100% clean-detection accuracy with zero false positives. Under 17 attack types, it recovers the identifier at 97.6% accuracy under 8 variable renames and 94.1% under 10% random per-site corruption, while the strongest post-hoc baseline collapses to 0% under any single-transform attack. Embedding and detection together take under 200 ms on CPU without training data or GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多通道扩频代码水印，这是首个事后、无需训练、具有24位载荷和正式鲁棒性保证的代码水印方案。该方案将比特编码到变量命名约定和八对语义等价的代码模式中，并通过密钥伪随机排列将每个位置映射到一个码字比特，使每个比特获得多个独立投票。多数投票吸收分布式破坏，而外部Reed-Solomon码在集中信道攻击破坏投票时恢复标识符。在来自CodeNet、GPT-4.1和Llama-4的1750个Python文件上，水印实现了100%干净检测准确率和零假阳性。在17种攻击类型下，8次变量重命名时恢复准确率97.6%，10%随机逐位置破坏时恢复准确率94.1%，而最强的事后基线在单次变换攻击下即崩溃至0%。嵌入和检测在CPU上总共耗时不到200毫秒，无需训练数据或GPU。
Motivation: 现有代码水印方法存在不足：生成时方案需要访问生成模型且无法应用于第三方代码，而事后方案载荷最多4比特，不足以区分众多已部署的模型配置。
Method: 提出多通道扩频水印，利用变量命名约定和八组语义等价代码模式编码比特，通过密钥伪随机排列实现每个比特的多投票，结合多数投票和外部Reed-Solomon码提供鲁棒性保证。
Result: 在1750个Python文件上实现100%干净检测准确率和零假阳性；8次变量重命名攻击下恢复准确率97.6%，10%随机破坏下94.1%；最强基线在单次攻击下即失效。
Conclusion: 这是首个事后、无需训练、具有24位载荷和正式鲁棒性证明的代码水印方案，适用于任意代码且高效。

papers.title: PolyWorkBench: Benchmarking Multilingual Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown strong performance in long-horizon tasks that require planning, tool use, and interaction with external environments. However, most existing benchmarks implicitly assume a monolingual setting, where the entire execution process, including reasoning, tool invocation, and output generation, is conducted within a single language. In contrast, real-world applications often involve multilingual inputs and outputs within a unified workflow, yet the interaction between multilinguality and agentic execution remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce PolyWorkBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on multilingual long-horizon workplace workflows. PolyWorkBench consists of 67 tasks across five domains, including commerce, knowledge work, legal analysis, localization, and manufacturing, where agents must process heterogeneous multilingual inputs, perform iterative reasoning, invoke external tools, and produce structured outputs. To enable comprehensive evaluation, we propose a hybrid framework that combines structural grading, executable verification, and LLM-based semantic assessment. This design allows us to capture both functional correctness and linguistic consistency across complex workflows. Empirical results show that state-of-the-art LLM agents suffer significant performance degradation in multilingual workflow settings compared to monolingual counterparts. Our analysis suggests that multilinguality introduces compounding effects across reasoning and execution steps, highlighting the importance of jointly modeling language variation and procedural decision-making in agent evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolyWorkBench，一个用于评估多语言长时程工作流中 LLM 智能体的基准。基准包含 67 个跨五个领域的任务，涉及多语言输入、迭代推理、工具调用和结构化输出。实验表明现有 LLM 智能体在多语言设置下性能显著下降，多语言性在推理和执行步骤中产生复合效应。
Motivation: 现有基准大多假设单语言环境，而真实应用常涉及多语言输入输出，多语言性与智能体执行之间的交互尚未被充分探索。
Method: 构建 PolyWorkBench 基准，包含 67 个跨商务、知识工作、法律分析、本地化和制造领域的任务；提出结合结构评分、可执行验证和 LLM 基于语义评估的混合评估框架。
Result: 状态-of-the-art LLM 智能体在多语言工作流设置中性能相比单语言设置显著下降，多语言性在推理和执行步骤中产生复合效应。
Conclusion: 多语言性对智能体性能有显著负面影响，强调在智能体评估中需联合建模语言变异和过程决策。

papers.title: OBBSeg: Irregular Lesion Segmentation under Oriented Bounding Box Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-level annotation remains a major bottleneck in medical image segmentation, making weak supervision an attractive yet under-constrained alternative. We propose OBBSeg, an intermediate supervision paradigm guided by Oriented Bounding Boxes (OBBs) that bridges the gap between full and weak supervision. By jointly encoding spatial extent and orientation, OBBs provide compact geometric supervision that better aligns with elongated or anisotropic lesions, reducing the ambiguity of coarse box annotations. To mitigate the inherent rectangular bias of OBBs, we introduce a Mask-to-OBB loss, a differentiable formulation that enforces geometric consistency between predicted masks and OBB regions. Furthermore, we incorporate prompt-driven semantic guidance through two complementary modules-PAFE and DBFE-which enhance foreground representation and suppress background interference. Extensive experiments on 13 datasets across 5 imaging modalities show that OBBSeg not only outperforms existing weakly supervised methods but also achieves performance comparable to fully supervised approaches, demonstrating its potential for efficient and scalable medical image segmentation. The code is available at https://github.com/StarLxc3/OBBSeg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OBBSeg 提出一种基于定向边界框（OBB）的中间监督范式，用于不规则病灶分割。通过联合编码空间范围和方向，OBB 减少了粗框标注的歧义，并引入 Mask-to-OBB 损失和提示驱动语义模块（PAFE 和 DBFE），在 13 个数据集、5 种影像模态上达到接近全监督的性能。
Motivation: 像素级标注是医学图像分割的瓶颈，弱监督方法约束不足。现有弱监督方法在处理细长或各向异性病灶时存在模糊性。
Method: 以定向边界框（OBB）作为中间监督，提出 Mask-to-OBB 损失进行几何一致性约束，并设计两个互补模块 PAFE 和 DBFE 增强前景表示、抑制背景干扰。
Result: 在 13 个数据集、5 种影像模态上，OBBSeg 超越现有弱监督方法，并达到与全监督方法相当的性能。
Conclusion: OBB 是一种有效的中间监督形式，能够桥接全监督与弱监督，为高效可扩展的医学图像分割提供了新方向。

papers.title: Information Limits and Attractor Dynamics in Economies of Frontier LLM Agents: A Pre-Registered Test
papers.abstract_en: We report a pre-registered, two-part experiment on small economies of frontier language-model agents (Claude Opus 4.8), testing two quantitative predictions about coupled multi-agent systems: an information-theoretic capacity region for wealth growth under market coupling, and a mean-field residual-scaling law for population misalignment under incentive and control levers. All predictions, acceptance bands, and decision rules were frozen in a public git chain before any run; every reported number re-derives mechanically from cached model outputs; the entire experiment cost $138.76 in metered API spend and is re-runnable at zero cost from the cache. Result 1 (confirmation): in parimutuel-coupled economies, relative growth equals relative claimed information -- the gap law G_a - G_b = I_a - I_b holds to a worst-case 46 millinats (pre-registered band: 50) across four perception structures; coalition value is submodular exactly where channels are conditionally independent, and a designed XOR synergy control flips it supermodular by 0.62 >= ln2/2 nats, with agents reasoning out the joint bit; the joint growth ceiling G_S <= H(X) binds exactly; and the best-informed agent absorbs essentially the whole wealth pool in 4/5 market seeds. Result 2 (structural negative): the residual-scaling test returned "domain not found." In all 72 population runs, goal dispersion collapsed (V -> 0; maximum 4.85 against a frozen floor of 5.31), the population's response to the two levers was a step function across the dominance boundary rather than a smooth response, and cells near the boundary were bistable with seed-selected outcomes. No tested LLM population at any capability level realizes the noise-maintained-dispersion regime the smooth mean-field model assumes. We release the full protocol, pre-registration chain, call cache, and analysis code.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一个预注册的两部分实验，使用前沿语言模型代理（Claude Opus 4.8）组成的小型经济体，测试了关于耦合多智能体系统的两个定量预测：一个关于市场耦合下财富增长的信息论容量区域，以及一个关于激励和控制杠杆下人口失调的平均场残差缩放定律。实验结果确认了第一个预测（财富增长与信息占有之间的差距定律），但第二个预测的残差缩放测试返回“域未找到”，所有人口运行中目标分散度崩溃，未实现平均场模型假设的噪声维持分散状态。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对LLM代理在耦合经济系统中行为极限的定量预测和实验验证，特别是信息论极限和平均场动力学预测。
Method: 采用预注册实验设计，使用Claude Opus 4.8代理构建小型经济系统，通过parimutuel耦合市场进行财富增长实验，并测试激励和控制杠杆对人口失调的影响。所有预测、接受带和决策规则在运行前公开冻结。
Result: 结果1确认了差距定律G_a - G_b = I_a - I_b，最坏偏差46 millinats（预注册带50）；联合增长上限G_S <= H(X)精确成立；最佳信息代理吸收大部分财富。结果2：残差缩放测试返回“域未找到”，所有72次人口运行中目标分散度崩溃，人口对杠杆的响应为阶跃函数，边界附近细胞双稳态。
Conclusion: 论文确认了信息论容量区域预测，但平均场残差缩放模型未得到支持，LLM代理人口未实现该模型假设的噪声维持分散状态。论文释放了完整的协议、预注册链、调用缓存和分析代码。

papers.title: AgoraSim: A Hybrid Agent-Based Modeling Framework
papers.abstract_en: LLM-agent simulations make natural-language social scenarios easy to instantiate, but their outputs can be overread as predictions and are often difficult to compare with explicit social dynamics. We present AgoraSim, a hybrid agent-based modeling framework for scenario-oriented social reaction analysis. AgoraSim resolves textual or multimodal artifacts into editable ABM configurations, runs ratio-controlled populations that mix LLM, vision-language, custom-endpoint, random, and classical agents, and compares the same scenario against matched classical reference dynamics. All agents emit a shared structured decision object, enabling common action spaces, interaction protocols, metrics, and audit records. Exposed through a local UI, Python SDK/CLI, and REST API, AgoraSim helps users inspect scenario trajectories, compare modeling assumptions, and identify cases that warrant empirical validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出AgoraSim混合智能体建模框架，用于场景导向的社会反应分析。该框架将文本或多模态产物解析为可编辑的ABM配置，运行混合LLM、视觉语言、自定义端点、随机和经典智能体的比例控制群体，并与经典参考动力学对比。所有智能体输出共享结构化决策对象，支持统一动作空间、交互协议、度量和审计记录。通过本地UI、Python SDK/CLI和REST API暴露，帮助用户检查场景轨迹、比较建模假设、识别需要实证验证的案例。
Motivation: 现有LLM-agent模拟输出容易被过度解读为预测，且难以与显式社会动力学进行比较。
Method: AgoraSim通过解析文本或多模态产物为可编辑ABM配置，运行比例控制的人群（混合LLM、视觉语言、自定义端点、随机和经典智能体），让所有智能体输出共享结构化决策对象，从而实现统一动作空间、交互协议、度量和审计记录。
Result: 框架提供本地UI、Python SDK/CLI和REST API，支持用户检查场景轨迹、比较建模假设、识别需要实证验证的案例。
Conclusion: AgoraSim有助于提高模拟的可比性和可审计性，帮助用户识别需要实证验证的案例。

papers.title: Unlearnable Faces: Privacy Protection Surviving Extraction Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: Unlearnable examples keep publicly shared photos from being learned by unauthorized face-recognition models. An imperceptible perturbation, added before sharing, makes any model trained on the protected photos fail on clean faces. The perturbation is crafted on the shared image, however the attacker trains on the face it extracts, cropped and resized to the recognizer input, and under this extraction the protection collapses. We propose LPID, which builds the extraction into the unlearnable-example objective. LPID confines the perturbation to the extracted face region and optimizes it through a differentiable model of the extraction, concentrating its energy in the frequency band the extraction preserves. Because this robustness is a property of the transform rather than of any identity, LPID is re-optimized per album and protects even users it has never seen. LPID attains the lowest attacker accuracy of all methods in every setting we evaluate, holding the attacker below $10\%$ under crop+resize extraction on identities unseen at protection time, while remaining imperceptible at $32.7$\,dB PSNR and $0.161$ LPIPS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LPID（提取感知不可学习示例）方法，通过将提取过程（裁剪+缩放）建模为可微操作，并限制扰动仅作用于面部区域的特定频带，使得任何人脸识别模型在从共享照片提取面部后训练时失效。LPID在每个相册上重新优化，能保护未见过的用户，在crop+resize提取下将攻击者准确率压制在10%以下，同时保持图像质量（PSNR 32.7 dB，LPIPS 0.161）。
Motivation: 现有不可学习示例在人脸识别中因攻击者从共享照片裁剪并缩放面部而失效，需要一种能抵抗提取管线的隐私保护方法。
Method: LPID将提取过程构建为可微分模型，优化扰动使其能量集中在提取保留的频带，并仅施加于面部区域。
Result: 在所有设置中取得最低攻击者准确率，crop+resize提取下对未见身份攻击准确率<10%，PSNR 32.7 dB，LPIPS 0.161。
Conclusion: LPID能有效抵抗提取管线，保护隐私，且鲁棒性强。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discovering Frequent Closed Embedded Sub-DAGs in Spatio-Temporal Event Data
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel approach to mine patterns in spatio-temporal event data based on discovering frequent closed embedded sub-Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs). In our method, event instances are represented as nodes labelled by event types, while edges capture spatio-temporal following relationships. We formally define the considered class of patterns and provide the rationale for focusing on closed sub-DAGs as compact and non-redundant representations of recurring interaction patterns. We implement the DigDag algorithm for mining such patterns and experimentally compare its efficiency with two related approaches: propagation pattern mining using the SLEUTH algorithm and Cascading Spatio-Temporal Pattern mining using the CSTPM algorithm. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach is substantially more efficient while operating under comparable parameter settings. Finally, we present a qualitative analysis of selected discovered patterns.

papers.title: SparseCtrl-HOI: Sparse Temporal Control for Human-Object Interaction Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Human-Object Interaction (HOI) video generation aims to synthesize realistic videos of humans manipulating diverse objects, serving as a promising avenue for AI-driven live streaming e-commerce. A primary obstacle in this domain lies in the complexity of modeling fine-grained physical dynamics and the intricate spatial-temporal coordination between human hands and objects. Existing approaches to this problem typically rely on dense temporal guidance, e.g., frame-wise hand-object pose sequences, to strictly control the interaction process. However, such dense guidance incurs high annotation costs and affects motion synthesis diversity. To overcome these limitations, we introduce SparseCtrl-HOI, a novel sparse temporal control framework for HOI video generation. It requires only a few keyframes that capture interaction states at designated timestamps. Specifically, we employ a Time-Controlled Rotary Positional Embedding (TiRoPE) mechanism to temporally anchor these keyframes while preserving their spatial integrity. Subsequently, to govern the dynamics across intermediate frames, we propose a Motion Prior Injection Module that leverages Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to extract high-level motion priors. This empowers the model to hallucinate logically and physically plausible transitions. Furthermore, we build SparseHOI-5K, a high-quality and richly annotated dataset for HOI video generation with sparse temporal control. Comprehensive evaluations confirm that our method substantially reduces annotation overhead while synthesizing superior live-streaming e-commerce videos. Both our code and dataset are publicly available at https://mpi-lab.github.io/SparseCtrl-HOI.

papers.title: PluraMath: Extending Mathematical Reasoning Evaluation Beyond High-Resource Languages
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical reasoning has become a central task for evaluating and tuning reasoning Large Language Models (LLMs), yet existing benchmarks remain heavily biased toward high-resource languages, with English and Chinese dominating both pre-training corpora and evaluation suites. The recently released PolyMath (Wang et al., 2025) dataset represents a significant step forward, yet its coverage is still limited to 18 only high-resource languages. To address this gap, we introduce PluraMath, an extension of PolyMath to 18 additional {underrepresented languages spanning 6 language families -- ranging from mid-resource to extreme low-resource settings. We constructed the dataset through a human-curated pipeline, where native speakers thoroughly validated pre-computed translations. Using PluraMath, we then benchmark 27 reasoning LLMs across four model scales -- small, mid-size, large, and closed-source ensembles -- probing the multilingual mathematical reasoning capabilities of state-of-the-art models under diverse linguistic conditions. Our fine-grained analysis confirms a persistent gap in mathematical reasoning performance between high-resource and underrepresented languages, with stronger results largely associated with better instruction-following ability. We fully open-source our dataset, data acquisition pipeline, and evaluation framework, with the goal of lowering the barrier to multilingual benchmark development for underrepresented communities.

TL;DR: 本文提出PluraMath，将数学推理评估从原有的高资源语言扩展到18种新增的低资源语言（涵盖6个语系）。通过人工验证翻译管道构建数据集，并在27个推理LLM（从小型到闭源集成）上评估多语言数学推理能力，发现高资源与低资源语言间存在持续的性能差距，且性能与指令遵循能力相关。数据集和框架已开源。

papers.title: SpecTrack: Spectral Prompt Guided Adaptive Experts for Multispectral Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Multispectral image(MSI) and hyperspectral image(HSI) object tracking object tracking exploits recorded band-wise observations to improve target--background discrimination under similar RGB appearance, mixed pixels, illumination variation, occlusion, and clutter. However, existing trackers commonly process all search regions through a fixed capacity spectral--spatial path, ignoring that tracking difficulty varies substantially across frames and target states. Clear regions may require only lightweight local discrimination, whereas ambiguous boundaries and spectrally similar distractors often demand stronger contextual reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose SpecTrack, a spectral--spatial complexity-aware tracker that formulates MSI tracking as search-region-level adaptive capacity allocation. Its core component, the Spectral Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts (SAMoE) module, provides a capacity-ordered expert pool with progressively increasing latent rank, receptive field, and depth. Expert selection is guided by a Spectral Prompt Router, which fuses semantic context, spatial boundary cues, and a latent channel-variation cue computed after multispectral patch embedding to activate a sparse subset of SAMoE experts for each search region. In parallel, a Shared Global Expert supplies common latent spectral--spatial context to reduce fragmented sparse-routing decisions. Experiments on MUST, MSITrack, and HOTC20 demonstrate a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off. The accuracy-oriented SpecTrack-L384 achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive AUCs of 65.2\%, 51.9\%, and 72.6\% on the three benchmarks, while the balanced SpecTrack-B224 reaches 62.4\% AUC at 43.7 FPS on MUST. An additional GOT-10k evaluation indicates RGB-domain architectural generalization, with SpecTrack-L384 achieving 79.3\% AO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpecTrack，一种光谱-空间复杂度感知的多光谱目标跟踪器，通过光谱自适应混合专家（SAMoE）模块实现搜索区域级的自适应容量分配。利用光谱提示路由器（Spectral Prompt Router）融合语义、边界和通道变化线索，为每个搜索区域激活稀疏专家子集。在MUST、MSITrack和HOTC20基准上取得先进结果，并展示RGB域泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有跟踪器对所有搜索区域使用固定容量的光谱-空间路径，忽略了不同帧和目标状态下跟踪难度的差异，导致在清晰区域过度计算，在模糊区域能力不足。
Method: 提出SpecTrack，核心是SAMoE模块，包含容量递增的专家池（潜在秩、感受野、深度逐步增加）。专家选择由光谱提示路由器引导，融合语义上下文、空间边界线索以及多光谱块嵌入后的潜在通道变化线索，为每个搜索区域激活稀疏子集。同时共享全局专家提供共同潜在上下文。
Result: 在MUST、MSITrack和HOTC20上，精度导向的SpecTrack-L384达到65.2%、51.9%、72.6% AUC，平衡型SpecTrack-B224在MUST上达到62.4% AUC和43.7 FPS。在GOT-10k上显示RGB域泛化，SpecTrack-L384达到79.3% AO。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的复杂度感知自适应分配策略在多光谱目标跟踪中实现了精度与效率的良好平衡，并具有RGB域泛化潜力。

papers.title: Auto-DSM Under the Lens: A Black-Box Evaluation Framework for LLM-Based DSM Generation
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a black-box evaluation framework to systematically assess the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate Design Structure Matrices (DSMs) from structured technical documentation. Motivated by the closed-source nature of current Auto-DSM pipelines, the framework introduces a reproducible methodology that benchmarks generated DSMs (GEN-DSMs) against manually validated ground-truth matrices (GT-DSMs). The evaluation integrates both single-run and multi-run perspectives, combining structural metrics (Completeness, Correctness, Coupling Density), classification metrics (Selective Accuracy, Abstention Coverage), and stability measures (Entropy, Fleiss' $κ$). To synthesize these aspects, a Composite Quality Score (Q) is proposed. Controlled experiments are conducted on two datasets: a fictive abstract system and a real-world refrigerator decomposition, covering variations in phrasing, parameter-dataset alignment, and system complexity. Results show that LLMs can produce structurally plausible DSMs and achieve high reproducibility under well-structured inputs, but remain sensitive to ambiguity, inconsistent dependency definitions, and prompt formulation. The findings highlight systematic sources of hallucination and abstention failure, demonstrating both the potential and current limitations of LLM-driven DSM automation. The proposed framework provides a transparent benchmark for auditing Auto-DSM pipelines and establishes foundations for integrating LLM-based decomposition methods into model-based systems engineering (MBSE) workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个黑盒评估框架，系统评估大语言模型（LLM）从结构化技术文档生成设计结构矩阵（DSM）的能力。框架结合结构指标、分类指标和稳定性指标，提出综合质量分数Q，并在虚构抽象系统和真实冰箱分解数据集上进行对照实验。结果表明LLM能生成结构合理的DSM且高重现性，但对歧义、不一致依赖定义和提示表述敏感，揭示LLM驱动DSM自动化的潜力与当前局限。
Motivation: 现有Auto-DSM管道通常是闭源的，缺乏可重复的评估方法。本文旨在建立一个透明的基准框架，以审计和比较不同LLM在DSM生成任务上的表现。
Method: 提出黑盒评估框架，包含单次运行和多次运行视角，综合使用结构指标（完整性、正确性、耦合密度）、分类指标（选择性准确率、弃权覆盖率）和稳定性指标（熵、Fleiss' κ），并设计复合质量分数Q。在两个数据集（虚构抽象系统和真实冰箱分解）上进行控制实验，变化表述、参数-数据集对齐和系统复杂度。
Result: LLM在输入结构良好时能生成结构合理的DSM并达到高重现性，但对歧义、不一致依赖定义和提示表述敏感，存在系统性幻觉和弃权失败。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了透明的基准，可用于审计Auto-DSM管道，并为将基于LLM的分解方法集成到基于模型的系统工程工作流奠定基础。

papers.title: Learning Sparsest Linear Causal DAGs with Latent Confounders via Higher-Order Cumulants
papers.abstract_en: Recovering the exact directed acyclic graph (DAG) in linear non-Gaussian acyclic models with latent confounders (LvLiNGAM) remains a challenging problem. Although LvLiNGAM is identifiable only up to an observational equivalence class, each equivalence class is characterized by a unique sparsest DAG. Recovering the sparsest DAG from finite samples, however, remains difficult. Although existing methods are asymptotically consistent, they do not provide an explicit finite-sample procedure for recovering the unique sparsest DAG, nor do they handle models with an arbitrary number of latent confounders. In this paper, we propose a finite-sample method for recovering the sparsest DAG without imposing any restriction on the number of latent confounders. Simulation studies and real-data analyses demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior finite-sample performance compared with existing approaches.
