papers.title: Propose and Attend: Training-free MLLM Grounding Confidence via Multi-Token Localized Attention
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models can emit localized predictions, bounding boxes for objects and temporal windows for video and audio events, but they hallucinate these regions prolifically. The model's own token log-probabilities are nearly uninformative: they conflate grounding quality with input ambiguity, and coordinate tokens become near-deterministic once the model commits. We propose Multi-Token Localized Attention (MTLA): a training-free, post-hoc score that measures how strongly a prediction's tokens attend to the region they claim. Prior attention-based detectors, which sum attention over the entire input modality and read a single response token, are weaker special cases; we show that summing only within the claimed region and aggregating across all prediction tokens recovers a stronger grounding signal. The same recipe applies almost trivially to other modalities and tasks: object detection in images and temporal localization in video and audio. Across multiple MLLM families and three modalities, MTLA improves hallucination AUROC by +7 to +38 over the best prior training-free baseline. Used as a confidence score for re-ranking, it nearly doubles the zero-shot COCO detection AP of an open-source 8B generalist (from 20.4 to 37.0), narrowing the gap to supervised detectors without any task-specific training.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi-Token Localized Attention (MTLA)，一种无需训练的后处理分数，用于衡量多模态大语言模型输出的定位预测（如边界框、时间窗口）的置信度。通过聚合预测标记在声称区域内的注意力，MTLA 在多个模型和模态（图像、视频、音频）上显著优于先前的无训练基线，将幻觉检测 AUROC 提升 7-38 点。用于重新排序时，在零样本 COCO 检测上使 AP 从 20.4 提升至 37.0。

Conclusion: MTLA 是一种简单、无需训练的通用方法，能显著提升多模态大语言模型的定位置信度，适用于多种模态和任务，且无需任务特定训练。

papers.title: MCP-Enabled Agentic AI for Autonomous IPoDWDM Network Lifecycle Automation
papers.abstract_en: This demo presents an MCP-enabled agentic AI architecture for autonomous control of vendor-agnostic IPoDWDM networks. We demonstrate live end-to-end lifecycle multi-layer automation and closed-loop control using GNPy and telemetry, validated on a real testbed.
papers.comment: Accepted for demo presentation at the European Conference on Optical Communication (ECOC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于MCP的智能代理架构，用于实现供应商无关的IPoDWDM网络的自主控制。演示了实时端到端生命周期多层自动化和闭环控制，利用GNPy和遥测技术在真实测试平台上验证。
Motivation: 现有光网络管理缺乏完全自主的跨层生命周期自动化能力，尤其在多供应商环境中面临互操作性和闭环控制挑战。
Method: 采用MCP（可能是Model Context Protocol或类似）使能的代理人工智能架构，结合GNPy（物理层模型）和遥测数据，实现多层网络的端到端自动化和闭环控制。
Result: 在真实测试平台上成功演示了自主的IPoDWDM网络生命周期自动化，包括闭环控制。
Conclusion: 该架构展示了在真实网络中实现供应商无关的自主光网络管理的可行性，但摘要未提及泛化性或局限性。

papers.title: Faithful or Findable? Evaluating LLM-Generated Metadata for RDF Dataset Search
papers.abstract_en: Dataset search depends heavily on metadata, making LLM-generated metadata a consequential form of synthetic content in retrieval systems. We study six metadata-generation settings for RDF datasets, ranging from simple rewriting to profile-grounded and agentic graph-based generation, and evaluate them jointly for retrieval effectiveness and faithfulness. Unconstrained metadata rewriting delivers the strongest retrieval gains over the original metadata, but it is also the least faithful, showing that search improvements can be driven by unsupported semantic expansion. More grounded settings substantially improve faithfulness, and profile-grounded rewriting provides the most balanced trade-off between retrieval effectiveness and grounding. These findings position synthetic metadata as a system-level IR problem in which effectiveness, provenance, and trust must be evaluated together.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, accepted at SynthIR @ SIGIR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM生成RDF数据集元数据的六种设置（从简单重写到基于图谱的生成），并联合评估检索效果和忠实度。发现无约束重写在检索上增益最大但最不忠实，而基于profile的改写提供了最佳的均衡。作者强调应将合成元数据视为系统级IR问题，需同时评估效果、溯源和信任。
Motivation: 数据集搜索依赖元数据，LLM生成的元数据成为检索系统中重要的合成内容，但忠实度和检索效果之间的权衡未被充分研究。
Method: 定义了六种元数据生成设置：简单重写、基于profile的改写、基于profile和知识图谱的生成等，并在RDF数据集上评估检索效果和忠实度。
Result: 无约束重写在检索上超过原始元数据，但忠实度最低；更基于上下文的设置显著提高忠实度，其中profile-based改写提供了最佳权衡。
Conclusion: 合成元数据应作为系统级IR问题处理，需要同时优化检索效果、溯源和信任，而非单独追求检索性能。

papers.title: InfluMatch: Frontier-Quality KOL Search at 4B-Model Cost
papers.abstract_en: Matching influencers (KOLs) to free-form, multi-part Thai marketing criteria is today served either by keyword search over structured profiles, which misses semantic fit, or by prompting frontier LLMs over every candidate, which is accurate but slow and expensive. We present InfluMatch, a low-cost three-stage cascade -- retrieval $\rightarrow$ rerank $\rightarrow$ reason -- built entirely from small open-weight models: dense retrieval returns 50 candidates, a 4B pointwise reranker scores each by the log-probability of a single Yes token and keeps 10, and a 4B reasoner grades the shortlist per criterion on a rubric with a Thai rationale. The cascade is designed for cost: reasoning over a filtered top-10 halves token spend versus reasoning over all 50 while scoring 14 points higher. End-to-end against human relevance labels on an 11-query set with all 50 candidates labeled, the full cascade reaches 94.1% P@5, versus a retrieval-only baseline near random; it matches the frontier model Kimi-K2.6 (91.8%) while emitting ${\sim}35\times$ fewer output tokens and serving a 50-KOL query in ${\sim}20$ s on one A100. Notably, the only fine-tuning that pays off is pairwise: a SimPO-tuned reranker matches the frontier baseline's best-pick accuracy (78.0 EM), whereas fine-tuning the reasoner on pointwise per-criterion labels improves offline scores yet degrades end-to-end ranking -- an inversion we trace to the design of the absolute labeling task -- leaving the untuned base model as the strongest deployed reasoner. The result is a deployable, explainable KOL search system at a small fraction of frontier serving cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对泰语自由格式多条件营销标准中的影响者（KOL）匹配问题，提出了InfluMatch低成本三级级联系统（检索→重排序→推理），全部由小型开放权重模型构建。级联设计旨在降低推理成本：对过滤后的前10名候选进行推理，相比对全部50名候选进行推理，分词消耗减半而评分提高14分。在含有全部50名候选标注的11查询集上，完整级联达到94.1%的P@5，匹配前沿模型Kimi-K2.6 (91.8%)，输出token减少约35倍，在单张A100上处理50个KOL的查询约需20秒。值得注意的是，仅有的有效微调是成对微调：SimPO调优的重排序器在前沿基线的最佳选择准确率上达到78.0 EM，而对理由器进行逐点逐标准标注的微调虽然提高了离线分数，却降低了端到端排名性能，这种反转归因于绝对标注任务的设计，导致未调优的基础模型成为最强的部署理由器。
Motivation: 现有方法要么依赖对结构化配置文件的关键词搜索，忽略语义匹配；要么对每个候选提示前沿LLM，准确但昂贵且缓慢。需要一种低成本的、可部署且可解释的KOL搜索系统。
Method: 提出三级级联：密集检索返回50个候选，4B逐点重排序器通过Yes token的log概率评分并保留10个，4B理由器按标准对候选列表进行评分，同时输出泰语解释。系统完全由小型开放权重模型构建。
Result: 在11个查询（所有50个候选均有标注）上，完整级联达到94.1% P@5，匹配Kimi-K2.6 (91.8%)，输出token减少约35倍，单查询约20秒（单A100）。SimPO调优的重排序器在前沿基线的最佳选择准确率达到78.0 EM，而理由器微调反而降低端到端排名。
Conclusion: 证明低成本的级联方法可以在KOL搜索中达到前沿质量，同时大幅降低部署成本。理由器微调效果的异常反转提示逐点绝对标注任务可能不适合该场景。

papers.title: Decoupled Single-Mask Annotation Noise Detection via Cross-Sectional Patch Self-Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Vascular computed tomography datasets are commonly annotated only once per scan, yielding the pervasive yet under addressed problem of single mask annotation noise. Existing solutions either require costly multirater fusion or are coupled with network training, preventing explicit auditing of where and why labels fail. We introduce a decoupled framework for single-mask annotation noise detection that leverages cross-sectional patch self-consistency to produce interpretable and auditable noise evidence. Tubular anatomy exhibits strong cross-sectional recurrence: patches extracted orthogonally along vessel centrelines recur in appearance across locations and subjects. Thus, anatomically similar patches should have consistent masks, and disagreement signals unreliable annotation. Our method samples cross-sectional patches, retrieves intensity-equivalent neighbours via scalable vector search, and computes a patch-level noise score from statistical mask disagreement, yielding explicit image-mask evidence for every flagged region. Aggregating scores produces scan-level quality maps for dataset quality assessment or quality-weighted training. Experiments on the coronary CT dataset validate the detected noise for improving training robustness and reveal systematic annotation biases. Specifically, transverse and oblique vessels exhibit 5.1 times higher error rates than axis-aligned structures, with additional correlations to cross-sectional area and intensity. Code is available here.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种解耦的针对单掩膜标注噪声的检测框架，利用横截面补丁自一致性生成可解释的噪声证据。该方法通过沿血管中心线正交提取补丁，检索强度相似的邻居并计算掩膜不一致性分数，为每个异常区域提供明确的图像-掩膜证据。实验在冠状动脉CT数据集上验证了检测到的噪声可提升训练鲁棒性，并揭示了系统性的标注偏差。
Motivation: 血管CT数据集通常每张扫描只标注一次，导致单掩膜标注噪声问题普遍存在但未被充分解决。现有方法要么需要昂贵的多评分者融合，要么与网络训练耦合，无法明确审计标签失败的位置和原因。
Method: 提出解耦的单掩膜标注噪声检测框架：沿血管中心线正交提取横截面补丁，通过可扩展向量搜索检索强度一致的邻居，计算补丁级掩膜统计不一致性分数，聚合得到扫描级质量图。
Result: 在冠状动脉CT数据集上，检测到的噪声提升了训练鲁棒性，并揭示了系统性标注偏差：横向和斜向血管的错误率是轴向对齐结构的5.1倍，且与横截面积和强度相关。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了可解释的噪声证据，支持数据集质量评估或质量加权训练，有助于理解和修正标注偏差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic AI for IPoDWDM Network Lifecycle Automation: An MCP-Enabled Architecture
papers.abstract_en: We present a distributed, vendor-agnostic multi-MCP architecture for SDN-based automation and autonomous control of multi-vendor, multi-layer IPoDWDM networks. The framework enables E2E service lifecycle automation, closed-loop cross-layer control using GNPy model and optical telemetry, and is experimentally validated on a IPoDWDM testbed.
papers.comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the European Conference on Optical Communication (ECOC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种分布式、供应商无关的多 MCP 架构，用于 SDN 驱动的多供应商多层 IPoDWDM 网络的自动化与自主控制。框架实现端到端服务生命周期自动化、基于 GNPy 模型和光学遥测的闭环跨层控制，并在 IPoDWDM 测试台上进行了实验验证。
Motivation: 现有 IPoDWDM 网络存在多供应商环境下的自动化孤岛问题，需要统一的架构实现跨层闭环控制和生命周期管理。
Method: 提出基于多 MCP（Model Context Protocol）的分布式架构，利用 GNPy 模型和光学遥测实现跨层闭环控制。
Result: 在 IPoDWDM 测试台上进行了实验验证，展示了端到端服务生命周期自动化和闭环控制的能力。
Conclusion: 该架构可扩展至多供应商多层网络，为未来自主 IPoDWDM 网络提供基础。

summary_sections.method: 提出基于多 MCP（Model Context Protocol）的分布式架构，利用 GNPy 模型和光学遥测实现跨层闭环控制。
summary_sections.result: 在 IPoDWDM 测试台上进行了实验验证，展示了端到端服务生命周期自动化和闭环控制的能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该架构可扩展至多供应商多层网络，为未来自主 IPoDWDM 网络提供基础。

papers.title: Integrating knowledge graphs and multilingual scholarly corpora for domain-adaptive LLMs in SSH
papers.abstract_en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into scientific research workflows, particularly for bibliographic discovery and literature synthesis, raises significant methodological, epistemic and regulatory challenges for the Social Sciences and Humanities (SSH), especially with regard to disciplinary diversity, multilingual access to sources and the evaluation of results. This paper presents an on-going use case developed within the European project LLMs4EU and the ALT-EDIC infrastructure, aimed at adapting foundation models to SSH research practices and supporting tasks such as question answering, comparative document analysis and literature review. The evaluation framework follows the LLMs4EU protocol and encompasses both independent quantitative benchmarking (retrieval, summarisation, traceability and hallucination detection) and a qualitative assessment involving a panel of Digital Humanities experts. By embedding model adaptation within research infrastructures and a structured legal and ethical compliance framework, the use case explores how domain-sensitive and regulation-aware generative AI can support SSH scholarship while preserving reliability and epistemic responsibility.

papers.title: NegROI: Click-Centric Uncertainty-Guided Refinement with Scene-Conditioned Negative Prompts for Robust Interactive 3D Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Interactive 3D segmentation aims to extract object masks in point clouds with minimal user clicks. Despite recent progress, most existing approaches still struggle with (i) coarse voxel resolution that blurs fine boundaries under limited clicks and (ii) hard false positives caused by confusing background structures. These issues are exacerbated by density and scale shifts across datasets (e.g., dense RGB-D reconstructions vs. sparse LiDAR scans), where fixed refinement heuristics and purely click-driven decoding generalize poorly. To address them, we propose NegROI -- a novel transformer-based interactive framework that couples click-centric multi-resolution refinement with scene-conditioned negative prompts. Given a coarse voxel prediction, it refines only a local Region Of Interest (ROI) around the current click on a finer grid and fuses refined logits back to the coarse mask. To improve robustness and efficiency, we introduce uncertainty-driven selective refinement that prioritizes ambiguous regions. Meanwhile, we model hard background patterns via a set of scene-conditioned negative prompts obtained by cross-attention over scene tokens. We further stabilize these prompts with a diversity regularizer. Finally, we propose boundary-aware hard negative mining to supervise negative-prompt attention toward boundary-proximal, high-confidence false positives. Our experiments on common benchmark datasets (i.e., ScanNet, S3DIS, and KITTI) demonstrate improved click efficiency and reduced false positives, with stronger cross-dataset robustness than the state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NegROI，一种基于 Transformer 的交互式 3D 点云分割框架，通过点击中心的多分辨率细化（click-centric multi-resolution refinement）和场景条件负提示（scene-conditioned negative prompts）来应对粗体素分辨率导致的边界模糊和背景结构的假阳性问题。实验在 ScanNet、S3DIS 和 KITTI 上展示了优于现有方法的点击效率和跨数据集鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有交互式 3D 分割方法受限于粗体素分辨率导致边界模糊，且难以处理由混乱背景结构引起的难假阳性，这些问题在不同数据集（如密集 RGB-D 重建与稀疏 LiDAR 扫描）间因密度和尺度变化而加剧。
Method: 提出一种基于 Transformer 的交互式框架，包含点击中心的多分辨率细化（仅在当前点击的局部 ROI 上以更细网格进行细化并融合回粗掩码）、不确定性驱动的选择性细化（优先处理模糊区域）以及场景条件负提示（通过场景 token 的交叉注意力学习背景模式，并引入多样性正则化和边界感知的难负样本挖掘）。
Result: 在 ScanNet、S3DIS 和 KITTI 基准上，该方法相比现有基线提升了点击效率并减少了假阳性，同时展现出更强的跨数据集鲁棒性。
Conclusion: NegROI 通过结合点击中心局部细化与场景条件负提示，有效解决了粗分辨率模糊和背景假阳性问题，在多种点云场景下提升了交互式分割的性能和泛化能力。

papers.title: Signed-Graph Recommendation as Structural Consistency Maximization
papers.abstract_en: While signed social recommendation has shown great potential by modeling both trust and distrust relations, its effectiveness is often hindered by structural noise and data sparsity. In this work, we first identify a fundamental inconsistency across the structural, propagation, and semantic layers of existing models, which leads to biased representations learned from sparse or noisy datasets. Furthermore, we observe that most existing methods treat the observed graph as fixed, failing to bridge the gap between noisy topologies and reliable social semantics. To address these issues, we propose a unified framework named SSC-Loop that treats signed social recommendation as the maximization of structural consistency. SSC-Loop includes three dedicated modules: ESA-DA for structural consistency, a P/N/O propagation mechanism for propagation consistency, and a contrastive learning objective for semantic consistency. Experiments on Epinions demonstrate that SSC-Loop achieves strong performance on explicit signed social rating prediction, while auxiliary results on Slashdot under a derived link-existence setting further suggest its ability to exploit signed social structures. Source code is available at https://github.com/Refrainwww/SSC-Loop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SSC-Loop 框架，将有符号社会推荐问题转化为结构一致性最大化。该框架包含三个模块：ESA-DA 保证结构一致性、P/N/O 传播机制保证传播一致性、对比学习目标保证语义一致性。在 Epinions 数据集上，对显式有符号评分预测任务取得了强性能；在 Slashdot 数据集上的辅助实验表明该方法能有效利用有符号社交结构。
Motivation: 现有有符号社会推荐模型在结构、传播和语义层面存在不一致，导致从稀疏或有噪声数据中学到的表征有偏；且大多数方法将观察到的图视为固定，未能弥合有噪声拓扑与可靠社交语义之间的差距。
Method: 提出 SSC-Loop 统一框架，通过三个模块最大化结构一致性：ESA-DA 模块处理结构一致性、P/N/O 传播机制处理传播一致性、对比学习目标处理语义一致性。
Result: 在 Epinions 数据集上显式有符号评分预测任务取得强性能；在 Slashdot 数据集上通过推导的链接存在性设置进一步验证了利用有符号社交结构的能力。
Conclusion: 将有符号社会推荐作为结构一致性最大化是有效的，未来可探索扩展到更多社交信号。

papers.title: SearchEyes: Towards Frontier Multimodal Deep Search Intelligence via Search World Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Training multimodal search agents to perform multi-hop reasoning remains challenging due to a fundamental structural disconnect: existing pipelines construct training data, search environments, and reward signals independently, causing synthesized structural metadata to be discarded, environments to rely on irreproducible external engines, and RL rewards to remain sparse at the trajectory level. We present \textbf{SearchEyes}, which uses a typed knowledge graph as the backbone of a \emph{simulated search world} that unifies all three components. We propose \textbf{Perception-Knowledge Chains (PKC)} to sample constrained multi-hop paths over the visual-knowledge intersection of Wikidata5M, retaining hop-level entity metadata that simultaneously defines a self-contained search world and step-level reward anchors. We further propose \textbf{Hop-Anchored Policy Optimization (HaPO)}, which reuses these anchors for step-level credit assignment without a separately trained process reward model. Experiments on six multimodal knowledge-intensive benchmarks show that SearchEyes achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source multimodal search agents, with SearchEyes-27B improving over the strongest open-source baseline by 6.2 points on average.%
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SearchEyes，利用类型化知识图谱作为模拟搜索世界的骨干，统一训练数据、搜索环境和奖励信号。提出Perception-Knowledge Chains (PKC) 从Wikidata5M的视觉-知识交集采样约束多跳路径，保留跳级实体元数据；提出Hop-Anchored Policy Optimization (HaPO) 进行步级信用分配。在六个多模态知识密集型基准上，SearchEyes-27B平均比最强开源基线提升6.2分。
Motivation: 现有多模态搜索智能体的训练数据、搜索环境和奖励信号独立构建，导致合成结构元数据被丢弃、环境依赖不可重现的外部引擎、RL奖励在轨迹层面稀疏。
Method: 使用类型化知识图谱作为模拟搜索世界骨干，统一三个组件。提出PKC从Wikidata5M的视觉-知识交集采样约束多跳路径；提出HaPO重用锚点进行步级信用分配。
Result: 在六个多模态知识密集型基准上取得开源多模态搜索智能体的最佳性能，SearchEyes-27B平均比最强开源基线提升6.2分。
Conclusion: 通过统一训练、环境和奖励信号解决了结构脱节问题，实现了更好的多跳推理性能。

papers.title: Is Domain Adaptation Always Helpful? A Frozen-Backbone Study of Cross-Domain Sentiment Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Sentiment analysis with frozen pre-trained language model (PLM) backbones has become a common paradigm, yet the practical benefit of explicit domain adaptation remains unclear, particularly when backbones encode varying degrees of target-domain knowledge. We present a preliminary case study evaluating a controlled family of frozen embedding backbones (Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B, 4B, 8B), alongside RoBERTa-base and FinBERT. We train a lightweight MLP adapter on consumer reviews using Domain-Adversarial Neural Networks (DANN), Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), and Supervised Contrastive Learning (SCL), and evaluate transfer to movie reviews (SST-2) and a heavily restricted subset of financial news (Financial PhraseBank). Within this constrained sample, we observe two distinct transfer patterns. On SST-2, domain adaptation provides negligible gain regardless of scale. On the financial subset, explicit domain adaptation appears to recover substantial performance for small general-purpose backbones. Notably, we find that adversarial alignment (DANN) is associated with degraded performance for domain-specialized backbones like FinBERT, consistent with erosion of pre-existing domain-specific structure, whereas supervised contrastive loss appears to preserve it. These preliminary findings suggest that the efficacy of explicit domain adaptation is highly contingent on whether the frozen backbone already possesses target-domain coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过冻结预训练语言模型（PLM）骨干的跨情感域迁移实验，发现显式域适应（domain adaptation）并非总是有益。在消费者评论到电影评论（SST-2）的迁移中，域适应几乎无增益；而在到金融新闻子集（Financial PhraseBank）的迁移中，对小规模通用骨干有显著恢复效果，但对领域专用骨干（FinBERT）反而导致性能下降。
Motivation: 当前冻结PLM骨干的情感分析范式下，显式域适应是否带来实际收益尚不明确，尤其是当骨干已编码不同程度的目标域知识时。
Method: 使用Qwen3-Embedding（0.6B/4B/8B）、RoBERTa-base和FinBERT作为冻结骨干，训练轻量MLP适配器，并比较Domain-Adversarial Neural Networks（DANN）、Maximum Mean Discrepancy（MMD）和Supervised Contrastive Learning（SCL）三种域适应方法。
Result: 在SST-2上域适应无实质提升；在金融子集上，DANN对FinBERT等专用骨干造成性能退化，而SCL则保留了领域专用结构。
Conclusion: 显式域适应的有效性高度依赖于冻结骨干是否已覆盖目标域，对于已具备目标域知识的骨干，域适应可能适得其反。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mitigating Errors in LLM-Generated Web API Invocations via Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Constrained Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Integration of web APIs is a cornerstone of modern software systems, yet writing correct web API invocation code remains challenging due to complex and evolving API specifications. Although LLMs are increasingly used for code generation, previous work has empirically shown that their ability to generate correct web API integrations is limited. At the same time, mitigation techniques and their effectiveness for this setting remain insufficiently understood. In this paper, we propose and systematically evaluate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and constrained decoding (CD) as two complementary approaches to improving LLM-generated web API invocation code. For RAG, we design a retriever that processes OpenAPI specifications and retrieves compact endpoint representations to inject into model prompts. For CD, we introduce an automatic translation from OpenAPI specifications to regex-based constraints enforced during generation. We evaluate both approaches on WAPIIBench's existing synthetic dataset and on a new real-world dataset derived from GitHub repositories. Our results show that RAG reduces hallucinations and improves correctness when generating full API invocations but reduces it when the endpoint is already provided as it encourages the generation of unnecessary parameters. In contrast, CD reliably prevents illegal URLs, HTTP methods, and arguments and substantially improves overall correctness for both starter codes.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了检索增强生成（RAG）和约束解码（CD）两种方法在改善大语言模型生成Web API调用代码中的错误问题。作者基于OpenAPI规范设计检索器提取紧凑端点表示注入提示，并自动将规范转换为正则约束。实验表明RAG在生成完整API调用时减少幻觉并提高正确性，但当端点已提供时反而因鼓励生成多余参数而降低性能；CD则能可靠防止非法URL、HTTP方法和参数，显著提高整体正确性。
Motivation: Web API集成是现代软件系统的关键，但编写正确的API调用代码因规范复杂且易变而困难。LLM生成代码的能力有限，而针对该场景的缓解技术及其有效性尚不明确。
Method: 提出两种互补方法：RAG方面，设计检索器处理OpenAPI规范，检索紧凑端点表示注入提示；CD方面，自动将OpenAPI规范转换为基于正则表达式的约束，在生成过程中强制执行。
Result: 在WAPIIBench合成数据集和从GitHub仓库导出的新真实世界数据集上，RAG在生成完整API调用时减少幻觉并提高正确性，但提供端点时反而降低性能；CD可靠防止非法URL、HTTP方法和参数，显著改善整体正确性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调RAG和CD是互补的方法，CD在防止语法错误方面尤为有效，而RAG在上下文完整时有益。未来工作需进一步研究两者结合及对真实API的影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Energy-Efficient GPU DVFS for Fine-Tuning of SLMs on Resource-constrained Embedded Devices
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic Voltage Frequency Scaling (DVFS) on resource-constrained embedded GPU platforms is essential for energy-efficient small language model (SLM) fine-tuning, as privacy- and personalization-driven adaptation increasingly requires local execution and involves repeated forward-backward optimization over many mini-batches, making it substantially more time- and energy-intensive than single-pass inference. To this end, 1) we first characterize the fine-tuning behavior of representative encoder-only SLMs of BERT variants, and autoregressive decoder-only SLMs of Pythia variants on GLUE benchmarks. In addition to the characterizations, 2) we propose a simple yet effective ML-based model selection that selects energy-optimal GPU DVFS settings on resource-constrained embedded platforms. Our results on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin demonstrate average 13.11% energy savings (up to 26.73%) over MAXN Mode 0, which has no explicit power cap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对资源受限嵌入式GPU平台上小语言模型(SLM)微调的高能耗问题，提出基于机器学习的GPU DVFS设置选择方法。在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上，相比无显式功率上限的MAXN Mode 0，平均节能13.11%（最高26.73%）。
Motivation: SLM微调比推理更耗能，而嵌入式设备资源受限，需要动态电压频率缩放(DVFS)来节能，但现有方法未针对微调优化。
Method: 首先表征编码器型（BERT变体）和自回归解码器型（Pythia变体）SLM在GLUE基准上的微调行为，然后提出一种基于机器学习的高效模型选择方法，用于选择能量最优的GPU DVFS设置。
Result: 在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上，相比无显式功率上限的MAXN Mode 0，平均节能13.11%，最高26.73%。
Conclusion: 该工作表明通过ML模型选择GPU DVFS设置能有效降低嵌入式平台SLM微调能耗，但仅限于特定平台和模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CMDR: Contextual Multimodal Document Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal document retrieval aims to retrieve relevant pages while preserving both textual and visual content from the original document. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate simple lexical or semantic matching, and most methods encode pages independently. Consequently, they overlook the contextual information in the document required to resolve queries that aggregate information across multiple pages. In this paper, we introduce CMDR and CMDR-Bench, a new multimodal document retrieval task and benchmark that require modeling document context. To address this challenge, we propose CMDR-Embed, a contextual multimodal embedding framework that explicitly incorporates document context by jointly encoding multiple pages and deriving page-level embeddings from a shared contextual representation. Furthermore, we introduce CMCL, a contextual multimodal contrastive learning objective that effectively trains CMDR-Embed by balancing contextual modeling with page-level discriminability. Experiments demonstrate that CMDR-Embed significantly outperforms non-contextual embeddings, highlighting the importance of context-aware multimodal embeddings for advancing document retrieval.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态文档检索中忽略文档上下文的问题，提出新任务CMDR及基准CMDR-Bench，并提出了上下文多模态嵌入框架CMDR-Embed，通过联合编码多页面并运用上下文多模态对比学习目标CMCL，显著提升检索效果。
Motivation: 现有多模态文档检索基准主要评估简单的词汇或语义匹配，方法独立编码页面，缺乏对跨页面聚合查询所需的文档上下文信息的建模。
Method: 提出CMDR-Embed框架，联合编码多个页面并从共享上下文表示中生成页面级嵌入；同时引入CMCL对比学习目标，在保留页面级区分性的同时增强上下文建模能力。
Result: 实验结果显示CMDR-Embed在CMDR-Bench上显著优于非上下文嵌入方法，证明了上下文感知多模态嵌入对文档检索的重要性。
Conclusion: 论文强调，通过显式建模文档上下文并平衡上下文与页面级特征，可以显著提升多模态文档检索的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PCBWorld: A Benchmark Environment for Engine-Grounded PCB Design Automation
papers.abstract_en: PCB routing is the task of connecting the nets of a board with copper traces under strict design rules, yet learning-based methods still lag behind rule-based routers. We introduce PCBWorld, an open-source engine-grounded PCB routing environment built on the KiCad EDA engine. As a human engineer does, agents in PCBWorld interactively route a board through the engine's native operations, using its Design Rule Check (DRC) feedback to keep the routing within the design rules. The environment supports both RL policies and tool-using LLM agents. Alongside the environment, PCBWorld-Bench provides three dataset families in KiCad's native board format (.kicad_pcb), covering two types of controllable synthetic instances and 679 real open-source boards. It scores any completed board with eight engine-checked evaluation metrics, regardless of the routing method. In our experiments, agents in PCBWorld consistently outperformed grid-action RL policies and open-loop LLM baselines, and an RL policy trained only on synthetic boards transferred zero-shot to real boards, approaching rule-based routers. These results position the engine-grounded, interactive approach of PCBWorld as a promising foundation for advancing the routing ability of both RL and LLM agents.
papers.comment: Accepted to the KDD 2026 Workshop on Evaluation and Trustworthiness of Agentic AI (non-archival). Main text with appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PCBWorld，一个基于KiCad EDA引擎的PCB布线环境，支持强化学习（RL）和工具使用的大语言模型（LLM）智能体。环境提供设计规则检查（DRC）反馈，并配备包含合成和真实板卡的基准测试集。实验表明，RL和LLM智能体在该环境中优于基线方法，且仅用合成数据训练的RL策略可零样本迁移至真实板卡，性能接近基于规则的布线器。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的PCB布线方法仍落后于基于规则的布线器，缺乏一个能够模拟人类工程师交互式布线过程、并提供真实引擎反馈的基准环境。
Method: 基于KiCad EDA引擎构建PCBWorld环境，智能体通过引擎原生操作进行交互式布线，并利用DRC反馈确保符合设计规则。同时发布PCBWorld-Bench，包含三类数据集（可控合成实例和679个真实开源板卡），并提供八种引擎检查的评估指标。
Result: 在实验中，PCBWorld中的智能体一致优于基于网格动作的RL策略和开环LLM基线。仅用合成板卡训练的RL策略零样本迁移到真实板卡，性能接近基于规则的布线器。
Conclusion: 引擎接地、交互式方法为提升RL和LLM智能体的布线能力提供了有希望的基础。

papers.title: Progressive Reasoning with Primitive Correction for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL) aims to combine known attributes and objects as primitives for recognizing previously unseen attribute-object pairs. Prior works either predict attributes and objects independently, missing their strong contextual dependency, or use unidirectional conditional modeling (e.g., object-guided attribute prediction), which is prone to error propagation. We propose PRPC, a Progressive Reasoning framework with Primitive Correction, which explicitly models the bidirectional dependency between attributes and objects via step-wise inference. PRPC performs mutual correction of primitives to suppress prediction errors in earlier steps. Specifically, we formulate CZSL as structured, Q&A-style Chain-of-Thought reasoning process and constrain the MLLM to follow predefined semantic steps to generate intermediate decisions. To further enhance the reliability and logical consistency of intermediate reasoning, we introduce reinforcement learning post-training with a GRPO-based objective, providing step-level rewards aligned with the progressive inference procedure. Extensive experiments on three CZSL benchmarks demonstrate that PRPC achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of progressive reasoning and bidirectional correction for robust compositional generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出渐进式推理与原始纠正框架（PRPC），用于组合零样本学习（CZSL），通过双向依赖建模和步骤级强化学习提升属性-对象组合的泛化能力。在三个 CZSL 基准上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有 CZSL 方法或独立预测属性和对象导致上下文依赖缺失，或使用单向条件建模导致错误传播。
Method: 将 CZSL 建模为结构化链式推理过程，约束 MLLM 按预定义语义步骤生成中间决策，并通过 GRPO 目标进行强化学习后训练，提供步骤级奖励。
Result: 在三个 CZSL 基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，验证了渐进推理和双向纠正的有效性。
Conclusion: 渐进推理与双向纠正为鲁棒的组合泛化提供了有效途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PolicyShiftGuard: Benchmarking and Improving Policy-Adaptive Image Guardrails
papers.abstract_en: Image guardrails are typically trained and evaluated under a fixed safety policy, implicitly treating safety as an intrinsic property of an image. Real deployments are different: the same image may be allowed in one product, restricted in another, and newly disallowed when a policy boundary changes. We study policy-adaptive image guardrailing, where a model must decide whether an image violates the currently supplied policy and generalize to held-out policy definitions. We introduce PolicyShiftBench, a comprehensive benchmark with 2,000 policy-discriminative instances over 265 images, where each image is paired with 7.55 policy-conditioned prompts on average to test whether models adapt to the active policy rather than relying on image-level safety priors. We then propose PolicyShiftGuard, a compact policy-conditioned guardrail trained with a two-stage training recipe that combines Randomized Policy SFT (RP-SFT) with Boundary-Pair Policy Adaptation (BP-Adapt). BP-Adapt trains matched prompts for the same image and risk category using standard label supervision and a pairwise comparison loss that separates blocking policies from passing policies. Experiments show that existing VLMs and specialized guardrails remain brittle under policy shifts, while PolicyShiftGuard substantially improves policy-sensitive performance. The 7B model achieves SOTA performance of 76.9 Avg. F1 and 72.1 Avg. PSS on PolicyShiftBench, transfers well to UnSafeBench and SafeEditBench, and improves the latency-performance trade-off with a concise output format. Ablations confirm that matched pass/block boundary pairs are essential for stable policy adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究策略自适应的图像安全护栏（policy-adaptive image guardrails），指模型需根据当前提供的策略判断图像是否违规，而非依赖图像固有安全属性。作者构建了包含2000个策略判别实例的基准PolicyShiftBench，并提出PolicyShiftGuard模型，采用两阶段训练（随机化策略SFT和边界对策略适应），在基准上取得SOTA性能。实验表明现有VLM和安全护栏在策略变化时表现脆弱，而PolicyShiftGuard显著提升策略敏感性能。
Motivation: 现有图像安全护栏通常在固定策略下训练和评估，隐含将安全视为图像固有属性，但实际部署中同一图像在不同产品、不同策略边界下可能被允许或禁止，缺乏策略适应能力。
Method: 提出PolicyShiftGuard，一个紧凑的策略条件护栏，采用两阶段训练：Randomized Policy SFT (RP-SFT) 和 Boundary-Pair Policy Adaptation (BP-Adapt)。BP-Adapt使用标准标签监督和成对比较损失训练同一图像和风险类别的匹配提示，分离阻止策略与通过策略。
Result: 7B模型在PolicyShiftBench上达到76.9 Avg. F1和72.1 Avg. PSS的SOTA性能，且能良好迁移至UnSafeBench和SafeEditBench，并通过简洁输出格式改善延迟-性能权衡。消融实验证实匹配的通过/阻止边界对对于稳定策略适应至关重要。
Conclusion: 论文强调策略自适应的图像护栏是必要且可行的，PolicyShiftGuard通过边界对训练有效提升策略敏感性能，但现有模型在策略漂移下仍脆弱。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Drift Happens: An Empirical Study of Neural Architecture Robustness to Temporal Distribution Shift
authors: Riccardo Colletti (1) ((1) Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences
papers.abstract_en: Real-world data distributions evolve over time, inducing temporal distribution shift that can substantially degrade the reliability of deployed machine learning systems. However, the extent to which architectural choices and their associated inductive biases affect temporal robustness remains insufficiently understood. We present a systematic empirical comparison of temporal robustness across three heterogeneous, time-indexed domains encompassing image classification, multi-label text classification, and text regression tasks. Using a unified evaluation framework based on temporal drift matrices, we train models on cumulative historical data and evaluate their performance on both earlier and later time periods, thereby quantifying cross-temporal generalization. Our study spans model families ranging from simple multilayer perceptrons and convolutional networks to recurrent networks and pretrained Transformer-based encoders. Collectively, the results show that architectural inductive biases systematically shape temporal robustness: models whose inductive biases lead them to exploit localized, highly discriminative features attain the highest in-distribution accuracy, yet those features are often the ones that change most over time, so these models degrade fastest, while pretrained encoders that draw on coarser, more stable representations drift more gradually. These observations offer practical guidance for selecting architectures for real-world systems subject to temporal drift.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 28 figures. Extended version of the QCDS 2026 proceedings paper; proceedings version to appear in Springer LNCS. Interactive website: https://drift-happens.org/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过系统实证比较，研究了不同神经网络架构（包括MLP、CNN、RNN和预训练Transformer编码器）对时间分布偏移的鲁棒性。使用统一的时间漂移矩阵评估框架，在图像分类、多标签文本分类和文本回归三个时间索引域中，发现架构的归纳偏置系统性地影响时间鲁棒性：依赖局部高判别特征的模型随时间的性能下降最快，而预训练编码器因使用更粗粒度、更稳定的表征而漂移更慢。
Motivation: 现实世界的数据分布随时间演化，导致时间分布偏移降低机器学习系统的可靠性，但架构选择及其归纳偏置对时间鲁棒性的影响尚不明确。
Method: 采用统一的时间漂移矩阵评估框架，在三个异构时间索引域（图像分类、多标签文本分类、文本回归）上，使用累积历史数据训练模型，并评估其在早期和晚期时间段的性能，量化跨时间泛化能力。比较的模型系列包括MLP、CNN、RNN和预训练Transformer编码器。
Result: 研究发现，架构的归纳偏置系统性地塑造时间鲁棒性：依赖局部高判别特征（如CNN）的模型在分布内准确率最高，但这些特征随时间变化最快，导致性能下降最快；而预训练编码器（如Transformer）因使用更稳定、更粗粒度的表征而漂移更慢。
Conclusion: 这些观察结果为在时间漂移环境中选择实际部署的架构提供了实践指导。

papers.title: GaussFusion: Towards Multimodal 3D Gaussian Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting provides an explicit representation that jointly models geometry and appearance, serving as a scalable foundation for 3D representation learning. Existing pre-training methods for Gaussian representations, such as masked Gaussian reconstruction, primarily capture local structures but offer limited semantic supervision. In this paper, we propose GaussFusion, a multimodal pre-training framework for 3D Gaussian representations. GaussFusion integrates image and text supervision into masked Gaussian modeling through cross-modal semantic alignment, enabling the Gaussian encoder to learn both visual and language-level semantic information during pre-training. To better adapt masked modeling to the non-uniform distribution of Gaussian primitives, we further propose Gaussian Salience-guided Multi-scale Hole Masking (GSHM). GSHM constructs spatially continuous masked regions based on Gaussian salience. By applying hole masks at multiple scales, GSHM encourages the encoder to capture both fine-grained local patterns and broader structural dependencies. Extensive experiments on downstream tasks demonstrate that GaussFusion improves the transferability of Gaussian representations. Notably, GaussFusion outperforms Gaussian-MAE on ModelNet40 and ScanObjectNN (PB-T50-RS) by 0.61\% and 3.85\%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GaussFusion，一个多模态预训练框架，用于3D高斯表示。它通过跨模态语义对齐将图像和文本监督整合到掩码高斯建模中，并提出高斯显著性引导的多尺度空洞掩码（GSHM）适应高斯原语的非均匀分布。在下游任务（如ModelNet40和ScanObjectNN）上，GaussFusion优于Gaussian-MAE。
Motivation: 现有的高斯表示预训练方法（如掩码高斯重建）主要捕获局部结构，但缺乏语义监督，限制了表示的可迁移性。
Method: GaussFusion集成图像和文本监督进行跨模态语义对齐，并提出GSHM，根据高斯显著性构建空间连续掩码区域，并采用多尺度空洞掩码以捕获细粒度局部模式和更广的结构依赖。
Result: 在ModelNet40上比Gaussian-MAE提高0.61%，在ScanObjectNN (PB-T50-RS)上提高3.85%。
Conclusion: GaussFusion通过多模态监督和改进的掩码策略提升了3D高斯表示的可迁移性，实验证明了其有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: More Convincing, Not More Correct: Self-Play Reward Hacking of Reference-Free LLM Judges
papers.abstract_en: Training a language model against its own reference-free judgments (the premise of self-rewarding, self-play, and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines) assumes a model's verdict on a shown answer tracks correctness. We show it fails structurally: conditioned on a candidate, a judge scores plausibility, not correctness, leaving false-positive basins a policy learns to exploit. We measure this with a hidden-anchor audit: a held-out, cross-source exact-match check the judge never sees. On GSM8K with Qwen3 policies, self-play drives the judge's pass rate from 0.72 to 0.94 while true accuracy stays at 0.20 (three seeds). This reward hacking is not white-box gaming: the errors transfer across judge families (Qwen, Llama, Gemma) and scales, a strict three-judge ensemble still accepts 55% of them, and no plausibility-scoring defense closes the basin. The decisive variable is whether the judge commits an answer of its own before using the candidate: committing first drops the false-positive rate from 0.719 to 0.012, blind solving lifts discrimination to 0.96, and used as the training reward the de-anchored channel keeps false positives at zero, preventing the basin rather than only detecting it. A falsifiable bound (the gap is at most 1 - accuracy) predicts which regimes are exposed. The full arc replicates without training under best-of-N selection in code and competition math, and with a Gemma policy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究参考无关的LLM裁判在自奖励/自对弈管道中的奖励破解问题。通过隐藏锚点审计发现，在GSM8K上使用Qwen3策略，自我对弈将裁判通过率从0.72提升到0.94，但真实准确率仅0.20。这种奖励破解跨裁判家族和规模迁移，而让裁判先提交自己的答案再使用候选答案可以大幅降低假阳性率。
Motivation: 现有自奖励/自对弈方法假设模型对答案的评判跟踪正确性，但本文指出裁判实际上评估的是合理性而非正确性，导致存在假阳性盆地，策略可以利用。
Method: 提出隐藏锚点审计（hidden-anchor audit），即一个裁判从未见过的跨源精确匹配检查；并分析通过要求裁判先提交自己的答案再使用候选答案（de-anchoring）来防止奖励破解。
Result: 在GSM8K上，自我对弈驱动裁判通过率从0.72到0.94，但真实准确率仅0.20；裁判先提交答案可将假阳性率从0.719降至0.012，盲解提升辨别力至0.96，用作训练奖励时保持假阳性为零。
Conclusion: 论文强调裁判先提交自己的答案（commit first）是防止奖励破解的关键，而非事后检测；并提供了一个可证伪的界（差距最多1-准确率）预测暴露区域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: K-ABENA: K-Adaptive Backpropagation with Error-based N-exclusion Algorithm : (Compensated Loss-Based Sample Exclusion with Unbiased Gradient Estimation)
papers.abstract_en: We present K-ABENA (K-Adaptive Backpropagation with Error-based N-exclusion Algorithm), a selective gradient computation framework that reduces per-iteration training cost by excluding a fraction of low-loss ("minor") observations from the backward pass. Its canonical form (v3) combines a defensive-mixture sampling design over the minor set with Horvitz-Thompson inverse-probability reweighting, yielding a design-unbiased Horvitz-Thompson gradient estimator (Lemma 2) and whose self-normalized practical variant carries a bias of order O(1/m) with an explicit constant (Lemma 3). We prove an O(1/sqrt(T)) non-convex convergence guarantee for SGD under the estimator, with an additive term that quantifies the residual bias (Theorem 1). We further prove that uncompensated loss-based selection - a family that includes OHEM, SBP, and the two earlier K-ABENA variants - admits no stationary point at any minimizer where its selection bias is bounded away from zero (Proposition 2), and we quantify this failure empirically: at 0.17% class imbalance, uncompensated variants reach test AUC 0.53-0.62 versus 0.9998 for full-batch SGD, while the compensated estimator attains 0.9991 at identical 28.4% compute savings. On real datasets (Breast Cancer, Digits, Wine, Diabetes) the compensated estimator is statistically indistinguishable from full-batch SGD (paired permutation tests, p >= 0.5; Section 7) while saving 28-54% of per-epoch gradient computation. A biased "regularized mode" (the earlier half-domain variant) is retained as an option with a proven exact bias decomposition (Lemma 5) and quantified contraindications: it collapses to 0.386 accuracy under 40% label noise (baseline: 0.832) and to 0.53 AUC under extreme imbalance. Every advantage and every limitation reported in this paper is either proved or measured; all experiments are CPU-scale (NumPy/scikit-learn) and their scope is stated explicitly.
papers.comment: 11 pages main text + appendices, 13 pages total. Code: https://github.com/Bonbhel/kabena-ml
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: K-ABENA 是一种选择性梯度计算框架，通过从反向传播中排除低损失样本（“次要”样本）来降低每次迭代的训练成本。其第三版（v3）采用防御性混合抽样设计结合霍维茨-汤普森逆概率重加权，得到无偏的梯度估计量，并提供了非凸收敛保证。实验表明，在类别不平衡和标签噪声场景下，补偿估计器能保持与全批量SGD相当的统计性能，同时节省28-54%的梯度计算。
Motivation: 标准训练中，所有样本都参与反向传播，但低损失样本对梯度贡献小，计算浪费。现有基于损失的选择方法（如OHEM、SBP）存在不可忽略的选择偏差，导致在极端不平衡或噪声下性能崩溃。
Method: 提出K-ABENA v3：对次要样本（低损失子集）进行防御性混合抽样，然后使用霍维茨-汤普森逆概率加权估计全梯度。同时提供自归一化实际变体，偏差阶数为O(1/m)。还保留了有偏正则化模式，并给出了精确的偏差分解。
Result: 在0.17%类不平衡下，无补偿变体AUC为0.53-0.62，全批量SGD为0.9998，补偿估计器为0.9991（节省28.4%计算）。在真实数据集上，补偿估计器与全批量SGD统计无显著差异（p≥0.5），节省28-54%梯度计算。有偏正则化模式在40%标签噪声下准确率从0.832降至0.386，极端不平衡下AUC降至0.53。
Conclusion: K-ABENA 提供了理论与实验支持：补偿的样本排除方法可以在不牺牲性能的情况下节省计算；而有偏方法在特定条件下非可靠。所有结论均有证明或测量，实验在CPU尺度（NumPy/scikit-learn）上进行，范围明确说明。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Textural Counterpoint to Feature Encoding: A Multi-Dimensional Machine Representation Study of Haydn's "The Lark" Integrating Electroacoustic Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Chamber music, as a highly precise multi-part interactive system, contains a logic of "role assignment and dynamic interaction" that provides an extremely valuable blueprint for exploring human-computer collaborative composition paradigms. Addressing the lack of role perception capabilities in existing deep music generation models during polyphonic interactions, this paper conducts an interdisciplinary analysis of Haydn's String Quartet in D Major, The Lark (Op. 64, No. 5). We propose a novel research path: "Classical Morphology Qualitative Analysis-Electroacoustic Quantitative Measurement-Machine Representation Reconstruction." The study first utilizes auditory analysis to dissect the counterpoint morphology of the leading voice and the underlying groove in the first movement. Subsequently, it introduces spectrum and dynamic feature analysis tools from a Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) to translate subjective auditory perception into objective, measurable physical parameters. Building on this, the paper introduces a fundamentally new approach to low-level computer feature extraction: completely abandoning the traditional mechanical quantization grid, introducing Event-based Timestamps to record the duration of micro-timing, and transforming acoustic features into an independent "Role-Aware Encoding" as an aesthetic heuristic mechanism (a phenomenological anchor). This study not only completes the logical loop spanning classical analysis, electronic music mapping, and AI symbolic generation but also establishes a profound theoretical foundation-from the perspectives of interactive aesthetics and media philosophy-for constructing human-computer collaborative music systems imbued with "social attributes" and "otherness awareness."
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多声部交互中角色感知缺失的问题，本文提出从古典形态定性分析、电声定量测量到机器表示重构的研究路径，以海顿《云雀》四重奏第一乐章为例，通过听觉分析、DAW频谱动态特征提取，并引入基于事件的时戳（Event-based Timestamps）和角色感知编码（Role-Aware Encoding）作为美学启发机制。该工作为构建具有社会属性的人机协作音乐系统提供了理论框架。
Motivation: 现有深度音乐生成模型在多声部交互中缺乏角色感知能力，限制了人机协作作曲的范式探索。
Method: 提出三阶段研究路径：古典形态定性分析（听觉分析对位形态）→ 电声定量测量（DAW频谱与动态特征提取）→ 机器表示重构（抛弃传统量化网格，采用基于事件的时戳记录微时序，将声学特征转化为独立的角色感知编码）。
Result: 摘要声称该研究完成了从古典分析、电声映射到AI符号生成的逻辑闭环，并为构建具有社会属性的人机协作音乐系统奠定了理论基础。
Conclusion: 从交互美学和媒介哲学视角，为建构蕴含“社会属性”和“他者意识”的人机协作音乐系统提供了理论基础。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出三阶段研究路径：古典形态定性分析（听觉分析对位形态）→ 电声定量测量（DAW频谱与动态特征提取）→ 机器表示重构（抛弃传统量化网格，采用基于事件的时戳记录微时序，将声学特征转化为独立的角色感知编码）。
summary_sections.result: 摘要声称该研究完成了从古典分析、电声映射到AI符号生成的逻辑闭环，并为构建具有社会属性的人机协作音乐系统奠定了理论基础。
summary_sections.conclusion: 从交互美学和媒介哲学视角，为建构蕴含“社会属性”和“他者意识”的人机协作音乐系统提供了理论基础。

papers.title: Uncovering Latent Depression Severity for Binary Depression Detection via Advantage-weighting Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Automatic depression detection using audio-visual data faces significant challenges, particularly in disentangling overlapping feature distributions and establishing robust decision boundaries. To address this, we propose a fine-grained multimodal framework featuring a temporal encoder and a mutual transformer to facilitate deep cross-modal fusion. Our core contribution is the Binary Advantage-weighting Ranking Loss, which optimizes the latent space distribution through two complementary mechanisms: Advantage-weighted Separation, which mines hard pairs by computing a pairwise prediction difference matrix and dynamically weighting them based on their difficulty; and Advantage-weighted Compactness, which minimizes intra-class variance to force features to cluster around their respective class centers. Extensive experiments on D-vlog and LMVD demonstrate that our model reconstructs the latent ordinal structure by prioritizing hard pairs, thereby achieving state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于音视频的抑郁检测中特征分布重叠和决策边界模糊的问题，提出一个细粒度多模态框架，包含时序编码器和互Transformer进行深度跨模态融合。核心创新是二元优势加权排序损失（Binary Advantage-weighting Ranking Loss），通过优势加权分离（挖掘困难样本对并动态加权）和优势加权紧致性（最小化类内方差）优化潜在空间分布。在D-vlog和LMVD数据集上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有自动抑郁检测方法难以解耦重叠的特征分布并建立稳健的决策边界，导致识别效果受限。
Method: 提出一个多模态框架，使用时序编码器和互Transformer实现跨模态融合，并设计二元优势加权排序损失，包含两个机制：优势加权分离（基于预测差异矩阵挖掘困难样本对并加权）和优势加权紧致性（最小化同类特征方差）。
Result: 在D-vlog和LMVD数据集上取得最优性能，表明模型通过优先处理困难样本重构了潜在有序结构。
Conclusion: 通过优先处理困难样本和增强类内紧致性，该损失函数有效改善了抑郁检测的潜在空间分布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Auditing of Unlearning Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating whether unlearning algorithms truly remove training data influence remains an open challenge. We propose a practical auditor that computes data-dependent lower bounds on the unlearning parameter $\varepsilon$ using membership inference attacks. Evaluating multiple unlearning algorithms, we find a sharp separation: algorithms with rigorous guarantees, such as model clipping and rewind-to-delete, achieve very small $\varepsilon$ bounds that do not falsify their unlearning guarantees, whereas empirical methods such as Hessian-based unlearning, interleaved ascent-descent, ascent on the forget set, and fine-tuning on the retain set exhibit large bounds, indicating poor unlearning. Our auditor provides a practical tool for empirically falsifying unlearning claims through a hypothesis-testing framework, and we validate it on CIFAR-100 and Shakespeare text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于成员推断攻击的审计工具，用于评估机器学习遗忘算法是否真正移除训练数据影响。审计器计算数据依赖的隐私参数 ε 下界，并在多个遗忘算法上测试，结果显示具有严格保证的算法（如模型裁剪和倒回删除）的 ε 下界很小，而经验方法（如Hessian遗忘、交替上升-下降等）的 ε 下界很大，表明其遗忘效果不佳。该审计器提供了一个实证反驳遗忘声明的假设检验框架，并在CIFAR-100和莎士比亚文本数据集上验证。
Motivation: 评估遗忘算法是否真正移除训练数据影响是一个开放挑战，需要有效的审计方法来验证其隐私保证。
Method: 提出一个实用审计器，通过成员推断攻击计算数据依赖的遗忘参数 ε 的下界，并基于假设检验框架来检验遗忘声明的有效性。
Result: 具有严格保证的算法（如模型裁剪、倒回删除）的 ε 下界非常小，未否定其遗忘保证；而经验方法（如Hessian遗忘、在遗忘集上上升、在保留集上微调等）的 ε 下界很大，表明遗忘效果差。
Conclusion: 该审计器提供了实证反驳遗忘声明的实践工具，并在CIFAR-100和莎士比亚文本上得到验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the convergence of graph Laplacians with a symmetric divergence
papers.abstract_en: When analyzing a manifold learning algorithm for data lying on a smooth, compact, connected Riemannian submanifold $(\mathcal{M}, g)$ of $\mathbb{R}^d$, a key estimate for the geodesic distance $d_g$ is that there exists $K > 0$ such that $0 \leq d_g(p, q)^2 - \|p-q\|^2 \leq K d_g(p, q)^4$ for all $p, q \in \mathcal{M}$. We observe that more generally, when $\mathcal{M}$ is equipped with a smooth symmetric divergence $D$ satisfying a non-degeneracy condition and $g$ is given by $g_p := \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{Hess}_p(D(p, \cdot))$ for all $p \in \mathcal{M}$, there exists $K > 0$ such that $\left| D(p, q) - d_g(p, q)^2 \right| \leq K d_g(p, q)^4$ for all $p, q \in \mathcal{M}$. We demonstrate that this is sufficient for the pointwise convergence of graph Laplacians constructed with $D$ and discuss examples where $D$ is given by the Sinkhorn divergence on a family of probability measures parametrized by a manifold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明对于光滑紧致黎曼子流形上的对称散度D，若满足非退化条件且g定义为Hessian的一半，则存在K使得|D(p,q)-d_g(p,q)^2| ≤ K d_g(p,q)^4。该界足以保证图拉普拉斯算子的逐点收敛，并用Sinkhorn散度在概率测度族上的例子进行说明。
Motivation: 流形学习算法中，图拉普拉斯收敛性依赖于测地距离与欧氏距离之差的估计，本文将此估计推广到一般的对称散度框架。
Method: 定理证明：对于满足非退化条件的对称散度D，存在常数K使得散度与测地距离平方之差被d_g的四次方控制，并基于此建立图拉普拉斯的逐点收敛性。
Result: 证明了|D(p,q)-d_g(p,q)^2| ≤ K d_g(p,q)^4，并且该不等式足以推导出图拉普拉斯算子的点态收敛。
Conclusion: 结果适用于任意满足条件的对称散度，特别地，可用于流形参数化概率测度族上的Sinkhorn散度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Few-Medoids: An Embarrassingly Simple Coreset Selection Method for Few-Shot Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Coreset selection aims to identify a small and highly representative subset of a massive dataset for efficient model training. The problem remains challenging even in the few-shot knowledge distillation (KD) setup, where a full-scale pre-trained teacher informs the student network. Typical sample selection strategies often struggle to surpass the random selection baseline. In this paper, we showcase few-medoids, an embarrassingly simple coreset selection strategy that chooses the samples closest to the centroid (average image) of each class. We present extensive KD experiments on four datasets, covering a wide range of image classification problems, and three teacher-student model pairs, comprising both convolutional and transformer networks. Although the proposed method is embarrassingly simple, our empirical results indicate that few-medoids is able to consistently surpass the random selection baseline, as well as the other coreset selection strategies. We therefore consider that few-medoids can be used as a drop-in replacement for commonly-used baselines (e.g. herding or k-center Greedy), in future research on coreset selection. To reproduce the reported results, we publicly release our code at https://github.com/CemilAndreiDilmac/Few-Shot-KD-Coreset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种极其简单的核心集选择方法（few-medoids），在少样本知识蒸馏（few-shot KD）中，选择每个类别中距离质心（平均图像）最近的样本作为核心集。在四个图像分类数据集、三个师生模型对（包括卷积和Transformer）上的实验表明，该方法始终优于随机选择和其他核心集选择策略。
Motivation: 现有核心集选择方法在少样本知识蒸馏中往往难以超越随机选择基线，需要一种更简单且有效的方法。
Method: 提出few-medoids方法：对于每个类别，计算所有样本的平均图像（质心），然后选择与该质心欧氏距离最近的若干样本作为核心集。
Result: 在四个数据集和三个模型对上的知识蒸馏实验表明，few-medoids始终优于随机选择基线以及其他核心集选择策略（如herding、k-center greedy）。
Conclusion: few-medoids作为核心集选择方法简单有效，可作为未来研究的即插即用基线。代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: i-EXAM: Instructable and Explainable Attack Connectivity Graph Modeler
papers.abstract_en: i-EXAM is a planning-powered tool that helps system administrators to create security profiles of complex networks and perform what-if analyses to identify network hardening strategies. It leverages planning compilation that provides soundness and completeness guarantees to identify attack paths, evaluate security metrics, generate diverse hardening strategies, and explain these strategies in natural language using Large Language Models.
papers.comment: In the Proceedings of the International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling (ICAPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 i-EXAM，一个基于规划（planning）的工具，帮助系统管理员创建复杂网络的安全配置文件并进行假设分析以识别网络加固策略。它利用规划编译提供完备性和可靠性保证，识别攻击路径，评估安全指标，生成多样化加固策略，并使用大语言模型以自然语言解释这些策略。
Motivation: 当前网络安全管理缺乏可解释且完备的攻击路径分析和加固策略生成工具，管理员难以快速了解网络弱点和应对措施。
Method: 将网络攻击连通性问题编译为规划问题，利用规划求解器提供完备性和可靠性保证；结合大语言模型生成自然语言解释。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，但声称可生成多样化的加固策略并以自然语言解释。
Conclusion: i-EXAM 提供了可解释、可靠的网络攻击连通性分析工具，适用于安全管理员进行假设分析和策略生成。

papers.title: Harrison.Rad 1.5 Technical Report: A radiology foundation model that can draft reports from images, priors and clinical context
papers.abstract_en: Imaging demand is growing faster than the radiology workforce can expand, and reporting backlogs cannot be resolved through training and recruitment alone. The most direct opportunity is reducing the time and effort radiologists spend producing reports, a task that requires interpreting images, integrating clinical history and prior studies, and drafting structured findings. We present Harrison.Rad 1.5 (HR1.5), a radiology-specific multimodal large language model that accepts interleaved text and visual inputs and generates structured and unstructured text across plain-film radiology, spanning computed radiography, chest, musculoskeletal, abdominal, spine, and pelvic x-rays, and mammography. HR1.5 is trained through a three-stage pipeline: domain adaptation of a base language model on radiology reports, contrastive vision-encoder training with curriculum-based hard negatives on ~6 million image-report instances, and visual-question-answering fine-tuning on multi-turn conversations. We evaluate it with a Findings-Diagnosis scoring framework that extends RadGraph-XL entity extraction with ontology-based synonym matching and polarity-contradiction detection, benchmarked on RadBench, a simulated FRCR 2B Short Case examination scored against Angoff-method thresholds, ReXGradient, and internal multi-modality datasets. HR1.5 is the only system evaluated to meet the simulated FRCR passing standard and achieves the highest accuracy on closed-format clinical questions, across anatomical regions, on internal multi-body-part and mammography reporting, and on the primary clinically-aligned score for public chest reporting. We further examine explainability and model behaviour, including question-sensitive Grad-CAM heatmaps, attention analysis, and confidence estimation, to support responsible future evaluation toward clinical use, and a framework for clinically grounded assessment of report quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Harrison.Rad 1.5 (HR1.5)，一个放射学专用多模态大语言模型，可接受文本和视觉输入，生成结构化/非结构化放射报告。模型通过三阶段训练（领域适应、对比视觉编码器训练、多轮对话微调），在放射学报告生成任务上达到临床级性能，是唯一通过模拟FRCR 2B考试标准的系统。
Motivation: 影像需求增长超过放射学劳动力扩张，需要减少放射科医生撰写报告的时间和精力。
Method: 三阶段训练：基础语言模型在放射报告上的领域适应；基于课程难负例的对比视觉编码器训练（约600万图像-报告实例）；多轮对话的视觉问答微调。评估使用Findings-Diagnosis评分框架（扩展RadGraph-XL、本体同义词匹配和极性矛盾检测）。
Result: HR1.5是唯一通过模拟FRCR 2B考试标准的系统，在封闭式临床问题上达到最高准确率，并在内部多部位和乳腺X线报告以及公共胸部报告的主要临床对齐评分上表现最佳。
Conclusion: HR1.5在放射学报告生成上展示了临床实用性，并提供了可解释性分析（Grad-CAM热图、注意力分析、置信度估计）以支持未来临床评估。

papers.title: Think Before You Grid-Search: Floor-First Triage for LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: LLM serving optimization typically benchmarks many configurations and reaches for heavy profilers when latency targets are missed. We argue for the reverse discipline: estimation is the analytical layer of profiling -- without it, optimization degenerates to grid search. Floor First is a residual-driven triage workflow. Each decode step is modeled as a five-dimensional resource vector (HBM bytes, FLOPs, network bytes, network messages, KV capacity); summing within a resource and maximizing across resources gives an optimistic floor, the plain sum a pessimistic one. Where a measurement lands inside this [max, sum] interval reads out overlap quality before any profiler is opened, and profilers escalate only on residuals above a stated threshold. Deployment alternatives are compared by wall ordering -- which resource wall binds first as load grows -- rather than by point benchmarks. The account is compositional: new attention or state-space variants enter by declaring one module, and the workflow ships as a zero-dependency calculator plus an agent skill that enforces the discipline in agentic optimization loops. As a case study we analyze a DeepSeek-V3.2-style 671B MoE/MLA model on 16 NVIDIA H20 GPUs, whose ridge point of ~74 FLOP/byte (vs ~590 for H100) makes it an extreme decode-oriented part. The floors show TP16 decoding is KV-capacity-limited to ~70 concurrent 8K requests; sparse attention removes the KV-bandwidth term but not the capacity wall; an EP16+DP-attention layout accepts slightly worse same-batch weight traffic for an order-of-magnitude higher capacity wall (~644) -- while single-stream latency favors TP by 2.4x. The layout judgment is thus a computable function of the operating point, explaining why production deployments on identical hardware have shipped opposite attention layouts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为“Floor First”的残差驱动三分法工作流，用于大语言模型（LLM）服务优化。该方法将每个解码步骤建模为五维资源向量（HBM字节、FLOPs、网络字节、网络消息、KV容量），通过计算乐观下限（最大值）和悲观上限（求和）构成的区间来评估重叠质量，从而在调用剖析器前进行三分。案例研究分析了类似DeepSeek-V3.2的671B MoE/MLA模型在16×H20 GPU上的表现，展示了如何通过墙排序（wall ordering）计算性地指导注意力布局决策，而无需网格搜索。
Motivation: 现有LLM服务优化通常依赖大量配置的基准测试和重型剖析器，导致优化退化为网格搜索。本文主张采用逆向原则：先进行估算（分析性剖析层），在调用剖析器之前先通过估算确定优化方向。
Method: 提出Floor First工作流：每个解码步骤建模为五维资源向量，每个维度求和得到悲观下限，跨维度取最大值得到乐观上限，形成[min, max]区间。测量值落在此区间内可读出重叠质量，只有残差超过阈值时才升级到剖析器。部署替代方案通过墙排序（比较随负载增长哪个资源先成为瓶颈）而非点基准进行比较。该方法具有组合性，新模块只需声明资源向量即可纳入。
Result: 案例研究显示：在16×H20 GPU上，TP16解码受KV容量限制，约支持70个并发8K请求；稀疏注意力只移除了KV带宽项但未改变容量墙；EP16+DP-attention布局的容量墙比TP16高约一个数量级（~644），但单流延迟慢2.4倍。布局判断是操作点的可计算函数，解释了相同硬件上出现相反注意力布局的原因。
Conclusion: 该工作流提供了一种计算性的LLM服务优化方法，通过资源墙排序指导部署布局决策，避免了网格搜索。作者强调其组合性，允许轻松引入新注意力或状态空间变体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: No Subspace to Track: Non-Identifiability and Optimizer State in Low-Rank Training
papers.abstract_en: Memory-efficient optimizers such as GaLore train large language models by projecting gradients onto a rank-r subspace recomputed every T steps, assuming this subspace is a slowly drifting object that can be tracked. We show that beyond a small reproducible core, there is no such object. Two estimates of the top-r subspace computed at the same step from disjoint minibatches disagree as much as estimates computed T steps apart (0.73 vs 0.74 of the maximal chordal distance sqrt(2r), at Pythia-160M with r=128): the apparent rotation at each refresh is dominated by estimator noise. This holds across four model families in three architecture classes from 70M to 6.9B parameters, strengthening with scale, and more weakly in a vision transformer. Only ~39 of 128 directions are reproducible across minibatches, and averaging cannot recover the rest: under N-fold averaging the gradient's spectral tail shrinks as N^(-1/4) rather than the N^(-1/2) of pure noise, so no averaging budget makes the subspace well defined. What helps instead follows from treating each refresh as a change of coordinates for Adam's state. Carrying the second moment blindly is provably about (r-k*)/2 worse than the best rotation-blind estimator, while the first moment transports exactly through the rotation, the optimal linear map under isotropic gradients and the rule LDAdam uses. At 1B over 40k steps (3 seeds), full LDAdam reaches 18.7 perplexity at beta2=0.999, beating untransported GaLore after its best beta2 fix (19.3); shortening the second-moment memory to beta2=0.99 helps the refreshing optimizers, though for canonical GaLore the effect is small and a full-rank control reverses it. One measurable fact, subspace non-identifiability, clarifies why GaLore works, which patches work, and what to check before trusting a low-rank assumption: the reproducible rank k*.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了低秩训练（如GaLore）中子空间难以被可靠跟踪的问题：除少量可重复方向外，子空间主要由估计噪声主导。作者提出LDAdam方法，通过正确迁移Adam状态（第一矩通过旋转传输，第二矩盲传输效果更差），在1B参数规模上达到18.7 perplexity，优于GaLore的19.3。论文强调子空间非可识别性（non-identifiability）是核心问题，并引入可重复秩 k* 作为评估指标。
Motivation: 现有低秩训练方法（如GaLore）假设梯度主子空间（dominant subspace）随时间缓慢漂移并可跟踪，但该假设缺乏严格验证，且优化器状态在子空间刷新时的处理方法尚不明确。
Method: 通过理论分析和实验，测量不同时间步及不同小批次间的子空间一致性，发现噪声主导了子空间变化。提出LDAdam，将Adam状态中的第一矩通过精确的旋转映射传递，第二矩采用盲传输（比最优旋转无关估计差约(r-k*)/2）。
Result: 在Pythia-160M模型上，子空间在时间步T间隔后的平均弦距离与随机样本间的一致（0.74 vs 0.73），仅约39/128方向可重复。在1B参数模型上，LDAdam在40k步后达到18.7 perplexity（beta2=0.999），优于GaLore最佳beta2调整后的19.3。
Conclusion: 子空间非可识别性是低秩训练的根本局限，它解释了GaLore为何有效以及何种补丁（如优化器状态迁移）有益。可重复秩 k* 是评估低秩假设可靠性的关键指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GraspIT: A Dataset Bridging the Sim-to-Real gap and back for Validated Grasping SE(3) Pose Generation
papers.abstract_en: Robust robotic grasping of novel objects requires datasets that simultaneously provide photorealistic RGB-D observations, physically validated grasp quality annotations, and a principled bridge between simulation and the real world, which existing datasets lack to provide jointly. \textbf{GraspIT} addresses this gap: tabletop scenes in NVIDIA Isaac Sim are annotated via a four-stage physical slip-test on parallel Franka Panda instances, producing trajectory-reachability checks and continuous quality scores beyond force-closure.Of ${\sim}$2.3M candidates, 83% pass as \emph{good} ($s{\geq}0.50$); the 17% that passed force-closure but failed the slip-test provide graded hard negatives. A Real$\leftrightarrow$Sim loop back-projects these labels onto 100 real-world scenes. The release provides ${\sim}$316k annotated RGBD frame sets across 1035 sim and 100 real scenes, with instance masks, 6-DoF poses, physical object properties, and scored 6-DoF grasps. All tools are open-source and Docker-containerized. The trajectory planning within Isaac Sim further allows streaming of high resolution demonstrations for tabletop manipulation policy learning and behavior cloning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GraspIT数据集，在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中对桌面场景进行物理滑移测试标注，生成约230万个候选抓取，其中83%为good，17%为hard negatives。通过Real↔Sim循环将标签投影到100个真实场景，最终提供约31.6万标注RGBD帧，包含实例掩码、6-DoF姿态、物理属性、评分抓取。所有工具开源并容器化。
Motivation: 现有数据集无法同时提供逼真RGB-D观测、物理验证的抓取质量标注和仿真到现实的桥梁，GraspIT填补这一空白。
Method: 使用NVIDIA Isaac Sim生成桌面场景，通过四阶段物理滑移测试（parallel Franka Panda夹具）标注抓取质量，产生轨迹可达性检查和连续质量分数，并通过Real↔Sim循环将仿真标签映射到真实场景。
Result: 约230万候选抓取中83%为good（s≥0.50），17%为hard negatives；最终数据集包含1035个仿真场景和100个真实场景的约31.6万标注RGBD帧。
Conclusion: 数据集提供了仿真到现实的桥梁，支持抓取策略学习，轨迹规划可用于高分辨率演示进行策略学习和行为克隆。

papers.title: Differentially Private Natural Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Under a fixed privacy budget, the utility of differentially private (DP) training is ultimately determined by its optimization efficiency. Standard first-order DP optimizers such as DP-SGD rely solely on local gradients and ignore the underlying loss curvature. This geometric blindness causes severe zigzagging in ill-conditioned landscapes, squandering precious privacy budgets on inefficient iterations. Practitioners are thus trapped in a bind: either stop training prematurely or inject massive per-step noise, both of which critically compromise final model utility. Natural Gradient Descent (NGD) resolves this by preconditioning gradients with curvature, aligning updates with the loss geometry and extracting more efficient signal from every noisy step, offering a principled pathway to break the privacy-utility bottleneck. Despite its theoretical appeal, directly integrating NGD with DP introduces fundamental challenges: curvature estimation itself consumes prohibitive privacy budgets, isotropic DP operations conflict with the anisotropic scaling of NGD, and the inverse curvature catastrophically amplify parameter updates in flat directions, causing training instability. We propose DP-NGD, a practical framework that systematically addresses these obstacles by decoupling curvature estimation from private data, reconciling isotropic DP constraints with anisotropic second-order optimization via a whitened-space mechanism, and dynamically clamping the curvature to stabilize training. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that DP-NGD achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, breaking through the utility ceilings of first-order baselines while delivering up to a $10\times$ convergence speedup under the same privacy budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DP-NGD，一个将自然梯度下降（NGD）与差分隐私（DP）相结合的实际框架。通过解耦曲率估计与私有数据、使用白化空间机制调和各向同性DP约束与各向异性二阶优化、动态钳制曲率稳定训练，解决了直接集成NGD与DP时曲率估计消耗隐私预算、DP与NGD缩放冲突、逆曲率放大更新等根本挑战。在标准基准上，DP-NGD实现了最先进的准确率，突破了基于一阶优化的基线效用上限，并在相同隐私预算下实现了高达10倍的收敛加速。
Motivation: 标准一阶差分隐私优化器（如DP-SGD）仅依赖局部梯度，忽视损失曲率，在病态场景中导致严重锯齿形震荡，浪费隐私预算。实践者面临要么过早停止训练、要么注入大量每步噪声的两难选择，两者都严重损害最终模型效用。
Method: 提出DP-NGD框架，通过三种机制解决集成挑战：解耦曲率估计与私有数据（避免额外隐私消耗）；引入白化空间机制协调各向同性DP约束与各向异性二阶优化；动态钳制曲率以防止平坦方向上的更新放大导致训练不稳定。
Result: 在标准基准上达到最先进准确率，突破一阶基线的效用天花板，并在相同隐私预算下实现高达10倍的收敛加速。
Conclusion: DP-NGD通过几何意识优化为差分隐私训练提供了突破隐私-效用瓶颈的原则性途径，证明了二阶优化在DP场景中的有效性。

papers.title: Strategic Bargaining in Multi-Buyer Markets: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards for LLM Negotiations
papers.abstract_en: Negotiation is a fundamental strategic interaction in management science, characterized by agents attempting to reach agreements while protecting private information, such as reservation costs and hidden valuations. A prevalent yet complex scenario involves a single seller negotiating concurrently with multiple buyers, each possessing heterogeneous, private budgets. In such settings, constrained by a limited number of communication turns, the seller must balance exploring the broader market to discover the highest valuation with concentrating sufficient turns on a single target buyer to secure the best possible outcome. Our analysis reveals a significant gap in standard Large Language Models (LLMs): while these models are linguistically proficient, they fail to act as effective economic decision-makers. Specifically, they exhibit a failure to explore the buyer pool, often fixating on the current highest bid rather than strategically investigating the market to discover latent high valuations. In this paper, we propose a specialized training recipe using Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). By anchoring the reward function to objective economic outcomes, the strategic balance between market discovery and surplus extraction emerges natively through the learning process. Our results demonstrate that the trained seller undergoes a multi-stage strategic evolution, learning to leverage price anchoring and strategic probing to identify more profitable counterparties. The agent extracts a substantially higher surplus than frontier models by both improving its persuasive bargaining skills and consistently closing deals with high-value buyers. Finally, we show that our seller strategies generalize robustly to unseen buyer negotiation styles and budget distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单卖家与多买家同时谈判的市场策略。标准大语言模型（LLM）在谈判中缺乏经济决策能力，例如无法有效探索买家池。作者提出使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练卖家，奖励函数基于客观经济结果。训练后的卖家学会价格锚定与战略试探，提取显著高于前沿模型的剩余，并且策略能泛化到未见过的买家风格与预算分布。
Motivation: 标准LLM在多买家谈判中无法有效探索市场、发现高估值买家，而是错误地固守当前最高出价，导致经济决策低效。
Method: 采用强化学习从可验证奖励（RLVR）训练卖家，奖励函数直接锚定经济结果，使战略平衡（市场发现与剩余提取）自然涌现。
Result: 训练后的卖家经历多阶段策略演化，学会利用价格锚定与战略试探，提取的剩余显著高于前沿模型，且策略鲁棒地泛化到未见过的买家谈判风格与预算分布。
Conclusion: 通过RLVR训练，LLM能成为有效的经济决策者，在复杂多买家谈判中实现战略平衡。

papers.title: Mitigating Factual Hallucination in Large Reasoning Models via Mixed-Mode Advantage Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve language model capabilities by generating explicit thinking traces before final answers. In factuality-oriented question answering (QA), such thinking often improves overall performance by helping the model recover relevant knowledge and refine its answers. However, we find that this benefit is not uniform at the instance level: explicit thinking can also overturn correct non-thinking answers and lead to factual drift. We refer to this failure mode as \emph{thinking-induced hallucination}. To explain this phenomenon, we formulate explicit thinking in factuality QA as a thinking residual over the model's direct-answer tendency, which can either recover missing knowledge or introduce unsupported associations. Based on this formulation, we propose MARGO, \underline{\textit{M}}ixed-Mode \underline{\textit{A}}dvantage \underline{\textit{R}}egularization for \underline{\textit{G}}rounded \underline{\textit{O}}ptimization, a reinforcement learning framework that uses non-thinking rollouts as same-model references in advantage estimation. By constructing mixed-mode rollout groups with both thinking and non-thinking trajectories, MARGO evaluates whether explicit thinking adds factual value beyond direct answering, thereby suppressing hallucination-prone thinking while preserving beneficial thinking behaviors. Experiments across multiple factuality-oriented QA benchmarks demonstrate that MARGO improves factual reliability over strong baselines, while evaluations on mathematical benchmarks show that it preserves general reasoning ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大型推理模型在事实型问答中，显式思考有时会推翻本来正确的直接答案，导致事实漂移（thinking-induced hallucination）。作者将显式思考建模为对直接回答倾向的残差，并提出MARGO框架，通过混合模式（思考/非思考）轨迹的强化学习优势正则化，抑制易产生幻觉的思考行为，同时保留有益的思考。实验表明MARGO在多个事实性QA基准上提升了事实可靠性，并在数学基准上保持推理能力。
Motivation: 大型推理模型在事实型问答中，显式思考虽能提升整体表现，但实例层面可能推翻正确的直接答案，导致事实漂移。现有方法未能针对性抑制这种思考引发的幻觉。
Method: 提出MARGO（混合模式优势正则化框架），将非思考rollout作为同模型参考，构建包含思考和非思考轨迹的混合模式组，通过优势估计评估显式思考是否增加事实价值，从而在强化学习中正则化易幻觉的思考行为。
Result: 在多个事实导向QA基准上，MARGO提升了事实可靠性，优于强基线；在数学基准上保持了通用推理能力。
Conclusion: 通过将思考建模为残差并利用非思考参考进行正则化，可有效缓解思考引发的幻觉，同时不损害推理能力。

papers.title: AVA-VLM: Adaptive Visual Attention-Vision Language Model for In-the-Wild Construction Site Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are promising for construction-site monitoring, and recent construction-tailored VLMs have primarily adapted pretrained VLMs through direct QA-style fine-tuning from a single global image. We argue that this direct paradigm remains limited for in-the-wild deployment in terms of operational range, reliability under reduced-resolution inputs, and inference efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose AVA-VLM, an Adaptive Visual Attention-Vision Language Model that follows a human-inspired coarse-to-fine reasoning strategy. AVA-VLM first reasons over a low-resolution global image and selectively requests a high-resolution local crop only when detailed inspection is needed, similar to how a human inspector zooms in on hard-to-see yet important areas. We further introduce a region-aware Chain-of-Thought dataset that teaches the model when to inspect, where to crop, and how to use local evidence. Experiments show that AVA-VLM improves reliability under long-distance and reduced-resolution conditions while substantially reducing visual-token usage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AVA-VLM，一种自适应视觉注意力视觉语言模型，用于野外建筑工地监测。模型遵循由粗到细的推理策略：先分析低分辨率全局图像，仅在需要详细检查时请求高分辨率局部裁剪，类似于人类检查员的放大行为。此外，还引入了区域感知的思维链数据集来训练模型何时检查、何处裁剪以及如何使用局部证据。实验表明，AVA-VLM在长距离和低分辨率条件下提高了可靠性，同时显著减少了视觉标记的使用。
Motivation: 现有建筑工地专用视觉语言模型主要通过对单个全局图像直接进行QA风格微调，在野外部署时存在操作范围有限、低分辨率输入下可靠性差以及推理效率低下的问题。
Method: 提出自适应视觉注意力机制，采用由粗到细的推理策略：先低分辨率全局推理，再根据需求请求高分辨率局部裁剪；同时构建区域感知的思维链数据集来训练模型的决策过程。
Result: 实验证明，AVA-VLM在长距离和低分辨率条件下提升了可靠性，并大幅减少了视觉标记的使用量。
Conclusion: AVA-VLM通过模仿人类检查员的由粗到细策略，有效提升了建筑工地监测中视觉语言模型的鲁棒性和效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection of Information Operations Users via Behavioral and Language Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Information Operations on social media networks have been identified as a significant threat to democracy and modern society, but they are challenging and expensive to detect by humans. Existing supervised IO detection methods fail to capture the dynamic nature of evolving IO user behavior, while existing unsupervised approaches rely on oversimplified assumptions of coordination among IO users that may not exist in practice. To overcome the limitations of existing methods, we formulate IO user detection as an anomaly detection problem and propose a novel unsupervised IO user detection approach called Temporal-bEhavior-laNguage Signals for information Operation Recognition (TENSOR), which leverages multimodal data, including temporal online user behavior, such as message posting activities, and the textual content of the messages. The motivation is that IO users are typically a very small fraction of all online users and have unique temporal behavioral and language patterns. Specifically, we train a Temporal Point Process (TPP) to capture abnormal temporal behavioral patterns of IO users because they are known to behave in a coordinated manner for IO campaigns. We further introduce a novel evidence function that converts LLM responses, which are generated from user post timelines, into quantitative scores to adjust the TPP outputs for better IO user detection. Experimental results show that TENSOR outperforms the baselines on five real-world IO datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/xiuzhenzhang/TENSOR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督异常检测方法 TENSOR，用于检测社交媒体上的信息操作用户。该方法利用时间点过程 (TPP) 建模用户发帖行为的时间模式，并引入基于 LLM 的证据函数将用户时间线文本转化为量化分数，以调整 TPP 输出。在五个真实信息操作数据集上，TENSOR 优于现有基线方法。
Motivation: 现有监督方法无法适应信息操作用户行为的动态演化，而无监督方法通常依赖不切实际的协调假设。因此，需要一种无需标签且能捕捉复杂行为与语言模式的无监督检测方法。
Method: 提出 TENSOR 框架：1) 训练时间点过程 (TPP) 捕捉操作用户异常的协作性时间行为模式；2) 设计证据函数，利用 LLM 根据用户帖子时间线生成定量分数，调整 TPP 的输出以提升检测效果。
Result: 在五个真实世界信息操作用户数据集上，TENSOR 在检测性能上优于所有基线方法。
Conclusion: 将信息操作用户检测视为异常检测问题，并融合行为与语言多模态信号的无监督方式是有效的，代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Breaking Spurious Correlations via Generative Randomization and Cross-Variant Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks trained with Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often fail under distribution shifts because they exploit spurious correlations between object labels and background context. Recent generative approaches address this issue by creating counterfactual images with altered contexts, but typically use these samples as standard data augmentation, leaving the model free to retain background-sensitive representations. We propose a two-stage framework that uses generative intervention to explicitly learn background-invariant visual representations. First, we isolate the foreground object using zero-shot segmentation and generate context-shifted variants with a structure-preserving diffusion model, preserving object identity while varying the surrounding environment. We then introduce Cross-Variant Self-Supervised Learning, where variants of the same object under different backgrounds form positive pairs in a contrastive objective. This encourages the encoder to align object-centric representations while suppressing background-specific cues. Then, we fine-tune the pretrained encoder using an ERM warm-up followed by GroupDRO with layer-wise learning rates. Experiments on distribution-shift benchmarks demonstrate best worst-group performance, achieving 92.5% on Waterbirds, 81.7% on MetaShift, and 87.4% on NICO++. Code: https://github.com/surajyadav-research/GRSSL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段框架，通过生成式干预和跨变体自监督学习来学习背景不变的视觉表示，从而打破深度神经网络中的虚假相关性。第一阶段使用零样本分割和结构保持扩散模型生成上下文变换的样本；第二阶段引入跨变体对比学习，使同一物体在不同背景下的表示对齐。实验在Waterbirds、MetaShift和NICO++上分别达到92.5%、81.7%和87.4%的最差分组准确率。
Motivation: 基于ERM训练的深度神经网络在分布偏移下常因利用标签与背景的虚假相关性而失败，现有生成方法虽能生成反事实图像但仅作为数据增强，未能显式学习背景不变表示。
Method: 两阶段框架：先通过零样本分割提取前景，用结构保持扩散模型生成背景变换的变体；然后提出跨变体自监督学习，将同一物体不同背景的变体作为对比学习中的正对，促使编码器对齐物体中心表示并抑制背景特征；最后用ERM预热和GroupDRO配合层间学习率微调。
Result: 在分布偏移基准上取得最佳最差分组准确率：Waterbirds 92.5%、MetaShift 81.7%、NICO++ 87.4%。
Conclusion: 该方法通过显式学习背景不变表征有效提升分布泛化能力，代码已开源。

papers.title: AbICL: In-Context Learning for Antigen-Specific Antibody Affinity Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Accurate ranking of antibody candidates according to their binding affinity is essential for therapeutic antibody discovery. However, existing methods treat affinity comparisons independently and ignore the contextual information encoded in other labeled comparisons, limiting their ability to capture antigen-specific binding landscapes. For many target antigens, a small number of experimentally characterized affinity comparisons are often available. An important question is whether the model can exploit these existing comparisons to infer antigen-specific ranking patterns that facilitate subsequent affinity ranking. This form of learning from labeled demonstrations closely resembles the paradigm of In-Context Learning, motivating us to revisit antibody affinity ranking from an ICL perspective. To this end, we propose AbICL, an ICL framework for antigen-specific antibody affinity ranking. AbICL combines a pretrained structural encoder with a context ranking head and is trained with an episodic meta-training strategy that enables the model to leverage support demonstrations for test-time adaptation without gradient updates. Experiments on the AbRank benchmark demonstrate that AbICL consistently outperforms existing ranking baselines across almost all data splits and evaluation benchmarks. Further analysis shows that the value of contextual demonstrations depends on how well they match the target inference task, and becomes increasingly pronounced under distribution shift and fine-grained affinity discrimination. These findings highlight the potential of ICL as an effective paradigm for antigen-specific antibody affinity ranking, particularly in challenging settings where a single global ranking function is insufficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AbICL，一种基于上下文学习（ICL）的框架，用于抗原特异性抗体亲和力排序。该方法结合预训练结构编码器和上下文排序头，通过情景元训练策略使模型在测试时利用支持样本进行无梯度更新。在 AbRank 基准上，AbICL 始终优于现有排序基线，尤其在分布偏移和精细亲和力判别场景下效果显著。
Motivation: 现有抗体亲和力排序方法将比较视为独立任务，忽略了其他标记比较中蕴含的上下文信息，限制了模型捕获抗原特异性结合模式的能力。
Method: 提出 AbICL 框架，包含预训练结构编码器和上下文排序头，采用情景元训练策略，使模型能从少量实验表征的亲和力比较中学习抗原特异性排序模式，并在测试时无需梯度更新即可适应。
Result: 在 AbRank 基准上，AbICL 在几乎所有数据划分和评估基准上一致优于现有排序基线。上下文演示的价值取决于与目标推理任务的匹配程度，在分布偏移和精细亲和力判别下尤为明显。

papers.title: StateFuse: Deterministic Conflict-Preserving Memory for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agent systems accumulate conflicting observations across branches, retries, and replicas, yet many practical memory layers still collapse disagreement behind overwrite rules that are difficult to inspect or correct. We present StateFuse, a conflict-aware replicated memory contract built on standard OpSet/CRDT merge. StateFuse does not introduce a new join algebra; it defines an agent-facing semantics layer with immutable history, explicit conflict objects, exact and semantic correction handles (claim_id / claim_ref), deterministic predicate contracts, and projection-time resolution that cannot rewrite replicated state. We evaluate StateFuse against flat multi-value, raw-log, provenance-style, and collapsed baselines under matched resolver and verification policies. On a 282-question official conflict-bearing MemoryAgentBench slice, the compared methods tie on answer accuracy, but conflict-preserving surfaces keep contradictions visible while collapsed surfaces do not. In a controlled agent loop with uniform verification, preserving ambiguity enables safer abstention and correction than early collapse. A correction-handle ablation further shows that semantic handles matter when exact prior identifiers are unavailable. The resulting claim is narrow: StateFuse is best supported as a safer public memory contract for contradiction surfacing, abstention, and auditable correction, not as a universal accuracy gain.
papers.comment: Code and supplementary materials available at: https://github.com/nZiben/statefuse
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StateFuse 是一种基于 CRDT 的冲突感知复制内存合约，用于多智能体系统。它通过不可变历史、显式冲突对象、确定性谓词合约和投影时解析来保留冲突，而不是像传统方法那样覆盖矛盾。在 MemoryAgentBench 的 282 个冲突样本上，冲突保留方法与基准在答案准确性上持平，但能保持矛盾可见，支持更安全的弃权（abstention）和审计修正。
Motivation: 多智能体系统在执行分支、重试和复制时会产生冲突的观测，但现有内存层常通过难以检查或纠正的覆盖规则消除矛盾。
Method: 基于标准 OpSet/CRDT 合并，定义面向智能体的语义层，包含不可变历史、显式冲突对象、精确和语义修正句柄（claim_id/claim_ref）、确定性谓词合约以及不可重写复制状态的投影时解析。
Result: 在 MemoryAgentBench 的 282 个冲突样本上，与平坦多值、原始日志、溯源风格和覆盖基线相比，答案准确性持平，但冲突保留表面保持矛盾可见；在统一验证的智能体循环中，保留歧义比早期覆盖带来更安全的弃权和修正。语义修正句柄在精确先验标识符不可用时尤为重要。
Conclusion: StateFuse 的最佳适用场景是作为更安全的公开内存合约，用于矛盾浮现、弃权和可审计修正，而非通用准确性提升。
