papers.title: ARMS: Anchor-Relational Motion Streaming for Seamless Solo-Social Motion Transitions
papers.abstract_en: Generating temporally continuous and socially coherent human motion from text remains a fundamental challenge, particularly in realistic streams where people act alone, enter interactions, and later disengage. Most existing methods generate fixed-length motion clips under static agent configurations, which makes them brittle to solo-social transitions and unsuitable for incremental generation over long horizons. We propose ARMS, an Anchor-Relational Motion Streaming framework that unifies solo motion and human-human interaction within a single causal generative process. ARMS introduces a dynamics-asymmetric representation that decouples per-person temporal evolution from inter-person alignment via a partner-referenced relative-translation term, enabling seamless switching of social coupling without sacrificing long-horizon stability or spatial consistency between agents. On top of a causal latent space, a causal relational diffusion model progressively refines motion segment by segment using only past context, capturing both intra-person temporal dependencies and inter-person relations. Mode-aware relational gating activates or masks cross-agent connections, allowing the same model to support both solo and interaction generation. Experiments show that ARMS improves transition smoothness and social coherence compared to interaction-centric baselines, while also achieving competitive results on human-human interaction benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. Project page: https://hkliu.com/arms
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARMS（Anchor-Relational Motion Streaming）框架，用于从文本生成时间连续且社交连贯的人体运动，特别处理单人-社交-单人的过渡。该方法采用动力学非对称表示（dynamics-asymmetric representation）解耦单人时间演化与双人对齐，并通过因果潜在空间上的因果关系扩散模型逐段生成运动。实验表明，ARMS 在过渡平滑性和社交连贯性上优于交互式基线，并在人-人交互基准上取得竞争性结果。
Motivation: 现有方法大多生成固定长度运动片段，且假设静态主体配置，难以处理单人-社交-单人的自然过渡，不适用于长时程增量生成。
Method: 提出 ARMS 框架，包含动力学非对称表示（解耦单人时序演化与人对齐）和因果关系扩散模型（逐段利用过去上下文细化运动），以及模式感知关系门控（激活或屏蔽跨主体连接）。
Result: ARMS 在过渡平滑性和社交连贯性上优于交互基线，并在人-人交互基准上取得竞争性结果。
Conclusion: ARMS 统一了单人运动和人-人交互的因果生成，实现无缝过渡且保持长时程稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAMPLe: SAM-based Optimizer for Prompt Learning in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) like CLIP have proven highly effective as foundation models for various downstream applications. However, prompt learning in VLMs encounters a performance-generalization dilemma: while prompts can be tuned to achieve high accuracy on seen distributions, this tuning process often undermines their generalizability to unseen data. The limited set of learnable prompts, which contextualize and condition the input to steer it toward the task within the pretrained VLM, tends to overfit the training data, leading to a trade-off between task-specific performance and preserving generalization. To address this dilemma, we introduce SAMPLe (Sharpness-Aware Minimization Prompt Learning), a plug-in sharpness-aware optimizer that enhances prompt generalizability by accounting for loss landscape sharpness. Unlike conventional methods, SAMPLe balances exploration and exploitation by satisfying objective function constraints at each step, dynamically adapting to the current optimization state based on the local curvature and gradient properties. This approach reduces overfitting on seen distributions and improves adaptability to unseen data, preserving the generalization potential of pre-trained VLM models. We integrate SAMPLe into multiple prompt learning frameworks, including CoOp, CoCoOp, MaPLe, TCP, and Co-Prompt, demonstrating its effectiveness across diverse methods. Experiments show that SAMPLe elevates prompt learning frameworks and consistently outperforms existing optimizers across diverse settings, establishing itself as a robust, model-agnostic solution for prompt learning.
papers.comment: The manuscript has been accepted to ECCV and will be presented at the conference and published in the main proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于锐度感知最小化（Sharpness-Aware Minimization）的即插即用优化器SAMPLe，用于提升视觉语言模型中提示学习的泛化能力。通过考虑损失景观的锐度，SAMPLe在每步优化中动态平衡探索与利用，减少对训练分布的过拟合。集成到CoOp、CoCoOp、MaPLe等多个提示学习框架后，实验表明其一致优于现有优化器。
Motivation: 提示学习在视觉语言模型中面临性能-泛化困境：调优提示可在已知分布上获得高精度，但常损害对未知数据的泛化能力，现有方法难以兼顾两者。
Method: 提出SAMPLe优化器，基于锐度感知最小化，通过每步满足目标函数约束并动态适应局部曲率和梯度性质，同时平衡探索与利用，从而提升提示泛化性。
Result: 集成到多种提示学习框架（如CoOp、CoCoOp、MaPLe等）后，实验表明SAMPLe一致优于现有优化器，在不同设置下均有效。
Conclusion: SAMPLe是一种模型无关的即插即用优化器，能提升提示学习的泛化能力并缓解过拟合，可广泛适用于不同提示学习方法。

papers.title: Association Restoration Test: Revealing Restorable Shortcuts after Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Association unlearning aims to disable learned label-attribute shortcuts while preserving task performance. Existing evaluations mainly measure output-level robustness or probe whether shortcut attributes remain readable in frozen features, but neither test determines whether a retained association remains functionally usable by the original classifier. We propose the Association Restoration Test (ART), a post-hoc diagnostic for functional shortcut restorability. ART estimates class-conditional association directions, amplifies residual components, and evaluates the modified features with the original classifier head. Across Waterbirds, CelebA, SpuCoDogs, and an ISIC timestamp-artifact extension, we show that output metrics, representation probes, and ART characterize distinct aspects of shortcut mitigation. These findings motivate restoration-aware evaluation for unlearning and shortcut-mitigation methods that target learned associations rather than individual classes or concepts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出协会恢复测试（ART），一种用于诊断分类器在去学习后是否仍然保留可恢复的标签-属性快捷方式的后验方法。在Waterbirds、CelebA、SpuCoDogs和ISIC数据集上，展示了输出指标、表示探针和ART分别表征了快捷方式缓解的不同方面。
Motivation: 现有去学习评估主要检查输出级鲁棒性或特征中属性可读性，但无法确定是否仍保留功能可用的快捷方式。
Method: 提出ART，通过估计类条件关联方向、放大残差成分、用原始分类器头评估修改后的特征。
Result: 在多个数据集上显示ART揭示了输出指标和表示探针未捕获的快捷方式可恢复性。
Conclusion: 需要基于恢复意识的评估来改进针对习得关联而非单类或概念的去学习和快捷方式缓解方法。

papers.title: Low-Overhead Error-Corrected QCNNs Using Bivariate Bicycle Codes
papers.abstract_en: Quantum convolutional neural networks (QCNNs) combine the power of quantum computing and classical CNN for computational speedup in classification tasks. However, noise levels on state-of-the-art quantum devices remain too high for practical QCNN execution. In addition, despite the reliable surface code providing a method for error rates below a threshold value, they have a prohibitively large qubit cost. Recently introduced bivariate bicycle (BB) codes are of particular interest for their high error threshold, constant encoding rate, and linear code distance. Through simulation with realistic hardware noise sources, we demonstrate that a 4-qubit unprotected QCNN fails to converge and exhibits a worse learning rate compared to numerical simulations. Addressing both limitations, we propose a distance-4 BB quantum error-correction (QEC) technique for QCNNs. In doing so, we validate that our low-overhead QEC technique for QCNNS represents a step toward practical QCNNs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对量子卷积神经网络（QCNN）在实际量子设备中噪声过高且现有表面码纠错量子比特开销过大的问题，提出使用距离-4的双变量自行车码（BB code）进行低开销量子纠错。模拟表明，未保护的4-qubit QCNN无法收敛且学习率差，而所提方案在真实硬件噪声源模拟下有效。
Motivation: 当前量子设备噪声水平高，QCNN难以实用；表面码虽阈值低但量子比特成本过高。需要一种低开销的纠错方案。
Method: 采用双变量自行车（BB）码，构造距离-4的量子纠错码，并将其集成到QCNN中。
Result: 未保护4-qubit QCNN模拟显示无法收敛且学习率劣于数值模拟；使用BB码纠错的QCNN在模拟中表现有效。
Conclusion: 该低开销量子纠错技术是迈向实用QCNN的一步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Plainbook: Data Science, in Plain Language
papers.abstract_en: Jupyter Notebooks have become widely adopted in data science, as they allow the sharing of reproducible computational analysis. They are, however, accessible only to people who understand computer code. To reach the broader audience of scientists interested in data analysis and computation, but unfamiliar with code, we introduce Plainbook, notebooks centered on natural language rather than code. Plainbook is based on two principles: promote the natural language descriptions, and verify the values. In plainbook, the natural language descriptions are preserved, rather than the resulting code; the code is generated automatically from the cell descriptions. As natural language is read top to bottom, Plainbook adopts a linear execution semantics, in which cells are guaranteed to be executed in the order in which they appear; there is no "hidden state" or out-of-order execution as in Jupyter. To allow users who may not understand code to verify the correctness of the computation, we have built into Plainbook verification mechanisms centered on values and value inspection. These include mechanisms that focus on individual cells, akin to unit tests, as well as global mechanisms. Both the linear execution semantics, and the verification mechanisms, are underpinned by a snapshot kernel that caches execution states and makes execution and verification efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Plainbook 是一种以自然语言而非代码为核心的数据科学笔记本系统，旨在让不熟悉编程的科学家也能进行可重现的计算分析。它通过自动从自然语言描述生成代码、强制线性执行顺序（消除隐藏状态）以及内置基于数值验证的机制来降低使用门槛。系统依赖快照内核缓存执行状态以提升效率。
Motivation: Jupyter Notebooks 虽然广泛用于数据科学，但仅对懂代码的人可用，限制了不熟悉代码但对数据分析和计算感兴趣的科学家群体。
Method: 基于两个原则：突出自然语言描述并验证数值。采用线性执行语义保证单元格按顺序执行，避免隐藏状态。内置验证机制包括单元格级别的单元测试和全局验证，快照内核缓存执行状态以支持高效执行和验证。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，仅描述了系统设计与原理。
Conclusion: Plainbook 通过自然语言优先和验证机制，使不熟悉代码的用户也能参与数据科学。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Scene Graph Thinking: Reinforcing Structured Visual Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong perception and reasoning capabilities. However, most existing models focus on isolated objects and neglect structured relationships for efficient target navigation, limiting their performance on visually intensive tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Scene Graph Thinking (SaGe), a novel paradigm that enables fine-grained and structured visual reasoning through explicit scene-graph representations. Specifically, we first introduce an automated data engine that converts flat image-text corpora into structured scene graphs, where hierarchical entities constitute the nodes and diverse visual relations define the edges. Building upon this, we construct 120K high-quality training data by sampling reasoning traces from scene graphs. Then, two-stage graph-aligned post-training paradigms are introduced, where supervised fine-tuning internalizes MLLMs with structured reasoning, and subsequent reinforcement fine-tuning proposes node-as-proxy graph rewards to consolidate efficient graph exploration. With curated data and graph-aligned training, our approach achieves significant improvements across eight multimodal benchmarks, demonstrating strong effectiveness on fine-grained perception and reasoning tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/zwyang6/SaGe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Scene Graph Thinking (SaGe) 范式，通过构建显式场景图表示增强多模态大语言模型的细粒度结构化视觉推理能力。方法包括自动数据引擎将图文数据转换为场景图、构建12万高质量训练数据、两阶段图对齐后训练（监督微调+强化微调）。在八个多模态基准上取得显著改进。
Motivation: 现有MLLM大多关注孤立物体，忽视结构化关系，导致在视觉密集型任务上性能受限。
Method: 提出SaGe范式：1) 自动数据引擎将图文数据转换为结构化场景图（层次实体为节点，视觉关系为边）；2) 从场景图中采样推理轨迹构建12万训练数据；3) 两阶段图对齐后训练：监督微调内化结构化推理，强化微调提出节点代理图奖励以巩固图探索。
Result: 在八个多模态基准上取得显著改进，证明了细粒度感知和推理任务的有效性。
Conclusion: SaGe通过结构化场景图表示和图对齐训练提升了MLLM的视觉推理能力，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FourTune: Towards Fully 4-Bit Efficient Post-Training for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have become a dominant paradigm for high-quality generative modeling, while post-training is essential for adapting them to diverse downstream applications. However, post-training of large diffusion models is still challenging due to the prohibitive memory footprints and slow training speed, which existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods only partially address. To overcome these limitations, we propose FourTune, an efficient post-training framework for diffusion models based on an end-to-end W4A4G4 paradigm. FourTune introduces a triple-branch hybrid pipeline that augments the standard LoRA architecture with a frozen numerical stabilizer to isolate quantization-sensitive outliers, enabling stable training under native 4-bit computation. In addition, FourTune employs hardware-efficient block-wise quantization and customized fused kernels to support efficient quantized backpropagation and reduce memory bandwidth overhead. Across customization, reinforcement learning, and distillation tasks, FourTune matches the quality of full-precision fine-tuning. On FLUX.1-dev (12B), FourTune reduces memory overhead by 2.25$\times$ and increases end-to-end training throughput by 2.27$\times$ compared to BF16 LoRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FourTune，一种基于端到端 W4A4G4（权重4比特、激活4比特、梯度4比特）的扩散模型高效后训练框架。通过三分支混合流水线（标准LoRA分支加冻结数值稳定器分支）隔离量化敏感异常值，并结合硬件高效的分块量化和定制融合内核，实现原生4比特计算下的稳定训练。在FLUX.1-dev (12B)模型上，相比BF16 LoRA，内存开销降低2.25倍，端到端训练吞吐量提升2.27倍，且在定制化、强化学习和蒸馏任务中匹配全精度微调质量。
Motivation: 扩散模型后训练面临巨大的内存占用和缓慢的训练速度，现有参数高效微调方法仅部分缓解这些问题。
Method: 提出 FourTune 框架，采用端到端 W4A4G4 量化范式，包含三分支混合流水线：标准LoRA分支、冻结数值稳定器分支（隔离量化敏感异常值），以及硬件高效的分块量化和定制融合内核，支持量化反向传播并减少内存带宽开销。
Result: 在FLUX.1-dev (12B)上，相比BF16 LoRA，内存开销降低2.25倍，端到端训练吞吐量提升2.27倍；在定制化、强化学习和蒸馏任务中匹配全精度微调质量。
Conclusion: FourTune 证明了全4比特后训练扩散模型在效率和质量上的可行性，为大规模模型的后训练提供了实用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Akashic: A Low-Overhead LLM Inference Service with MemAttention
papers.abstract_en: Recent LLM-based agent systems continuously accumulate context across multi-turn interactions, tool invocations, and cross-session workflows. Replaying the full history for every request quickly becomes impractical: long contexts increase prefill cost, may exceed context limits, and often bury task-relevant evidence in irrelevant content, degrading both serving efficiency and output quality. We propose Akashic, a low-overhead memory system built around MemAttention, which organizes context into bounded chunks and models semantic relationships across chunks, preserving cross-chunk evidence without repeatedly rewriting the full history. Akashic further applies hardware-software co-designed memory placement to co-locate likely co-retrieved chunks, reducing retrieval fragmentation and I/O overhead. Across four representative workloads and three model sizes, Akashic improves task accuracy by up to 10.2 points, throughput by up to 1.21x, and sustainable request rate by up to 1.88x over strong prior memory baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Akashic，一个基于 MemAttention 的低开销 LLM 推理服务内存系统。MemAttention 将上下文组织为有界块并建模跨块语义关系，避免重复重放完整历史。结合硬件-软件协同设计的内存放置，减少检索碎片和 I/O 开销。在四种典型工作负载和三种模型规模上，相比强基线，任务准确率提升最多 10.2 个点，吞吐量提升最多 1.21 倍，可持续请求率提升最多 1.88 倍。
Motivation: LLM 代理系统在多轮交互、工具调用和跨会话工作流中持续累积上下文，重放完整历史导致预填充成本高、可能超出上下文限制，且无关内容掩盖任务相关信息，降低服务效率和输出质量。
Method: 提出 MemAttention，将上下文组织为有界块并建模块间语义关系，保留跨块证据而不重写完整历史。采用硬件-软件协同设计的内存放置，将可能共同检索的块放置在一起，减少检索碎片和 I/O 开销。
Result: 在四种代表性工作负载和三种模型规模上，任务准确率提升最多 10.2 个点，吞吐量提升最多 1.21 倍，可持续请求率提升最多 1.88 倍。
Conclusion: Akashic 通过 MemAttention 和协同内存放置有效提升 LLM 推理服务的效率和输出质量，为长上下文场景提供低开销方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning the Supports for Categorical Critic in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Value functions are an essential component in actor-critic based deep reinforcement learning (RL). Conventionally, these functions are trained as a regression task by minimising the mean squared error (MSE) relative to bootstrapped target values. Meanwhile, in distributional RL, a distribution of returns is modelled based on the distributional Bellman operator. This work investigates the Gaussian Histogram Loss (HL-Gauss), a recent approach that reframes value estimation as classification by encoding each scalar Bellman target as a Gaussian-smoothed categorical target. Despite its potential, applying histogram-based losses to RL presents inherent challenges, most notably the requirement to pre-define a fixed support interval, which is often complicated by the non-stationary and stochastic nature of target values typically found in RL tasks. In this work, we propose an approach that dynamically learns the lower and upper bounds of the support instead of assigning them beforehand. We derive an objective that jointly learns these bounds whilst learning the categorical representation of the scalar values, and we show that this objective forms an upper bound on the mean-squared Bellman error. Our theoretical analysis further shows that this bound is tighter than that of non-learned supports of HL-Gauss. Empirically, the proposed objective enables stable adaptation of the support interval and matches HL-Gauss-based actor-critic algorithms on most continuous-control tasks whilst improving on a subset, without requiring a pre-specified support interval.
papers.comment: In RLC 2026. Project page at https://isatine.xyz/projects/dysel, code at https://github.com/atine/dysel
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种动态学习直方图损失（HL-Gauss）中支持区间上下界的方法，用于强化学习中的值函数估计。该方法通过联合学习上下界和分类表示，形成均方贝尔曼误差的上界，且理论上比固定支持更紧。实验显示，在大多数连续控制任务上与基于HL-Gauss的actor-critic方法性能相当，部分任务有提升。
Motivation: 直方图损失（HL-Gauss）将值估计转化为分类问题，但需要预定义固定的支持区间，而在强化学习中目标值的非平稳性和随机性使固定区间难以设定。
Method: 提出动态学习支持区间下界和上界的方案，推导了一个联合优化目标，该目标同时学习区间边界和标量值的分类表示，并证明该目标构成均方贝尔曼误差的上界。
Result: 理论分析表明该上界比非学习支持（HL-Gauss）的更紧。实验上，该方法在大多数连续控制任务上达到或超过基于HL-Gauss的actor-critic算法，部分任务有改进，且无需预设支持区间。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了支持区间可动态学习以应对RL中值目标的非平稳性，提供了一种更鲁棒的值分布建模方式。

papers.title: Token Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Language models learn continuous programs over discrete symbols, with the embedding table and LM-head acting as the read/write interface between them. We show that this interface has gradient geometry distinct from dense hidden weights which can be exploited to improve the Pareto frontier across supervised finetuning, RL, and pretraining, while only utilizing kilobytes of optimizer state. We introduce Ember, a lightweight optimizer for embedding and LM-head matrices that utilizes O(V + D) VRAM, instead of Adam's O(2VD), and forgoes the need to shard both token table optimizer states. We provide empirical evidence that Ember scales effectively across batch size and parameter count. We show that the optimization trajectory of tokens can be well described by a simple 1D ray, counter to the popular belief that neural net parameters navigate a heavily nonconvex landscape. We provide a principled view on the surprisingly narrow space of optimizers that suffice for Transformer training. Finally, we open-source our distributed Ember implementation that merges cleanly with existing ZeRO/FSDP setups to support further research at https://github.com/katop1234/ember
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现语言模型的嵌入表和LM-head具有区别于密集隐藏权的梯度几何结构，并利用此结构提出轻量级优化器Ember。Ember仅需O(V+D)显存，优于Adam的O(2VD)，且无需分片token表优化器状态。实验表明Ember在批大小和参数规模上有效扩展，token优化轨迹可被简单一维射线描述。
Motivation: 现有优化器（如Adam）在嵌入表和LM-head上消耗大量显存（O(2VD)），且需要分片优化器状态，限制了大规模训练效率。本文旨在利用这些矩阵独特的梯度几何结构设计更高效的优化器。
Method: 提出Ember优化器，专注于嵌入表和LM-head矩阵，利用其梯度几何特性，将显存需求降至O(V+D)，并避免分片优化器状态。
Result: 实验证明Ember在监督微调、强化学习和预训练中改善了帕累托前沿，且能有效扩展至不同批大小和参数规模。token优化轨迹可由简单一维射线描述。
Conclusion: 嵌入表和LM-head的优化可以利用其梯度几何简化，Ember提供了一种高效且易于集成的替代方案，兼容ZeRO/FSDP设置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HARC: Coupling Harmfulness and Refusal Directions for Robust Safety Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how aligned LLMs internally represent safety is critical for diagnosing alignment vulnerabilities, as it explains why jailbreaks succeed and informs the design of robust alignment strategies. Prior work shows that aligned LLMs encode harmfulness and refusal as separable directions in the residual stream at prompt-side token positions. We show that jailbreaks succeed at prompt encoding by suppressing either the refusal or harmfulness direction before any token is generated, with distinct attack classes occupying separable regions of the harmfulness-refusal plane. Extending the analysis to response-token positions, we find that the model recognizes harmful content while it is generating that content, even when it failed to recognize the input as harmful at the prompt side. Motivated by our findings, we introduce HARC (Harmfulness-And-Refusal Coupling), a fine-tuning method that pairs the two directions across both prompt and response positions. Since the intervention is confined to the harmfulness-refusal subspace, it leaves the rest of the residual stream intact and does not degrade general capability or inflate over-refusal. Across extensive experiments, HARC achieves the strongest robustness-capability-usability trade-off among six baselines spanning the major training-time and inference-time safety methods. The harmfulness and refusal directions at prompt and response positions transfer across the five model families and two scales we tested without architecture-specific tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分析对齐LLM内部的安全表示，发现越狱攻击通过抑制拒绝方向或有害性方向来成功，且模型在生成响应时能识别自己的有害内容即使之前未识别。基于此，提出HARC微调方法，在prompt和response位置耦合有害性和拒绝方向，仅扰动该子空间，从而在不降低通用能力或过度拒绝的情况下提升安全性。实验表明HARC在六种方法中取得最佳鲁棒性-能力-可用性权衡，且跨模型族和规模迁移。
Motivation: 现有对齐方法容易受到越狱攻击，但内部机制不清晰。理解LLM如何表示安全性对于诊断漏洞和设计更鲁棒的对齐策略至关重要。
Method: 提出HARC微调方法，通过耦合prompt和response位置的有害性方向 (harmfulness direction) 与拒绝方向 (refusal direction)，仅在该子空间内进行干预，保持残差流其余部分不变。
Result: 在六种涵盖训练时和推理时安全方法的基线上，HARC取得了最强的鲁棒性-能力-可用性权衡，且有害性和拒绝方向在五个模型家族和两种规模上无需架构特定调整即可迁移。
Conclusion: 通过限制干预到有害性-拒绝子空间，HARC能够在不损害通用能力或导致过度拒绝的前提下实现鲁棒对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAMBA: A Scatter-Guided Masked Bidirectional Mamba Foundation Model for SAR Target Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic aperture radar automatic target recognition (SAR ATR) is critical for Earth observation and defense, but its practical deployment is constrained by scarce annotated training data. Self-supervised pre-training alleviates this label bottleneck, yet prevailing Transformer architectures incur prohibitive quadratic computational complexity, and conventional universal masking neglects the unique electromagnetic scattering properties intrinsic to SAR imagery. To address these limitations, we propose SAMBA (Scattering-Guided Bidirectional Mamba), an efficient self-supervised pre-training foundation model for SAR target interpretation. Our framework features three core innovations: (i) a linear-complexity Mamba encoder with a mid-sequence class token to mitigate computational bottlenecks; (ii) a three-level hierarchical Scattering-Guided Masked Autoencoder (SG-MAE) masking strategy guided by SAR physical priors, aligning the pretext task with SAR's intrinsic imaging mechanism; (iii) a lightweight SpatialMix feature interaction module to enhance cross-region feature fusion. We also design a two-stage cross-domain pre-training pipeline to optimize the overall pre-training process. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SAMBA consistently delivers superior performance across all pre-training configurations, with substantially fewer parameters than both CNN and Transformer baselines. Compared with the default masking strategy in standard MAE, the proposed SG-MAE strategy further boosts the model's few-shot transfer capability. Benchmarking on seven downstream datasets covering classification and detection tasks shows SAMBA achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on most metrics, fully validating its robust generalizability across diverse SAR interpretation tasks. Source code and pre-trained weights are publicly available at https://github.com/mynswkk/SAMBA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAMBA，一种基于散射引导掩码的双向Mamba自监督预训练基础模型，用于SAR目标识别。该模型采用线性复杂度的Mamba编码器、三级散射引导掩码策略（SG-MAE）和轻量级SpatialMix特征交互模块，在多个下游数据集上达到SOTA性能，参数量显著少于CNN和Transformer基线。
Motivation: SAR目标识别中标注数据稀缺，现有Transformer计算复杂度高，且通用掩码策略未考虑SAR图像的电磁散射特性。
Method: 提出SAMBA框架，包含：线性复杂度的Mamba编码器（带中间序列类令牌）；三级层次化散射引导掩码自编码器（SG-MAE），基于SAR物理先验设计掩码策略；轻量级SpatialMix模块增强跨区域特征融合；两阶段跨域预训练流程。
Result: 在七个下游分类和检测数据集上，SAMBA在多数指标上达到SOTA，SG-MAE策略相比标准MAE掩码进一步提升少样本迁移能力，模型参数量显著少于CNN和Transformer基线。
Conclusion: SAMBA验证了结合SAR物理先验的自监督预训练在SAR目标识别中的有效性，代码和权重已开源。

papers.title: Vertigo Vertigo: Reconstructing a Cinematic Ideal through its Predictive AI Double
papers.abstract_en: Vertigo Vertigo is a scene-for-scene AI reconstruction of Hitchcock's Vertigo (1958), generated from only 2.78% of the original film's frames. Using this sparse set of keyframe anchors, we perform first-last frame interpolation via a large video diffusion model to predict the intervening sequences. Vertigo is itself a film about the obsessive reconstruction of an artificial ideal; Vertigo Vertigo extends this logic to the material of the film, treating the canonical text as a probe for the normative conventions of classical cinema encoded within generative systems. Evaluated through computational analysis and critical feedback from media theorists (Lev Manovich, Shane Denson, Kevin L. Ferguson), the artifact demonstrates remarkable structural fidelity: 73.1% of frames are recognizable as plausible renditions of Vertigo and only 3.6% fail catastrophically. This fidelity suggests that cinematic norms are deeply compressed within the model's latent priors. Aesthetically, the reconstruction is rendered as an unstable overlay between the original film and its predictive shadow, fueling a persistent doubt in the viewer's perception of authenticity -- a 21st-century vertigo. The work argues that generative media is not a paradigm shift from cinema but an acceleration of its logic of desire and false authenticity, extending from classical Hollywood through to the predictive media environments now reshaping contemporary perception.
papers.comment: Accepted to Ars Electronica EXPANDED 2026 - Conference on Animation and Interactive Art (in cooperation with ACM SIGGRAPH), Ars Electronica Festival, Linz. 7 pages, 7 figures. Authors' version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过仅使用原片2.78%的关键帧，利用大规模视频扩散模型进行首末帧插值，逐镜头重构了希区柯克《迷魂记》（1958）。计算分析和媒体理论家反馈显示，73.1%的帧可识别为可信重建，仅3.6%完全失败，表明电影规范深度压缩于生成模型的潜在先验中。作品论证生成媒体并非电影范式的转变，而是其欲望与虚假真实性逻辑的加速。
Motivation: 探索经典电影文本如何检视生成系统内编码的规范惯例，以及生成式AI对电影本体论的延续而非断裂。
Method: 从原片抽取稀疏关键帧作为锚点，通过大规模视频扩散模型执行首末帧插值（first-last frame interpolation），预测中间序列。
Result: 73.1%的帧可被识别为《迷魂记》的可信版本，仅3.6%严重失败；媒体理论家反馈强调了结构保真度与感知不确定性。
Conclusion: 生成式媒体不是电影范式的革命，而是加速了古典好莱坞逻辑中欲望与虚假真实性的运作，扩展至重塑当代感知的预测性媒体环境。

papers.title: Reweighting Framewise Attention in Video Transformers for Facial Expression Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Understanding facial expressions in videos requires modeling subtle and localized facial dynamics under unconstrained conditions. Although recent Vision Transformer (ViT)-based video models have shown strong performance through large-scale self-supervised pretraining, their attention mechanisms often emphasize dominant global motions and coarse temporal dynamics, limiting sensitivity to fine-grained facial variations. To address this limitation, we propose MiRA (Marginal-induced Attention Redistribution), a plug-in frame-marginal attention redistribution framework for ViT backbones that enhances spatio-temporal selectivity toward subtle facial dynamics without introducing additional trainable parameters. MiRA derives frame-level confidence and intra-frame concentration statistics from self-attention maps to estimate frame-wise marginal importance and redistribute attention toward spatiotemporally localized facial cues. We first introduce a principled exact mode based on post-softmax attention redistribution. To further improve efficiency, we propose flashLite mode, a lightweight pre-softmax approximation that integrates frame-marginal redistribution into FlashAttention kernels while preserving the effectiveness of the exact formulation. Experimental results on challenging Facial Expression Recognition (FER) benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong ViT baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出MiRA框架，通过重新加权视频Transformer中的帧级注意力来增强对细微面部动态的时空选择性，无需额外参数。实验表明在面部表情识别基准上持续提升强ViT基线性能。
Motivation: 现有ViT视频模型注意力机制常偏向主导全局运动和粗糙时间动态，对细微面部变化敏感度不足。
Method: 提出MiRA（Marginal-induced Attention Redistribution），一种即插即用的帧边缘注意力重分布框架，通过自注意力图计算帧级置信度和帧内集中度统计，重分布注意力聚焦于时空局部面部线索。包括精确的后softmax模式和高效的flashLite模式（预softmax近似，集成到FlashAttention核中）。
Result: 在多个具有挑战性的面部表情识别基准上，MiRA持续改进强ViT基线。
Conclusion: MiRA在不增加参数的情况下提升视频Transformer对面部细微动态的敏感性，但方法主要针对面部表情理解，可能泛化到其他细粒度视频分析任务。

papers.title: Active Quantum Kernel Acquisition for Gaussian Process Regression
papers.abstract_en: Quantum kernel estimation on near-term hardware is shot-budgeted: every entry of the kernel Gram matrix is a Bernoulli expectation that must be sampled with a finite number of circuit executions. Recent work on quantum kernel classification has shown that allocating shots non-uniformly across kernel entries, weighted by their downstream task sensitivity, can reduce the shot budget required to reach a target accuracy. We extend this idea to Gaussian process (GP) regression, a setting whose downstream quantities (full-spectrum posterior variance, log-determinant, marginal likelihood) couple to kernel error more tightly than the sign-only outputs of classification. We derive three closed-form pair-level sensitivities predictive coupling $|α_iα_j|$, leave-one-out residual, and marginal-likelihood gradient and plug them into a Neyman-style minimum-variance allocation rule. To prevent catastrophic over-concentration when the warm-up sensitivity estimate is itself noisy, we add a high uniform coverage floor justified by a Frobenius lower bound on the missing-entry perturbation. On four UCI benchmarks and two synthetic RBF + Bernoulli controlled studies, the resulting allocator delivers $10$--$21\%$ test-RMSE improvement over uniform allocation across the moderate-budget regime. The gain transfers (i) to genuine ZZ and Pauli-Z quantum kernels on quantum-natural data ($-13$--$15\%$ at low budget, $p<0.05$ paired) and (ii) to four downstream tasks (Bayesian quadrature, heteroscedastic regression, hyperparameter learning, multi-output Cokriging). On UCI features embedded into a ZZ kernel the gain disappears, consistent with the exponential-concentration regime where shot allocation has nothing to exploit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对量子核估计在近期硬件上的有限采样预算问题，将非均匀分配方案从分类任务扩展到高斯过程回归。推导了三种封闭形式的成对敏感性指标用于优化分配，并引入均匀覆盖下限防止估计噪声导致的过度集中。在多个基准和量子核实验上，所提分配器在中等预算下将测试RMSE降低10-21%。
Motivation: 量子核估计的采样预算有限，均匀分配可能导致低效。分类任务中非均匀分配已有研究，但高斯过程回归中下游量（后验方差、对数行列式、边际似然）对核误差更敏感，需新的敏感性指标和分配策略。
Method: 提出基于Neyman最小方差分配的主动量子核获取方法，使用三种成对敏感性指标（|α_iα_j|、留一残差、边际似然梯度）指导采样分配，并加入Frobenius下限约束的均匀覆盖层防止过度集中。
Result: 在四个UCI基准和两个合成任务上，测试RMSE比均匀分配降低10-21%。在量子核任务上低预算时改善13-15%（p<0.05），并推广至贝叶斯求积等四个下游任务。但在UCI特征嵌入ZZ核时增益消失。
Conclusion: 非均匀分配能有效提升量子核GP回归的采样效率，但增益依赖于核函数的可分离性和任务敏感性信号的存在。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Agent Dynamics in World Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative world models hold immense promise as scalable simulators for autonomous systems, particularly for synthesizing rare but safety-critical multi-agent interactions, such as vehicle collisions. However, current evaluation paradigms index heavily on visual fidelity and semantic alignment, leaving a critical blind spot: they cannot reliably quantify whether generated dynamics actually obey the fundamental physical laws required for reliable simulation. Assessing this physical plausibility is inherently difficult due to a lack of physical metrics and the challenge of extracting metric-scale kinematics from uncalibrated video rollouts. To bridge this gap, we introduce CrashTwin, a physics-grounded evaluation framework designed to stress-test the physical trustworthiness of world models. CrashTwin couples a diverse dataset of multi-agent collision scenarios, comprising 25K controllable synthetic and 12K in-the-wild real-world collision sequences with a novel calibration-free reconstruction pipeline, enabling the recovery of 3D physical attributes directly from world model rollouts. We propose a diagnostic suite that systematically evaluates three dimensions: spatio-temporal consistency, momentum and kinetic energy conservation, and world-dynamics integrity. Extensive benchmarking of state-of-the-art models reveals a crucial insight: high perceptual quality frequently masks severe physical violations during complex interactions. By quantitatively exposing these failure modes, CrashTwin provides a vital diagnostic tool for developing physically grounded world models capable of reliable real-world simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CrashTwin，一个基于物理的多智能体动力学评估框架，用于测试世界模型在生成碰撞场景时的物理可信度。该框架包含 25K 合成和 12K 真实碰撞序列的数据集，以及无需标定的 3D 物理属性重建流程，从时空一致性、动量能量守恒和世界动力学完整性三个维度进行诊断。基准测试表明，高感知质量常掩盖严重物理违规。
Motivation: 现有世界模型评估侧重于视觉保真度和语义对齐，缺乏对生成动力学是否遵守物理定律的定量衡量，而这对安全关键的多智能体交互模拟至关重要。
Method: 构建包含合成与真实碰撞序列的数据集 CrashTwin，并设计无需标定的重建管线以从世界模型 rollout 中恢复 3D 物理属性；提出三个诊断维度：时空一致性、动量与动能守恒、世界动力学完整性。
Result: 对多种最先进世界模型的基准测试揭示，高感知质量常掩盖复杂交互中的严重物理违规。
Conclusion: CrashTwin 提供了诊断工具，以暴露当前世界模型在物理可信度上的失败模式，推动开发更可靠的物理基础模型。

papers.title: DanceOPD: On-Policy Generative Field Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Modern image generation demands a single model that unifies diverse capabilities, including text-to-image (T2I), local editing, and global editing. However, these capabilities are rarely naturally aligned and often conflict. For instance, editing tends to degrade T2I performance, while global and local editing interfere with each other. Consequently, effectively composing these capabilities has become a central challenge for image generation model training. To tackle this, we introduce DanceOPD, an on-policy generative field distillation framework for flow-matching models that routes each sample to one capability field, queries one low-noise student-induced state, and trains with a simple velocity MSE objective. With each capability source defined as a velocity field over the shared flow state space, the student learns from fields queried on its own rollout states to compose expert capabilities. This formulation also absorbs operator-defined fields such as classifier-free guidance. Comprehensive experiments on T2I, editing, realism-field absorption, and CFG absorption show that our approach improves multi-capability composition, strengthening target capabilities while preserving anchor generation quality. We believe this work establishes a practical route for generative field distillation in flow-matching models.
papers.comment: Technical Report; 40 pages, 13 figures, 9 tables; Project Page at https://danceopd.github.io/ GitHub Repo at https://github.com/worldbench/DanceOPD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DanceOPD，一个用于 flow-matching 模型的 on-policy 生成场蒸馏框架，旨在统一文本到图像（T2I）、局部编辑和全局编辑等能力，解决能力间的冲突。该方法将每个样本路由到一个能力场，查询低噪声学生诱导状态，并用速度均方误差（velocity MSE）训练。实验表明该方法提升了多能力组合性能，同时保持 anchor 生成质量。
Motivation: 现代图像生成模型需要单一模型具备多种能力，但这些能力（如 T2I、编辑）相互冲突，编辑会损害 T2I 性能，局部与全局编辑互相干扰，缺少有效的组合训练方法。
Method: 提出 on-policy 生成场蒸馏框架，在 flow-matching 模型中定义每个能力源为共享流状态空间上的速度场，学生从其自身 rollout 状态上查询场进行学习，并可吸收操作定义的场（如 classifier-free guidance）。训练目标为简单的 velocity MSE。
Result: 在 T2I、编辑、现实主义场吸收和 CFG 吸收等实验上，该方法改善了多能力组合，强化了目标能力同时保持了 anchor 生成质量。
Conclusion: 该工作为 flow-matching 模型中的生成场蒸馏建立了一条实用路线，但未提及具体数值或有局限性的量化分析。

papers.title: Application of LLMs to Threat Assessment of Foreign Peacekeeping Missions
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel approach for applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to threat assessment in the context of foreign peacekeeping missions. Building on the PINPOINT project and its use case, the EU Monitoring Mission in Georgia, we combine an interdisciplinary risk-model with OSINT-based media collection and LLM-supported threat extraction. The proposed workflow maps media contents to mission-relevant threats, extracts structured information and applies several additional LLM-based processing steps to improve relevance and grounding. An evaluation of threats extracted from media documents shows high agreement between automatically generated results and human judgment for core aspects such as threat and mission relevance. These results indicate that LLMs provide a promising approach to support analysts in the context of peacekeeping missions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将大型语言模型（LLM）应用于外国维和任务的威胁评估，结合跨学科风险模型、OSINT媒体收集和LLM支持的威胁提取，在地理监测任务（欧盟驻格鲁吉亚监测团）中验证了自动结果与人工判断高度一致。
Motivation: 维和任务中需要从大量媒体信息中快速识别与任务相关的威胁，传统方法依赖人工分析，效率低且主观性强。
Method: 基于PINPOINT项目，构建跨学科风险模型，利用OSINT收集媒体内容，通过LLM提取威胁并映射到任务相关类别，再经多步LLM处理提升相关性和基础性。
Result: 摘要报告从媒体文档提取的威胁在威胁相关性和任务相关性等核心指标上与人工判断高度一致。
Conclusion: LLM为维和任务中的威胁分析提供了有前景的辅助手段，但摘要未提及在更广泛场景或与其他方法对比的局限性。

papers.title: Reproducibility Study of "AlphaEdit: Null-Space Constrained Knowledge Editing for Language Models"
papers.abstract_en: Fang et al. (2025) introduced a null-space constrained projection, named AlphaEdit, for locate-then-edit knowledge editing methods, theoretically guaranteeing that edits do not disrupt previously preserved knowledge, and reports substantial gains over existing editing methods on LLaMA3, GPT2-XL, and GPT-J. In this work, we present a reproducibility study of AlphaEdit, reproducing its reported results under the original experimental setup and extending the evaluation along three axes: new model architectures, additional downstream benchmarks, and substantially longer sequential editing horizons. We successfully reproduce AlphaEdit's reported metrics across the original models, though we identify a discrepancy in the reported fluency and consistency metric. Extending AlphaEdit to newer model families, we find that its advantage does not generalize uniformly, which we trace to architectural assumptions in the locate-then-edit paradigm that are violated by these newer models. We further stress-test AlphaEdit's central sequential-editing claim by extending the number of edits well beyond those evaluated in the original paper, and find that performance, which is stable at the originally reported scale, degrades as edits reach a much higher count, indicating that the null-space projection's protection against catastrophic forgetting is bounded rather than unconditional. Finally, we extend evaluation of edited models on three extra benchmarks, namely, BoolQ, HellaSwag, and XSTest, and we find that large-scale sequential editing degrades both general downstream task competence and safety-relevant refusal behavior. Our results confirm that AlphaEdit performs as reported within its original scope, while showing that its core theoretical guarantees are sensitive to model architecture and editing scale in ways that have practical implications for its deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对AlphaEdit（一种基于零空间约束的语言模型知识编辑方法）进行了可重复性研究，在原始实验条件下成功复现了其报告指标，但发现流畅性和一致性指标存在差异。进一步扩展评估显示，AlphaEdit的优势在新模型架构上并不普遍，且其防止灾难性遗忘的零空间投影保护是有界的：当顺序编辑次数大大超过原始评估范围时，性能下降；大规模顺序编辑还会损害下游任务能力和安全相关拒绝行为。
Motivation: 验证AlphaEdit知识编辑方法的可重复性，并评估其在更广泛场景（新架构、更多编辑次数、额外基准）下的泛化能力和局限性。
Method: 复现AlphaEdit的原始实验，并扩展三个维度：测试新模型架构（如LLaMA3系列之外的模型）、在BoolQ/HellaSwag/XSTest三个新基准上评估、以及大幅增加顺序编辑次数。
Result: 成功复现原始指标（除流畅性和一致性指标有出入）；AlphaEdit的优势在新模型架构上不统一；顺序编辑次数超过原始范围后性能下降；大规模编辑降低下游任务能力和安全行为。
Conclusion: AlphaEdit在其原始范围内有效，但其理论保证对模型架构和编辑规模敏感，实际部署时需谨慎。

papers.title: The Inattentional Gap: Task-Conditioned Language and Vision Models Omit the Safety-Critical Signals They Can Otherwise Report
papers.abstract_en: AI safety is evaluated by how reliably a model detects the hazards it is told to find, yet accidents often arise from the hazard no one specified. We show that conditioning a language or vision model on a narrow task suppresses its reporting of co-present, safety-critical signals it can otherwise report, a machine analogue of human inattentional blindness, produced by a different mechanism. Across radiology and driving text scenarios and chest-radiograph vision tasks, the ordinary focused instructions under which such systems are deployed suppressed reporting by up to 0.92 in report rate relative to the same models when unconstrained, and an explicit exclusive instruction abolished reporting entirely in radiology. Suppression appeared in every model tested, did not diminish with scale, persisted in a reasoning model, and varied more by model family than by size. We name this dissociation the Inattentional Gap and argue that it decouples measured benchmark safety from real-world safety: a system can score near-perfectly on the hazards an evaluation specifies while remaining blind to those that cause harm. Probing the mechanism, we localize the proximal trigger to output scope and find System-1-style task capture without reliable intrinsic oversight in the sampled systems. Oversight could, however, be supplied externally: routing each narrow report to an independent open-ended critic restored every omitted finding, demonstrating that the gap is both measurable and mitigable. We propose reporting-complete evaluation, scoring what a system fails to report alongside what it is asked to find, as a requirement for safety-critical deployment.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 8 figures. v2: author list expanded; statistical robustness additions (bootstrap CIs, Holm-Bonferroni, judge-sensitivity analysis). Reproducibility deposit: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20826824
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现语言和视觉模型在条件化于狭窄任务时，会抑制报告共同出现的安全关键信号，类似于人类的非注意盲视。在放射学和驾驶文本场景以及胸部X光视觉任务中，专注指令使报告率下降高达0.92，排他指令在放射学中完全消除了报告。这种现象在所有测试模型中出现，不随规模减小，在推理模型中也存在，且不同模型族间差异大于规模差异。作者将其命名为“非注意缺口”，认为它使基准安全与现实安全脱钩。
Motivation: AI安全评估通常只关注指定危险，但事故常来自未指定的危险。现有方法忽视了模型在专注任务下可能忽略其他关键信号的问题。
Method: 通过设置聚焦指令和排他指令，比较模型在受约束与无约束条件下的报告率变化。在放射学和驾驶文本场景、胸部X光视觉任务上进行实验，并分析模型规模、家族、推理模型等的影响。提出通过外部独立开放批评者来恢复被忽略的发现。
Result: 专注指令使报告率下降高达0.92；排他指令在放射学中完全消除了报告。所有模型均出现抑制，不随规模减小，推理模型也受影响。不同模型族间差异大于规模差异。
Conclusion: 非注意缺口将测量到的基准安全与现实安全分离，一个系统可能在评估指定的危险上表现完美，但对导致伤害的危险视而不见。该缺口可通过外部批评者缓解。作者提出报告完整性评估作为安全关键部署的要求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DDStereo: Efficient Dual Decoder Transformers for Stereo 3D Road Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Stereo-based 3D obstacle perception for autonomous driving is currently constrained by an imbalanced triplet: deployment cost, detection accuracy, and open-set adaptability. While existing methods struggle to balance these three competing objectives, there is an urgent demand for high-precision, real-time algorithms capable of detecting arbitrary obstacles in the wild. In this paper, we present DDStereo, a novel Dual-Decoder Stereo Transformer that achieves a synergistic integration of 3D object detection and Out-of-Distribution (OoD) road anomaly detection. Leveraging the geometric priors of stereo disparity, our approach effectively couples 3D attribute regression with open-set foreground detection within a streamlined dual-branch decoder architecture. Conventional methods rely on complex feature-level fusion; DDStereo maintains execution efficiency by employing a decoupled decoding strategy and shared object-level queries to ensure cross-modal target alignment. Extensive evaluations of public benchmarks demonstrate that DDStereo not only achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under open-set and closed-set protocols. Our method delivers real-time performance comparable to monocular 3D detection baselines, providing a cost-effective solution for the perception of obstacles of the normal and OoD category. Code and models are available at https://github.com/shiyi-mu/DDStereo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DDStereo，一种双解码器立体 Transformer，用于同时进行 3D 目标检测和开放集道路异常检测。利用立体视差的几何先验，通过解耦解码策略和共享目标查询实现高效执行。在公开基准上达到 SOTA 准确率，且推理速度与单目 3D 检测相当。
Motivation: 现有立体 3D 感知方法在部署成本、检测精度和开放集适应性三者之间难以平衡，急需一种高精度、实时且能检测任意障碍物的算法。
Method: 提出双解码器立体 Transformer 架构，包含两个分支：一个用于 3D 属性回归，一个用于开放集前景检测。采用解耦解码策略和共享目标查询，避免复杂的特征级融合，保持执行效率。
Result: 在公开基准测试中，在开放集和封闭集协议下均达到最先进准确率，且推理速度与单目 3D 检测基线相当。
Conclusion: DDStereo 为自动驾驶中正常和分布外障碍物感知提供了一种成本有效的解决方案，代码和模型已开源。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出双解码器立体 Transformer 架构，包含两个分支：一个用于 3D 属性回归，一个用于开放集前景检测。采用解耦解码策略和共享目标查询，避免复杂的特征级融合，保持执行效率。
summary_sections.result: 在公开基准测试中，在开放集和封闭集协议下均达到最先进准确率，且推理速度与单目 3D 检测基线相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: DDStereo 为自动驾驶中正常和分布外障碍物感知提供了一种成本有效的解决方案，代码和模型已开源。

papers.title: AutoSpec: Safety Rule Evolution for LLM Agents via Inductive Logic Programming
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate complex tasks by integrating language models with external tools and environments. However, their autonomy poses significant safety risks: agents may execute destructive commands, leak sensitive data, or violate domain constraints. Existing safety approaches face a fundamental tradeoff: hand-crafted rules are interpretable but brittle, with overly conservative rules blocking safe operations (high false positives) while permissive rules miss unsafe behaviors (high false negatives). Neural classifiers lack the interpretability required for safety-critical deployments. We present AutoSpec, a framework that automatically evolves deployed expert-designed safety rules from user safe/unsafe annotations through counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS) guided by inductive logic programming (ILP). Starting from the expert rules and a stream of annotated traces, AutoSpec iteratively evaluates rules, mines false-positive and false-negative counterexamples, uses ILP to learn which predicates discriminate them, generates candidate rule edits, and verifies candidates to select the best revision. The key insight is that ILP efficiently identifies predicates that appear frequently in false negatives but rarely in false positives (or vice versa), dramatically pruning the exponential search space of rule edits. This continues until convergence, producing interpretable rules that balance precision and recall. We evaluate AutoSpec on 291 execution traces spanning code execution and embodied agent domains. AutoSpec raises rule F1 to 0.98 and 0.93 across the two domains, achieving up to 94% false positive reduction while maintaining high recall, and converges within 4-5 iterations. The ILP-guided approach achieves up to 4.8x higher F1 than heuristic CEGIS. The learned rules are human-readable, auditable, and generalize to unseen scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoSpec框架，通过归纳逻辑编程（ILP）自动演化LLM智能体的安全规则，从专家初始规则和用户标注轨迹中迭代生成可解释的规则，平衡精确率和召回率。在代码执行和具身智能体领域的291条轨迹上，F1分别达到0.98和0.93，假阳性减少94%，且收敛于4-5次迭代。
Motivation: 现有安全方法面临手工规则过于保守或过于宽松的权衡，神经分类器缺乏可解释性，难以用于安全关键场景。
Method: 采用反例引导的归纳合成（CEGIS）结合归纳逻辑编程（ILP），从专家规则和标注轨迹中迭代挖掘假阳性和假阴性反例，学习关键谓词，候选规则编辑并验证最佳修订。
Result: 在代码执行和具身智能体域上规则F1达0.98和0.93，假阳性减少94%，收敛于4-5次迭代，比启发式CEGIS高4.8倍F1。
Conclusion: AutoSpec生成的规则可读、可审计，并泛化到未见场景，平衡了安全与可用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Open Waters to Enclosed Cabins: ProteusVPR for Cross-Scene Visual Place Recognition in Maritime Perception and Cabin Inspection
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous robotic inspection in maritime environments presents unique challenges for Visual Place Recognition (VPR) due to cross-scene perceptual shifts. Robots navigating ship-borne environments must transition between visually distinct domains: open decks with sparse textures and severe illumination changes, and enclosed cabins with repetitive structures and high visual ambiguity. Existing VPR methods, designed primarily for urban or indoor scenes, fail to generalize reliably across these starkly different scenarios. To address this, we propose ProteusVPR, a two-stage retrieval-refinement framework. The first stage employs any standard VPR model for initial image retrieval. The second stage introduces a geometric-visual estimation network that fuses the retrieved image with two temporally preceding frames, incorporating geometric descriptors, a local affine coordinate system, and camera azimuth encoding to achieve precise localization. To support this task, we introduce the XHZ dataset, an 8K-panoramic ship-borne dataset collected from an operational vessel, featuring multi-floor cabin structures, deck transition zones, and strict query-database separation for rigorous evaluation. Extensive experiments on the XHZ dataset demonstrate that ProteusVPR consistently improves the localization accuracy across multiple VPR backbones, reducing mean localization error by over 60\% on average and that ProteusVPR offers an effective and robust solution for precise visual localization in challenging, cross-scene maritime environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ProteusVPR，一个两阶段检索-精化框架，用于解决海上环境中跨场景视觉位置识别（VPR）的挑战。第一阶段使用标准VPR模型进行初始图像检索，第二阶段引入几何-视觉估计网络，融合检索图像和两个时间上相邻的帧，利用几何描述子、局部仿射坐标系和相机方位角编码实现精确定位。在XHZ数据集上，该方法将平均定位误差降低60%以上。
Motivation: 现有VPR方法主要针对城市或室内场景设计，无法可靠地泛化到海上环境中开放甲板与封闭舱室之间的跨场景感知变化。
Method: 提出ProteusVPR框架，包含两个阶段：第一阶段用任意标准VPR模型进行初始检索；第二阶段用几何-视觉估计网络融合检索图像和两个时间上相邻的帧，结合几何描述子、局部仿射坐标系和相机方位角编码进行精确重定位。
Result: 在XHZ数据集上，ProteusVPR在多种VPR骨干网络上一致地提高了定位精度，平均定位误差降低超过60%。
Conclusion: ProteusVPR为具有挑战性的跨场景海上环境提供了有效且鲁棒的精确视觉定位解决方案。

papers.title: On the Redundancy of Timestep Embeddings in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models rely heavily on explicit timestep embeddings to modulate the denoising process across various noise scales. In this work, we challenge the necessity of these temporal signals by analyzing their impact on U-Net and Diffusion Transformer architectures. Beyond empirical evidence, we provide a theoretical framework demonstrating that, under certain conditions, the global minimizer of the diffusion training objective can be achieved without explicit timestep conditioning. Our findings reveal a surprising robustness when timestep embeddings are completely removed. Extensive ablation studies on the CelebA and CIFAR-10 datasets show that these time-agnostic models can maintain high structural fidelity and even surpass their conditioned counterparts in competitive metrics, including FID, precision, and recall. Our analysis suggests these architectures can implicitly infer noise scales from the corrupted input under specific assumptions, rendering explicit temporal conditioning redundant. This study challenges long-standing temporal conditioning paradigms and paves the way for more efficient and structurally focused generative architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑扩散模型中显式时间步嵌入的必要性，通过理论证明和实验发现，在U-Net和Diffusion Transformer架构中移除时间步嵌入后，模型在CelebA和CIFAR-10数据集上的FID、精度和召回率等指标仍能维持甚至超越有条件的版本。作者认为架构可以从含噪输入隐式推断噪声尺度，使得显式时间步条件冗余。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型高度依赖显式时间步嵌入来调节不同噪声尺度的去噪过程，但该嵌入是否必要尚不清楚。
Method: 提供理论框架证明扩散训练目标的全局最小化可在无需显式时间步条件下实现，并在U-Net和Diffusion Transformer上进行去除时间步嵌入的消融实验。
Result: 在CelebA和CIFAR-10数据集上，无时间步嵌入的模型在FID、精度和召回率等指标上达到或超过有条件的对应模型。
Conclusion: 扩散架构可隐式推断噪声尺度，显式时间步条件可能是多余的，这一发现挑战了长期存在的时序条件范式，有助于设计更高效的生成架构。

papers.title: A Neuromorphic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Efficient Pathfinding in Robotic Mobile Fulfillment Systems
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic environmental changes, confined workspaces, and stringent real-time constraints make pathfinding in Robotic Mobile Fulfillment Systems (RMFS) a challenging problem for conventional search- and rule-based methods, which typically suffer from high computational complexity and long decision latency. While reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful alternative, deploying learned policies with extreme energy efficiency on resource-constrained hardware remains an open challenge. We present SDQN-RMFS, an end-to-end framework that achieves high-fidelity deployment of an RL-trained policy from a full-precision artificial neural network (ANN) through to a neuromorphic chip. By computing only when triggered by sparse events, this framework unlocks ultra-low-power RMFS pathfinding. Our full-stack pipeline operates as follows: an ANN policy is first efficiently trained via a collision-allowing strategy to densify informative trajectories, and then converted into a spiking neural network (SNN) via a hard-label knowledge distillation approach. This effectively addresses the output distribution mismatch, preserving policy capability across the ANN-to-SNN pipeline while substantially reducing inference latency. Hardware experiments demonstrate up to 11,281$\times$ energy savings and a nearly two-fold reduction in latency compared to a high-performance GPU baseline, while maintaining decision quality on par with the original trained policy. These results establish physical neuromorphic inference as a practical and energy-sustainable pathway for large-scale RMFS operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SDQN-RMFS框架，用于机器人移动履行系统（RMFS）中的高效路径规划。该框架将全精度ANN策略通过硬标签知识蒸馏转换为SNN，并在神经形态芯片上实现超低功耗推理。硬件实验显示相比GPU基准实现高达11,281倍能耗节省和近两倍延迟降低，同时保持决策质量不变。
Motivation: 传统搜索和规则方法在动态变化的RMFS中计算复杂且延迟高；强化学习虽有效但部署到资源受限硬件时面临能耗挑战。
Method: 提出端到端SDQN-RMFS框架：首先通过允许碰撞的策略训练ANN以密集化信息轨迹，然后利用硬标签知识蒸馏将ANN转换为SNN，解决输出分布不匹配问题，最终在神经形态芯片上部署。
Result: 硬件实验表明，与高性能GPU基线相比，能耗节省高达11,281倍，延迟降低近两倍，决策质量与原始训练策略相当。
Conclusion: 物理神经形态推理可作为大规模RMFS操作中实用且节能的路径，证明了SNN在资源受限场景下的可行性。

papers.title: When Lower Privileges Suffice: Investigating Over-Privileged Tool Selection in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents increasingly select tools autonomously, their choices among tools with different privileges become safety-relevant. However, prior tool-selection studies focus on safety-agnostic metadata preferences, leaving privilege-sensitive choices underexplored. To address this gap, we study over-privileged tool selection, in which an agent selects or escalates to a higher-privilege tool despite a sufficient lower-privilege alternative. We introduce ToolPrivBench to evaluate whether agents choose higher-privilege tools despite sufficient lower-privilege alternatives, measuring both initial selection and escalation after transient tool failures. Across eight domains and five recurring risk patterns, we find that over-privileged tool selection is common among mainstream LLM agents and is further amplified by transient failures. We further find that general safety alignment does not reliably transfer to least-privilege tool choice, while prompt-level controls provide only limited mitigation under transient failures. We therefore introduce a privilege-aware post-training defense that teaches agents to prefer sufficient lower-privilege tools and escalate only when necessary. Our mitigation experiments show that this defense substantially reduces unnecessary high-privilege tool use while preserving general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM代理在自主选择工具时倾向选择过高权限工具（over-privileged tool selection）的问题，即存在足够低权限替代品时仍选择或升级到高权限工具。作者引入ToolPrivBench基准，覆盖8个领域和5种风险模式，发现主流LLM代理普遍存在此行为，且临时工具失败会加剧该倾向。通用安全对齐和提示级控制缓解有限，而提出的特权感知后训练防御能显著减少不必要的高权限工具使用，同时保持通用能力。
Motivation: 现有工具选择研究关注安全无关的元数据偏好，忽视了权限敏感的选择，而LLM代理自主选择不同权限工具时存在安全隐患。
Method: 提出ToolPrivBench基准，评估代理的初始选择和失败后升级行为；设计特权感知后训练防御，教导代理偏好足够低权限工具，仅在必要时升级。
Result: 主流LLM代理中过度特权选择普遍，临时失败放大此现象；通用安全对齐无法可靠传递到最小特权选择，提示级控制缓解有限；所提防御大幅降低不必要的高权限工具使用。
Conclusion: 过度特权选择是LLM代理的安全漏洞，需专门的防御机制；文中防御有效且不影响通用能力。

papers.title: Reward as An Agent for Embodied World Models
papers.abstract_en: While RL has become a promising tool for refining world models, existing methods largely rely on conservative rollouts near the training distribution, limiting exploration, behavioral diversity, and richer dynamic discovery. In this work, we challenge this conservative paradigm. We argue that the core limitation is not exploration itself, but the lack of reliable verification strategies to support broader exploration. Without reliable verification, expanded exploration becomes highly susceptible to reward hacking, where policies exploit imperfect rewards without achieving genuine improvement. To evaluate this motivation, we instantiate our method in embodied world models, where physical plausibility, and task completion provide a rigorous testbed for scalable RL under complex dynamics. On the verification side, we introduce Reward as an Agent, an agentic reward framework that actively evaluates generated behaviors to provide robust reward signals and mitigate reward hacking under distribution shifts. On the exploration side, we introduce Dynamic-Aware Rollout Diversification through DynDiff-GRPO, which explicitly expands action-space exploration to diversify trajectories, broaden state-action coverage, and encourage richer embodied behaviors beyond conservative rollout regimes. By unifying Reward as an Agent with DynDiff-GRPO, we enable RL on a more reliable reward foundation with substantially diversified sampling, effectively mitigating reward hacking while yielding significant accuracy gains across multiple open-source world models, thereby demonstrating that broader exploration can scale successfully when grounded in robust verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的强化学习框架，通过将奖励函数代理化（Reward as an Agent）并结合动态感知的轨迹多样化生成（DynDiff-GRPO），在体现世界模型中实现更可靠的探索与验证，有效缓解奖励破解问题，提升模型精度。
Motivation: 现有基于RL的世界模型优化依赖保守的rollout策略，限制了探索和行为多样性；根本问题不是探索本身，而是缺乏可靠的验证机制来支持更广泛的探索，否则容易导致奖励破解。
Method: 提出Reward as an Agent框架，将奖励作为主动评估行为的代理，提供鲁棒的奖励信号；同时引入DynDiff-GRPO，通过显式扩展动作空间探索来多样化轨迹，拓宽状态-动作覆盖，促进更丰富的体现行为。
Result: 在多个开源世界模型上，统一两种方法后显著缓解了奖励破解，同时获得了显著的精度提升。
Conclusion: 当基于鲁棒的验证机制时，更广泛的探索可以成功扩展，该框架在复杂动力学下的体现世界模型中展示了可扩展的RL效果。

papers.title: eCREAM-MedCorpus A Large-Scale Corpus of Clinical Notes for Italian
papers.abstract_en: We present eCREAM-MedCorpus, a new and unique large-scale dataset of clinical notes produced in Emergency Departments of Italian hospitals. The corpus, in its current version, is composed of approximately 4 million clinical notes fully anonymized, covering diverse phases of patient care during the stay in the emergency department. In addition, a subset of about six thousand notes has been manually annotated by clinical experts through a structured Case Report Form (CRF) containing 132 items relevant for two patient situations in emergency departments, dyspnea and loss of consciousness. Items may assume numerical values (e.g., for blood saturation), categorical (e.g., for level of consciousness ), binary (e.g., for presence of traumas), and mixed value types. The annotation process involved multiple clinicians and underwent iterative revision to resolve ambiguities in item formulation, resulting in a richly structured (although high imbalanced) resource. The dataset aims to fill a relevant gap of data able to support both the development and the use of Large Language Models in concrete medical applications. We describe the data collection protocol, the on-site anonymisation pipeline, corpus statistics, and the annotation scheme. Finally, we propose CRF-filling as a novel structured information extraction benchmark, and provide zero-shot baseline resulting from Gemma-27B and MedGemma-27B. To the best of our knowledge, eCREAM-MedCorpus is the largest freely available dataset of clinical notes existing for the Italian language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了 eCREAM-MedCorpus，一个大规模意大利语临床笔记数据集，包含约400万条完全匿名的急诊科临床笔记，以及约6000条由临床专家根据结构化病例报告表（CRF）手动标注的子集，涵盖132个与呼吸困难和意识丧失相关的项目。该数据集旨在填补意大利语临床笔记语料库的空白，支持大语言模型在医疗领域的应用，并提出了基于CRF填充的结构化信息抽取基准，提供了Gemma-27B和MedGemma-27B的零样本基线结果。
Motivation: 现有意大利语临床笔记数据集稀缺，限制了LLM在意大利医疗场景中的应用，特别是在急诊科中的信息提取。
Method: 通过收集急诊科临床笔记，采用现场匿名化流程，并邀请多位临床专家进行多轮迭代标注，形成带有数值、类别、二元等多类型标注的CRF数据集。
Result: 构建了包含约400万条匿名笔记和6000条精细标注笔记的数据集，并为零样本CRF填充任务提供了基线结果。
Conclusion: 该数据集是目前最大的意大利语临床笔记公开数据集，有助于推动基于LLM的临床应用，但标注类别高度不平衡。

papers.title: U-TTT: Towards Generalizable PET Image Denoising via Test-Time Training
papers.abstract_en: Existing deep learning models for Positron Emission Tomography (PET) image denoising often suffer from severe performance degradation under distribution shifts, fundamentally restricting their robust clinical deployment. This lack of generalization stems from the conventional paradigm of fixed-parameter models that cannot adapt to variations in test data (e.g., dose levels or scanner types) after training. To overcome this limitation and achieve robust generalization, we introduce U-TTT, a novel U-shaped model that integrates Test-Time Training (TTT) layers to dynamically adjust model parameters during inference through self-supervision, thereby adapting to the specific characteristics of each test instance. Furthermore, to comprehensively capture the complex degradations of 3D PET data, U-TTT features a dual-domain adaptation mechanism comprising a Spatial Test-Time Training (S-TTT) layer and a Frequency Test-Time Training (F-TTT) layer. The S-TTT layer captures and corrects spatial structural degradations, while the F-TTT layer suppresses global noise spectra and restores delicate high-frequency details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that U-TTT achieves state-of-the-art PET denoising performance and exhibits superior generalization under challenging distribution shifts, including both unseen dose levels and unseen scanners. Our code will be available at https://github.com/Yaziwel/U-TTT.
papers.comment: This paper introduces the first TTT-based model for image restoration
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出U-TTT，一种基于测试时训练（TTT）的U形网络用于PET图像去噪，通过自监督方式在推理时动态调整模型参数以适应测试实例。模型包含空间TTT层（S-TTT）和频率TTT层（F-TTT），分别处理空间结构退化和全局噪声谱。实验表明在未见过的剂量水平和扫描仪类型下具有优越的泛化性能。
Motivation: 现有PET图像去噪模型在分布偏移下性能严重下降，因为固定参数模型无法适应测试数据的变化（如剂量水平或扫描仪类型），限制了鲁棒的临床部署。
Method: 提出U-TTT，集成测试时训练（TTT）层的U形网络，通过自监督在推理时调整参数。包含S-TTT层（空间结构校正）和F-TTT层（频率域降噪与细节恢复）的双域适应机制。
Result: 在多种分布偏移（未见剂量水平和扫描仪类型）下取得最先进的PET去噪性能，并展现出优越的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 测试时训练可有效提升深度学习模型在PET图像去噪中的泛化性，双域TTT设计有助于全面捕捉3D PET数据的复杂退化。

papers.title: GENERIC-FNO: Embedding Energy Conservation and Entropy Production into Fourier Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GENERIC-FNO, the first neural operator to embed the full GENERIC (metriplectic) structure of nonequilibrium thermodynamics -- reversible, energy-conserving dynamics and irreversible, entropy-producing dynamics coupled through the degeneracy conditions -- directly in function space. Existing structure-preserving neural operators enforce at most a single conservation law or reversible (Hamiltonian) structure, while thermodynamically consistent learning has been confined to finite-dimensional, graph, or particle systems. GENERIC-FNO closes this gap: it learns the energy and entropy functionals as neural operators and parameterizes the Poisson and friction operators as diagonal Fourier multipliers sandwiched between rank-one projections that enforce the degeneracy conditions exactly, by construction, with no penalty term, update projection, or residual. The degeneracy identities hold to machine precision (residuals ~10^-13) for any initialization, dimension, or resolution, so the continuous-time dynamics conserve the learned energy and produce entropy exactly; the explicit time stepping adds only a small O(dt^2) drift (per-step residual ~10^-6). We further note that the (E,S,L,M) decomposition of a given flow is not unique, and introduce a gauge-invariant dissipation diagnostic separating reversible from dissipative dynamics independently of the learned functionals. Across three operator backbones (1D/2D FNOs and DeepONet) and four PDEs spanning reversible, dissipative, and mixed regimes, GENERIC-FNO preserves its exact structural guarantees zero-shot across a 4x super-resolution range (64 to 256), recovers the ground-truth ordering of physical dissipation, and is competitive with strong unconstrained and energy-penalized baselines, outperforming them on several dissipative and mixed problems at comparable or fewer parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GENERIC-FNO，首个将非平衡热力学完整GENERIC结构（可逆能量守恒+不可逆熵产生，通过退化条件耦合）嵌入函数空间的神经算子。通过将泊松和摩擦算子参数化为对角傅里叶乘子夹在秩一投影之间，精确强制退化条件至机器精度（残差~1e-13），无需惩罚项。在1D/2D FNO和DeepONet三种算子主干及四个PDE（涵盖可逆、耗散和混合 regime）上验证，零样本超分辨率4倍（64→256），恢复真实耗散排序，与强基线竞争力相当或更优。
Motivation: 现有结构保持神经算子最多只强制单一守恒律或可逆（哈密顿）结构，而热力学一致性学习局限于有限维、图或粒子系统。本文填补了函数空间中对完整非平衡热力学结构进行嵌入的空白。
Method: 将能量和熵泛函学习为神经算子，泊松和摩擦算子参数化为对角傅里叶乘子，夹在两个秩一投影之间，通过构造精确满足退化条件（L∇E=0，L∇S=0，M∇S=0），无需惩罚项或投影更新。
Result: 退化恒等式在任意初始化、维度和分辨率下保持机器精度（残差~1e-13）；显式时间步进仅引入O(dt²)漂移（每步残差~1e-6）。在三个算子主干和四个PDE上零样本超分辨率4倍，恢复真实耗散排序，在多个耗散和混合问题上优于或媲美强无约束和能量惩罚基线。
Conclusion: GENERIC-FNO通过构造精确保持能量守恒和熵产生，但(E,S,L,M)分解不唯一，因此引入规范不变耗散诊断以独立于学习泛函分离可逆与耗散动力学。

papers.title: Gaussian Process Latent Factor Regression for Low-Data, High-Dimensional Output Problems
papers.abstract_en: In the sciences, regression tasks often require predicting high-dimensional outputs from few training examples. Multi-output Gaussian processes excel in low-data regimes but typically struggle with high-dimensional outputs. Compress-then-predict pipelines such as PCA-GP (principal component analysis plus Gaussian process regression) handle high dimensionality, but rely on bases optimized for reconstruction rather than prediction. To address this gap, we propose a model that represents each output as a linear-Gaussian decoding of a low-dimensional latent state drawn from a Gaussian process prior. By analytically marginalizing the decoder weights, we couple compression and prediction in a single objective that scales to high-dimensional outputs. We refer to this model as Gaussian process latent factor regression (GPLFR). We demonstrate GPLFR by building the first spatially resolved emulator of global climate models for rocky exoplanets.
papers.comment: 9 pages content + 23 pages appendix/references. Supporting code at https://github.com/edstevenson/GPLFR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出高斯过程潜在因子回归（GPLFR）模型，用于解决低数据、高维输出问题。该模型将每个输出表示为潜在低维状态的线性高斯解码，并通过分析边缘化解码器权重，在单一目标中耦合压缩与预测。作者通过构建首个岩石系外行星全球气候模型的空间分辨仿真器展示了GPLFR的效果。
Motivation: 科学中的回归任务常需从少量训练样本预测高维输出。多输出高斯过程在低数据场景中表现优异，但难以处理高维输出；PCA-GP等压缩-预测流水线虽能处理高维，但其基函数针对重构而非预测优化。
Method: 提出GPLFR模型，将每个输出表示为从高斯过程先验中抽取的低维潜在状态的线性高斯解码，并通过分析边缘化解码器权重，在单一目标函数中同时实现压缩与预测，可扩展至高维输出。
Result: 在岩石系外行星全球气候模型数据集上，首次构建了空间分辨仿真器，展示了GPLFR在低数据、高维输出场景中的有效性。
Conclusion: GPLFR通过耦合压缩与预测，为低数据、高维输出问题提供了一种有效方法，特别适用于科学仿真任务。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: What Type of Inference is Active Inference?
papers.abstract_en: Active inference casts decision-making as inference, with the Expected Free Energy (EFE) unifying goal-directed and information-seeking behavior. Recent work showed that EFE minimization can be written as Variational Free Energy (VFE) minimization on a generative model augmented with epistemic priors. We prove that the VFE of the augmented model can be rewritten as the VFE of the predictive model plus explicit entropy-correction terms, making the EFE contribution transparent. We then show that proper EFE-based planning requires combining these epistemic corrections with a planning correction that turns marginal inference into policy optimization, yielding a full variational characterization of EFE-based planning. This clarifies which corrections are needed for cross-entropy planning and for full EFE-based planning. The same entropy-corrected formulation leads to a detailed message-passing scheme for EFE-based planning together with simpler ablations. Experiments on three grid-world environments show that full EFE-based planning outperforms ablations that omit either the planning correction or the epistemic corrections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对active inference中期望自由能(EFE)最小化与变分自由能(VFE)最小化的关系进行了理论分析，证明EFE规划需要同时包含认知校正和规划校正，并在网格世界环境中验证了完整EFE规划优于消融模型。
Motivation: Active inference将决策视为推理，但EFE规划与标准VFE推理之间的精确关系尚未完全澄清，特别是所需的校正项。
Method: 通过数学推导，将增强生成模型的VFE重写为预测模型的VFE加上熵校正项，进而推导出EFE规划需要的认知校正和规划校正，并给出消息传递方案。
Result: 在三个网格世界环境中，完整EFE规划的性能优于省略规划校正或认知校正的消融模型。
Conclusion: 本文提供了EFE规划的完整变分刻画，澄清了交叉熵规划和完整EFE规划所需的不同校正，并提出了消息传递方案。

papers.title: GARDEN: Gravity-Aligned Reconstruction of Disentangled ENvironments from RGB images
papers.abstract_en: Converting multi-view RGB observations into simulation-ready 3D environments remains challenging because current reconstruction pipelines produce monolithic scene representations without explicit physical structure. They are typically defined up to an arbitrary global rotation and entangle rigid foreground objects with background geometry, which hinders stable physical interaction. Existing solutions often recover interactivity by replacing reconstructed objects with retrieved CAD assets, but this introduces a slow retrieval-and-replacement stage and weakens scene-specific geometric fidelity. We propose GARDEN, an RGB-only framework that reformulates reconstruction as physically-grounded scene factorization and outputs a structured hybrid scene representation. The key idea is to use gravity as a universal physical prior: we first align the reconstruction to a unified Gravity-View frame to resolve gauge ambiguity, then recover object-centric rigid meshes with accurate 6-DoF placement, and finally remove duplicate object geometry from the background through conditional 3D point classification. The resulting representation combines explicit rigid bodies with a decoupled background, enabling direct physics simulation while preserving visual realism. Experiments on both simulated and real multi-view scenes show that GARDEN improves object placement reliability, disentanglement quality, and rendering-simulation efficiency compared with retrieval-based baselines. Project page: https://sunjiahaovo.github.io/garden/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GARDEN 是一种仅依赖 RGB 图像的重建框架，将多视图观测转化为可直接用于物理仿真的结构化混合场景表示。通过引入重力作为通用物理先验，先对齐到重力-视角坐标系，再恢复物体级别的刚性网格（附 6-DoF 位姿），并利用条件 3D 点分类从背景中去除重复物体几何，最终得到包含显式刚体与分离背景的表示，提升仿真真实感与效率。
Motivation: 现有 RGB 重建管线输出单一场景表示，缺乏物理结构且存在全局旋转歧义，导致难以用于稳定物理交互；基于 CAD 检索的替代方法速度慢且牺牲几何保真度。
Method: 提出三步流程：1) 重力对齐到统一坐标系消除歧义；2) 恢复物体级刚性网格与 6-DoF 位姿；3) 通过条件 3D 点分类从背景中去除重复的物体几何，得到解耦的刚体与背景。
Result: 在模拟和真实多视图场景上，GARDEN 相比基于检索的基线方法，在物体放置可靠性、解耦质量和渲染-仿真效率上均有提升。
Conclusion: 实验表明利用重力作为物理先验进行场景因子分解，可以有效提高物理仿真直接性和几何保真度。

papers.title: It does what it says on the tin: safe synthetic data from coarsened margins
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a method of creating synthetic data (SD) that will have two important advantages for the user compared to other methods currently available. The first is transparency; unlike other methods, the person in receipt of the SD will know which of the relationships between variables in the original data will be approximately maintained in the SD. The second is a guarantee that the SD is derived from information that has already been judged to be free of disclosure risk. This is achieved by first defining and calculating the margins where relationships between variables will be maintained in the SD. Each margin will then be subject to statistical disclosure control (SDC) to the standards defined by the data custodian, e.g. top-coding and bottom-coding, combination of small categories and/or modifying small counts. Further adjustment of the curated margins is advised by coarsening all counts in the table to multiples of the disclosure limit. These adjusted margins are used to create SD by the Iterative Proportional Fitting (IPF) algorithm. The practical steps involved in creating such SD are illustrated using data from the 1901 Census of Scotland.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于统计披露控制（SDC）后的边界（margins）生成合成数据的方法，使用迭代比例拟合（IPF）算法，确保用户清楚哪些变量关系被保留，且数据来自已判定无风险的统计量。以1901年苏格兰人口普查数据为例展示流程。
Motivation: 现有合成数据方法缺乏透明性，用户不清楚哪些关系被保留，且披露风险难以保证。本文旨在提供一种同时满足透明性和安全性的合成数据生成方案。
Method: 先定义需保留的变量关系边界，对边界施加SDC（顶码底码、合并小类别、修改小计数），再将表格中所有计数粗略化为披露限制的倍数以调整边界，最后用IPF算法从调整后的边界生成合成数据。
Result: 用1901年苏格兰人口普查数据展示了完整步骤，未提供定量指标，验证了方法的可行性。
Conclusion: 该方法能保证合成数据的安全性（基于受控边界）和透明性（用户知晓保留的关系），但需根据数据特性合理设定披露控制标准。

papers.title: EVA-Net: Subject-Independent EEG Motor Decoding with Video-Derived Motor Priors
papers.abstract_en: Practical non-invasive Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) systems require EEG decoders with strong cross-subject generalization and minimal calibration. However, inter-subject variability and signal non-stationarity often entangle motor semantics with subject-specific noise, limiting subject-independent decoding. Recent multimodal approaches use text as a semantic anchor, yet text provides sparse and static supervision for inherently dynamic motor processes. To address this issue, we propose EVA-Net, a two-stage framework that uses action videos as semantic priors for subject-independent EEG motor decoding. In the first stage, EEG and video features are aligned in a shared space using cross-modal and supervised contrastive objectives to reduce subject-specific variation. In the second stage, video category prototypes and knowledge distillation transfer video-derived priors to an EEG-only classifier without adding inference overhead. Experiments on two public datasets show that EVA-Net achieves strong subject-independent decoding performance, including an 8.66% LOSO accuracy gain on EEGMMI. Ablation results further suggest that video provides a more effective semantic anchor than the text baseline considered in this work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EVA-Net，一个两阶段框架，利用动作视频作为语义先验进行独立于受试者的EEG运动解码。第一阶段通过跨模态和对比学习对齐EEG和视频特征以减少个体差异；第二阶段通过视频类别原型和知识蒸馏将视频先验传递到仅EEG的分类器。在EEGMMI等数据集上LOSO准确率提升8.66%，表明视频锚比文本更有效。
Motivation: 非侵入式BCI系统需要跨受试者泛化且少校准的解码器，但跨个体变异性限制独立解码。现有多模态方法用文本作为语义锚，但文本对动态运动过程监督稀疏静态。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用跨模态和对比损失对齐EEG与视频特征；第二阶段用视频类别原型和知识蒸馏将视频先验迁移到仅EEG分类器，不增加推理开销。
Result: 在EEGMMI数据集上LOSO准确率提升8.66%，表明视频锚优于文本基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调视频比文本提供更有效的语义锚，且框架实现强跨受试者解码性能。

papers.title: Parameter-Free and Group Conditional Online Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is critical for the deployment of machine learning predictors in real-world scenarios where the data distribution may shift over time (i.e., data may not be exchangeable). Online conformal prediction (OCP) methods address this issue at the expense of either (i) group-wise error control or (ii) learning-rate independent implementation. Group-conditional coverage is essential for fairness across different collections of data points and for providing finer UQ guarantees. Parameter-free optimization is crucial for robustness to adversarial and unknown data shifts. We propose a parameter-free algorithm for group-conditional OCP and demonstrate that it achieves the best group-conditional coverage guarantees. We evaluate our algorithm on synthetic and real-world data, demonstrating that our method not only improves the reliability of existing parameter-free OCP methods but also provides prediction intervals that are comparable in size to well-tuned group-conditional approaches. By unifying group-conditional coverage with parameter-free online algorithms, our work lays a foundation for fair and robust uncertainty quantification in shifting environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无参数（parameter-free）的在线共形预测算法，用于在数据分布随时间变化（非可交换）的场景下实现组条件覆盖（group-conditional coverage）。该算法无需调整学习率，且能够提供最坏的组条件覆盖保证。实验表明，该方法在合成和真实数据上不仅提升了现有无参数在线共形预测方法的可靠性，还生成了与精心调参的组条件方法大小相当预测区间。
Motivation: 现有在线共形预测方法要么牺牲组条件误差控制，要么依赖于学习率的调参。组条件覆盖对公平性和细粒度不确定性量化至关重要，而无参数优化对于对抗性和未知数据漂移的鲁棒性不可或缺。
Method: 提出一种无参数算法，结合组条件覆盖与无参数在线学习技术，实现无需学习率调参的组条件在线共形预测。
Result: 该方法在合成和真实数据上取得最优的组条件覆盖保证，预测区间大小与调参良好的组条件方法相当，同时提升了已有无参数方法的可靠性。
Conclusion: 本文统一了组条件覆盖和无参数在线算法，为漂移环境下的公平且鲁棒的不确定性量化奠定了基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MechVQA: Benchmarking and Enhancing Multimodal LLMs on Comprehensive Mechanical Drawing Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant achievements in general visual question answering (VQA) tasks. However, they remain brittle on mechanical engineering drawings, where high annotation density and weak domain knowledge, compounded by unreliable spatial relation reasoning under strict projection rules and geometric constraints, make decisive cues easy to miss and frequently lead to wrong answers. To bridge this gap, we introduce the first comprehensive mechanical drawing understanding dataset, MechVQA, created through a semi-automated construction and quality-control pipeline. MechVQA contains 3.3k high-density pictures with 21K question-answer pairs, spanning 10 different fine-grained tasks across three capability levels: Recognition, Reasoning, and Judging, providing a testbed to evaluate and improve MLLM understanding on real-world mechanical drawings. On top of MechVQA, we then develop the MechVL model through a multi-stage training paradigm, building a strong domain-specialized baseline. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that MechVL outperforms the strongest closed-source baseline by 7.57 percentage points on the MechVQA total score, significantly enhancing mechanical drawing understanding ability and providing a reusable foundation for deploying MLLMs in mechanical design and inspection scenarios.

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个面向机械工程图纸理解的综合性数据集MechVQA，包含3.3k张高密度图片和21k问答对，覆盖识别、推理和判断三个能力层次的10种细粒度任务。基于该数据集，作者开发了MechVL模型，通过多阶段训练在MechVQA总分上超越最强闭源基线7.57个百分点，显著提升了多模态大模型在机械图纸理解上的性能。

Result: MechVL在MechVQA总分上比最强闭源基线高7.57个百分点，显著提升了机械图纸理解能力。
Conclusion: MechVQA和MechVL为机械设计及检测场景中部署多模态大模型提供了可复用的基础。

papers.title: SuperVoxelGPT: Adaptive and Ordered 3D Tokenization for Autoregressive Shape Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive multimodal large language models (MLLMs) enable 3D generation but struggle to scale to high-resolution shapes due to inadequate 3D tokenizations. Compact set-based representations discard deterministic spatial ordering, leading to ambiguous sequence prediction, while uniform or octree-based voxel grids preserve ordering at the cost of severe redundancy and excessively long sequences. This structural trade-off limits stable and efficient autoregressive 3D generation. We present SuperVoxelGPT, a representation-first framework that resolves this tension through adaptive and deterministically ordered supervoxel tokenization. Given a prompt, we first predict a coarse geometric saliency distribution and construct a shape-adaptive supervoxel partition using saliency-guided centroidal Voronoi tessellation, allocating fine-grained cells to complex regions and larger cells to smooth regions. Conditioned on this prompt and ordered supervoxel layout, we introduce a SuperVoxelVAE and fine-tune a pretrained MLLM to autoregressively generate supervoxel tokens. Experiments using Trellis-500K data show that SuperVoxelGPT reduces token sequence length to 12.8% of uniform voxel tokenization while achieving state-of-the-art generation quality and an average 10x speedup over prior methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SuperVoxelGPT提出一种基于超体素的自适应有序3D分词方法，用于自回归形状生成。通过预测几何显著性分布并构建适应形状的超体素划分，将序列长度压缩至均匀体素分词的12.8%，同时实现生成质量和10倍加速。
Motivation: 现有3D分词方法在紧凑集表示中丢失有序性，或均匀/八叉树体素网格导致冗余和长序列，阻碍高分辨率自回归生成。
Method: 首先预测粗粒度几何显著性分布，通过显著性引导的质心Voronoi剖分构建形状自适应超体素分区；然后引入SuperVoxelVAE并微调预训练多模态大模型，以自回归方式生成有序超体素token。
Result: 在Trellis-500K数据上，token序列长度降至均匀体素分词的12.8%，生成质量达到最先进水平，平均推理速度比先前方法快10倍。
Conclusion: 自适应有序超体素分词有效解决了3D自回归生成中的序列长度与有序性矛盾。

summary_sections.method: 首先预测粗粒度几何显著性分布，通过显著性引导的质心Voronoi剖分构建形状自适应超体素分区；然后引入SuperVoxelVAE并微调预训练多模态大模型，以自回归方式生成有序超体素token。
summary_sections.result: 在Trellis-500K数据上，token序列长度降至均匀体素分词的12.8%，生成质量达到最先进水平，平均推理速度比先前方法快10倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自适应有序超体素分词有效解决了3D自回归生成中的序列长度与有序性矛盾。

papers.title: BigMac: Breaking the Pareto Frontier of Compute and Memory in Multimodal LLM Training
papers.abstract_en: Training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is challenged by both model and data heterogeneity. Existing systems redesign the training pipeline to address these challenges, but remain bound by a Pareto frontier between compute and memory efficiency, improving one only at the expense of the other. We present BigMac, a new training pipeline for multimodal LLMs. The core idea of BigMac is to elegantly nest the encoder and generator computation into the original LLM pipeline, forming a dependency-safe nested pipeline structure. With this design, BigMac reduces the activation memory complexity of the encoder and generator to O(1) while keeping the activation memory complexity of the LLM unchanged. At the same time, it achieves the same computational efficiency as the idealized setting with unlimited memory. As a result, BigMac breaks the Pareto frontier between computational efficiency and memory usage, enabling simultaneous optimization of both computation and memory in MLLM training. We evaluate BigMac on multiple MLLMs and training workloads. Experimental results show that BigMac achieves a 1.08$\times$-1.9$\times$ training speedup over baseline systems while maintaining stable memory usage as batch size increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BigMac，一种新的多模态大语言模型训练管线，通过将编码器和生成器计算嵌套到原始LLM管线中，形成依赖安全的嵌套结构，从而打破计算效率与内存使用之间的帕累托前沿。该方法将编码器和生成器的激活内存复杂度降至O(1)，同时保持LLM的激活内存复杂度不变，并达到与无限内存理想设置相同的计算效率。实验表明，BigMac在多个MLLM上实现1.08倍至1.9倍的训练加速，且内存使用不随批次大小增长。
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型训练系统受限于计算效率与内存效率之间的帕累托前沿，优化一方必然牺牲另一方，亟需一种能同时优化二者的方法。
Method: 提出BigMac训练管线，核心是依赖安全的嵌套管线结构：将编码器和生成器的计算嵌套到原始LLM管线中，使编码器和生成器的激活内存复杂度降低到O(1)，而LLM的激活内存复杂度保持不变，同时达到无限内存下的计算效率。
Result: 在多个MLLM和训练负载上，BigMac相比基线系统实现1.08倍至1.9倍的训练加速，且随着批次大小增加，内存使用保持稳定。
Conclusion: BigMac打破了多模态LLM训练中计算与内存的帕累托前沿，实现了计算和内存的同时优化。
