papers.title: LingDT-VL-OCR: Structure-Aware Document-Level Parsing with Fine-Grained Visual Reference
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose LingDT-VL-OCR, a document parsing system tailored to financial-domain documents, transforming ultra-long financial PDFs into semantically consistent, highly accurate, structured outputs with auditing-grade provenance. To address finance-specific challenges such as complex layouts, cross-page structural discontinuities, and cell-level referencing capability, LingDT-VL-OCR combines (1) a Cross-page Contents Consolidation algorithm to restore continuity across pages and a Document-level Heading Hierarchy Reconstruction (DHR) module to build a globally consistent Table of Contents (TOC) tree for structure-aware retrieval, and (2) a difficulty-adaptive curriculum learning training strategy for table parsing, together with a CellBBoxRegressor module that uses structural anchor tokens to localize table cells from decoder hidden states without external detectors. Experiments demonstrate that our model shows high performance on the Overall metric of OmniDocBench. To enable realistic evaluation in the financial vertical, we further introduce FinDocBench, a benchmark that includes six financial document categories with expert-verified annotations and evaluation metrics including Table of Contents edit-distance-based similarity (TocEDS), cross-page concatenated TEDS, and Table Cell Intersection over Union (C-IoU). We evaluate a wide range of state-of-the-art models on FinDocBench to assess their capabilities and remaining limitations on financial documents. Overall, LingDT-VL-OCR and FinDocBench provide a practical foundation for reliable downstream financial document applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LingDT-VL-OCR，一个面向金融领域的文档解析系统，能够将超长金融PDF转换为语义一致、高准确度的结构化输出，并具备可审计溯源能力。系统通过跨页内容合并算法、文档级标题层次重建模块、难度自适应课程学习策略以及CellBBoxRegressor模块，解决了复杂布局、跨页结构不连续和单元格级引用等金融特有挑战。实验在OmniDocBench和新建的FinDocBench基准上展示了高性能。
Motivation: 金融文档解析面临复杂布局、跨页结构不连续和单元格级引用等特有挑战，现有方法难以生成语义一致且高准确度的结构化输出，缺乏审计级溯源能力。
Method: 提出LingDT-VL-OCR系统，包含：(1) 跨页内容合并算法恢复连续性；(2) 文档级标题层次重建模块构建全局一致的目录树；(3) 难度自适应课程学习策略训练表格解析；(4) CellBBoxRegressor模块利用结构锚点标记从解码器隐藏状态定位表格单元格，无需外部检测器。
Result: 在OmniDocBench总体指标上表现优异；并引入FinDocBench基准，包含六类金融文档及专家验证标注，评估多种先进模型，展示了系统的有效性。
Conclusion: LingDT-VL-OCR和FinDocBench为可靠的金融文档下游应用提供了实用基础。

papers.title: Leech Lattice Vector Quantization for Efficient LLM Compression
authors: Tycho F. A. van der Ouderaa
papers.abstract_en: Scalar quantization of large language models (LLMs) is fundamentally limited by information-theoretic bounds. While vector quantization (VQ) overcomes these limits by encoding blocks of parameters jointly, practical implementations must avoid the need for expensive lookup mechanisms or other explicit codebook storage. Lattice approaches address this through highly structured and dense packing. This paper explores the Leech lattice, which, with its optimal sphere packing and kissing configurations at 24 dimensions, is the highest dimensional lattice known with such optimal properties. To make the Leech lattice usable for LLM quantization, we extend an existing search algorithm based on the extended Golay code construction, to i) support indexing, enabling conversion to and from bitstrings without materializing the codebook, ii) allow angular search over union of Leech lattice shells, iii) propose fully-parallelisable dequantization kernel. Lastly, we provide a geometric reinterpretation of combining shape--gain quantization with GPTQ-style Hessian corrections: the standard scale-correction step of shape--gain acts as a retraction onto a product of spheres, yielding a Spherical GPTQ primarily acting on directions. We find that low-angular-distortion LLVQ reduces sensitivity to Hadamard/rotation preprocessing, and enables a strong Hadamard-free PTQ in practice. LLVQ delivers state-of-the-art LLM quantization performance, outperforming recent methods such as Quip\#, QTIP, and PVQ. The results highlight the effectiveness of high-dimensional lattices for scalable, theoretically grounded model compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索使用Leech晶格（24维最优球堆积）进行LLM向量量化，提出扩展搜索算法支持索引、角度搜索和全并行去量化核，并给出形状增益量化与GPTQ Hessian校正的几何解释。LLVQ在LLM量化上优于Quip#、QTIP、PVQ等方法。
Motivation: 标量量化受信息论上限限制，向量量化需避免昂贵的查找或码本存储，晶格方法通过结构化密集堆积克服此问题。
Method: 基于扩展Golay码构造的搜索算法，支持索引（无需实例化码本）、允许Leech晶格壳联合的角度搜索、提出全并行去量化核。还给出了形状增益量化与GPTQ Hessian校正的几何解释。
Result: 摘要报告LLVQ在LLM量化上达到最先进性能，优于Quip#、QTIP、PVQ等方法，且低角度失真降低了对Hadamard/旋转预处理的敏感性。
Conclusion: 强调高维晶格在可扩展、理论有据的模型压缩中的有效性。

papers.title: Improving TabPFN's Synthetic Data Generation by Integrating Causal Structure
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic tabular data generation addresses data scarcity and privacy constraints in a variety of domains. Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Network (TabPFN), a recent foundation model for tabular data, has been shown capable of generating high-quality synthetic tabular data. However, TabPFN is autoregressive: features are generated sequentially by conditioning on the previous ones, depending on the order in which they appear in the input data. We demonstrate that when the feature order conflicts with causal structure, the model produces spurious correlations that impair its ability to generate synthetic data and preserve causal effects. We address this limitation by integrating causal structure into TabPFN's generation process through two complementary approaches: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-aware conditioning, which samples each variable given its causal parents, and a partially directed acyclic graph (PDAG)-based strategy for scenarios with partial causal knowledge. We evaluate these approaches on controlled benchmarks and six CSuite datasets, assessing structural fidelity, distributional quality, and Average Treatment Effect (ATE) preservation. Across most settings, DAG-aware conditioning improves the quality and stability of synthetic data relative to vanilla TabPFN. Under partial causal knowledge, the oracle partially directed acyclic graph (oracle-PDAG), which orients only the edges into the colliders, shows moderate gains, while the benefit of a Completed Partially Directed Acyclic Graph (CPDAG) discovered from data depends on how well the causal structure is recovered. These results indicate that reliable causal structure, even partial, can be injected into TabPFN at inference time, without parameter updates, to improve synthetic data quality.
papers.comment: Accepted at UAI 2026. 9 pages main text, 44 pages total (including supplementary material), 35 figures. Code: https://github.com/DavideTugnoli/tabpfn-causal-synthetic
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现TabPFN在生成合成表格数据时，由于自回归生成顺序与因果结构冲突，会产生虚假相关性，损害数据质量和因果效应保留。作者提出两种因果结构整合方法：DAG-aware conditioning（根据因果父代采样）和基于PDAG的部分因果知识策略。在受控基准和六个CSuite数据集上的评估表明，DAG-aware conditioning能提升合成数据的质量和稳定性，而部分因果知识下的PDAG策略只在因果结构恢复良好时才有适度收益。
Motivation: TabPFN作为表格数据基础模型能够生成高质量合成数据，但其自回归生成过程完全依赖特征顺序，当该顺序与真实因果结构不一致时，会引入虚假相关，削弱合成数据的实用性和因果效应保真度。
Method: 提出两种融合因果结构的生成方法：1）DAG-aware conditioning：按照真实DAG的因果顺序，每个变量以其因果父代为条件进行采样；2）基于PDAG的策略：在仅知道部分因果结构（如限制性PDAG或从数据中学习的CPDAG）时，利用该部分知识引导生成顺序。
Result: 在受控基准和CSuite数据集上，DAG-aware conditioning相比原始TabPFN在结构保真度、分布质量和平均处理效应（ATE）保留上均有提升；oracle-PDAG（仅确定碰撞节点方向）带来中等增益，而数据驱动的CPDAG的效果取决于因果结构恢复的准确性。
Conclusion: 可靠的因果结构（即使是部分知识）可以在不更新参数的情况下，在推理时注入TabPFN，有效改善合成数据质量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: UniField: A Unified Field-Aware MRI Enhancement Framework
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) field-strength enhancement holds immense value for both clinical diagnostics and advanced research. However, existing methods typically focus on isolated enhancement tasks, such as specific 64mT-to-3T or 3T-to-7T transitions using limited subject cohorts, thereby failing to exploit the shared degradation patterns inherent across different field strengths and severely restricting model generalization. To address this challenge, we propose \methodname, a unified framework integrating multiple modalities and enhancement tasks to mutually promote representation learning by exploiting these shared degradation characteristics. Specifically, our main contributions are threefold. Firstly, to overcome MRI data scarcity and capture continuous anatomical structures, \methodname departs from conventional methods that treat 3D MRI volumes as independent 2D slices. Instead, we directly exploit comprehensive 3D volumetric information by leveraging pre-trained 3D foundation models, thereby embedding generalized and robust structural representations to significantly boost enhancement performance. In addition, to mitigate the spectral bias of mainstream flow-matching models that often over-smooth high-frequency details, we explicitly incorporate the physical mechanisms of magnetic fields to introduce a Field-Aware Spectral Rectification Mechanism (FASRM), tailoring customized spectral corrections to distinct field strengths. Finally, to resolve the fundamental data bottleneck, we organize and publicly release a comprehensive paired multi-field MRI dataset, which is an order of magnitude larger than existing datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate our method's superiority over state-of-the-art approaches, achieving an average improvement of approximately 1.81 dB in PSNR and 9.47% in SSIM. Codes and datasets are available at: https://github.com/linyiyang98/UniField.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniField，一个统一的多场强MRI增强框架，通过利用预训练3D基础模型、场感知频谱整流机制（FASRM）以及发布大规模配对数据集，在多种场强（如64mT/3T/7T）的MRI增强任务上取得平均PSNR提升1.81 dB、SSIM提升9.47%的结果。
Motivation: 现有MRI场强增强方法通常针对单一特定场强转换（如64mT→3T）且使用小规模数据集，未能利用不同场强间共享的退化模式，导致模型泛化能力受限。
Method: 提出UniField框架，包含三个关键贡献：使用预训练3D基础模型直接处理3D体积以捕捉连续解剖结构；引入场感知频谱整流机制（FASRM）利用磁场物理机制修正高频细节；发布一个比现有数据集大一个数量级的配对多场强MRI数据集。
Result: 在多项实验中，UniField优于现有最先进方法，平均PSNR提升约1.81 dB，SSIM提升9.47%。
Conclusion: UniField通过统一框架和共享退化模式学习，显著提升了不同场强MRI增强的性能，并开源了代码和数据集以促进后续研究。

papers.title: Volumetric Directional Diffusion: Anchoring Uncertainty Quantification in Anatomical Consensus for Ambiguous Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Ambiguous 3D medical image segmentation often involves boundaries where different expert delineations are non-identical yet clinically plausible. Modeling such inter-observer variability requires a careful balance between diversity and anatomical fidelity: deterministic models preserve coherent volumetric structures but collapse expert disagreement into a single mask, while stochastic generative models can produce diverse samples but may introduce disconnected components or slice-to-slice inconsistency when generating full 3D masks from unstructured noise. We propose Volumetric Directional Diffusion (VDD), a prior-anchored diffusion framework that shifts stochastic generation from full-mask synthesis to residual boundary exploration. VDD uses a coarse consensus prediction as an anatomical anchor and learns a directional diffusion process to generate plausible boundary variations around ambiguous regions while preserving stable volumetric topology. Experiments on three multi-rater datasets, including LIDC-IDRI, KiTS21, and ISBI 2015, show that VDD improves uncertainty distribution alignment while maintaining competitive segmentation accuracy and 3D structural consistency. These results suggest that prior-anchored residual diffusion can model clinically plausible expert disagreement without sacrificing anatomical fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出体素方向扩散（Volumetric Directional Diffusion, VDD），一种先验锚定的扩散框架，用于解决模糊医学图像分割中专家标注不一致的问题。VDD 将随机生成从全掩码合成转向残差边界探索，使用粗共识预测作为解剖锚点，在保持稳定体积拓扑的同时生成边界变化。在 LIDC-IDRI、KiTS21 和 ISBI 2015 三个多标注者数据集上，VDD 改善了不确定性分布对齐，同时保持竞争性分割精度和3D结构一致性。
Motivation: 现有确定性模型将专家分歧压缩为单一掩码，而随机生成模型可能产生不连续或切片不一致的结果。需要一种既能保持解剖结构一致性又能建模专家分歧的方法。
Method: 提出 VDD，使用粗共识预测作为解剖锚点，学习一个方向扩散过程，在模糊区域生成合理的边界变化，同时保持稳定的体积拓扑。
Result: 在 LIDC-IDRI、KiTS21 和 ISBI 2015 三个多标注者数据集上，VDD 改善了不确定性分布对齐，同时保持竞争性分割精度和3D结构一致性。
Conclusion: 先验锚定的残差扩散可以在不牺牲解剖保真度的情况下建模临床合理的专家分歧。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 VDD，使用粗共识预测作为解剖锚点，学习一个方向扩散过程，在模糊区域生成合理的边界变化，同时保持稳定的体积拓扑。
summary_sections.result: 在 LIDC-IDRI、KiTS21 和 ISBI 2015 三个多标注者数据集上，VDD 改善了不确定性分布对齐，同时保持竞争性分割精度和3D结构一致性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 先验锚定的残差扩散可以在不牺牲解剖保真度的情况下建模临床合理的专家分歧。

papers.title: Quantifying Frontier LLM Capabilities for Container Sandbox Escape
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as autonomous agents, using tools to execute code, read and write files, and access networks, creating novel security risks. To mitigate these risks, agents are commonly deployed and evaluated in isolated "sandbox" environments, often implemented using Docker/OCI containers. We introduce SANDBOXESCAPEBENCH, an open benchmark that safely measures an LLM's capacity to break out of these sandboxes. The benchmark is implemented as an Inspect AI Capture the Flag (CTF) evaluation utilising a nested sandbox architecture with the outer layer containing the flag and no known vulnerabilities. Following a threat model of a motivated adversarial agent with shell access inside a container, SANDBOXESCAPEBENCH covers a spectrum of sandboxescape mechanisms spanning misconfiguration, privilege allocation mistakes, kernel flaws, and runtime/orchestration weaknesses. We find that, when vulnerabilities are added, LLMs are able to identify and exploit them, showing that use of evaluation like SANDBOXESCAPEBENCH is needed to ensure sandboxing continues to provide the encapsulation needed for highly-capable models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SANDBOXESCAPEBENCH，一个用于衡量大语言模型（LLM）突破容器沙箱能力的开放基准。该基准采用嵌套沙箱架构和安全评估框架，涵盖配置错误、权限分配错误、内核缺陷及运行时/编排弱点等多种逃逸机制。实验表明，当存在漏洞时，LLM能够识别并利用它们进行逃逸。
Motivation: 随着LLM作为自主代理执行代码、读写文件和访问网络，安全风险增加。当前部署常依赖隔离沙箱（如Docker容器），但缺乏系统性评估LLM逃逸能力的基准。
Method: 基于Inspect AI的CTF评估框架，设计嵌套沙箱架构，外层包含无已知漏洞的标志位。基准覆盖多种沙箱逃逸机制，包括配置错误、权限分配错误、内核缺陷及运行时/编排弱点。
Result: LLM能够在存在漏洞时成功识别并利用它们进行逃逸，表明需要此类评估来确保沙箱对高能力模型的有效封装。
Conclusion: 该基准提供了一种安全测量LLM沙箱逃逸能力的方法，强调了持续评估对于维持沙箱安全性的必要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PoseVLA: Universal Pose Pretraining for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often suffer from feature collapse and low training efficiency because they entangle high-level perception with sparse, embodiment-specific action supervision. Since these models typically rely on VLM backbones optimized for Visual Question Answering (VQA), they excel at semantic identification but often overlook subtle 3D state variations that dictate distinct action patterns. To resolve these misalignments, we propose Pose-VLA, a decoupled paradigm that separates VLA training into a pre-training phase for extracting universal 3D spatial priors in a unified camera-centric space, and a post-training phase for efficient embodiment alignment within robot-specific action space. By introducing discrete pose tokens as a universal representation, Pose-VLA seamlessly integrates spatial grounding from diverse 3D datasets with geometry-level trajectories from robotic demonstrations. Our framework follows a two-stage pre-training pipeline, establishing fundamental spatial grounding via poses followed by motion alignment through trajectory supervision. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Pose-VLA achieves state-of-the-art results on RoboTwin 2.0 with a 79.5% average success rate and competitive performance on LIBERO at 96.0%. Real-world experiments further showcase robust generalization across diverse objects using only 100 demonstrations per task, validating the efficiency of our pre-training paradigm.
papers.comment: Accepted to Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2026. Project website: https://hetolin.github.io/PoseVLA
papers.journal_ref: Robotics: Science and Systems, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PoseVLA，一种将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型训练解耦为两阶段的框架：先通过离散姿态令牌（pose tokens）在统一相机中心空间预训练通用3D空间先验，再在机器人特定动作空间进行后训练以适应具体本体。该方法在RoboTwin 2.0上达到79.5%平均成功率，在LIBERO上达到96.0%，并展示了仅需100条演示即可泛化到不同物体的能力。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型因将高层感知与稀疏动作监督纠缠在一起，导致特征坍塌和训练效率低下；且依赖为VQA优化的VLM骨干，善于语义识别却忽视影响动作决策的细微3D状态变化。
Method: 提出解耦范式：预训练阶段利用离散姿态令牌从多样化3D数据集提取通用空间先验（姿态学习），再通过轨迹监督进行运动对齐；后训练阶段在机器人特定动作空间进行高效本体对齐。
Result: 在RoboTwin 2.0上平均成功率为79.5%，在LIBERO上为96.0%；真实世界实验表明每任务仅需100条演示即可泛化到不同物体。
Conclusion: 该方法通过预训练-后训练解耦有效缓解了VLA模型中的特征崩溃和训练效率问题，验证了通用空间先验在机器人策略学习中的重要性。

papers.title: Universal Algorithm-Implicit Learning
papers.abstract_en: Current meta-learning methods are constrained to narrow task distributions with fixed feature and label spaces, limiting applicability. Moreover, the current meta-learning literature uses key terms like "universal" and "general-purpose" inconsistently and lacks precise definitions, hindering comparability. We introduce a theoretical framework for meta-learning which formally defines practical universality and introduces a distinction between algorithm-explicit and algorithm-implicit learning, providing a principled vocabulary for reasoning about universal meta-learning methods. Guided by this framework, we present TAIL, a transformer-based algorithm-implicit meta-learner that functions across tasks with varying domains, modalities, and label configurations. TAIL features three innovations over prior transformer-based meta-learners: random projections for cross-modal feature encoding, random injection label embeddings that extrapolate to larger label spaces, and efficient inline query processing. TAIL achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard few-shot benchmarks while generalizing to unseen domains. Unlike other meta-learning methods, it also generalizes to unseen modalities, solving text classification tasks despite training exclusively on images, handles tasks with up to 20$\times$ more classes than seen during training, and provides orders-of-magnitude computational savings over prior transformer-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个元学习的理论框架，精确定义了实用普适性（practical universality），并区分了算法显式学习（algorithm-explicit）与算法隐式学习（algorithm-implicit）。基于该框架，作者提出TAIL，一种基于Transformer的算法隐式元学习器，通过随机投影编码跨模态特征、随机注入标签嵌入以泛化到更大标签空间、以及高效内联查询处理。TAIL在标准小样本基准上达到最先进性能，且能泛化到未见过的模态（如图像到文本）和20倍于训练时的类别数，同时相比先前基于Transformer的方法节省数量级的计算量。
Motivation: 现有元学习方法受限于固定的特征和标签空间，且领域内对“通用”等术语缺乏统一定义，阻碍了不同方法的比较。
Method: 提出TAIL：利用随机投影实现跨模态特征编码，通过随机注入标签嵌入外推到更大标签空间，并采用高效内联查询处理。
Result: TAIL在标准小样本基准上达到最先进性能，能泛化到未见过的模态（如从图像训练迁移到文本分类），处理训练时未见过的20倍类别数，且计算成本相比先前基于Transformer的方法降低数个数量级。
Conclusion: 该框架和TAIL为通用元学习提供了统一词汇和有效方法，展示了在跨领域、跨模态及大标签空间设置下的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LaViDa-R1: Advancing Reasoning for Unified Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) recently emerged as a promising alternative to auto-regressive LLMs. The latest works further extended it to multimodal understanding and generation tasks. In this work, we propose LaViDa-R1, a multimodal, general-purpose reasoning dLLM. Unlike existing works that build reasoning dLLMs through task-specific reinforcement learning, LaViDa-R1 incorporates diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks in a unified manner. In particular, LaViDa-R1 is built with a novel unified post-training framework that seamlessly integrates supervised finetuning (SFT) and multi-task reinforcement learning (RL). It employs several novel training techniques, including answer-forcing, tree search, and complementary likelihood estimation, to enhance effectiveness and scalability. Extensive experiments demonstrate LaViDa-R1's strong performance on a wide range of multimodal tasks, including visual math reasoning, reason-intensive grounding, and image editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LaViDa-R1，一个统一的多模态推理扩散语言模型。它通过结合监督微调（SFT）和多任务强化学习（RL）的后训练框架，并采用answer-forcing、tree search和互补似然估计等训练技术，在视觉数学推理、推理密集型grounding和图像编辑等任务上取得强性能。
Motivation: 现有扩散语言模型在多模态理解和生成任务上缺乏统一的推理能力，且往往通过任务特定的强化学习构建，推广性不足。
Method: 提出统一的后训练框架，集成SFT和多任务RL，并引入answer-forcing、tree search和互补似然估计等技术以增强效果和可扩展性。
Result: 在视觉数学推理、推理密集型grounding和图像编辑等多种多模态任务上展示出强劲性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: LaViDa-R1验证了统一多模态推理扩散语言模型的有效性，但摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: Estimation of instrument and noise parameters for inverse problem based on prior diffusion model
papers.abstract_en: This article addresses the issue of estimating observation parameters (response and error parameters) in inverse problems. The focus is on cases where regularization is introduced in a Bayesian framework and the prior is modeled by a diffusion process. In this context, the issue of posterior sampling is known to be thorny, and a recent paper proposes a notably simple and effective solution. Additionally, it opens an remarkable flexibility when it comes to estimating observation parameters. The proposed strategy enables to define an optimal estimator for both observation parameters and image of interest. Furthermore, the strategy provides a means for uncertainty quantification. In addition, MCMC algorithms allow for the computation of estimates and properties of posteriors, while offering some guarantees. The paper presents several numerical experiments that clearly confirm the computational efficiency and the quality of both estimates and uncertainty quantification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对逆问题中观测参数（响应和误差参数）的估计问题，提出基于扩散过程先验的贝叶斯方法，利用后验采样的简单有效方案，实现对观测参数和感兴趣图像的联合最优估计，并提供不确定性量化。数值实验验证了计算效率、估计质量和不确定性量化的有效性。
Motivation: 逆问题中观测参数估计困难，尤其在贝叶斯框架下先验由扩散过程建模时，后验采样棘手。现有方法缺乏简单有效的解决方案，且难以同时估计观测参数和图像并量化不确定性。
Method: 在贝叶斯框架下，将先验建模为扩散过程，利用近期提出的简单后验采样方法，定义观测参数和图像的联合最优估计器，并通过MCMC算法计算后验估计和性质，提供不确定性量化。
Result: 数值实验确认了方法的计算效率，以及估计和不确定性量化的高质量。
Conclusion: 该方法为扩散过程先验下的逆问题观测参数估计提供了灵活有效的策略，兼具估计与不确定性量化能力。

papers.title: A Gibbs posterior sampler for inverse problem based on prior diffusion model
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the issue of inversion in cases where (1) the observation system is modeled by a linear transformation and additive error, (2) the problem is ill-posed and regularization relies on a Bayesian strategy, (3)~the prior is modeled by a diffusion process adjusted on an available large set of examples. In this context, it is known that the issue of posterior sampling is a thorny one and the paper introduces a Gibbs algorithm. It appears that this avenue has not been explored, and we show that it is particularly effective and remarkably simple. In addition, it provides clear elements regarding convergence guarantees in a specific case and arguments supporting such guarantees in practical cases. The results are clearly confirmed by numerical simulations based on a toy example.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对线性观测加噪声的不适定反问题，采用扩散模型作为先验的贝叶斯策略，提出一种吉布斯采样器进行后验采样。该方法简单有效，并在特定情况下提供收敛保证，通过玩具例子验证。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散先验的反问题后验采样方法复杂或缺乏理论保证，本文旨在提出一种简单且可证明收敛的吉布斯采样算法。
Method: 提出一个吉布斯算法，交替采样隐变量和参数，利用扩散先验的前向过程的马尔可夫性质设计条件分布。
Result: 通过玩具例子的数值模拟表明所提后验采样器的有效性，并提供了理论上的收敛保证。

papers.title: FGAA-FPN: Foreground-Guided Angle-Aware Feature Pyramid Network for Oriented Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: With the increasing availability of high-resolution remote sensing and aerial imagery, oriented object detection has become a key capability for geographic information updating, maritime surveillance, and disaster response. However, it remains challenging due to cluttered backgrounds, severe scale variation, and large orientation changes. Existing approaches largely improve performance through multi-scale feature fusion with feature pyramid networks or contextual modeling with attention, but they often lack explicit foreground modeling and do not leverage geometric orientation priors, which limits feature discriminability. To overcome these limitations, we propose FGAA-FPN, a Foreground-Guided Angle-Aware Feature Pyramid Network for oriented object detection. FGAA-FPN is built on a hierarchical functional decomposition that accounts for the distinct spatial resolution and semantic abstraction across pyramid levels, thereby strengthening multi-scale representations. Concretely, a Foreground-Guided Feature Modulation module learns foreground saliency under weak supervision to enhance object regions and suppress background interference in low-level features. In parallel, an Angle-Aware Multi-Head Attention module encodes relative orientation relationships to guide global interactions among high-level semantic features. Extensive experiments on DOTA v1.0 and DOTA v1.5 demonstrate that FGAA-FPN achieves state-of-the-art results, reaching 75.5% and 68.3% mAP, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FGAA-FPN，一种用于定向目标检测的前景引导角度感知特征金字塔网络。通过前景引导特征调制模块和角度感知多头注意力模块，分别增强低层特征的物体区域并抑制背景干扰，以及编码高层语义特征间的相对方向关系。在DOTA v1.0和DOTA v1.5上分别达到75.5%和68.3% mAP，取得最新最优结果。

Method: 提出FGAA-FPN，包含两个核心模块：前景引导特征调制模块（Foreground-Guided Feature Modulation）在弱监督下学习前景显著性以增强目标区域并抑制背景干扰；角度感知多头注意力模块（Angle-Aware Multi-Head Attention）编码相对方向关系以引导高层语义特征的全局交互。

Conclusion: 作者认为显式前景引导和角度感知机制有效提升了定向目标检测的性能，尤其适用于复杂遥感场景。

papers.title: Conformal Prediction Sets for Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Current instance segmentation models achieve high performance on average predictions, but lack principled uncertainty quantification: their outputs are not calibrated, and there is no guarantee that a predicted mask is close to the ground truth. To address this limitation, we introduce a conformal prediction algorithm to generate adaptive confidence sets for instance segmentation. Given an image and a pixel coordinate query, our algorithm generates a confidence set of instance predictions for that pixel, with a provable guarantee for the probability that at least one of the predictions has high Intersection-Over-Union (IoU) with the true object instance mask. We apply our algorithm to instance segmentation examples in agricultural field delineation, cell segmentation, and vehicle detection. Empirically, we find that our prediction sets vary in size based on query difficulty and attain the target coverage, outperforming baselines (naive best parameter and morphological dilation-based methods). We provide versions of the algorithm with asymptotic and finite sample guarantees. Our work is the first to capture structural uncertainty in instance segmentation by constructing confidence sets of diverse segmentation predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于实例分割的自适应置信集构建算法，基于保形预测（conformal prediction）为每个像素提供一组实例预测，保证这些预测中至少一个与真实掩膜的IoU超过阈值。在农业田块分割、细胞分割和车辆检测任务上验证了覆盖率和集大小适应性，优于简单阈值和形态学膨胀基线。这是首个通过构建多样化分割预测集来捕获实例分割结构不确定性的工作。
Motivation: 现有实例分割模型给出点估计，缺乏校准和不确定性量化，无法保证预测掩膜接近真实值。
Method: 提出保形预测算法，对图像中每个像素查询生成一组实例预测，并给出该组中至少一个预测与真实掩膜IoU高的概率保证。提供渐近和有限样本两种版本。
Result: 在农业田块、细胞和车辆分割任务上，预测集大小随查询难度自适应变化，且达到目标覆盖，优于朴素最佳参数和形态学膨胀基线。
Conclusion: 保形预测可有效为实例分割提供有理论保证的不确定性量化，是首个构造多样性分割置信集的工作。

papers.title: BitLogic: Training Framework for Gradient-Based FPGA-Native Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Gradient-based LUT- and logic-gate-based neural networks (LUTNet, LogicNets, DiffLogic, PolyLUT, NeuraLUT, WARP-LUT, DWN, LILogicNet, LightLUT) replace multiply-accumulate arithmetic with Boolean lookups. The same trained checkpoint deploys to GPU as bitwise ops on bit-packed activations, to FPGA as LUT primitives, and to ASIC as standard-cell gates, all from one code path. Yet each method ships its own training pipeline, encoder, connectivity rule, fan-in, and hardware-reporting convention. The natural practitioner question, which of these choices actually matter for accuracy and which for hardware cost, therefore has no answer in the current literature. We release \textbf{BitLogic}, a unified framework that factors the field into a five-axis design space (encoder, connectivity, fan-in, node parameterization, head) and instantiates every prior method under one shared training and evaluation protocol. The framework deliberately omits method-specific procedures such as calibration, pruning, and thresholding, and all evaluations are limited to two-layer feed-forward networks. Combining the per-axis winners identifies a new best-of-space configuration that outperforms every retrained prior on every (dataset, width) cell in which every compared prior fits the shared budget, across MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100. We evaluate the best-of-space model on all three backends. On MNIST, the resulting two-layer network reaches ${\sim}126$\,MSamples/s on FPGA, ${\sim}15\times$ the throughput of a bit-packed GPU forward path that itself processes $64$ samples per $64$-bit operation, at four-to-five orders of magnitude less energy.
papers.comment: Accepted at TMLR (Transactions on Machine Learning Research)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BitLogic，一个统一训练框架，将基于LUT和逻辑门的神经网络（如LUTNet、LogicNets等）的设计空间分解为五个轴（编码器、连接性、扇入、节点参数化、输出头），并在共享协议下评估所有先前方法。实验基于两层前馈网络，在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，组合各轴最佳配置得到的模型优于所有重训练的先前方法。在MNIST上，FPGA吞吐量达约126 MSamples/s，比位打包GPU快约15倍，能耗低4-5个数量级。
Motivation: 现有基于LUT和逻辑门的神经网络各有独立的训练流程、编码器、连接性规则等，导致从业者无法区分哪些设计选择影响精度、哪些影响硬件成本。
Method: 提出BitLogic框架，将设计空间分解为五个独立轴（编码器、连接性、扇入、节点参数化、输出头），并实例化所有先前方法于统一的训练和评估协议下。框架省略校准、剪枝、阈值等方法特定步骤，所有评估限于两层前馈网络。
Result: 组合各轴最佳配置得到的模型在所有（数据集、宽度）单元上优于重训练的先前方法。在MNIST上，两层网络在FPGA上达到约126 MSamples/s，是位打包GPU的约15倍，能耗低4-5个数量级。
Conclusion: BitLogic提供了一个标准化基准，能够公平比较不同设计选择，并识别出当前设计空间中的最佳配置。局限性包括仅评估两层前馈网络、忽略方法特定步骤（如校准、剪枝）。

papers.title: Reliable Mislabel Detection for Video Capsule Endoscopy Data
papers.abstract_en: The classification performance of deep neural networks relies strongly on access to large, accurately annotated datasets. In medical imaging, however, obtaining such datasets is particularly challenging since annotations must be provided by specialized physicians, which severely limits the pool of annotators. Furthermore, class boundaries can often be ambiguous or difficult to define which further complicates machine learning-based classification. In this paper, we want to address this problem and introduce a framework for mislabel detection in medical datasets. This is validated on the two largest, publicly available datasets for Video Capsule Endoscopy, an important imaging procedure for examining the gastrointestinal tract based on a video stream of lowresolution images. In addition, potentially mislabeled samples identified by our pipeline were reviewed and re-annotated by three experienced gastroenterologists. Our results show that the proposed framework successfully detects incorrectly labeled data and results in an improved anomaly detection performance after cleaning the datasets compared to current baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC) 2026. Code on Github: https://github.com/juliawerner/vce-noise-identification

papers.title: Superman: Unifying Skeleton and Vision for Human Motion Perception and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Human motion analysis tasks, such as temporal 3D pose estimation, motion prediction, and motion in-betweening, play an essential role in computer vision. However, current paradigms suffer from severe fragmentation. First, the field is split between ``perception'' models that understand motion from video but only output text, and ``generation'' models that cannot perceive from raw visual input. Second, generative MLLMs are often limited to single-frame, static poses using dense, parametric SMPL models, failing to handle temporal motion. Third, existing motion vocabularies are built from skeleton data alone, severing the link to the visual domain. To address these challenges, we introduce Superman, a unified framework that bridges visual perception with temporal, skeleton-based motion generation. Our solution is twofold. First, to overcome the modality disconnect, we propose a Vision-Guided Motion Tokenizer. Leveraging the natural geometric alignment between 3D skeletons and visual data, this module pioneers robust joint learning from both modalities, creating a unified, cross-modal motion vocabulary. Second, grounded in this motion language, a single, unified MLLM architecture is trained to handle all tasks. This module flexibly processes diverse, temporal inputs, unifying 3D skeleton pose estimation from video (perception) with skeleton-based motion prediction and in-betweening (generation). Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks, including Human3.6M, demonstrate that our unified method achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance across all motion tasks. This showcases a more efficient and scalable path for generative motion analysis using skeletons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Superman，一个统一框架，通过视觉引导的运动分词器（Vision-Guided Motion Tokenizer）建立跨模态运动词汇，并基于此训练统一的MLLM，同时处理3D骨架姿态估计（感知）和运动预测/插值（生成）。在Human3.6M等基准上达到SOTA或竞争性能。
Motivation: 当前人体运动分析领域碎片化严重：感知模型与生成模型割裂，生成MLLM只能处理单帧静态SMPL，且运动词汇仅基于骨架数据，缺乏与视觉域的连接。
Method: 提出Superman框架：1）利用3D骨架与视觉数据的几何对齐，设计Vision-Guided Motion Tokenizer实现跨模态联合学习，构建统一运动词汇；2）基于此运动语言，训练单一MLLM架构，统一处理视频3D骨架姿态估计、运动预测和运动插值任务。
Result: 在Human3.6M等标准基准上，该方法在所有运动任务中均达到或超过现有最佳性能。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了基于骨架的统一运动分析更高效、可扩展的路径。

papers.title: StepShield: When, Not Whether to Intervene on Rogue Agents
authors: Zitha Sasindran (Indian Institute of Science Bangalore)
Milan Hussain Angati (California State University Northridge)
papers.abstract_en: Agent safety benchmarks measure whether a monitor detects harm, not when. Yet timing is the difference between intervention and autopsy. We introduce StepShield, the first benchmark that treats detection timeliness as a first-class metric. On 9,429 incident-grounded code-agent trajectories, we define the Early Intervention Rate (EIR): the fraction of detected rogue trajectories where the alert fires within a k-step window after the divergence point, isolating timing quality from coverage. This metric exposes what we call the Forensics Trap: a pattern-based guardrail with 847 rules achieves 86% recall yet is statistically indistinguishable from random timing on EIR (0.23 vs. 0.24; p = 0.66, one-sided binomial; difference within CI), because over three-quarters of its alerts trigger on benign prefix code before any violation occurs. The 4x EIR gap between rule-based and semantic detectors is completely invisible to accuracy, recall, or F1. Our finding is structural: regex guardrails detect syntax, not intent, and therefore cannot distinguish the moment an agent turns rogue, rendering the entire deployed class of pattern-based monitors unsuited for real-time oversight. No existing method simultaneously achieves high recall, low false-positive rate, and timely intervention, establishing step-level rogue detection as genuinely unsolved.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 10 ablation studies. Code and data: https://github.com/glo26/stepshield
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StepShield是一个新的代理安全基准，首次将检测及时性作为一等指标。在9429条代码代理轨迹上定义了早期干预率（EIR），揭示了模式检测器（如基于规则的防火墙）在及时性上与随机无异（EIR 0.23 vs 0.24），尽管召回率达86%。语义检测器在EIR上比规则检测器高4倍，但传统指标（准确率、召回率、F1）完全无法体现这一差距。结论认为，现有基于模式的监控器不适合实时监督，步骤级恶意检测仍是一个未解决的问题。
Motivation: 现有的代理安全基准只衡量检测器是否检测到危害，而不关心检测时机。然而，在实时监督中，检测的及时性决定了能否干预而非事后分析。
Method: 提出了StepShield基准，定义了一个新指标——早期干预率（EIR），即检测器在偏离点后k步窗口内发出警报的比例，从而将检测时机质量与覆盖率解耦。数据集包含9429条具有明确偏离点的代码代理轨迹。
Result: 一个包含847条规则的模式检测器召回率达86%，但EIR仅为0.23，与随机时机（0.24）无统计差异（p=0.66）。语义检测器的EIR是规则检测器的4倍，但传统指标（准确率、召回率、F1）无法显示这一差距。
Conclusion: 基于正则表达式的检测器检测的是语法而非意图，无法区分代理何时变坏，因此整个部署的模式型监控器不适合实时监督。目前没有任何方法能同时实现高召回、低误报和及时干预，步骤级恶意检测仍是未解决难题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Global to Granular: Revealing IQA Model Performance via Correlation Surface
papers.abstract_en: Evaluation of Image Quality Assessment (IQA) models has long been dominated by global correlation metrics, such as Pearson Linear Correlation Coefficient (PLCC) and Spearman Rank-Order Correlation Coefficient (SRCC). While widely adopted, these metrics reduce performance to a single scalar, failing to capture how ranking consistency varies across the local quality spectrum. For example, two IQA models may achieve identical SRCC values, yet one ranks high-quality images (related to high Mean Opinion Score, MOS) more reliably, while the other better discriminates image pairs with small quality/MOS differences (related to $|Δ$MOS$|$). Such complementary behaviors are invisible under global metrics. Moreover, SRCC and PLCC are sensitive to test-sample quality distributions, yielding unstable comparisons across test sets. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{Granularity-Modulated Correlation (GMC)}, which provides a structured, fine-grained analysis of IQA performance. GMC includes: (1) a \textbf{Granularity Modulator} that applies Gaussian-weighted correlations conditioned on absolute MOS values and pairwise MOS differences ($|Δ$MOS$|$) to examine local performance variations, and (2) a \textbf{Distribution Regulator} that regularizes correlations to mitigate biases from non-uniform quality distributions. The resulting \textbf{correlation surface} maps correlation values as a joint function of MOS and $|Δ$MOS$|$, providing a 3D representation of IQA performance. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that GMC reveals performance characteristics invisible to scalar metrics, offering a more informative and reliable paradigm for analyzing, comparing, and deploying IQA models. Codes are available at https://github.com/Dniaaa/GMC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图像质量评估（IQA）模型中全局相关性指标（如PLCC和SRCC）的局限性，提出粒度调制相关性（GMC），通过构建相关曲面（correlation surface）来揭示模型在局部质量范围内的性能差异。GMC包含粒度调制器和分布调节器，分别在MOS绝对值和MOS差异值上施加高斯加权相关性，并正则化非均匀质量分布带来的偏差。实验表明，GMC能揭示标量指标无法捕捉的性能特征。
Motivation: 现有IQA模型评估依赖全局相关性指标，但这些标量指标无法反映模型在局部质量区间（如高质量图像或小质量差异图像对）上的排序一致性差异，且对测试样本的质量分布敏感，导致跨数据集比较不稳定。
Method: 提出GMC方法，包含两个模块：（1）粒度调制器（Granularity Modulator），在MOS绝对值和MOS差异值（|ΔMOS|）上应用高斯加权相关性，以检测局部性能变化；（2）分布调节器（Distribution Regulator），正则化相关性以缓解非均匀质量分布的偏差。最终生成一个以MOS和|ΔMOS|为坐标的3D相关曲面。
Result: 在标准IQA基准上的实验显示，GMC能够揭示标量指标无法观察到的性能特征，提供更丰富可靠的IQA模型分析、比较与部署方式。
Conclusion: GMC提供了一个细粒度的IQA性能分析框架，弥补了全局标量指标的不足，有助于更全面地理解IQA模型在不同质量区域的行为。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: TRACE: Trajectory Recovery for Continuous Mechanism Evolution in Causal Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Temporal causal representation learning methods assume that causal mechanisms switch instantaneously between discrete domains, yet real-world systems often exhibit continuous mechanism transitions. For example, a vehicle's dynamics evolve gradually through a turning maneuver, and human gait shifts smoothly from walking to running. We formalize this setting by modeling transitional mechanisms as convex combinations of finitely many atomic mechanisms, governed by time-varying mixing coefficients. Our theoretical contributions establish that both the latent causal variables and the continuous mixing trajectory are jointly identifiable. We further propose TRACE, a Mixture-of-Experts framework where each expert learns one atomic mechanism during training, enabling recovery of mechanism trajectories at test time. This formulation generalizes to intermediate mechanism states never observed during training. Experiments on synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that TRACE recovers mixing trajectories with up to 0.99 correlation, substantially outperforming discrete-switching baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间因果表示学习中假设机制突变的问题，提出连续机制转变的形式化建模，将过渡机制建模为有限个原子机制的凸组合，并证明潜因果变量和连续混合轨迹联合可识别。提出TRACE框架，基于混合专家模型（MoE）在训练时学习每个原子机制，测试时恢复机制轨迹，泛化到未见的中间状态。实验显示轨迹恢复相关性高达0.99，显著优于离散切换基线。
Motivation: 现有时间因果表示学习方法假设因果机制在离散域间瞬时切换，但真实系统（如车辆转向、人体步态变化）常呈现连续机制过渡，现有方法无法处理。
Method: 形式化连续机制转变，建模为有限个原子机制的凸组合（时间依赖混合系数）；提出TRACE（MoE框架），每个专家学习一个原子机制，训练后可在测试时恢复机制轨迹。
Result: 在合成和真实数据上，TRACE恢复混合轨迹的相关性高达0.99，大幅优于离散切换基线。
Conclusion: 本文证明连续机制转变下潜因果变量和混合轨迹的可识别性，提出的TRACE能有效恢复未观测过的中间机制状态，为处理连续变化的环境提供了新视角。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: GraphAllocBench: A Flexible Benchmark for Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Preference-Conditioned Policy Learning (PCPL) in Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (MORL) approximates diverse Pareto-optimal solutions by conditioning a single policy on user-specified preferences, enabling run-time adaptation to arbitrary trade-offs without retraining. However, existing PCPL benchmarks are largely restricted to toy tasks and fixed environments, limiting their realism and scalability. To address this gap, we introduce GraphAllocBench, a flexible benchmark built on CityPlannerEnv, a novel graph-based resource allocation sandbox inspired by city management. GraphAllocBench provides a rich suite of problems with customizable objective functions, varying preference conditions, complex Pareto Fronts, and high-dimensional scalability. We further propose two supplementary metrics -- Proportion of Non-Dominated Solutions (PNDS) and Ordering Score (OS) -- that capture prediction reliability and preference consistency while complementing the widely used hypervolume metric. Through experiments with several state-of-the-art PCPL algorithms and our own MLP and graph-aware PCPL-PPO baseline, we show that GraphAllocBench exposes distinct failure modes that hypervolume alone does not capture but our supplementary metrics reveal, while motivating graph-based approaches such as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for scaling to complex, high-dimensional allocation tasks. By letting users freely vary objectives, preferences, and allocation rules, GraphAllocBench serves as a versatile and extensible testbed for advancing PCPL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GraphAllocBench，一个基于城市管理图资源分配沙箱 CityPlannerEnv 的灵活基准，用于偏好条件多目标策略学习（PCPL）。该基准提供可定制的目标函数、偏好条件、复杂帕累托前沿和高维可扩展性，并引入两个补充指标——非支配解比例（PNDS）和排序分数（OS），以捕捉超体积指标无法揭示的预测可靠性和偏好一致性。实验表明，现有 PCPL 算法在 GraphAllocBench 上暴露了特定失败模式，并激励了基于图神经网络（GNN）的方法。
Motivation: 现有的 PCPL 基准大多局限于玩具任务和固定环境，缺乏真实感和可扩展性，无法有效评估算法在复杂资源分配场景下的表现。
Method: 构建 GraphAllocBench，基于 CityPlannerEnv 提供丰富的资源配置问题，支持自定义目标函数和偏好条件；提出 PNDS 和 OS 两个指标，用于补充超体积指标以评估预测可靠性和偏好一致性。
Result: 实验显示，现有 SOTA PCPL 算法及 MLP/图感知 PCPL-PPO 基线在 GraphAllocBench 上表现出超体积无法捕捉的失败模式，而新指标能有效揭示；同时，图感知方法（如 GNN）在高维复杂分配任务中更具优势。
Conclusion: GraphAllocBench 作为一个灵活且可扩展的测试平台，能够促进 PCPL 领域的发展，尤其适用于需要复杂帕累托前沿和可扩展性的资源分配问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Agentic AI for Commercial Insurance Underwriting with Adversarial Self-Critique
papers.abstract_en: Commercial insurance underwriting is a labor-intensive process that requires manual review of extensive documentation to assess risk and determine policy pricing. While AI offers substantial efficiency improvements, existing solutions lack comprehensive reasoning and internal mechanisms to ensure reliability in regulated, high-stakes environments. Full automation remains impractical and inadvisable when human judgment and accountability are critical. This study presents a decision-negative, human-in-the-loop agentic system that incorporates an adversarial self-critique mechanism as a bounded safety architecture for regulated underwriting workflows. In this system, a critic agent challenges the primary agent's conclusions prior to submitting recommendations to human reviewers. This internal system of checks and balances addresses a critical gap in AI safety for regulated workflows. Additionally, the research develops a formal taxonomy of failure modes to characterize potential errors by decision-negative agents. This taxonomy provides a structured framework for risk identification and management in high-stakes applications. Experimental evaluation using 500 expert-validated underwriting cases demonstrates that the adversarial critique mechanism reduces AI hallucination rates from 11.3% to 3.8% and increases decision accuracy from 92% to 96%. At the same time, the framework enforces strict human authority over all binding decisions by design. These findings indicate that adversarial self-critique supports safer AI deployment in regulated domains and offers a model for responsible integration where human oversight is indispensable.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文提出一种用于商业保险承保的、带对抗自批判机制的决策负向人机协同AI系统。系统包含一个批评者智能体挑战主智能体的结论，以减少幻觉并提高决策准确性。在500个专家验证案例上，幻觉率从11.3%降至3.8%，准确率从92%升至96%。
Motivation: 商业保险承保过程劳动密集，现有AI缺乏可靠推理和安全机制，难以在监管要求严格的高风险环境中完全自动化。需要一种保证人类最终决策权的同时提升AI辅助安全性的方法。
Method: 提出决策负向（decision-negative）人机协同框架，包含主智能体和一个对抗性自我批评者（critic agent）。批评者智能体在提交给人类审核者之前挑战主智能体的结论，形成内部制衡。同时构建了一个形式化的故障模式分类法。
Result: 在500个专家验证案例上，对抗性自我批评机制将AI幻觉率从11.3%降至3.8%，决策准确率从92%提升至96%。
Conclusion: 对抗性自我批评支持在监管领域更安全地部署AI，并为必须保留人类监督的场景提供了负责任的集成模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Task Instruction Tuning via Data Scheduling for Low-Resource Arabic SpeechLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Audio large language models (LLMs) enable unified speech understanding and generation, but adapting them to linguistically complex and dialect-rich settings such as Arabic-English remains challenging. We present a controlled study of multi-task instruction tuning for an Arabic-centric audio LLM across generative tasks, including automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech and text summarization, as well as discriminative tasks, including dialect identification (DID) and speech emotion recognition (SER), in a resource-constrained setting. To support end-to-end Arabic speech summarization, we introduce AraMega-SSum, the first Arabic speech summarization dataset designed for training and benchmarking Arabic-centric audio LLMs. We compare four training strategies: (i) Uniform Mixing (UM), (ii) Task-Progressive Curriculum (TPC), (iii) Aligner-Based Diverse Sampling (ADS) for training-time batch construction, and (iv) a two-stage TPC->ADS strategy. Our results reveal a clear efficiency-robustness trade-off. TPC achieves the strongest performance on generative tasks, including ASR and summarization. ADS improves paralinguistic tasks but reduces generative stability when used alone. The two-stage TPC->ADS strategy provides the best overall balance, achieving the strongest DID and SER performance while outperforming large proprietary models such as Gemini-2.5-Pro on discriminative tasks. We will publicly release AraMega-SSum together with all experimental resources to support future research in Arabic speech understanding.

papers.title: BabyVision: Visual Reasoning Beyond Language
papers.abstract_en: While humans develop core visual skills long before acquiring language, contemporary Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) still rely heavily on linguistic priors to compensate for their fragile visual understanding. We uncovered a crucial fact: state-of-the-art MLLMs consistently fail on basic visual tasks that humans, even 3-year-olds, can solve effortlessly. To systematically investigate this gap, we introduce BabyVision, a benchmark designed to assess core visual abilities independent of linguistic knowledge for MLLMs. BabyVision spans a wide range of tasks, with 388 items divided into 22 subclasses across four key categories. Empirical results and human evaluation reveal that leading MLLMs perform significantly below human baselines. Gemini3-Pro-Preview scores 49.7, lagging behind 6-year-old humans and falling well behind the average adult score of 94.1. These results show despite excelling in knowledge-heavy evaluations, current MLLMs still lack fundamental visual primitives. Progress in BabyVision represents a step toward human-level visual perception and reasoning capabilities. We also explore solving visual reasoning with generation models by proposing BabyVision-Gen and automatic evaluation toolkit. Our code and benchmark data are released at https://github.com/UniPat-AI/BabyVision for reproduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BabyVision 基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在无需语言先验的基础视觉能力上的表现，涵盖 388 项任务、22 个子类。实验表明，最先进的 MLLMs（如 Gemini3-Pro-Preview 得分 49.7）远低于 6 岁人类（94.1 分），揭示出当前模型在视觉推理上的根本缺陷。
Motivation: 人类在掌握语言前已具备核心视觉能力，而当代 MLLMs 仍依赖语言先验弥补脆弱的视觉理解，导致它们在 3 岁儿童都能轻松解决的基本视觉任务上系统性失败。
Method: 构建 BabyVision 基准，包含 388 个测试项，分为 4 大类 22 子类，覆盖基础视觉推理任务。同时提出 BabyVision-Gen 生成模型和自动化评估工具包，用于探索视觉推理的生成式方法。
Result: Gemini3-Pro-Preview 得分 49.7，显著低于 6 岁人类（94.1）和成人平均（94.1），表明当前 MLLMs 缺乏基础视觉原语（visual primitives）。
Conclusion: 尽管 MLLMs 在知识密集型评估中表现优异，但基础视觉感知与推理能力仍远落后于人类；BabyVision 可作为迈向人类级别视觉智能的关键步骤。

papers.title: FlexAct: Why Learn when you can Pick?
papers.abstract_en: Learning activation functions has emerged as a promising direction in deep learning, allowing networks to adapt activation mechanisms to task-specific demands. In this work, we introduce a novel framework that employs the Gumbel-Softmax trick to enable discrete yet differentiable selection among a predefined set of activation functions during training. Our method dynamically learns the optimal activation function independently of the input, thereby enhancing both predictive accuracy and architectural flexibility. Experiments on synthetic datasets show that our model consistently selects the most suitable activation function, underscoring its effectiveness. These results connect theoretical advances with practical utility, paving the way for more adaptive and modular neural architectures in complex learning scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlexAct框架，利用Gumbel-Softmax技巧在训练过程中从预定义的激活函数集合中进行离散且可微的选择。该方法独立于输入动态学习最优激活函数，提高了预测精度和架构灵活性。在合成数据集上的实验表明，模型能够一致地选择最合适的激活函数。
Method: 使用Gumbel-Softmax技巧实现离散且可微的激活函数选择，在训练过程中学习每个神经元或层的最优激活函数。
Result: 在合成数据集上，模型能够一致地选择最合适的激活函数，验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法连接了理论进展与实际应用，为构建更自适应和模块化的神经架构铺平了道路。

papers.title: RL-AWB: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Auto White Balance Correction in Low-Light Night-time Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Nighttime color constancy still remains a challenging problem in computational photography due to low-light noise and complex illumination conditions. We present RL-AWB, a novel framework combining statistical methods with deep reinforcement learning for nighttime white balance. Our method begins with a statistical algorithm tailored for nighttime scenes, integrating salient gray pixel detection with novel illuminant estimation. Building on this foundation, we develop the first deep reinforcement learning approach for color constancy that leverages the statistical algorithm as its core, mimicking professional AWB tuning experts by dynamically determining image-specific parameters at inference time, without requiring ground-truth illuminants or reference images. To further facilitate cross-sensor evaluation, we introduce the first multi-sensor nighttime dataset. Experiment results demonstrate that our method achieves strong generalization capability across low-light and well-illuminated images. Project page: https://ntuneillee.github.io/research/rl-awb/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RL-AWB，结合统计方法与深度强化学习进行夜间白平衡校正。方法首先使用针对夜间场景的统计算法（包括显著灰色像素检测和新颖光源估计），然后首次将深度强化学习用于颜色恒常性，以统计算法为核心，在推理时动态确定图像特定参数。还引入了首个多传感器夜间数据集。实验表明方法在低光和良好光照图像上具有强泛化能力。
Motivation: 夜间颜色恒常性由于低光噪声和复杂光照条件仍然是计算摄影中的难题。
Method: 提出RL-AWB框架，结合统计方法与深度强化学习。先使用统计算法检测显著灰色像素并估计光源，然后深度强化学习模仿专业AWB调优专家，动态确定推理时的图像特定参数，无需真实光源或参考图像。
Result: 实验表明方法在低光和良好光照图像上具有强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了方法的泛化能力和首次应用深度强化学习于颜色恒常性，以及引入了多传感器夜间数据集。

papers.title: MorphGS: Morphology-Adaptive Articulated 3D Motion Transfer from Videos
papers.abstract_en: Transferring articulated motion from monocular videos to rigged 3D characters is challenging due to pose ambiguity in 2D observations and morphological differences between source and target. Existing approaches often follow a reconstruct-then-retarget paradigm, tying transfer quality to intermediate 3D reconstruction and limiting applicability to categories with parametric templates. We propose MorphGS, a framework that formulates motion retargeting as a target-driven analysis-by-synthesis problem, directly optimizing target morphology and pose through image-space supervision. A rig-coupled morphology parameterization factorizes character identity from time-varying joint rotations, while dense 2D-3D correspondences and synthesized views provide complementary structural and multi-view guidance. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and real-world videos show consistent improvements over baselines. Project page: https://xodus777.github.io/MorphGS/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MorphGS 框架，将单目视频中的关节运动直接迁移到已绑定骨骼的 3D 角色上，通过目标驱动的分析合成方法，在图像空间监督下同时优化目标形态和姿态，避免了传统重建-重定向范式中对中间 3D 重建的依赖。
Motivation: 现有方法通常先重建 3D 再重定向，受限于中间重建质量和参数化模板，难以处理形态差异大的源目标对。
Method: 提出一种刚体耦合的形态参数化，将角色身份与时变关节旋转分离；利用密集 2D-3D 对应和合成视图提供结构和多视角监督，直接优化目标形态和姿态。
Result: 在合成基准和真实视频上均取得一致改进。
Conclusion: MorphGS 通过目标驱动的分析合成有效解决了形态差异下的运动迁移问题，但摘要未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SGD-Based Knowledge Distillation with Bayesian Teachers: Theory and Guidelines
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Distillation (KD) is a central paradigm for transferring knowledge from a large teacher network to a typically smaller student model, often by leveraging soft probabilistic outputs. While KD has shown strong empirical success in numerous applications, its theoretical underpinnings remain only partially understood. In this work, we adopt a Bayesian perspective on KD to rigorously analyze the convergence behavior of students trained with Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD). We study two regimes: $(i)$ when the teacher provides the exact Bayes Class Probabilities (BCPs); and $(ii)$ supervision with noisy approximations of the BCPs. Our analysis shows that learning from BCPs yields variance reduction and removes neighborhood terms in the convergence bounds compared to one-hot supervision. We further characterize how the level of noise affects generalization and accuracy. Motivated by these insights, we advocate the use of Bayesian deep learning models, which typically provide improved estimates of the BCPs, as teachers in KD. Consistent with our analysis, we experimentally demonstrate that students distilled from Bayesian teachers not only achieve higher accuracies (up to +4.27%), but also exhibit more stable convergence (up to 30% less noise), compared to students distilled from deterministic teachers.
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从贝叶斯视角严格分析了知识蒸馏（KD）中学生模型在随机梯度下降（SGD）下的收敛行为。研究表明，当教师提供精确的贝叶斯类概率（BCPs）时，相比独热监督，能减少方差并消除收敛界中的邻域项；当BCP存在噪声时，噪声水平影响泛化与精度。基于理论指导，作者提倡使用贝叶斯深度学习模型作为教师，实验表明贝叶斯教师蒸馏的学生精度提升高达4.27%，且收敛噪声降低30%。
Motivation: 知识蒸馏在应用中表现优异，但其理论理解尚不完整，尤其是教师输出概率的性质如何影响学生训练的收敛行为。
Method: 采用贝叶斯视角分析KD，研究两种场景：教师提供精确BCPs与噪声近似BCPs，推导SGD训练下的收敛界，并基于理论建议使用贝叶斯神经网络作为教师。
Result: 学生从贝叶斯教师蒸馏相比确定性教师，精度提升最多4.27%，收敛噪声降低最多30%。
Conclusion: 理论分析说明BCP监督能改善收敛，实际应优先选用提供更好BCP估计的贝叶斯教师。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: OpenGround: Planning-based Online Perception for Open-World 3D Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: 3D visual grounding aims to locate objects based on natural language descriptions in 3D scenes. Existing supervised methods are limited by generalization and recent zero-shot methods typically rely on a predefined Object Lookup Table (OLT) to query Visual Language Models (VLMs) for reasoning about object locations via a single step grounding, which limits the applications in scenarios with undefined targets and complex queries. To address these problems, we present OpenGround, a novel zero-shot framework for open-world 3D visual grounding that remains compatible with recent zero-shot methods. OpenGround integrates Task-Chain Planning to decompose a query into a plan of context-to-target sub-goals for progressive grounding, and Context-Guided Perception to perceive novel objects online under context guidance from the task chain. We also propose a new dataset named OpenTarget, which contains over 7000 object-description pairs to mimic open-world evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OpenGround achieves competitive performance on Nr3D, state-of-the-art on ScanRefer, and delivers a substantial 17.6\% improvement on OpenTarget. Project Page at https://why-102.github.io/openground.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OpenGround框架，用于开放世界3D视觉定位的零样本方法，通过任务链规划分解查询为逐步定位的子目标，并在线感知新物体。在Nr3D、ScanRefer和新建的OpenTarget数据集上取得竞争性能，OpenTarget上提升17.6%。
Motivation: 现有监督方法泛化性有限，零样本方法依赖预定义物体查找表，难以处理未定义目标和复杂查询。
Method: 提出任务链规划（Task-Chain Planning）将查询分解为上下文到目标的子目标序列进行逐步定位，以及上下文引导感知（Context-Guided Perception）根据任务链的上下文在线感知新物体。

Conclusion: 该方法兼容现有零样本方法，扩展了开放世界3D视觉定位的应用场景。

papers.title: VASP Agent: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous First-principles Calculations
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in agentic frameworks for scientific discovery. First-principles materials computation imposes a demanding standard for autonomy: successful execution depends on internally consistent inputs, supervision of long-running calculations, and verified outputs. Here we present VASP Agent, a coding-agent-centered system that combines reusable domain skills, deterministic tools, workspace-state inspection, runtime evidence, and scientific guardrails to execute multi-step VASP calculations. The system is evaluated across multiple tasks including structural relaxation, bandgap calculation, equilibrium lattice constant determination, and CO/Pt(111) adsorption. VASP Agent completes all evaluated cases, and its computed numerical results are compared with those obtained using pymatgen and other agentic tools. When large deviations occur, the calculation parameters produced by VASP Agent are more appropriate than those produced by LLM-based workflows. Failure analysis shows that errors that terminate fixed pipelines can be diagnosed and recovered under agentic control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VASP Agent，一种以编码代理为中心的自主框架，用于执行多步VASP第一性原理计算。系统集成可复用领域技能、确定性工具、工作空间状态检查、运行时证据和科学护栏，在结构弛豫、带隙计算、平衡晶格常数确定和CO/Pt(111)吸附等任务上完成所有评估案例。与pymatgen及其他代理工具相比，VASP Agent计算数值合理，且在出现较大偏差时其参数更合适。故障分析表明代理控制可以诊断并恢复固定管线的错误。
Motivation: 第一性原理材料计算对自主性要求高：需要内部一致的输入、长时间计算的监督以及验证输出。现有LLM工作流在参数合理性上存在不足，且固定管线易因错误终止。
Method: 提出以编码代理为核心的VASP Agent系统，结合可复用领域技能、确定性工具、工作空间状态检查、运行时证据和科学护栏，实现多步VASP计算的自主执行。
Result: 系统在结构弛豫、带隙计算、平衡晶格常数确定和CO/Pt(111)吸附等任务上全部成功完成，其计算结果与pymatgen等工具对比，参数更合理；故障分析显示代理控制可诊断并恢复错误。
Conclusion: VASP Agent展示了LLM代理框架在第一性原理计算中的潜力，能够实现自主执行和错误恢复，但摘要未提及局限性与泛化性。

papers.title: SecureCode: A Production-Grade Multi-Turn Dataset for Training Security-Aware Code Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: AI coding assistants produce vulnerable code in 45\% of security-relevant scenarios~\cite{veracode2025}, yet no public training dataset teaches both traditional web security and AI/ML-specific defenses in a format suitable for instruction tuning. We present SecureCode, a production-grade dataset of 2,185 multi-turn security training examples spanning two domains: web application security (1,435 examples covering the OWASP Top 10 2021 across 11 languages and 9 frameworks, 100\% grounded in documented CVEs and security incidents) and AI/ML security (750 examples covering all 10 OWASP LLM Top 10 2025 categories across more than 40 frameworks, including LangChain, OpenAI, and Hugging Face). Every example follows a 4-turn conversational structure -- feature request; vulnerable and secure implementations with attack demonstrations; advanced probing; and defense-in-depth operational guidance -- designed for direct use in instruction tuning pipelines. Quality assurance combines automated structural validation with multi-agent review from seven specialist AI perspectives (more than 10{,}500 assessments) and an 8-phase remediation pipeline, producing a rubric-calibrated mean quality score of 93.8/100 ($σ= 0.93$) for the AI/ML component. Each example provides SIEM integration strategies, infrastructure hardening recommendations, and testing approaches using production frameworks. We release the unified dataset on Hugging Face with domain-specific loading configurations (web, aiml, default), alongside eight fine-tuned open-source models (3B--20B parameters, QLoRA), and an evaluation framework with four security-specific metrics. To our knowledge, SecureCode is the first public dataset that jointly provides OWASP Top 10 2021 web coverage and OWASP LLM Top 10 2025 AI/ML coverage in a unified conversational schema suitable for instruction tuning.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 12 figures, 10 tables. Dataset available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/scthornton/securecode. Code and validation tools at https://github.com/scthornton/securecode
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍SecureCode，一个包含2,185个多轮安全训练示例的数据集，涵盖Web应用安全（OWASP Top 10 2021，11种语言、9种框架）和AI/ML安全（OWASP LLM Top 10 2025，40+框架），采用4轮对话结构，适用于指令微调。质量保证结合自动化验证和多智能体评审，AI/ML组件平均质量评分93.8/100。数据集和8个微调开源模型（3B-20B参数，QLoRA）已发布。
Motivation: 现有AI编码助手在45%的安全场景下生成漏洞代码，但缺乏同时覆盖传统Web安全和AI/ML特定防御的公开训练数据集，且不适合指令微调格式。
Method: 构建2,185个多轮安全训练示例，每个示例包含4轮对话：功能请求、漏洞/安全实现及攻击演示、高级探测、纵深防御操作指导。质量保证通过自动化结构验证和七种AI视角的多智能体评审（10,500+评估）以及8阶段修复流程。
Result: AI/ML组件的质量评分平均93.8/100（σ=0.93），数据集通过Hugging Face发布，包含领域特定加载配置和评估框架，以及8个微调开源模型。
Conclusion: SecureCode是首个在统一对话模式中联合提供OWASP Top 10 2021 Web覆盖和OWASP LLM Top 10 2025 AI/ML覆盖的公开数据集，适用于指令微调。

papers.title: No-Regret Gaussian Process Optimization of Time-Varying Functions
papers.abstract_en: Sequential optimization of black-box functions from noisy evaluations has been widely studied, with Gaussian Process bandit algorithms such as GP-UCB guaranteeing no-regret in stationary settings. However, for time-varying objectives, no-regret is unattainable under pure bandit feedback unless strong and often unrealistic assumptions are imposed. We propose a novel method for optimizing time-varying rewards in the frequentist setting, where the objective has bounded RKHS norm almost surely. Time variations are captured through uncertainty injection, enabling heteroscedastic Gaussian process regression that adapts past observations to the current time step. As no-regret is unattainable in general in the strict bandit setting, we relax the latter allowing additional queries on previously observed points. Building on sparse inference and the effect of uncertainty injection on regret, we propose W-SparQ-GP-UCB, an online algorithm that achieves no-regret with a vanishing number of additional queries per iteration. To assess the theoretical limits of this approach, we establish a lower bound on the number of additional queries required for no-regret, proving the efficiency of our method. Finally, we provide a comprehensive analysis linking the temporal regime of the function to achievable regret rates, together with upper and lower bounds on the number of additional queries needed in each regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时变函数的贝叶斯优化问题，提出W-SparQ-GP-UCB算法。在频繁主义设定下，目标函数几乎必然具有有界RKHS范数，时间变化通过不确定性注入（uncertainty injection）建模，实现异方差高斯过程回归。由于纯bandit反馈下无法实现无遗憾（no-regret），算法允许额外查询先前观测点，并实现随迭代次数递减的额外查询数下的无遗憾。同时给出理论下界证明算法效率。
Motivation: 现有高斯过程bandit算法（如GP-UCB）在平稳设定下保证无遗憾，但对时变目标函数，纯bandit反馈下无遗憾不可达，除非强假设。需要一种无需强假设且能适应时间变化的优化方法。
Method: 通过不确定性注入捕捉时间变化，使用异方差高斯过程回归自适应调整历史观测。提出W-SparQ-GP-UCB算法，基于稀疏推理和不确定性注入对遗憾的影响，允许额外查询先前观测点，并保证无遗憾。
Result: 算法在每次迭代中仅需少量额外查询（vanishing number）即可实现无遗憾。同时建立所需额外查询数的下界，证明方法的有效性。给出不同时间变化 regime下的遗憾率上下界。
Conclusion: 本文为时变函数优化提供了一种理论上严谨的方法，通过放松严格bandit设定（允许额外查询）实现了无遗憾，并证明了算法在查询代价上的最优性。

papers.title: FIELDS: Face reconstruction with accurate Inference of Expression using Learning with Direct Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Monocular 3D face reconstruction estimates a 3D morphable model (3DMM) representation from a single image, providing geometry-aware expression codes that are useful for facial expression analysis and affect understanding. Despite strong progress, most pipelines are trained with image-level self-supervision and evaluated primarily by geometric fidelity, which does not necessarily maximize the affective utility of the learned expression representation and may encourage intensity-amplifying shortcuts when affect supervision is naively coupled. We propose FIELDS (Face reconstruction with accurate Inference of Expression using Learning with Direct Supervision), a task-driven framework that learns FLAME expression codes for facial expression recognition (FER) under a geometric plausibility constraint. Using hybrid 2D/3D supervision, FIELDS improves affect prediction in both in-domain and external evaluations while maintaining competitive geometric fidelity on held-out and out-of-domain 3D benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FIELDS框架，通过直接监督学习FLAME表情编码用于面部表情识别（FER），并引入几何合理性约束。使用混合2D/3D监督，在保持几何精度的同时提升情感预测性能。
Motivation: 现有单目3D人脸重建方法主要关注几何精度，而学到的表情表示在情感分析中的效用未最大化，且直接耦合情感监督可能导致强度放大捷径。
Method: 提出任务驱动框架FIELDS，直接监督学习FLAME表情编码，结合几何合理性约束和混合2D/3D监督信号。
Result: 在域内和外部评估中改善情感预测，同时在保留数据集和域外3D基准上保持有竞争力的几何精度。
Conclusion: 通过直接监督表情编码，可以在不牺牲几何保真度的情况下提升情感推理能力。

papers.title: A Fast Binary Splitting Approach for Non-Adaptive Learning of Erdős--Rényi Graphs
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning an unknown graph via group queries on node subsets, where each query reports whether at least one edge is present among the queried nodes. In general, learning arbitrary graphs with $n$ nodes and $k$ edges is hard in the non-adaptive setting, requiring $Ω\big(\min\{k^2\log n,\,n^2\}\big)$ tests even when a small error probability is allowed. We focus on learning Erdős--Rényi (ER) graphs $G\sim\mathrm{ER}(n,q)$ in the non-adaptive setting, where the expected number of edges is $\bar{k}=q\binom{n}{2}$, and we aim to design an efficient testing--decoding scheme, namely, a non-adaptive test design together with a decoding algorithm, achieving asymptotically vanishing error probability. Prior work (Li--Fresacher--Scarlett, NeurIPS 2019) presents a testing--decoding scheme that attains an order-optimal number of tests $O(\bar{k}\log n)$ but incurs $Ω(n^2)$ decoding time, whereas their proposed sublinear-time algorithm incurs an extra $(\log \bar{k})(\log n)$ factor in the number of tests. We extend the binary splitting approach, recently developed for non-adaptive group testing, to the ER graph learning setting, and prove that the edge set can be recovered with high probability using $O(\bar{k}\log n)$ tests while attaining decoding time $O(\bar{k}^{1+δ}\log n)$ for any fixed $δ>0$.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Information Theory (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非自适应学习Erdős–Rényi (ER) 图的问题，通过组查询（group queries）获取边信息。提出一种基于二分分裂（binary splitting）的测试-解码方案，在测试次数为O(¯k log n)的情况下实现解码时间O(¯k^{1+δ} log n)，其中¯k是期望边数，δ>0任意小。
Motivation: 现有非自适应学习ER图的方案在测试次数或解码时间上存在权衡：一种方案测试次数最优但解码时间高达Ω(n^2)；另一种子线性时间方案则测试次数多出一个(log ¯k)(log n)因子。需要一种同时保持测试次数最优和解码时间接近线性的方法。
Method: 将非自适应组测试中近期发展的二分分裂方法扩展到ER图学习，设计非自适应的测试矩阵和相应的贪婪解码算法。
Result: 理论证明该方案能以渐近消失的错误概率恢复边集，使用O(¯k log n)次测试，解码时间为O(¯k^{1+δ} log n)，其中δ>0可任意小。
Conclusion: 该方法在测试次数上达到渐近最优，同时解码时间比之前的工作有显著改进，接近线性于边数。

papers.title: SWITCH: Benchmarking Modeling and Handling of Tangible Interfaces in Long-horizon Embodied Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Tangible control interfaces (TCIs), such as appliance panels, remotes, elevators, and embedded GUIs, are a fundamental component of everyday human-built environments. Interacting with these interfaces requires agents not only to ground language in visual observations,but also to execute actions, track temporally evolving state changes, and verify whether intended outcomes have been achieved. However, existing benchmarks predominantly evaluate open-loop perception or single-step action execution, failing to capture this continuous cycle of interaction, feedback, and correction. We introduce SWITCH, a benchmark for closed-loop interactive reasoning with TCIs in realistic egocentric environments1. SWITCH comprises 1,170 temporally interactive videos across diverse functional categories, providing structured annotations of instructions, actions, state transitions, outcomes, and recovery behaviors over time. To probe generative world modeling, SWITCH also evaluates video generation models on interaction-centered tasks using both LLM-as-judge and human evaluation2.Experiments with frontier proprietary and opensource multimodal models reveal persistent weaknesses in fine-grained visual-temporal perception, outcome verification, and error recovery, highlighting SWITCH as a testbed for closed-loop embodied intelligence.

papers.title: Blind Quality Enhancement of Compressed Video via Fine-Grained Degradation-Guided Sequential Inference
papers.abstract_en: Existing studies on quality enhancement for compressed video (QECV) predominantly rely on known quantization parameters (QPs), training separate enhancement models for each QP setting, which are referred to as non-blind methods. However, in practical scenarios such as transcoding and transmission, QPs may be partially or entirely unavailable, which limits the applicability of these methods and motivates the development of blind QECV techniques. Existing blind methods typically generate degradation vectors using classification models trained with cross-entropy loss, and employ them as channel attention to guide artifact reduction. Nevertheless, such degradation representations mainly capture global compression information and lack fine-grained spatial cues, making them less effective in handling spatially varying artifact patterns. To address this issue, we propose a pre-trained degradation representation learning module that decouples and extracts high-dimensional, multi-scale degradation representations from compressed video content, providing fine-grained guidance for artifact reduction. Furthermore, most existing blind and nonblind methods adopt a uniform inference architecture for all compression levels, ignoring the distinct computational demands of different QPs. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a sequential inference strategy that adaptively adjusts the number of artifact reduction stages according to the estimated compression level. Extensive experiments show that the proposed method significantly improves enhancement performance. In particular, at QP = 22, it raises PSNR improvement from 0.31 dB to 0.65 dB over the previous state-of-the-art blind method. Meanwhile, with the proposed sequential inference strategy, the average inference time at QP = 22 is reduced by 50% compared with that at QP = 42.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对盲压缩视频质量增强问题，提出预训练的退化表示学习模块，提取高维多尺度退化表征以提供细粒度伪影消除指导，并引入顺序推理策略根据估计压缩级别自适应调整处理阶段。在QP=22时，PSNR提升从0.31 dB升至0.65 dB，推理时间较QP=42降低50%。
Motivation: 实际场景中量化参数（QP）常不可用，现有盲方法依赖分类模型生成的全局退化向量，缺乏空间细节，难以处理空间变化的伪影。
Method: 提出预训练退化表示学习模块，解耦并提取高维多尺度退化特征作为细粒度引导；并设计顺序推理策略，根据估计的QP动态调整伪影消除阶段数。
Result: 在QP=22时，PSNR提升从0.31 dB提升至0.65 dB（超过之前最优盲方法），且推理时间较QP=42减少50%。
Conclusion: 盲QECV中结合多尺度退化表示与自适应推理策略可提升性能与效率，但未讨论推广至其他压缩标准的可能性。

papers.title: FUSE: A Flow-based Mapping Between Shapes
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel neural representation for maps between 3D shapes based on flow-matching models, which is computationally efficient and supports cross-representation shape matching without large-scale training or data-driven procedures. 3D shapes are represented as the probability distribution induced by a continuous and invertible flow mapping from a fixed anchor distribution. Given a source and a target shape, the composition of the inverse flow (source to anchor) with the forward flow (anchor to target), we map points between the two surfaces. By encoding the shapes with a pointwise task-tailored embedding, this construction provides an invertible and modality-agnostic representation of maps between shapes across point clouds, meshes, signed distance fields (SDFs), and volumetric data. The resulting representation consistently achieves high coverage and accuracy across diverse benchmarks and challenging settings in shape matching. Beyond shape matching, our framework shows promising results in other tasks, including UV mapping and registration of raw point cloud scans of human bodies.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 9 figures. Accepted for publication at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于流匹配 (flow-matching) 的新型神经表示方法，用于三维形状之间的映射。该方法通过将形状表示为从固定锚点分布到目标分布的连续可逆流映射，组合源形状的逆流与目标形状的正向流实现点对应。该表示支持点云、网格、符号距离场 (SDF) 和体数据等跨模态形状匹配，无需大规模训练或数据驱动过程。在多种形状匹配基准上取得了高覆盖率和准确率，并展示了在UV映射和人体扫描配准等任务中的应用潜力。
Motivation: 现有形状映射方法通常需要针对特定表示或依赖大量训练数据，缺乏跨表示 (cross-representation) 的通用性和计算效率。本文旨在设计一种可逆、模态无关的映射表示，能够统一处理点云、网格、SDF 和体数据，同时避免大规模训练开销。
Method: 利用流匹配模型学习从固定锚点分布 (如高斯分布) 到三维形状表面的连续可逆流映射。对于源形状和目标形状，通过组合源形状的逆流 (映射到锚点) 和目标形状的正向流 (从锚点映射到目标) 获得点对应。通过点级任务定制嵌入 (pointwise task-tailored embedding) 编码形状，使得映射表示可逆且与具体表示形式无关。
Result: 在多种形状匹配基准上，该方法实现了高覆盖率和准确率，尤其在挑战性场景下表现优异。在UV映射和人体原始点云扫描配准任务中也取得了有希望的结果。
Conclusion: 基于流匹配的映射表示提供了一种计算高效、跨模态可逆的形状对应方案，无需大规模训练，在形状匹配及其他几何任务中具有潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Origin-Destination Matrix Estimation in Microscopic Traffic Simulations Considering Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: This paper focuses on dynamic origin-destination matrix estimation (DODE), a crucial calibration process necessary for the effective application of microscopic traffic simulations. The fundamental challenge of the DODE problem in microscopic simulations stems from the complex temporal dynamics and inherent uncertainty of individual vehicle dynamics. This makes it highly challenging to precisely determine which vehicle traverses which link at any given moment, resulting in intricate and often ambiguous relationships between origin-destination (OD) matrices and their contributions to resultant link flows. This phenomenon constitutes the credit assignment problem, a central challenge addressed in this study. We formulate the DODE problem as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and propose a novel framework that applies model-free deep reinforcement learning (DRL). Within our proposed framework, the agent learns an optimal policy to sequentially generate OD matrices, refining its strategy through direct interaction with the simulation environment. This approach was evaluated through a toy experiment on the Nguyen-Dupuis network and a case study utilizing an actual highway subnetwork spanning Santa Clara and San Jose. Experimental results show that the proposed method consistently improves calibration performance relative to the strongest conventional baseline, reducing link-flow MSE by 23.7% in the toy experiment and by 59.2-88.3% in the real-world case study. By reframing DODE as a sequential decision-making problem, our approach addresses the credit assignment challenge through a learned policy and provides a novel framework for calibration of microscopic traffic simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于模型无关深度强化学习（DRL）的框架用于微观交通仿真中的动态OD矩阵估计（DODE），将问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），通过学习策略解决信用分配问题。在Nguyen-Dupuis网络和圣克拉拉-圣何塞高速子网上的实验表明，该方法相比传统基线降低了23.7%至88.3%的链路流MSE。
Motivation: 微观交通仿真中DODE面临车辆动态的复杂时间依赖和不确定性，导致OD矩阵与链路流之间关系模糊，即信用分配问题，现有方法难以精确估计。
Method: 将DODE表述为MDP，使用模型无关的深度强化学习，智能体通过直接与仿真环境交互学习最优策略，逐步生成OD矩阵。
Result: 在玩具实验中链路流MSE降低23.7%，在真实高速子网案例中降低59.2%-88.3%。
Conclusion: 通过将DODE重构为序列决策问题，所提方法有效解决了信用分配挑战，为微观交通仿真标定提供了新框架。

papers.title: Perceptually Aligning Representations of Music via Noise-Augmented Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: We argue that training autoencoders to reconstruct inputs from noised versions of their encodings, when combined with perceptually motivated losses, yields encodings that are structured according to a perceptual hierarchy. We demonstrate the emergence of this hierarchy by showing that, after training an audio autoencoder in this manner, perceptually salient information is captured in coarser representation structures than with conventional training. Furthermore, we show that such perceptual hierarchies improve latent diffusion decoding in the context of estimating pitch surprisal in music and predicting EEG-brain responses to music listening. In both cases, our results surpass those of previous methods. Pretrained weights are available on github.com/CPJKU/pa-audioic.
papers.comment: Accepted to EUSIPCO 2026. Previous version appeared in NeurIPS 2025 - AI for Music Workshop. 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通过噪声增强自编码器（noise-augmented autoencoder）结合感知损失训练音频自编码器，使编码按照感知层级结构组织。实验表明，该方法在音乐音高惊奇度估计和EEG脑电预测任务上优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有自编码器训练未显式考虑人类感知层级，导致编码结构缺乏感知相关性。
Method: 训练自编码器从带噪声的编码重建输入，并加入基于感知的损失函数，促使编码形成感知层级结构。
Result: 在音乐音高惊奇度估计和EEG响应预测任务上，该方法超越先前方法，并展示了编码中感知显著信息集中在粗粒度结构中。
Conclusion: 噪声增强与感知损失的结合能诱导编码的感知层级性，提升下游任务性能。

papers.title: SmartMixed: A Two-Phase Training Strategy for Adaptive Activation Function Learning in Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The choice of activation function plays a critical role in neural networks, yet most architectures still rely on fixed, uniform activation functions across all neurons. We introduce SmartMixed, a novel two-phase training strategy that allows networks to learn optimal per-neuron activation functions while preserving computational efficiency at inference. In the first phase, neurons adaptively select from a pool of candidate activation functions (ReLU, Sigmoid, Tanh, Leaky_ReLU, ELU, SELU) using a differentiable hard mixture mechanism. In the second phase, each neuron's activation function is fixed according to the learned selection, resulting in a computationally efficient network that supports continued training with optimized vectorized operations. We evaluate SmartMixed on the MNIST dataset using feedforward neural networks of different architectures. Our analysis reveals that neurons in different layers exhibit distinct preferences for activation functions, providing insights into the functional diversity within neural architectures. We also demonstrated that SmartMixed effectively trains the network by allowing neurons to select their preferred activation functions, competing against models using a single fixed state-of-the-art activation function.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SmartMixed，一种两阶段训练策略，允许神经网络学习每个神经元的激活函数，同时保持推理时的计算效率。第一阶段使用可微硬混合机制从候选函数池中自适应选择，第二阶段固定选择，支持向量化继续训练。在 MNIST 上的前馈网络实验中，发现不同层神经元对激活函数有不同偏好，并可与单一最优激活函数模型竞争。
Motivation: 大多数神经网络对所有神经元使用固定且统一的激活函数，缺乏对每个神经元最优激活函数的适应性。
Method: 两阶段训练：第一阶段，每个神经元通过可微硬混合机制从 ReLU、Sigmoid、Tanh、Leaky_ReLU、ELU、SELU 池中自适应选择；第二阶段固定选择，得到计算高效的网络，支持向量化继续训练。
Result: 在 MNIST 数据集上，使用不同架构的前馈网络进行实验，结果表明不同层神经元对激活函数有不同偏好，且 SmartMixed 与单一固定最优激活函数模型性能相当。
Conclusion: SmartMixed 能有效学习每个神经元的激活函数，揭示网络内功能多样性，同时保持推理效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM4Delay: Flight Delay Prediction via Cross-Modality Adaptation of Large Language Models and Aircraft Trajectory Representation
papers.abstract_en: Flight delay prediction has become a key focus in air traffic management (ATM), as delays reflect inefficiencies in the system. This paper proposes LLM4Delay, a large language model (LLM)-based framework for predicting flight delays from the perspective of air traffic controllers monitoring aircraft after they enter the terminal maneuvering area (TMA). LLM4Delay is designed to integrate textual aeronautical information, including flight data, weather reports, and aerodrome notices, together with multiple trajectories that model airspace conditions, forming a comprehensive delay-relevant context. By jointly leveraging comprehensive textual and trajectory contexts via instance-level projection, an effective cross-modality adaptation strategy that maps multiple instance-level trajectory representations into the language modality, the framework improves delay prediction accuracy. LLM4Delay demonstrates superior performance compared to existing ATM frameworks and prior time-series-to-language adaptation methods. This highlights the complementary roles of textual and trajectory data while leveraging knowledge from both the pretrained trajectory encoder and the pretrained LLM. The proposed framework enables continuous updates to predictions as new information becomes available, indicating potential operational relevance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLM4Delay，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的航班延误预测框架，通过跨模态适配策略整合文本航空信息（航班数据、天气报告、机场通告）和多个轨迹表示，利用实例级投影将轨迹表示映射到语言模态，提升延误预测准确性。在现有ATM框架和时间序列到语言适配方法上表现更优，支持预测持续更新。
Motivation: 航班延误反映空中交通管理效率低下，现有方法未能有效融合文本和轨迹多模态信息，且缺乏利用预训练LLM和轨迹编码器知识的能力。
Method: 提出LLM4Delay框架，采用跨模态适配策略，通过实例级投影将多个轨迹表示映射到语言模态，与文本航空信息（飞行数据、天气报告、机场通告）共同构成上下文，输入LLM进行延误预测。
Result: 相比现有ATM框架和时间序列到语言适配方法，LLM4Delay在延误预测准确性上表现更优，验证了文本和轨迹数据的互补作用。
Conclusion: 该框架表明融合预训练LLM和轨迹编码器的跨模态方法能有效提升航班延误预测，且预测可随新信息更新，具有潜在操作应用价值。
