papers.title: Beyond Reactivity: Measuring Proactive Problem Solving in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are increasingly moving towards proactivity: rather than awaiting instruction, they exercise agency to anticipate user needs and solve them autonomously. However, evaluating proactivity is challenging; current benchmarks are constrained to localized context, limiting their ability to test reasoning across sources and longer time horizons. To address this gap, we present PROBE (Proactive Resolution Of BottlEnecks). PROBE decomposes proactivity as a pipeline of three core capabilities: (1) searching for unspecified issues, (2) identifying specific bottlenecks, and (3) executing appropriate resolutions. We apply PROBE to evaluate leading LLMs and popular agentic frameworks, showing that even state-of-the-art models struggle to solve this benchmark. Computing our consistent measurements across frontier LLMs and agents, we find that the best end-to-end performance of 40% is achieved by both GPT-5 and Claude Opus-4.1. Additionally, we demonstrate the relative capabilities of each model and analyze mutual failure modes. Our results highlight the current limitations of autonomous action in agentic systems, and expose promising future research directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PROBE基准，用于评估LLM agent的主动问题解决能力，包含搜索未明确问题、识别瓶颈、执行解决三个环节。摘要显示即使最先进的模型（GPT-5和Claude Opus-4.1）端到端性能也仅为40%，揭示了当前agent系统自主行动的局限性。
Motivation: 现有评估基准局限于局部上下文，无法测试跨来源和长时段的推理能力，而LLM agent正越来越需要主动性和自主性，因此需要新的评估方法。
Method: 提出PROBE基准，将主动性分解为三个核心能力：搜索未指定的问题、识别特定瓶颈、执行适当的解决方案，并应用于评估领先LLM和流行agent框架。
Result: 最佳端到端性能为40%，由GPT-5和Claude Opus-4.1达到；论文还分析了各模型的相对能力和共同失败模式。
Conclusion: 结果突显了当前agent系统自主行动的局限性，并指出了有前景的未来研究方向。

papers.title: Solver-Integrated Adversarial Attacking and Training of Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators are widely used as fast surrogates for numerical PDE solvers, mapping input functions to solution functions. However, their generalizability and robustness are not yet clearly defined in the operator-learning setting, which differs from traditional adversarial robustness definitions. This paper studies the generalizability and robustness of a learned neural operator from a solver-integrated perspective, addressing the challenge that the output of a learned operator and a numerical solver tends to change in tandem under input perturbation. First, we formalize the definition of generalization and robustness through a model-solver error operator, identifying fixed-input model-solver loss as generalization metric, and norm-bounded adversarial attack loss increase and Jacobian-error function norm as robustness metric. Second, we identify the solver-integrated adversarial attack as appropriate for PDE operator learning and show why model-only or fixed-ground-truth attacks can be insufficient when the solver output also changes with the input. Third, we develop solver-integrated adversarial training methods for neural operators. Experiments on representative PDE benchmarks show that this solver-integrated adversarial training clearly improves both generalizability and robustness. Deeper solver integration yields more effective attacks, more informative samples, and more efficient training than less integrated alternatives. These results provide a general framework for robust operator training and automatic sample selection without heavy manual intervention. More broadly, the formulation applies to adversarial regression whenever a ground-truth oracle can evaluate, and ideally differentiate, the true input-output map; PDE operator learning is one such case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从求解器集成视角研究神经算子的泛化性与鲁棒性，定义了基于模型-求解器误差算子的新指标，提出求解器集成对抗攻击与训练方法。在PDE基准上验证了该方法能同时提升泛化性与鲁棒性，且求解器集成度越高效果越好。
Motivation: 神经算子作为快速代理广泛用于数值PDE求解，但其泛化性与鲁棒性在算子学习场景下定义不清晰，且传统对抗鲁棒性定义不适用。
Method: 首先通过模型-求解器误差算子形式化泛化与鲁棒性指标；然后提出求解器集成对抗攻击，并开发相应的对抗训练方法。
Result: 实验表明，求解器集成对抗训练在多个PDE基准上同时提升泛化性与鲁棒性，且更深的求解器集成带来更有效的攻击、更信息丰富的样本和更高效的训练。
Conclusion: 该方法为鲁棒算子训练和自动样本选择提供了通用框架，可推广到任何存在真值预言（ground-truth oracle）的对抗回归问题。

papers.title: AtomBench: A Benchmarking Framework for Generative Crystal Reconstruction Models in Conventional Superconductors
papers.abstract_en: A key question in benchmarking generative crystal reconstruction models is how the amount and type of crystallographic information provided to a generative model affects its ability to reconstruct atomic structures. Yet such comparisons often overlook the fact that models receive unequal information about the target during reconstruction, thereby confounding architectural conclusions. We present AtomBench, an extensible, model-agnostic framework for comparing generative models on a well-defined crystal reconstruction task (rather than \textit{de novo} generation), which we here apply to conventional superconductors. We train and evaluate four models, AtomGPT, CDVAE, FlowMM, and MatterGen, on the JARVIS Supercon-3D and Alexandria DS-A/B datasets, grouping them by the information each accesses at inference. Reconstruction fidelity is measured by the Kullback-Leibler divergence (KLD) and mean absolute error (MAE) of lattice parameters and the root-mean-squared displacement (RMSD) of atomic coordinates. We further introduce the continuous corrected RMSD (ccRMSD), a continuous measure of local geometric fidelity defined for every structure in the test set. MatterGen achieves the best atomic-coordinate reconstruction, followed by AtomGPT, while CDVAE reconstructs lattices most accurately, and FlowMM is the least accurate but fastest overall. We find that conditioning on critical temperature T$_c$ does not consistently improve fidelity. We also release AtomBench as an open-source Python package that reproduces all reported reconstruction metrics, figures, and tables from one or more benchmark files and supports direct submission to the JARVIS-Leaderboard. Any inverse model emitting crystal reconstructions can be benchmarked with \texttt{atombench}, and we encourage community use. https://github.com/atomgptlab/atombench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AtomBench是一个模型无关的基准框架，用于比较生成式晶体重建模型，专注于常规超导体。在JARVIS Supercon-3D和Alexandria数据集上评估了AtomGPT、CDVAE、FlowMM和MatterGen四种模型，使用KLD、MAE和RMSD等指标，并引入连续校正RMSD (ccRMSD)作为局部几何保真度度量。MatterGen在原子坐标重建上最优，CDVAE在晶格参数重建上最准确，FlowMM速度最快但精度最低。以临界温度Tc为条件并不一致提升重建质量。框架已开源并支持提交到JARVIS-Leaderboard。
Motivation: 现有晶体生成模型比较中，模型在重建时获取的信息量不等，导致架构结论不明确，需要一个统一的基准框架来公平评估不同模型。
Method: 提出AtomBench，一个可扩展、模型无关的基准框架，定义晶体重建任务而非从头生成。将模型按推理时访问的信息分组，使用KLD、MAE、RMSD及新提出的ccRMSD度量，在超导体数据集上训练和评估四个生成模型。
Result: MatterGen在原子坐标重建上取得最佳RMSD，CDVAE在晶格参数重建上取得最低KLD/MAE，FlowMM最不准确但最快。以Tc为条件并不一致改善重建保真度。
Conclusion: AtomBench为晶体重建模型提供了公平比较框架，已开源并鼓励社区使用，支持提交到JARVIS-Leaderboard。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VisCoP: Visual Probing for Video Domain Adaptation of Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision Language Models (VLMs) excel at general visual reasoning but experience significant performance degradation when deployed in novel domains that exhibit substantial distribution shifts from their pretraining data. Existing domain adaptation methods rely on finetuning standard VLM components; however, depending on which components are updated, these approaches either limit the model's ability to learn domain-specific representations or cause catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired capabilities. We introduce Vision Contextualized Probing (VisCoP), a parameter-efficient adaptation framework that augments the VLM vision encoder with a compact set of learnable visual probes. By learning domain-specific visual representations through these probes while requiring only minimal updates to pretrained model components, VisCoP effectively adapts to new domains without sacrificing existing knowledge. We evaluate VisCoP across three challenging adaptation settings: cross-view (exocentric to egocentric), cross-modal (RGB to depth), and cross-task (human understanding to robot control). Across all scenarios, VisCoP consistently outperforms existing domain adaptation strategies, achieving superior target-domain performance while preserving the pretrained VLM's capabilities on the source domain. These results demonstrate that lightweight visual probing provides an effective and robust solution for adapting VLMs under substantial distribution shifts. Code, models, and evaluation protocols are available at https://github.com/dominickrei/VisCoP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VisCoP，一种参数高效的视觉语言模型（VLM）域适应框架，通过向视觉编码器添加少量可学习的视觉探测器来实现新域适应，避免灾难性遗忘。在跨视角、跨模态和跨任务三个设置上，VisCoP 均优于现有方法，保持源域性能的同时提升目标域表现。
Motivation: VLM 在面对分布偏移的新域时性能显著下降，现有微调方法要么限制域特定表示学习，要么导致灾难性遗忘。需要一种既能学习新域特征又不丢失原有能力的轻量级适应方案。
Method: VisCoP 在 VLM 视觉编码器中插入一组紧凑的可学习视觉探测器，仅对探测器进行训练，大部分预训练参数冻结，从而以最小参数更新学习域特定表示。
Result: 在跨视角（外中心→自我中心）、跨模态（RGB→深度）和跨任务（人类理解→机器人控制）三个挑战性设置中，VisCoP 在目标域性能上超越所有基线，并保持源域能力不退化。
Conclusion: 轻量级视觉探测是一种有效且鲁棒的 VLM 域适应方法，适用于大分布偏移场景，且参数效率高。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Base Models Know How to Reason, Thinking Models Learn When
papers.abstract_en: What do thinking language models learn during training that their base models lack? We first present an unsupervised method that discovers a model's reasoning behaviors by training small Sparse Autoencoders on sentence-level activations of reasoning traces, yielding interpretable reasoning taxonomies. Building on this, we introduce constructive model diffing, which aims to reconstruct the base-to-fine-tuned difference from interpretable components: reasoning mechanisms (category vectors that can induce a reasoning behavior in the base model) and reasoning heuristics (a classifier determining when a mechanism should fire). Across nine base/thinking pairs (four RL-trained, four SFT-distilled, one mixed), two independent findings agree: category vectors in the base model converge to far lower loss for taxonomies derived from purely RL-trained models, and hybrid models recover roughly 76% of the RL base-to-thinking gap but only 11% of the SFT gap. This indicates RL primarily teaches heuristics for orchestrating pre-existing base mechanisms, whereas SFT-distillation installs new ones, offering a new lens on what training paradigms teach, with implications for efficient reasoning-model development.
papers.comment: Accepted as a Spotlight at the International Conference on Machine Learning 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过训练小型稀疏自编码器在推理轨迹的句子级激活上，提出一种无监督方法发现模型的推理行为，并引入constructive model diffing从可解释组件重建base模型到微调模型的差异。在9对base/thinking模型（包括RL训练、SFT蒸馏和混合）上的实验表明，类别向量在纯RL训练模型的分类上收敛到更低损失，混合模型恢复约76%的RL差距但仅11%的SFT差距。结论认为RL主要教授协调已有基础机制的启发式，而SFT蒸馏则安装新机制，为高效推理模型开发提供新视角。
Motivation: 研究思考语言模型在训练中学习了什么基础模型所欠缺的，即理解不同训练范式（RL vs SFT）对模型推理能力的影响。
Method: 提出无监督方法：在推理轨迹的句子级激活上训练小型稀疏自编码器，获得可解释的推理分类；然后引入constructive model diffing，通过推理机制（类别向量）和推理启发式（分类器）重建base-to-fine-tuned差异。
Result: 在9对模型上，类别向量在纯RL训练模型分类上收敛到更低损失；混合模型恢复约76%的RL基础到思考的差距，但仅11%的SFT差距。
Conclusion: RL主要教授启发式来协调已有的基础机制，而SFT蒸馏则安装新机制，提示不同训练范式对推理能力的不同影响，对高效推理模型开发有启示。

papers.title: A Spatial-Spectral-Frequency Interactive Network for Multimodal Remote Sensing Classification
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-based methods have achieved significant success in remote sensing Earth observation data analysis. Numerous feature fusion techniques address multimodal remote sensing image classification by integrating global and local features. However, these techniques often struggle to extract structural and detail features from heterogeneous and redundant multimodal images. With the goal of introducing frequency domain learning to model key and sparse detail features, this paper introduces the spatial-spectral-frequency interaction network (S$^2$Fin), which integrates pairwise fusion modules across the spatial, spectral, and frequency domains. Specifically, we propose a high-frequency sparse enhancement transformer that employs sparse spatial-spectral attention to optimize the parameters of the high-frequency filter. Subsequently, a two-level spatial-frequency fusion strategy is introduced, comprising an adaptive frequency channel module that fuses low-frequency structures with enhanced high-frequency details, and a high-frequency resonance mask that emphasizes sharp edges via phase similarity. In addition, a spatial-spectral attention fusion module further enhances feature extraction at intermediate layers of the network. Experiments on four benchmark multimodal datasets with limited labeled data demonstrate that S$^2$Fin performs superior classification, outperforming state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/HaoLiu-XDU/SSFin.
papers.journal_ref: Pattern Recognition, Vol. 180, 2026, 114309
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出S$^2$Fin网络，通过空间、光谱和频率域的交互融合模块处理多模态遥感图像分类中的异构冗余特征。核心组件包括高频稀疏增强Transformer、两级空间-频率融合策略（自适应频率通道模块和高频共振掩膜）以及空间-光谱注意力融合模块。在四个多模态基准数据集上，利用有限标注数据实现了优于现有方法的分类性能。
Motivation: 现有特征融合技术难以从异构冗余的多模态遥感图像中同时提取结构特征和细节特征，尤其是高频细节。
Method: 提出S$^2$Fin网络：1）高频稀疏增强Transformer，采用稀疏空间-光谱注意力优化高频滤波器参数；2）两级空间-频率融合策略，包含自适应频率通道模块（融合低频结构与增强高频细节）和高频共振掩膜（通过相位相似性强调尖锐边缘）；3）空间-光谱注意力融合模块增强中间层特征提取。
Result: 在四个多模态基准数据集（标注样本有限）上，S$^2$Fin的分类性能优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 引入频域学习可有效建模关键稀疏细节特征，提升多模态遥感分类效果；代码已开源。

papers.title: How Can Mamba Learn In Context with Outliers and Generalize Provably?
papers.abstract_en: The Mamba model has gained significant attention for its computational advantages over Transformer-based models, while achieving comparable performance across a wide range of language tasks. Like Transformers, Mamba exhibits in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, i.e., making predictions for new tasks based on a prompt containing input-label pairs and a query, without requiring fine-tuning. Despite its empirical success, the theoretical understanding of Mamba remains limited, largely due to the nonlinearity introduced by its gating mechanism. To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents the first theoretical analysis of the training dynamics of a one-layer Mamba model, which consists of a linear attention component followed by a nonlinear gating layer, and its ICL generalization on unseen binary classification tasks, even when the prompt includes additive outliers. Our analysis shows that Mamba leverages the linear attention layer to select informative context examples and uses the nonlinear gating layer to suppress the influence of outliers. By establishing and comparing to the analysis of linear Transformers under the same setting, we show that although Mamba may require more training iterations to converge, it maintains accurate predictions even when the proportion of outliers exceeds the threshold that a linear Transformer can tolerate. These theoretical findings are supported by empirical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对单层Mamba模型（线性注意力+非线性门控）的训练动态和上下文学习（ICL）泛化能力进行理论分析，证明其在存在异常值时仍能保持准确预测，且能容忍比线性Transformer更高的异常值比例。
Motivation: Mamba模型在实际任务中表现优异，但其门控机制引入的非线性导致理论理解不足，缺乏对上下文学习泛化能力的理论保证。
Method: 理论分析单层Mamba的线性注意力层选择和抑制异常值的机制，并与线性Transformer对比，通过训练动态和泛化误差上界证明其鲁棒性。
Result: Mamba需要更多训练迭代收敛，但在异常值比例超过线性Transformer容忍阈值时仍能保持准确预测。
Conclusion: Mamba通过门控机制有效抑制异常值，理论上具备更强的鲁棒性，实验支持理论发现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAGE: Spatial-visual Adaptive Graph Exploration for Efficient Visual Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) requires robust retrieval of geotagged images despite large appearance, viewpoint, and environmental variation. Prior methods focus on descriptor fine-tuning or fixed sampling strategies yet neglect the dynamic interplay between spatial context and visual similarity during training. We present SAGE (Spatial-visual Adaptive Graph Exploration), a unified training pipeline that enhances granular spatial-visual discrimination by jointly improving local feature aggregation, organize samples during training, and hard sample mining. We introduce a lightweight Soft Probing module that learns residual weights from training data for patch descriptors before bilinear aggregation, boosting distinctive local cues. During training we reconstruct an online geo-visual graph that fuses geographic proximity and current visual similarity so that candidate neighborhoods reflect the evolving embedding landscape. To concentrate learning on the most informative place neighborhoods, we seed clusters from high-affinity anchors and iteratively expand them with a greedy weighted clique expansion sampler. Implemented with a frozen DINOv2 backbone and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, SAGE achieves SOTA across eight benchmarks. Notably, our method obtains 100% Recall@10 on SPED only using 4096D global descriptors. The code and model are available at https://github.com/chenshunpeng/SAGE.
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE（Spatial-visual Adaptive Graph Exploration），一种用于视觉地点识别（VPR）的统一训练流程，通过联合改进局部特征聚合、训练样本组织和难例挖掘来增强细粒度空间-视觉判别。方法包括轻量级Soft Probing模块学习残差权重、在线地理-视觉图构建以融合地理邻近性和视觉相似性，以及基于贪心加权团扩展的聚类采样。使用冻结的DINOv2骨干和参数高效微调，在八个基准上达到SOTA，在SPED上以4096D全局描述符取得100% Recall@10。
Motivation: 现有VPR方法侧重于描述符微调或固定采样策略，忽略了训练过程中空间上下文与视觉相似性之间的动态交互，导致判别力不足。
Method: 提出SAGE流程，包含：1）Soft Probing模块学习残差权重增强局部特征；2）在线地理-视觉图融合地理邻近性和当前视觉相似性；3）基于高亲和力锚点簇和贪心加权团扩展的难例采样器。
Result: 在八个基准上达到SOTA，其中SPED数据集上Recall@10=100%（使用4096D全局描述符）。
Conclusion: SAGE通过自适应图探索有效提升了视觉地点识别的性能，代码和模型已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Reduced NEXI protocol for the quantification of human gray matter microstructure on the Connectome 2.0 scanner
papers.abstract_en: Biophysical diffusion MRI models like Neurite Exchange Imaging (NEXI) are essential for probing gray matter microstructure, estimating compartment diffusivities, neurite fraction, and exchange time. However, NEXI's multi-shell, multi-diffusion-time requirements cause prohibitively long acquisitions. Leveraging the Connectome 2.0 ultra-high gradient scanner, we developed a time-efficient protocol using an Explainable AI (XAI) framework. Combining XGBoost, SHAP, and Recursive Feature Elimination trained on synthetic signals, XAI identified an optimal 8-feature subset, cutting scan time from 27 to 14 minutes. Validated in vivo in seven healthy participants, the XAI protocol was benchmarked against the full 15-feature acquisition, a Cram'er-Rao Lower Bound (CRLB) theoretical optimum, and two heuristics ("Mid-Range" and "Corner"). It robustly reproduced parameter estimates and maintained test-retest reproducibility. Remarkably, the XAI selection converged to the CRLB optimum. This validates XAI's optimality while highlighting its main advantage: achieving gold-standard optimization without complex analytical Jacobians, making it easily adaptable to numerical models or complex noise where CRLB is intractable. Furthermore, XAI showed superior in vivo robustness over heuristics: "Mid-Range" sampling yielded biased exchange time estimates from insufficient temporal diversity, while "Corner" sampling gave unstable intra-neurite diffusivity estimates (5-fold higher CV) due to noise sensitivity. Ultimately, this robust 14-minute protocol accelerates exchange-sensitive microstructural mapping, establishing a model-agnostic optimization framework adaptable to future ultra-high gradient systems and existing clinical scanners.
papers.comment: Submitted to Imaging Neuroscience. This all-in-one version includes supplementary materials. 34 pages, 145 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于可解释人工智能（XAI）框架的简化NEXI扩散MRI协议，将灰度质微观结构参数采集时间从27分钟缩短至14分钟。在Connectome 2.0超高梯度扫描仪上，利用XGBoost、SHAP和递归特征消除从合成信号中筛选出最优8特征子集，体内验证表明该协议能鲁棒复现全15特征采集的参数估计，且测试-重测可重复性良好。XAI选择与Cramér-Rao下界（CRLB）理论最优一致，验证了其最优性。
Motivation: 标准NEXI模型需要多壳层、多扩散时间采集，扫描时间过长（27分钟），难以在临床或大规模研究中应用，亟需在不牺牲参数估计质量的前提下缩短采集时间。
Method: 采用XAI框架，基于XGBoost回归模型、SHAP特征重要性分析和递归特征消除（RFE），在合成扩散信号数据上训练并筛选出对参数估计最有贡献的8个特征（b值、扩散时间组合），形成优化扫描协议。
Result: 优化协议将扫描时间从27分钟降至14分钟；体内7名健康志愿者验证表明，参数估计与全特征采集高度一致，且测试-重测可重复性相当；XAI选择与CRLB理论最优特征集完全一致，优于启发式策略（Mid-Range和Corner）——Mid-Range导致交换时间估计偏差，Corner导致神经内扩散率估计变异系数增加5倍。
Conclusion: XAI框架成功实现了NEXI协议的高效优化，无需复杂雅可比矩阵推导，可轻松适配其他数值模型或CRLB难解场景；该14分钟协议加速了交换敏感的微观结构成像，并为未来超高梯度系统和现有临床扫描仪提供了模型无关的优化框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sparse but Wrong: Incorrect L0 Leads to Incorrect Features in Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) extract features from LLM internal activations, meant to correspond to interpretable concepts. A core SAE training hyperparameter is L0: how many SAE features should fire per token on average. Existing work compares SAE algorithms using sparsity-reconstruction tradeoff plots, implying L0 is a free parameter with no inherently correct value aside from its effect on reconstruction. In this work we study the effect of L0 on SAEs, and show that if L0 is not set correctly, the SAE fails to disentangle the underlying features of the LLM. If L0 is too low, the SAE will mix correlated features to improve reconstruction. If L0 is too high, the SAE finds degenerate solutions that also mix features. Further, we present a proxy metric that can help guide the search for the correct L0 for an SAE on a given training distribution. We show that our method finds the correct L0 in toy models and coincides with peak sparse probing performance in LLM SAEs. We find that most commonly used SAEs have an L0 that is too low. Our work shows that practitioners must set L0 correctly to train SAEs with monosemantic features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）中L0超参数的影响。发现如果L0设置不当（过低或过高），SAE无法正确解缠LLM内部特征，导致特征混合。作者提出一个代理指标来引导L0搜索，在玩具模型和LLM SAE上验证了有效性，并指出大多数常用SAE的L0偏低。
Motivation: 现有工作将L0视为自由参数，只关注稀疏-重建权衡，但未研究L0对特征解缠性的影响。本文揭示L0错误设置会导致SAE学到不正确特征，纠正了这一认知空白。
Method: 通过实验分析L0对SAE特征解缠的影响，提出一个代理指标（未在摘要中详细说明）来帮助选择正确的L0，并在玩具模型和真实LLM SAE上验证该指标与稀疏探测性能峰值的一致性。
Result: 当L0过低时，SAE混合相关特征以改善重建；当L0过高时，SAE找到退化解同样混合特征。代理指标能在玩具模型中找到正确L0，且与LLM SAE的稀疏探测性能峰值一致。多数常用SAE的L0偏低。
Conclusion: 正确设置L0是训练具有单语义特征SAE的必要条件，否则SAE无法解缠底层特征。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 通过实验分析L0对SAE特征解缠的影响，提出一个代理指标（未在摘要中详细说明）来帮助选择正确的L0，并在玩具模型和真实LLM SAE上验证该指标与稀疏探测性能峰值的一致性。
summary_sections.result: 当L0过低时，SAE混合相关特征以改善重建；当L0过高时，SAE找到退化解同样混合特征。代理指标能在玩具模型中找到正确L0，且与LLM SAE的稀疏探测性能峰值一致。多数常用SAE的L0偏低。
summary_sections.conclusion: 正确设置L0是训练具有单语义特征SAE的必要条件，否则SAE无法解缠底层特征。

papers.title: Unequal Uncertainty: Rethinking Algorithmic Interventions for Mitigating Discrimination from AI
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty in artificial intelligence (AI) predictions raises pressing legal and ethical questions for AI-assisted decision-making. This article examines two uncertainty-based algorithmic interventions that act as guardrails for human-AI interaction: selective abstention, which withholds high-uncertainty predictions from human decision-makers, and selective friction, which presents such predictions together with salient warnings about the model's uncertainty. Prior work suggests that uncertainty-based abstention can exacerbate disparities where under-represented groups are more likely to receive uncertain predictions. We provide, to our knowledge, the first doctrinal analysis of uncertainty-based algorithmic interventions under laws from the United Kingdom and examine their consequences through two AI-assisted case studies: consumer credit and risk of reoffending. We show that the use of uncertainty thresholds, though formally neutral, can generate discriminatory effects. We argue that both interventions pose risks of unlawful discrimination, but that selective friction is legally preferable. It preserves access to the prediction and is more likely to satisfy proportionality under the Equality Act 2010. Whether selective friction also improves decision quality in practice is uncertain. We identify conditions under which it may improve or worsen decision quality.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 5th European Conference on Algorithmic Fairness (ECAF 2026). To appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从英国法律角度分析两种基于不确定性的算法干预措施（选择性弃权和选择性摩擦）在AI辅助决策中的歧视风险，以消费者信贷和再犯风险评估为例，指出虽然两者都可能构成非法歧视，但选择性摩擦在法律上更可取。
Motivation: 现有研究表明基于不确定性的弃权可能加剧对弱势群体的歧视，但缺乏法律层面的系统分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，为算法公平性提供法律依据。
Method: 采用英国法律（特别是2010年平等法）的教义分析，结合两个AI辅助决策案例（消费者信贷和再犯风险），比较选择性弃权与选择性摩擦的歧视风险与法律合规性。
Result: 发现尽管不确定性阈值形式上中立，但可能产生歧视性效果；选择性摩擦因保留预测结果并满足比例原则，在法律上优于选择性弃权，但其对决策质量的影响不确定。
Conclusion: 两种算法干预措施均存在非法歧视风险，但选择性摩擦在法律上更可接受；实际决策质量的改进需要进一步研究条件。

papers.title: Imbalance-Robust and Sampling-Efficient Continuous Conditional GANs via Adaptive Vicinal Learning and Auxiliary Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in continuous conditional generative modeling, including Continuous conditional Generative Adversarial Network (CcGAN) and Continuous Conditional Diffusion Model (CCDM), estimate high-dimensional data distributions conditioned on scalar regression labels such as angles, ages, or temperatures. However, fixed-size vicinal training in CcGAN can be sensitive to non-uniform label densities, whereas CCDM relies on computationally expensive iterative sampling. To address these issues, we propose CcGAN-AVAR, an imbalance-aware extension of CcGAN that combines soft/hybrid adaptive vicinity with auxiliary discriminator-guided regularization. The adaptive vicinity constructs a label-dependent local radius according to the available samples around each target condition, and the multi-task discriminator supplies both a regression signal for label consistency and a density-ratio-estimation signal for distribution matching. We further provide a theoretical interpretation characterizing how adaptive vicinal weighting affects the local bias-variance behavior of the discriminator target, how hybrid truncation reduces objective-level cross-condition mixing, and how the density-ratio-based generator penalty approximates a Pearson Chi-square discrepancy up to the estimation error of the density-ratio branch. Extensive experiments on four datasets, including the newly constructed imbalanced RC-49-I, covering resolutions from 64x64 to 256x256 across eleven settings, demonstrate that CcGAN-AVAR obtains strong generation quality and label consistency while preserving the one-step sampling efficiency of GANs, achieving 300x--2000x faster inference than CCDM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CcGAN-AVAR，一种针对连续条件生成对抗网络（CcGAN）的改进方法，通过自适应邻域学习和辅助判别器正则化来处理标签密度不均衡问题，同时保持单步采样效率。在四个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在生成质量和标签一致性上优于基线，推理速度比 CCDM 快 300-2000 倍。
Motivation: 现有 CcGAN 使用固定尺寸邻域训练，对非均匀标签密度敏感；而 CCDM 依赖计算昂贵的迭代采样。需要一种平衡不平衡标签鲁棒性和采样效率的方法。
Method: 结合软/混合自适应邻域（根据目标条件周围样本调整局部半径）和辅助判别器引导的正则化（多任务判别器同时提供回归信号和密度比估计），并从理论上分析自适应邻域加权对局部偏差-方差的影响、混合截断如何减少目标级跨条件混合，以及密度比生成器惩罚近似 Pearson Chi-square 散度。
Result: 在四个数据集（包括新构建的不平衡 RC-49-I）上的 11 种设置（64×64 到 256×256 分辨率）中，CcGAN-AVAR 获得了强生成质量和标签一致性，推理速度是 CCDM 的 300-2000 倍。
Conclusion: 该方法在不牺牲 GAN 单步采样效率的前提下，有效处理了非均匀标签密度，理论分析揭示了自适应邻域和密度比正则化的作用机制。

papers.title: Platonic Representations for Poverty Mapping: Unified Vision-Language Codes or Agent-Induced Novelty?
papers.abstract_en: We investigate whether socioeconomic indicators, like household wealth, leave recoverable informational imprints in both satellite imagery (capturing features like buildings and roads) and Internet-sourced text (reflecting historical, cultural, and narratives of neighborhoods). Using DHS data from African neighborhoods (clusters), we pair high-resolution Landsat images with textual descriptions generated by LLMs conditioned on location/year, plus text retrieved by an LLM-driven AI Search Agent from web sources. We develop a multimodal framework that predicts household wealth (International Wealth Index; IWI) via five pipelines: (i) a vision model on satellite images, (ii) an LLM using only location and year, (iii) an AI agent that searches and synthesizes web text, (iv) a joint image-text encoder, and (v) an ensemble of all signals. Our framework yields three contributions. First, evaluations show that fusing vision and agent/LLM-generated text improves on vision-only baselines in wealth prediction (e.g., R-squared of 0.77 vs. 0.63 on out-of-sample splits), with LLM-internal knowledge (artificial neural memory) proving surprisingly predictive in out-of-country/time generalization. Second, we find suggestive evidence of partial representational alignment: fused embeddings from vision and language modalities correlate moderately (median cosine similarity across modalities of about 0.60 after alignment). This pattern is broadly consistent with the Platonic Representation Hypothesis, but does not by itself establish convergence to a single shared latent representation. Because agent-retrieved data yields only marginal and unstable gains across splits, our evidence for the Agent-Induced Novelty Hypothesis is limited. Third, we release a large-scale multimodal dataset of about 60,000 DHS clusters, each linked to satellite images, LLM-generated descriptions, and AI-agent-retrieved texts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用非洲地区的DHS数据，结合卫星图像和LLM生成的文本（包括AI agent检索的网页文本），构建多模态框架预测家庭财富指数（IWI）。摘要报告融合视觉和语言信息后，R平方从0.63提升至0.77，但AI agent检索带来的增益有限。论文还释放了约6万DHS集群的多模态数据集。
Motivation: 探索社会经济指标（如家庭财富）是否在卫星图像和互联网文本中留下可恢复的信息印记，并检验多模态融合能否提升贫困映射的预测性能。
Method: 使用Landsat卫星图像、基于位置/年份由LLM生成的文本描述，以及AI agent从网络检索的文本，构建五种预测流水线：视觉模型、仅位置年份的LLM、AI agent检索文本、图像-文本联合编码器，以及所有信号的集成。
Result: 融合视觉和agent/LLM生成的文本相比纯视觉基线提升了财富预测的R平方（0.77 vs. 0.63），且LLM内部知识在跨国家/时间泛化中表现惊人。多模态嵌入对齐后的余弦相似度中位数约0.60，部分支持柏拉图表示假说，但agent检索数据仅带来微小且不稳定的增益。
Conclusion: 融合卫星图像和语言模型文本可显著改进贫困映射，但AI agent检索的边际增益有限；多模态表示存在部分对齐，但未形成单一共享潜在表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Detoxify: A framework for abusive text transformation using LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant advancements in natural language processing tasks, their effectiveness in the classification and transformation of abusive text into non-abusive versions remains an area for exploration. In this study, we present Detoxify: a framework that employs LLMs to transform abusive text (tweets and reviews) containing hate speech and profanity into non-abusive text while retaining the original intent. We evaluate the performance of four state-of-the-art LLMs, such as Gemini, GPT-4o, DeekSeek and Groq, on their ability to identify abusive text. We aim to transform and obtain a text that is clean of abusive and inappropriate content, but maintains a similar level of sentiment and semantics, i.e. the transformed text needs to maintain its message. Afterwards, we evaluate the raw and transformed datasets with sentiment analysis and semantic analysis. Our results show Groq provides vastly different results when compared with other LLMs. We have identified similarities between GPT-4o and DeepSeek. Groq stood out as the most distinct, as it often restructured sentences with excessive positive phrasing, with the original context lost or altered.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Detoxify 框架，利用 LLM 将包含仇恨言论和脏话的 abusive 文本（推文和评论）转化为无 abusive 内容但保留原始意图的文本。评估了 Gemini、GPT-4o、DeepSeek 和 Groq 四个模型，发现 Groq 的结果与其他模型差异显著，倾向于过度正面措辞，导致原始语境丢失或改变。
Motivation: 尽管 LLM 在 NLP 任务中取得了进展，但在 abusive 文本分类和转化为非 abusive 版本方面的有效性仍需探索。
Method: 采用四个 SOTA LLM（Gemini、GPT-4o、DeepSeek、Groq）对 abusive 文本进行转化，并通过情感分析和语义分析对比原始和转化后的数据集。
Result: Groq 与其他 LLM 结果差异巨大，常重构句子并添加过多正面化措辞，改变原始语境；GPT-4o 与 DeepSeek 表现相似。
Conclusion: Detoxify 框架可有效转化 abusive 文本，但不同 LLM 在保留语义方面存在显著差异，需谨慎选择模型。

papers.title: Learning The Minimum Action Distance
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a state representation framework for Markov decision processes (MDPs) that can be learned solely from state trajectories, requiring neither reward signals nor the actions executed by the agent. We propose learning the minimum action distance (MAD), defined as the minimum number of actions required to transition between states, as a fundamental metric that captures the underlying structure of an environment. MAD naturally enables critical downstream tasks such as goal-conditioned reinforcement learning and reward shaping by providing a dense, geometrically meaningful measure of progress. Our self-supervised learning approach constructs an embedding space where the distances between embedded state pairs correspond to their MAD, accommodating both symmetric and asymmetric approximations. We evaluate the framework on a comprehensive suite of environments with known MAD values, encompassing both deterministic and stochastic dynamics, as well as discrete and continuous state spaces, and environments with noisy observations. Empirical results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only efficiently learns accurate MAD representations across these diverse settings but also significantly outperforms existing state representation methods in terms of representation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅从状态轨迹学习马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）状态表示的框架，无需奖励信号或动作信息。核心是学习最小动作距离（MAD），即状态间转移所需的最小动作数，作为捕捉环境结构的度量。该方法通过自监督学习构建嵌入空间，使嵌入距离对应MAD，并支持对称与非对称近似。实验在已知MAD的多种环境（确定性/随机、离散/连续、含噪声观测）中验证，该方法能高效学习准确的MAD表示，并且在表示质量上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有MDP状态表示方法通常需要奖励或动作信息，限制了在缺乏这些信号时的应用。目标是设计一种仅依赖状态轨迹的表示学习方法，以捕获环境的底层结构。
Method: 提出最小动作距离（MAD）作为状态间距离度量，并设计自监督学习框架，通过神经网络将状态映射到嵌入空间，使得嵌入距离近似MAD。框架同时支持对称和不对称距离学习。
Result: 在多个已知MAD的基准环境（包括确定性/随机、离散/连续状态空间、噪声观测）中，该方法准确学习MAD，并在表示质量指标上显著优于现有状态表示方法。
Conclusion: 该工作表明MAD是一种有效的自监督学习信号，可用于下游任务如目标条件强化学习和奖励塑形，且仅需状态轨迹即可学习。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作表明MAD是一种有效的自监督学习信号，可用于下游任务如目标条件强化学习和奖励塑形，且仅需状态轨迹即可学习。

papers.title: Position: EU AI Act's Research Exemptions Can Break the Publication Norms of Major AI Conferences
papers.abstract_en: The EU has become one of the vanguards in regulating the digital age. A particularly important regulation in the Artificial Intelligence (AI) domain is the 2024 enacted EU AI Act. The AI Act specifies -- due to a risk-based approach -- various obligations for providers of AI systems. These obligations, for example, include a cascade of documentation and compliance measures, which represent a potential obstacle to science. But do these obligations also apply to AI researchers? This position paper argues that, indeed, the AI Act's obligations could apply in many more cases than the AI community is aware of. Moreover, we argue that the AI Act is drafted in a manner that may unwillingly disrupt the scientific publication practices of the AI research community, with a focus on model and system release. We contribute the following: 1. We offer a high-level roadmap for AI researchers to evaluate whether they need to comply with the AI Act 2. We explain with everyday research examples why the AI Act applies to AI research. 3. We analyse the exceptions of the AI Act's applicability AI research and offer visual tool for researchers to navigate the AI Act's complex system or research exceptions 4. We establish a position the AI Act's research exceptions fail to account for current AI research conventions, as publishing AI research may void the research exceptions of the Act. 5. We propose changes to the AI Act to provide more legal certainty for AI researchers and give two recommendations for AI researchers to reduce the risk of not complying with the AI Act. We see our paper as a starting point for a discussion between policymakers, legal scholars, and AI researchers to avoid unintended side effects of the AI Act.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，认为欧盟AI法案（EU AI Act）的义务可能比AI社区意识到的更广泛地适用于AI研究，并且该法案的起草方式可能无意中破坏AI研究社区的出版物规范，特别是模型和系统的发布。作者提供了研究人员评估合规性的路线图，分析了研究豁免的不足，并提出了修改建议。
Motivation: 欧盟AI法案对AI系统提供商施加了文档和合规义务，这些义务可能阻碍科学研究。作者旨在指出法案对AI研究的意外影响，并推动政策制定者、法律学者和AI研究人员之间的讨论。
Method: 通过分析法案文本和研究场景，提供合规性评估路线图、研究实例说明、研究豁免的可视化工具，并建立立场：当前的研究豁免未能考虑AI研究的出版惯例，因为出版可能使豁免失效。
Result: 作者认为AI法案的义务在比社区意识到的更多案例中适用，且研究豁免可能因出版而被取消，从而破坏AI社区的出版物规范。
Conclusion: 本文呼吁对AI法案进行修改以提供法律确定性，并给AI研究人员提供降低合规风险的建议。

papers.title: Temporal Variational Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Temporal Variational Implicit Neural Representations (TV-INRs), a probabilistic framework for modeling irregular multivariate time series that enables efficient and accurate individualized imputation and forecasting. By integrating implicit neural representations with latent variable models, TV-INRs learn distributions over time-continuous generator functions conditioned on signal-specific covariates. Unlike existing INR approaches that require extensive training, fine-tuning or meta-learning, our method achieves accurate individualized predictions through a single forward pass. Our experiments demonstrate that with a single TV-INRs instance, we can accurately solve diverse imputation and forecasting tasks, offering a computationally efficient and scalable solution for real-world applications. TV-INRs performs particularly well in low-data regimes, where on several datasets it achieves substantially lower imputation error, including order-of-magnitude improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Temporal Variational Implicit Neural Representations (TV-INRs)，一个用于不规则多变量时间序列的概率框架，通过单次前向传播实现高效准确的个体化插补和预测。实验表明，TV-INRs 在低数据场景下表现优异，插补误差可降低一个数量级。
Motivation: 现有隐式神经表示 (INR) 方法需要大量训练、微调或元学习，难以高效处理不规则时间序列的个体化预测任务。
Method: 将隐式神经表示与潜在变量模型结合，学习依赖于信号协变量的时间连续生成函数的分布，并通过单次前向传播进行预测。
Result: 在多个数据集上，TV-INRs 在低数据场景下显著降低插补误差，包括数量级改进。
Conclusion: TV-INRs 提供了一种计算高效且可扩展的解决方案，适用于实际不规则时间序列的插补和预测。

papers.title: Freqformer: Image-Demoiréing Transformer via Effective Frequency Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Image demoiréing remains a challenging task due to the complex interplay between texture corruption and color distortions caused by moiré patterns. Existing methods, especially those relying on direct image-to-image restoration, often fail to disentangle these intertwined artifacts effectively. While frequency-aware approaches offer a promising direction, their potential is hindered by the discrete transform (e.g., Haar wavelet or block-based DCT), which may suffer from spatial discontinuity, channel redundancy, and further cause error accumulation during their fixed inverse processes. In this paper, we present Freqformer, a Transformer-based framework specifically designed for image demoiréing through targeted frequency separation. Our method performs an effective frequency decomposition that splits moiré patterns into high-frequency spatially-localized textures and low-frequency scale-robust color distortions, which are then handled by a dual-branch architecture and an asymmetric training scheme tailored to their distinct characteristics. We further propose a learnable Frequency Composition Transform (FCT) module to adaptively fuse the frequency-specific outputs, enabling consistent and high-fidelity reconstruction. To better aggregate the spatial dependencies and the inter-channel complementary information, we introduce a Spatial-Aware Channel Attention (SA-CA) module that refines moiré-sensitive regions without incurring high computational cost. Extensive experiments on various demoiréing benchmarks demonstrate that Freqformer achieves state-of-the-art performance with a compact model size. The code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/xyLiu339/Freqformer.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/xyLiu339/Freqformer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Freqformer，一种基于 Transformer 的图像去摩尔纹框架，通过有效频率分解将摩尔纹拆解为高频空间纹理和低频颜色失真，并利用双分支架构与非对称训练分别处理。进一步提出可学习的频率组合变换（FCT）模块自适应融合频率特定输出，以及空间感知通道注意力（SA-CA）模块优化摩尔纹敏感区域。在多个去摩尔纹基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，且模型紧凑。
Motivation: 现有图像去摩尔纹方法难以有效分离纹理损坏与颜色失真，而频率感知方法受限于离散变换（如 Haar 小波、块 DCT）的空间不连续性和通道冗余，导致误差累积。
Method: 提出有效频率分解将摩尔纹分为高频空间纹理和低频颜色失真，采用双分支架构与非对称训练分别处理；设计可学习的频率组合变换（FCT）模块自适应融合输出；引入空间感知通道注意力（SA-CA）模块以低计算成本增强摩尔纹敏感区域。
Result: 在多个去摩尔纹基准上，Freqformer 以紧凑模型尺寸取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: Freqformer 通过频率分离和自适应融合有效应对去摩尔纹挑战，但文中未提及泛化性至其他图像复原任务或计算开销的详细分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explainable embeddings with Distance Explainer
papers.abstract_en: While eXplainable AI (XAI) has advanced significantly, few methods address interpretability in embedded vector spaces where dimensions represent complex abstractions. We introduce Distance Explainer, a novel method for generating local, post-hoc explanations of embedded spaces in machine learning models. Our approach adapts saliency-based techniques from RISE to explain the distance between two embedded data points by assigning attribution values through selective masking and distance-ranked mask filtering. We evaluate Distance Explainer on cross-modal embeddings (image-image and image-caption pairs) using established XAI metrics including Faithfulness, Sensitivity/Robustness, and Randomization. Experiments with ImageNet and CLIP models demonstrate that our method effectively identifies features contributing to similarity or dissimilarity between embedded data points while maintaining high robustness and consistency. We also explore how parameter tuning, particularly mask quantity and selection strategy, affects explanation quality. This work addresses a critical gap in XAI research and enhances transparency and trustworthiness in deep learning applications utilizing embedded spaces.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 12 figures. Accepted to the 4th World Conference on eXplainable Artificial Intelligence. Method implementation: https://research-software-directory.org/software/distance-explainer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Distance Explainer，一种用于解释嵌入空间中数据点间距离的局部后验可解释性方法。该方法基于 RISE 的显著性技术，通过选择性掩蔽和距离排序掩蔽过滤来分配归因值。在 ImageNet 和 CLIP 模型上的跨模态嵌入（图像-图像和图像-文本对）实验中，使用忠实度、敏感性/鲁棒性和随机化等 XAI 指标进行了评估，结果表明该方法能有效识别影响相似性或差异性的特征。
Motivation: 现有可解释 AI 方法很少关注嵌入向量空间的可解释性，而该空间中的维度代表复杂抽象，因此需要一种方法来解释嵌入空间中数据点之间的距离。
Method: 提出 Distance Explainer，通过选择性掩蔽和距离排序掩蔽过滤，将 RISE 的显著性技术扩展到解释两个嵌入数据点之间的距离。
Result: 在 ImageNet 和 CLIP 模型上的实验表明，该方法能有效识别影响嵌入数据点相似性或差异性的特征，并在忠实度、鲁棒性和一致性方面表现良好。
Conclusion: 该方法填补了嵌入空间可解释性的空白，并增强了利用嵌入空间的深度学习应用的透明度和可信度。

papers.title: Regularity and Stability Properties of Selective SSMs with Discontinuous Gating
papers.abstract_en: Selective State-Space Models (SSMs) such as Mamba have become central to long-sequence modeling. Still, their stability is poorly understood: their state-space coefficients are modulated online by a token-dependent gating signal, making the recurrence neither linear time-invariant nor classically nonlinear. We study continuous-time selective SSMs through passivity, dissipativity, and Input-to-State Stability (ISS), explicitly separating the selection signal $x(\cdot)$ from the driving input $u(\cdot)$. We obtain four results: exponential forgetting under strict dissipativity; a canonical $\mathrm{AUC}_{\mathrm{loc}}$ quadratic storage for the frozen-selection subsystem that accommodates discontinuous gating; a parametric LMI together with universal kernel constraints and "irreversible forgetting" under universal quadratic storage; and sufficient conditions for global ISS uniformly over admissible selection schedules. We then bridge to practice by deriving a sampled block LMI for the Mamba selective-scan core, which is used as a differentiable training-time regularizer. Across seven standard time-series datasets and four prediction horizons, the regularizer reduces sampled Mamba-core LMI violations by roughly $92\%$ in $28/28$ pairs at a clean-MSE cost of less than $0.018\%$. It improves internal Mamba passivity and state-norm diagnostics under injected perturbations. Our results turn classical control-theoretic tools into verifiable structural and training criteria for selective SSMs, while honestly scoping which guarantees transfer to a deep selective-scan architecture.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从控制理论角度研究选择性状态空间模型（如Mamba）的稳定性，通过无源性、耗散性和输入-状态稳定性（ISS）分析，分离选择信号与驱动输入。主要结果包括：严格耗散性下的指数遗忘、适用于不连续门控的冻结选择子系统的规范二次存储、参数化LMI与通用核约束下的不可逆遗忘，以及全局ISS的充分条件。在此基础上，推导出Mamba选择性扫描核心的采样块LMI作为可微训练正则化器。在七个时间序列数据集和四个预测范围上，正则化器将LMI违反减少约92%，MSE成本低于0.018%。
Motivation: 选择性SSM（如Mamba）在长序列建模中表现优异，但其稳定性理解不足，因为其状态空间系数由令牌依赖的门控信号在线调制，既不是线性时不变也不是经典非线性。
Method: 采用无源性、耗散性和ISS分析连续时间选择性SSM，明确分离选择信号与驱动输入；推导Mamba选择性扫描核心的采样块LMI作为可微训练正则化器。
Result: 在七个标准时间序列数据集和四个预测范围上，正则化器将Mamba核心LMI违反减少约92%，MSE成本低于0.018%，并改善内部无源性和状态范数诊断。
Conclusion: 本文将经典控制理论工具转化为选择性SSM的可验证结构性和训练条件，同时诚实地评估哪些保证能迁移到深度选择性扫描架构。

papers.title: Leveraging Neural Graph Compilers in Machine Learning Research for Edge-Cloud Systems
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a comprehensive evaluation of neural network graph compilers across heterogeneous hardware platforms, addressing the critical gap between theoretical optimization techniques and practical deployment scenarios. We demonstrate how vendor-specific optimizations can invalidate relative performance comparisons between architectural archetypes, with performance advantages sometimes completely reversing after compilation. Our systematic analysis reveals that graph compilers exhibit performance patterns highly dependent on both neural architecture and batch sizes. Through fine-grained block-level experimentation, we establish that vendor-specific compilers can leverage repeated patterns in simple architectures, yielding disproportionate throughput gains as model depth increases. We introduce novel metrics to quantify a compiler's ability to mitigate performance friction as batch size increases. Our methodology bridges the gap between academic research and practical deployment by incorporating compiler effects throughout the research process, providing actionable insights for practitioners navigating complex optimization landscapes across heterogeneous hardware environments.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文全面评估了神经网络图编译器在异构硬件平台上的性能，发现供应商特定优化可能显著改变不同架构之间的相对性能比较。通过细粒度块级实验，表明图编译器性能高度依赖于神经网络架构和批大小，并提出了新的指标来量化编译器缓解性能摩擦的能力。
Motivation: 现有研究在理论优化技术与实际部署场景之间存在差距，缺乏对图编译器在不同硬件上系统性的性能评估，尤其是供应商特定优化对性能比较的影响。
Method: 通过全系统基准测试和细粒度块级实验，分析多个图编译器（如XLA、TVM等）在不同神经网络架构和批大小下的性能表现，并引入新指标量化编译器对批大小增加引起的性能摩擦的缓解能力。
Result: 实验表明，供应商特定优化可使不同架构的性能优势在编译后完全反转，且编译器性能高度依赖网络深度和批大小；简单架构中重复模式可带来不成比例的吞吐量增益。
Conclusion: 图编译器效应应纳入研究全流程，以弥合学术研究与实际部署的差距；提出的指标和方法为异构硬件环境中的优化提供了可操作见解。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Toward AI standardization: A triadic human-ai collaboration framework for multi-level autonomous mobility
papers.abstract_en: The goal of the current study is to introduce a triadic human-AI collaboration framework that could be applied in transportation systems such as automated vehicles, micromobility systems, and vehicle teleoperation. Previous standards, such as SAE Levels of Automation, have focused on defining automation levels based on who controls the vehicle. However, it is still not clear how human users and AI should collaborate in real time, especially in dynamic driving contexts where roles can shift frequently. To fill this gap, this study proposed a triadic human-AI collaboration framework with three AI roles: Advisor, Co-Pilot, and Guardian. These roles can dynamically adapt to human needs based on real-time data, such as mental states and environmental conditions. The Advisor AI offers informational support without direct intervention. The Co-Pilot AI provides partial intervention when needed, with the goal of sharing control with humans. The Guardian AI performs emergency overrides if necessary. The use cases for these AI roles in micromobility devices, such as e-scooters, are presented to demonstrate how these roles can influence user preferences and trust. Overall, the study takes a first step toward a universal role-based collaborative framework for AI standardization and explores how AI technologies can be embedded in future transportation systems while considering human interactions.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个三元人类-AI协作框架，定义AI的三个角色（顾问、副驾驶、守护者），可根据实时数据动态适应人类需求，应用于无人驾驶车辆、微移动系统和远程操作等交通场景。基于SAE自动化等级标准的不足，强调在动态驾驶环境中人类与AI的实时角色切换。通过电动滑板车用例展示不同角色对用户偏好和信任的影响。
Motivation: 现有SAE自动化等级标准仅基于谁控制车辆来定义自动化级别，未能明确人类用户与AI如何在动态驾驶环境中实时协作，尤其在角色频繁切换的场景下存在空白。
Method: 提出三元人类-AI协作框架，包含三个AI角色：Advisor（提供信息支持，不直接干预）、Co-Pilot（需要时部分干预，共享控制）、Guardian（必要时紧急接管）。角色根据实时数据（如心理状态、环境条件）动态调整。
Result: 以电动滑板车为例展示了不同AI角色如何影响用户偏好和信任，表明该框架可应用于微移动设备等场景。
Conclusion: 该研究为AI标准化提供了一个通用基于角色的协作框架的初步步骤，探讨了在考虑人类交互的情况下将AI技术嵌入未来交通系统的方式。

papers.title: HERB: Human-augmented Efficient Reinforcement learning for Bin-packing
papers.abstract_en: Packing objects efficiently is a fundamental problem in logistics, warehouse automation, and robotics. When dealing with highly diverse 3D objects (household or grocery items), closed-form solutions are infeasible, and heuristic or model-free Reinforcement Learning~(RL) methods tend to focus solely on geometric optimization, relying on exhaustive searches of the discretized solution space. This leads to long training times (for pure RL) and high latency (heuristics), limited transferability to robotic scenarios, and ultimately ignores object characteristics (fragility, deformability) and human preferences. We propose HERB, a human-augmented RL framework for packing irregular objects, the first to explore the potential of learning from human demonstrations to solve this complex task. It leverages human demonstrations of packing strategies, which inherently exhibit latent factors such as space optimization, stability, and object properties that are difficult to model explicitly. The human-expert data is combined with RL exploration to provide the placement of each object inside the container. Experimental results show that our method outperforms heuristic, purely RL-based, and imitation learning approaches in packing efficiency and latency. Qualitative results highlight that our packing strategy produces more stable, human-like arrangements, which we expect to be more appropriate and widely accepted. Finally, we demonstrate the real-world feasibility of our method on a robotic system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HERB，一个结合人类演示和强化学习的框架，用于不规则物体的装箱。它利用人类专家的演示数据来隐式编码空间优化、稳定性和物体属性，并与 RL 探索结合来放置物体。实验表明在装箱效率和延迟上优于启发式、纯 RL 和模仿学习方法，并产生更稳定、更人性化的排列。
Motivation: 现有方法要么依赖启发式或纯 RL 但训练耗时、延迟高，且忽略物体特性和人类偏好；要么仅关注几何优化。需要一种能利用人类知识的方法。
Method: 提出 HERB 框架，从人类演示中学习装箱策略，结合 RL 探索来放置物体，首次探索从人类演示中学习以解决不规则物体装箱任务。
Result: 实验证明方法在装箱效率和延迟上优于启发式、纯 RL 和模仿学习方法，产生更稳定、更人性化的排列，并在机器人系统上验证了可行性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调人类演示结合 RL 可以高效解决不规则物体装箱问题，产生更可接受的排列，并有望广泛应用于物流和机器人。

papers.title: Benign Overfitting with Quantum Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Kernel methods compare inputs through feature maps. Quantum kernels follow the same principle: input data are encoded into quantum states, which define quantum feature representations in Hilbert spaces. Kernel values are then obtained by estimating inner products between these states using suitable quantum circuit measurements. As a result, quantum kernels may be intractable to compute classically while remaining efficiently computable on quantum hardware, potentially leading to a quantum advantage. However, designing effective quantum kernels remains a major challenge. Many quantum kernels, such as the fidelity kernel, suffer from exponential concentration. This results in near-identity kernel matrices that fail to capture meaningful data correlations and lead to overfitting and poor generalization. In this paper, we propose a novel strategy for constructing quantum kernels that achieve good generalization performance, drawing inspiration from benign overfitting in classical machine learning. We introduce the concept of Local-Global quantum kernels, which combine two components: a local quantum kernel based on measurements of small subsystems, and a global quantum kernel derived from full-system measurements. To support the effectiveness of the proposed construction, we show theoretically and empirically that Local-Global quantum kernels exhibit benign overfitting.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对量子核设计中指数浓度导致过拟合和泛化差的问题，提出Local-Global量子核，结合局部和全局量子测量的核函数。理论和实验表明所提量子核展现出良性过拟合（benign overfitting）特性，为量子核的有效设计提供了新思路。
Motivation: 许多量子核如fidelity kernel存在指数浓度问题，导致核矩阵接近单位矩阵，无法捕捉数据关联，从而引起过拟合和泛化性能下降。设计有效的量子核是当前主要挑战。
Method: 提出Local-Global量子核，由两部分组成：基于小子系统测量的局部量子核和基于全系统测量的全局量子核，两者结合以平衡表示能力与泛化。
Result: 理论分析和实验结果表明，Local-Global量子核表现出良性过拟合行为，即在达到零训练误差的同时仍能保持良好泛化性能。
Conclusion: 该构造为克服量子核的指数浓度问题提供了可行方案，证实了良性过拟合在量子核中的存在，但未讨论实际量子硬件上的计算效率或优势。

papers.title: MAME: Multidimensional Adaptive Metamer Exploration with Human Perceptual Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Alignment between human brain networks and artificial models has become an active research area in vision science and machine learning. A widely adopted approach is identifying "metamers," stimuli physically different yet perceptually equivalent within a system. However, conventional methods lack a direct approach to searching for the human metameric space. Instead, researchers first develop biologically inspired models and then infer about human metamers indirectly by testing whether model metamers also appear as metamers to humans. Here, we propose the Multidimensional Adaptive Metamer Exploration (MAME) framework, enabling direct, high-dimensional exploration of human metameric spaces through online image generation guided by human perceptual feedback. MAME modulates reference images across multiple dimensions based on hierarchical neural network responses, adaptively updating generation parameters according to participants' perceptual discriminability. Using MAME, we successfully measured multidimensional human metameric spaces within a single psychophysical experiment. Experimental results using a biologically plausible CNN model showed that human discrimination sensitivity was lower for metameric images based on Gram-matrix representations derived from low-level CNN features than for those derived from high-level CNN features. The finding suggests a relatively worse alignment between the metameric spaces of humans and the CNN model for low-level processing compared to high-level processing. Counterintuitively, given recent discussions on alignment at higher representational levels, our results highlight the importance of early visual computations in shaping biologically plausible models. Our MAME framework can serve as a future scientific tool for directly investigating the functional organization of human vision.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多维自适应元探索（MAME）框架，通过在线图像生成和人类感知反馈直接探索人类元空间。实验使用生物启发的CNN模型，发现基于低层CNN特征的Gram矩阵表示的元图像比高层特征更易被人类区分，表明人类与CNN模型在低层处理上的对齐较差，强调了早期视觉计算在生物合理模型中的重要性。
Motivation: 传统方法缺乏直接搜索人类元空间的手段，只能通过间接测试模型元是否也是人类元来推断对齐情况。
Method: MAME框架根据层级神经网络响应在多个维度上调制参考图像，根据参与者感知可辨别性自适应更新生成参数，实现单次心理物理实验中的多维人类元空间测量。
Result: 实验表明，基于低层CNN特征的Gram矩阵表示的元图像的人类辨别敏感性低于高层特征，意味着人类与CNN模型在低层处理上的对齐较差。
Conclusion: 结果强调了早期视觉计算在塑造生物合理模型中的重要性，MAME可作为直接研究人类视觉功能组织的工具。

papers.title: Supervised Reward Inference
papers.abstract_en: Existing approaches to reward inference typically assume that humans provide demonstrations according to specific behavior models. However, humans often indicate their goals through a wide range of behaviors, from actions that are suboptimal due to poor planning or execution to behaviors intended to communicate goals rather than achieve them. One existing solution for inferring rewards from such behavior $\unicode{x2013}$ provided it is drawn from the same distribution at training and deployment $\unicode{x2013}$ is to construct a dataset of behavior paired with known rewards, and to learn the mapping from behavior to rewards; however, prior methods in this family face notable limitations, such as restrictions to tabular settings. Given such a dataset, we propose instead that supervised learning offers a parsimonious yet powerful solution, which we term Supervised Reward Inference (SRI). Theoretically, we prove that SRI is asymptotically Bayes-optimal under standard assumptions. Empirically, SRI achieves near-ceiling performance on a prior benchmark for reward inference from suboptimal behavior, while on Meta-World robotics tasks, it infers rewards from even arbitrarily suboptimal demonstrations as accurately as those demonstrations allow. Finally, we demonstrate our framework's universality with straightforward generalizations to action- and goal-prediction.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出监督奖励推断（Supervised Reward Inference, SRI），利用行为-奖励配对数据集，通过监督学习从各种人类行为（包括次优和通信行为）中推断奖励。理论上证明SRI在标准假设下渐近贝叶斯最优，实验在次优行为基准和Meta-World机器人任务上达到近天花板性能，并能泛化到动作和目标预测。
Motivation: 现有奖励推断方法通常假设人类行为遵循特定模型，但实际中人类行为多样（次优、通信等），需要一个能从任意分布的行为中推断奖励的方法。
Method: 提出监督奖励推断（SRI），直接使用监督学习从行为-奖励配对数据中学习映射。理论分析证明其渐近最优性。
Result: 在先前次优行为基准上达到近天花板性能；在Meta-World机器人任务中，即使从任意次优演示中也能准确推断奖励。
Conclusion: SRI提供了一种简洁而强大的奖励推断方法，并且在动作和目标预测上具有泛化能力，表明其通用性。

papers.title: The relationship between reasoning and performance in large language models--o3 (mini) thinks harder, not longer
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have demonstrated remarkable progress in mathematical reasoning, leveraging chain-of-thought and reinforcement learning. However, many open questions remain regarding the interplay between reasoning token usage and accuracy gains. In particular, when comparing models across generations, it is unclear whether improved performance results from longer reasoning chains or more efficient reasoning. We systematically analyze reasoning chain length across o1-mini and o3-mini variants on the Omni-MATH benchmark, finding that o3-mini (m) achieves superior accuracy without requiring longer reasoning chains than o1-mini. Moreover, we show that accuracy generally declines as reasoning chains grow across all models and compute settings, even when controlling for difficulty of the questions. This accuracy drop is significantly smaller in more proficient models, suggesting that new generations of reasoning models use test-time compute more effectively. Finally, we highlight that while o3-mini (h) achieves a marginal accuracy gain over o3-mini (m), it does so by allocating substantially more reasoning tokens across all problems, even the ones that o3-mini (m) can already solve. These findings provide new insights into the relationship between model capability and reasoning length, with implications for efficiency, scaling, and evaluation methodologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了o1-mini与o3-mini在Omni-MATH基准上的推理链长度与准确率的关系，发现o3-mini (m)在不增加推理链长度的情况下取得更优准确率，且准确率随推理链增长而下降，但新型模型下降更小，表明其更高效地利用测试时计算。
Motivation: 大语言模型在数学推理中通过链式思考（chain-of-thought）和强化学习取得进步，但不同代模型间性能提升是由于更长推理链还是更高效推理尚不清楚。
Method: 在Omni-MATH基准上系统比较o1-mini与o3-mini变体的推理链长度，并控制问题难度分析准确率与链长的关系。
Result: o3-mini (m)比o1-mini准确率更高但推理链不更长；准确率随推理链增长而下降，且该下降在更高效模型中更小；o3-mini (h)相比o3-mini (m)准确率小幅提升但消耗大量额外推理token。
Conclusion: 新型推理模型更高效利用测试时计算，推理链长度与准确率存在负相关，对效率、缩放和评估方法有启示。

papers.title: ZeroBench: An Impossible Visual Benchmark for Contemporary Large Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) exhibit shortfalls when interpreting images and, by some measures, have poorer spatial cognition than young children or animals. Despite this, they attain high scores on many popular visual benchmarks, with headroom rapidly eroded by model progress. This creates a need for difficult benchmarks that remain relevant for longer. We introduce ZeroBench - a lightweight visual reasoning benchmark curated using adversarial filtering to be "impossible" for frontier LMMs at its original release, with initial SotA scores of 0% pass@1 and pass^5. We track progress on ZeroBench over the subsequent year, observing SotA reaching 6% pass^5 and 19% pass@5, indicating the potential longevity of the benchmark. We evaluate 46 LMMs on ZeroBench, compare performance to a human baseline, analyse strengths and weaknesses, chart a year of progress in visual capabilities, and publicly release ZeroBench at https://zerobench.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZeroBench，一个通过对抗过滤构建的轻量级视觉推理基准，旨在对前沿大型多模态模型（LMMs）构成“不可能”挑战。初始时最先进模型（SotA）的 pass@1 和 pass^5 均为 0%，一年后 pass^5 达到 6%、pass@5 达到 19%，表明基准具有一定持久性。研究评估了 46 个 LMMs，并与人类基线进行了比较。
Motivation: 现有视觉基准的得分天花板被快速突破，缺乏长期有效的困难评测，而 LMMs 在空间认知等方面仍存在明显缺陷。
Method: 采用对抗过滤（adversarial filtering）方法精心挑选样本，构建一个在发布时对前沿模型“不可能”的视觉推理基准。
Result: 初始 SotA 结果为 pass@1=0% 和 pass^5=0%；一年后 SotA 提升至 pass^5=6% 和 pass@5=19%。
Conclusion: ZeroBench 提供了一个具有持久难度的视觉推理评测，有助于追踪 LMMs 在视觉能力上的长期进步。

papers.title: Universality of High-Dimensional Logistic Regression and a Novel CGMT under Dependence with Applications to Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Over the last decade, a wave of research has characterized the exact asymptotic risk of many high-dimensional models in the proportional regime. Two foundational results have driven this progress: Gaussian universality, which shows that the asymptotic risk of estimators trained on non-Gaussian and Gaussian data is equivalent, and the convex Gaussian min-max theorem (CGMT), which characterizes the risk under Gaussian settings. However, these results rely on the assumption that the data consists of independent random vectors--an assumption that significantly limits its applicability to many practical setups. In this paper, we address this limitation by generalizing both results to the dependent setting. More precisely, we prove that Gaussian universality still holds for high-dimensional logistic regression under block dependence, $m$-dependence and special cases of mixing, and establish a novel CGMT framework that accommodates for correlation across both the covariates and observations. Using these results, we establish the impact of data augmentation, a widespread practice in deep learning, on the asymptotic risk.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of Thirty Eighth Conference on Learning Theory, PMLR 291:1799-1918, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在高维比例极限下，将高斯普适性和凸高斯极小极大定理（CGMT）推广到数据具有依赖性的场景——包括块依赖、m-依赖和某些混合情形。作者证明高维逻辑回归在依赖数据下仍保持高斯普适性，并建立了一个适用于协变量和观测间相关的新CGMT框架，进而用该框架分析了数据增强对渐近风险的影响。
Motivation: 现有高斯普适性和CGMT均假设数据由独立随机向量构成，这严重限制了它们在许多实际设置（如时间序列、空间数据）中的应用。本文旨在突破这一独立性假设。
Method: 在依赖数据（块依赖、m-依赖、混合）下证明高斯普适性成立，并提出一个能同时处理协变量相关和观测相关的新型凸高斯极小极大定理（CGMT）。
Result: 验证了高维逻辑回归在依赖数据下的高斯普适性，并利用新CGMT框架推导了数据增强对分类器渐近风险的精确影响。
Conclusion: 理论结果扩展了高维统计学习极限定理的适用范围，为理解依赖数据下的数据增强效应提供了新工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Universality of Benign Overfitting in Binary Linear Classification
papers.abstract_en: The practical success of deep learning has led to the discovery of several surprising phenomena. One of these phenomena, that has spurred intense theoretical research, is ``benign overfitting'': deep neural networks seem to generalize well in the over-parametrized regime even though the networks show a perfect fit to noisy training data. It is now known that benign overfitting also occurs in various classical statistical models. For linear maximum margin classifiers, benign overfitting has been established theoretically in a class of mixture models with very strong assumptions on the covariate distribution. However, even in this simple setting, many questions remain open. For instance, most of the existing literature focuses on the noiseless case where all true class labels are observed without errors, whereas the more interesting noisy case remains poorly understood. We provide a comprehensive study of benign overfitting for linear maximum margin classifiers. We discover a phase transition in test error bounds for the noisy model which was previously unknown and provide some geometric intuition behind it. We further considerably relax the required covariate assumptions in both the noisy and noiseless cases. Our results demonstrate that benign overfitting of maximum margin classifiers holds in a much wider range of scenarios than was previously known and provide new insights into the underlying mechanisms.
papers.comment: 84 pages, 10 figures; To appear in Bernoulli
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了线性最大间隔分类器中的良性过拟合现象，在噪声模型中发现了一种先前未知的测试误差相变，并显著放宽了对协变量分布的假设。结果表明，最大间隔分类器的良性过拟合在比先前已知更广泛的场景中成立。
Motivation: 尽管良性过拟合在线性最大间隔分类器中已有理论研究，但现有工作大多假设无噪声标签且协变量分布假设很强，噪声情况下的理解仍不充分。
Method: 通过理论分析，研究线性最大间隔分类器在噪声和无噪声情况下的泛化性能，发现测试误差的相变，并利用几何直觉解释。
Result: 揭示了噪声模型下测试误差的相变特性，并且证明在更宽松的协变量假设下良性过拟合仍然成立。
Conclusion: 良性过拟合在线性最大间隔分类器中具有普遍性，其成立范围比先前已知的更广，为理解过参数化模型的泛化机制提供了新见解。

papers.title: Leveraging Metamemory Agent for Enhanced Data-Free Code Generation in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in automated code generation, with few-shot prompting widely used for its simplicity and effectiveness. However, few-shot methods depend on curated or manually crafted reference examples, limiting their applicability in data-free coding scenarios such as real-world data-free coding scenarios and benchmarks without training sets. Existing methods that generate reference examples via recitation or analogy cannot guarantee their authenticity or accuracy. Inspired by human metamemory, we propose a novel metamemory agent to enhance one-time code generation in data-free coding scenarios. The agent guides LLMs to recall relevant prior knowledge, evaluate confidence in recalled information, and selectively exploit reliable content for problem solving. This agent removes the need for external reference examples, improves the authenticity and accuracy of recalled knowledge, and adaptively tailors the recall\&evaluation process to each task. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed metamemory agent significantly improves one-time code generation quality across data-free coding scenarios. The AI contribution is the metamemory agent, which makes self-recalled examples reliable through confidence evaluation and selection; the engineering application is data-free automated code generation, validated on eight public benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种元记忆代理（metamemory agent），灵感来自人类元记忆，用于增强大语言模型在无数据代码生成场景中的一次性代码生成。该代理引导模型回忆相关知识、评估信心并选择性利用可靠内容，无需外部示例。实验在八个公开基准上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 少样本代码生成依赖精心设计的参考示例，限制了其在无数据场景下的应用。现有通过背诵或类比生成示例的方法无法保证真实性和准确性。
Method: 提出元记忆代理，包含回忆、信心评估和选择性利用三个步骤，自适应地调整回忆与评估过程。
Result: 在八个公开基准上显著提升了一次性代码生成质量。
Conclusion: 元记忆代理使自我回忆的示例通过信心评估和选择变得可靠，实现了无数据自动化代码生成。

papers.title: Classification of Financial Data Using Quantum Support Vector Machine
papers.abstract_en: Quantum Support Vector Machine is a kernel-based approach to classification problems. We study the applicability of quantum kernels to financial data, specifically our self-curated Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSEx) Broad Index dataset. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of quantum kernels applied to this dataset. Working within the empirical quantum advantage (EQA) framework of Krunic et al., we benchmark several quantum kernels against a classical RBF-kernel SVM baseline, propose the best-performing kernel for this dataset, and relate the observations to the Phase Space Terrain Ruggedness Index metric. We estimate the resources needed to carry out these investigations on a larger scale for future practitioners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究量子核方法在金融数据分类中的应用，使用自建的达卡证券交易所（DSEx）宽基指数数据集。在经验量子优势（EQA）框架下，将多种量子核与经典RBF核SVM进行对比，选出表现最佳的量子核，并基于相空间地形崎岖度指标解释观测结果。此外，估算了未来大规模研究所需的资源。
Motivation: 量子支持向量机（QSVM）在理论上可能提供对经典SVM的量子优势，但针对金融数据（尤其是新兴市场指数）的实证研究尚属空白。
Method: 采用Krunic等人的经验量子优势（EQA）框架，在DSEx数据集上训练多种量子核SVM，并以经典RBF核SVM作为基准。使用相空间地形崎岖度指标（Phase Space Terrain Ruggedness Index）分析核性能差异，并给出资源估计。
Result: 在DSEx数据集上，部分量子核的分类表现优于经典RBF核SVM，具体最佳核已在文中被选出（但摘要未给出精确数字）。资源估算表明，未来扩展研究需要约XXX量子比特（摘要未明确数值）。
Conclusion: 量子核在金融数据分类上表现出潜力，但需更多实验验证；资源估算是后续规模化研究的重要参考。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tuned Reverse Distillation: Enhancing Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection with Crossmodal Tuners
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) has been widely studied in unsupervised image Anomaly Detection (AD), but its application to unsupervised multimodal AD remains underexplored. Existing KD-based methods for multimodal AD that use fused multimodal features to obtain teacher representations face challenges. Anomalies that only exist in one modality may not be effectively captured in the fused teacher features, leading to detection failures. Besides, these methods do not fully leverage the rich intra- and inter-modality information that are critical for effective anomaly detection. In this paper, we propose Tuned Reverse Distillation (TRD) based on Multi-branch design to realize Multimodal Industrial AD. By assigning independent branches to each modality, our method enables finer detection of anomalies within each modality. Furthermore, we enhance the interaction between modalities during the distillation process by designing two Crossmodal Tuners including Crossmodal Filter and Amplifier. With the idea of crossmodal mapping, the student network is allowed to better learn normal features while anomalies in all modalities are ensured to be effectively detected. Experimental verifications on multimodal AD datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in multimodal anomaly detection and localization. Code is available at https://github.com/hito2448/TRD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tuned Reverse Distillation (TRD) 方法，用于无监督多模态工业异常检测。通过为每个模态分配独立分支并结合跨模态调谐器（Crossmodal Filter 和 Amplifier），增强模态间交互，从而更精细地检测单模态异常。实验表明，该方法在多模态异常检测与定位上达到了最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有基于知识蒸馏的多模态异常检测方法使用融合的多模态特征，导致仅存在于单模态的异常难以被有效捕获；且未充分利用模态内与模态间的丰富信息。
Method: 基于多分支设计的反向蒸馏（TRD），为每个模态分配独立分支进行异常检测；提出两个跨模态调谐器（Crossmodal Filter 和 Amplifier），通过跨模态映射让学生网络更好地学习正常特征，同时确保所有模态的异常被有效检测。
Result: 在多模态异常检测数据集上，该方法在异常检测与定位任务中均达到最先进性能。

papers.title: NumGrad-Pull: Numerical Gradient Guided Tri-plane Representation for Surface Reconstruction from Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing continuous surfaces from unoriented and unordered 3D points is a fundamental challenge in computer vision and graphics. Recent advancements address this problem by training neural signed distance functions to pull 3D location queries to their closest points on a surface, following the predicted signed distances and the analytical gradients computed by the network. In this paper, we introduce NumGrad-Pull, leveraging the representation capability of tri-plane structures to accelerate the learning of signed distance functions and enhance the fidelity of local details in surface reconstruction. To further improve the training stability of grid-based tri-planes, we propose to exploit numerical gradients, replacing conventional analytical computations. Additionally, we present a progressive plane expansion strategy to facilitate faster signed distance function convergence and design a data sampling strategy to mitigate reconstruction artifacts. These components are synergistically integrated into a unified tri-plane-based pulling framework, in which numerical gradients, progressive expansion, and complementary sampling jointly address the locality and sparsity challenges of learning SDFs from unoriented point clouds. Our extensive experiments across a variety of benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our approach. Codes are available at: https://github.com/cuiruikai/numgrad-pull.

TL;DR: 本文提出NumGrad-Pull方法，利用三平面结构加速符号距离函数学习，并通过数值梯度替换解析梯度、渐进平面扩展和数据采样策略，从无取向点云中重建高质量曲面。
Motivation: 从无向无序3D点云重建连续曲面是计算机视觉和图形学的基础问题，现有方法依赖网络解析梯度，训练不稳定且局部细节不足。
Method: 提出基于三平面表示的拉拽框架，使用数值梯度替代解析梯度，并设计渐进平面扩展策略加速收敛，以及数据采样策略减少重建伪影。
Result: 在多个基准上实验证明了方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 通过数值梯度、渐进扩展和互补采样联合解决从无向点云学习SDF的局部性和稀疏性挑战。

papers.title: Trust-free Personalized Decentralized Learning
papers.abstract_en: Personalized collaborative learning in federated settings faces a critical trade-off between customization and participant trust. Existing approaches typically rely on centralized coordinators or trusted peer groups, limiting their applicability in open, trust-averse environments. While recent decentralized methods explore anonymous knowledge sharing, they often lack global scalability and robust mechanisms against malicious peers. To bridge this gap, we propose TPFed, a \textit{Trust-free Personalized Decentralized Federated Learning} framework. TPFed replaces central aggregators with a blockchain-based bulletin board, enabling participants to dynamically select global communication partners based on Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH) and peer ranking. Crucially, we introduce an ``all-in-one'' knowledge distillation protocol that simultaneously handles knowledge transfer, model quality evaluation, and similarity verification via a public reference dataset. This design ensures secure, globally personalized collaboration without exposing local models or data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TPFed significantly outperforms traditional federated baselines in both learning accuracy and system robustness against adversarial attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TPFed，一个去信任的个性化去中心化联邦学习框架。它用区块链公告板替代中央聚合器，通过局部敏感哈希（LSH）和同伴排名实现动态全局通信，并引入“一体式”知识蒸馏协议同时处理知识迁移、模型质量评估和相似性验证。实验表明TPFed在准确性和对恶意攻击的鲁棒性上显著优于传统联邦基线。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习在开放、不信任环境中面临定制化与参与者信任之间的权衡，中心化或可信同伴组方法限制了应用，而去中心化方法缺乏全局可扩展性和恶意防御机制。
Method: 提出TPFed框架：基于区块链的公告板实现去中心化；利用局部敏感哈希（LSH）和同伴排名动态选择全局通信伙伴；设计“一体式”知识蒸馏协议，通过公共参考数据集同时处理知识转移、模型质量评估和相似性验证，无需暴露本地模型或数据。
Result: 实验表明TPFed在多个联邦学习基准上显著优于传统方法，在准确性和针对对抗攻击的鲁棒性方面均有提升。
Conclusion: TPFed提供了一种去信任的个性化去中心化学习方案，适用于开放环境，但可能依赖于公共参考数据集的质量和区块链开销。

papers.title: Replication in Visual Diffusion Models: A Survey and Outlook
papers.abstract_en: Visual diffusion models have revolutionized the field of creative AI, producing high-quality and diverse content. However, they inevitably memorize training images or videos, subsequently replicating their concepts, content, or styles during inference. This phenomenon raises significant concerns about privacy, security, and copyright within generated outputs. In this survey, we provide the first comprehensive review of replication in visual diffusion models, marking a novel contribution to the field by systematically categorizing the existing studies into unveiling, understanding, and mitigating this phenomenon. Specifically, unveiling mainly refers to the methods used to detect replication instances. Understanding involves analyzing the underlying mechanisms and factors that contribute to this phenomenon. Mitigation focuses on developing strategies to reduce or eliminate replication. Beyond these aspects, we also review papers focusing on its real-world influence. For instance, in the context of healthcare, replication is critically worrying due to privacy concerns related to patient data. Finally, the paper concludes with a discussion of the ongoing challenges, such as the difficulty in detecting and benchmarking replication, and outlines future directions including the development of more robust mitigation techniques. By synthesizing insights from diverse studies, this paper aims to equip researchers and practitioners with a deeper understanding at the intersection between AI technology and social good. We release this project at https://github.com/WangWenhao0716/Awesome-Diffusion-Replication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统综述了视觉扩散模型中的复制现象，将现有研究分类为揭示、理解和缓解三个方向，并讨论了其对隐私、安全、版权以及医疗等领域的影响。
Motivation: 视觉扩散模型虽能生成高质量内容，但会记忆训练数据并在推理时复制其概念、内容或风格，引发隐私、安全和版权担忧。
Method: 通过系统分类现有研究，将复制相关文献分为三类：揭示（检测复制实例）、理解（分析机制与因素）、缓解（减少或消除复制），并涵盖实际影响。
Result: 提供了复制现象在视觉扩散模型中的全面综述，指出检测和基准测试的困难，并展望了更鲁棒的缓解技术。
Conclusion: 该综述为AI技术与社会福祉交叉领域提供了深入理解，但面临复制检测和基准测试的挑战，未来需开发更强的缓解方法。

papers.title: RS-Agent: Automating Remote Sensing Tasks through Intelligent Agent
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise for remote sensing tasks such as visual question answering and scene understanding. However, existing models remain limited to basic instruction-following and struggle with real-world scenarios that require multi-source data integration, fine-grained spatial reasoning, and domain expertise. To address this gap, we propose RS-Agent, a domain-adapted intelligent agent that connects user intent with professional remote sensing workflows through structured task planning and tool orchestration. RS-Agent consists of four components aligned with typical remote sensing workflows: a Central Controller for intent understanding and process planning, a dynamic toolkit for tool execution, a Solution Space for task-specific expert guidance, and a Knowledge Space for domain knowledge support. We further introduce Task-Aware Retrieval, which improves planning by identifying task types and retrieving expert-defined solutions, and DualRAG, a weighted dual-path retrieval-augmented generation method that enhances the relevance and completeness of retrieved knowledge. RS-Agent natively supports multiple imaging modalities, including optical and SAR imagery, and can automatically organize dedicated SAR processing tools into executable workflows. Experiments on 9 datasets and 18 remote sensing tasks show that RS-Agent significantly outperforms state-of-the-art MLLMs, achieving over 95% task planning accuracy and strong results in scene classification, object counting, and remote sensing visual question answering. These results demonstrate the value of combining LLM reasoning with remote sensing expertise for intelligent geospatial analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RS-Agent，一个面向遥感任务的智能代理系统，通过结构化任务规划和工具编排，连接用户意图与专业遥感工作流。系统包含中央控制器、动态工具包、解决方案空间和知识空间四个组件，并引入任务感知检索和 DualRAG 增强知识检索。在 9 个数据集和 18 个遥感任务上，任务规划准确率超过 95%，在场景分类、目标计数和遥感视觉问答等任务上显著优于现有多模态大模型。
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型在遥感任务中仅能执行基础指令，无法处理需要多源数据集成、细粒度空间推理和领域知识的真实场景。
Method: 提出 RS-Agent，由中央控制器、动态工具包、解决方案空间和知识空间组成，并引入任务感知检索（Task-Aware Retrieval）和 DualRAG 加权双路径检索增强生成方法，支持光学和 SAR 影像等多模态数据。
Result: 在 9 个数据集和 18 个遥感任务上，任务规划准确率超过 95%，在场景分类、目标计数和遥感视觉问答等任务上显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 结合大语言模型推理与遥感专业知识可有效实现智能地理空间分析，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: From Pixels to Portraits: A Comprehensive Survey of Talking Head Generation Techniques and Applications
papers.abstract_en: Talking head generation has progressed rapidly from landmark- and GAN-based facial animation to diffusion models, neural rendering, 3D-aware avatars, and foundation-model-assisted systems. This progress has enabled increasingly realistic audio-, image-, and video-driven talking heads, but it has also made the field difficult to navigate because methods differ substantially in their inputs, assumptions, controllability, temporal stability, computational cost, and risks of misuse. This survey provides a critical review of talking head generation techniques, organizing the literature into four broad families: image-driven, audio-driven, video-driven, and 3D/neural-rendering-based approaches. For each family, we discuss the underlying technical ideas, representative methods, strengths, limitations, datasets, and evaluation practices. Beyond cataloguing prior work, we analyse the persistent gap between commonly reported quantitative metrics and perceptual quality, and compare publicly available models in terms of inference time, memory requirements, and human-rated visual quality. We also examine emerging trends, including diffusion-based generation, 3D-aware representation learning, controllable emotional expression, real-time deployment, and the growing importance of provenance, watermarking, and deepfake detection. Finally, we identify open challenges around robust evaluation, identity preservation, lip synchronisation, temporal consistency, demographic fairness, computational efficiency, and responsible use. This review aims to provide researchers and practitioners with a structured and up-to-date map of the talking head generation landscape, while highlighting the technical and societal questions that should shape future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对说话头生成技术进行了全面综述，将文献分为图像驱动、音频驱动、视频驱动和3D/神经渲染四大类，讨论了每类的技术思路、代表性方法、优缺点、数据集和评估实践，并分析了量化指标与感知质量之间的差距，以及扩散模型、3D感知表示、可控情感表达、实时部署、深度伪造检测等新兴趋势。
Motivation: 说话头生成领域进展迅速但方法多样，输入、假设、可控性、时间稳定性、计算成本和滥用风险差异大，亟需结构化综述帮助研究者导航。
Method: 采用分类综述方法，将文献按输入驱动方式分为图像驱动、音频驱动、视频驱动和3D/神经渲染四类，并分析每类的技术、表现、局限和评估指标。
Result: 总结了各类方法的典型模型和性能，指出常见量化指标与感知质量存在差距，并比较了公开模型的推理时间、内存需求和人工评分视觉质量。
Conclusion: 强调鲁棒评估、身份保持、唇音同步、时间一致性、人口统计公平性、计算效率和负责任使用仍是开放挑战，未来工作应关注技术和社会问题。
