papers.title: Foundation Models for Automatic CAD Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable the automatic generation of parametric 3D designs from natural-language specifications. This chapter presents an empirical study of foundation models for automatic Computer-Aided Design (CAD) generation of mechanical parts, using a unified evaluation pipeline and a curated benchmark of 97 engineering design problems. We introduce LLMForge, a multi-model text-to-CAD framework integrating JSON-schema validation, analytic feature scoring, mesh synthesis, and multi-round iterative refinement, studied under two critique regimes. IterTracer uses a Phong-shaded ray-trace renderer with analytic visual metrics (silhouette IoU, hole visibility, edge clearance, aspect-ratio conformance) for lightweight geometry-aware feedback across rounds. IterVision replaces the analytic scorer with a VLM semantic critic (Qwen2.5-VL-72B) that evaluates rendered views via chain-of-thought visual reasoning, assessing spatial coherence and design intent. On a benchmark spanning four canonical geometry families (plates with holes and bolt circles, multi-feature boxes, flanged cylinders, and L-brackets), we evaluate seven foundation models: DeepSeek-V3.2, Qwen3-235B-A22B, Llama-3.3-70B, Gemma-3-27B, GLM-4.5, MiniMax-M2.1, and INTELLECT. Under IterTracer, the four highest-ranked models form a tight cluster (overall mean in [0.885, 0.890]) with 98.97% mesh success, showing that compact instruction-tuned models can match substantially larger systems. VLM-based critique in IterVision yields 100% watertight mesh generation on the leading model while surfacing systematic difficulty on rotationally symmetric geometries such as cylinders, where visual and semantic scoring diverge most. We discuss benchmark design, failure modes, CAD-oriented prompting, and implications for industrial workflows and scalable automated mechanical design.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用基础模型（LLMs和VLMs）自动生成参数化3D机械零件CAD模型。提出LLMForge框架，包含JSON-schema验证、特征评分、网格合成和多轮迭代优化，并比较了两种批评机制：基于光线追踪渲染的几何指标（IterTracer）和基于VLM语义批评（IterVision）。在97个工程问题基准上评估了7个模型，结果表明紧凑指令微调模型可以达到与大规模系统相当的性能。
Motivation: 自动从自然语言生成CAD设计可加速工程设计流程，现有方法在复杂几何和设计意图理解上仍有挑战。
Method: 提出LLMForge多模型文本到CAD框架，结合JSON-schema验证、分析特征评分、网格合成和多轮迭代。两种批评机制：IterTracer使用Phong着色光线追踪渲染和几何视觉指标；IterVision用VLM（Qwen2.5-VL-72B）进行链式思维视觉推理评估。
Result: 在97个问题基准上，IterTracer下最强模型聚类平均分0.885-0.890，网格成功率达98.97%。IterVision中领先模型实现100%水密网格，但旋转对称几何（如圆柱）上视觉与语义评分差异大。
Conclusion: 紧凑指令微调模型可匹敌更大系统；VLM批评可提升水密性但暴露特定几何困难；讨论了工业工作流和可扩展自动化机械设计的启示。

papers.title: CSTutorBench: Benchmarking Small Language Models as Tutors for Block-Based Programming
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly explored as AI tutors, yet deploying them in K-12 settings raises concerns around privacy, cost, and reliance on proprietary models. Small language models (SLMs) offer a promising alternative, but selecting the right model for a specific educational context remains difficult, particularly when the target domain, such as block-based programming, is largely absent from model training data. We introduce CSTutorBench, a benchmark for evaluating language models as CS tutors in VEX VR, a block-based robotics environment. The benchmark comprises 17 scenario-based questions scored against a pedagogical rubric grounded in established tutoring and feedback research, with a human-in-the-loop LLM-as-judge pipeline for evaluation. Preliminary findings across 11 models (4B-120B parameters) reveal that models perform well on surface-level criteria such as vocabulary and tone but struggle with deeper pedagogical behaviors, particularly avoiding answer leakage and engaging with student debugging histories. In our sample, model family and instruction-tuning approach appear to be better predictors of tutoring quality than parameter count alone, though the small number of models limits the strength of this conclusion. A targeted prompt revision grounded in recent educational prompt engineering research improved scores for 10 of 11 models. These results underscore the value of context-specific, pedagogically grounded benchmarks for SLM selection in educational deployment.
papers.journal_ref: SLM4ED'26: The 1st Workshop of Small Language Models for Education (SLM4ED). AIED 2026. Seoul, Republic of Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了CSTutorBench基准，用于评估小语言模型在VEX VR块编程环境中的教学表现。基准包含17个场景问题，基于教学理论评分，采用人机循环的LLM作为评判器。初步评估11个模型（4B-120B参数）发现，模型在表面标准（词汇、语气）上表现良好，但在深层教学行为（避免答案泄露、参与学生调试历史）上不足；模型家族和指令微调方法比参数数量更能预测教学质量；提示工程改进提升了10/11模型的分数。
Motivation: 大型语言模型作为AI导师在K-12部署存在隐私、成本和依赖专有模型等问题，小语言模型是可行替代，但针对块编程等特定教育场景的模型选择缺乏基准。
Method: 构建CSTutorBench基准，包含17个基于VEX VR块编程的导师场景问题，并依据教学和反馈研究设计评分标准。采用人机循环的LLM-as-judge流程进行自动化评估。
Result: 在11个模型上的初步结果表明，模型在词汇和语气等表面标准上表现优秀，但在避免答案泄露和参与学生调试历史方面存在困难；模型家族和指令微调方式比参数规模更能预测教学效果；通过提示工程改进，10/11模型的评分得到提升。
Conclusion: 该基准强调了在特定教育语境下，基于教育学理论的基准对小语言模型选型的重要性。

papers.title: Harnessing Generative Image Models for Training-Free Primitive Shape Abstraction
papers.abstract_en: Representing 3D shapes as compact sets of geometric primitives is fundamental to robotics, simulation, and scene understanding. Generative image models trained at scale have recently emerged as generalist visual learners that can identify and segment object parts directly in the image domain, across arbitrary categories and without task-specific training. Adapting such models to downstream tasks typically requires fine-tuning; we ask whether their pretrained capability can instead be harnessed directly, without any training, and answer affirmatively with a training-free harness. Our pipeline renders multi-view images of a 3D object, uses a vision-language model to analyze its semantic parts, prompts a generative image model to paint a color-coded part segmentation mask, reprojects it onto the geometry, and fits a superquadric primitive to each part via parameter optimization. The approach contains no learned parameters: it is category-agnostic and orientation-invariant, properties that previous learning-based models struggled with. Its accuracy ceiling rises with future generative-model improvements, which we confirm with a ground-truth segmentation study showing that part segmentation, not primitive fitting, is the current accuracy bottleneck. On HumanPrim and Toys4K, our method achieves the lowest Chamfer distance among all evaluated methods, using 5--9 primitives per object on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的三维形状基元抽象方法，利用预训练的生成式图像模型和视觉语言模型（vision-language model）直接从多视图图像中提取语义部件，并拟合超二次曲面（superquadric）基元。方法无需任何学习参数，类别无关且旋转不变，在HumanPrim和Toys4K数据集上取得最低Chamfer距离，平均每物体使用5-9个基元。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的基元抽象方法需要任务特定微调，跨类别泛化能力有限；本文旨在直接利用预训练生成模型的通用视觉能力，避免训练开销。
Method: 流程包括：渲染三维物体的多视图图像；使用视觉语言模型分析语义部件；提示生成式图像模型生成彩色编码部件分割掩码；将分割反投影到三维几何；对每个部件通过参数优化拟合超二次曲面。整个流程无任何可学习参数。
Result: 在HumanPrim和Toys4K数据集上，该方法在所有评估方法中取得最低Chamfer距离，平均每物体使用5-9个基元。真实分割实验表明，部件分割是当前精度瓶颈，基元拟合并非主要限制。
Conclusion: 该方法证明无需训练即可利用生成式图像模型进行基元抽象，其精度上限可随生成模型改进而提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Graphs to Gradients: Physics-Inspired Structural Attribution for Cyber-Physical IoT Systems and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: Interpretable explanation methods in Artificial Intelligence aim to uncover the underlying causes and their effects, enabling a deeper understanding of why a system behaves in a certain way under different inputs. Unlike traditional explainability methods, which mainly highlight correlations between input and output variables, causal explanation focuses on interventional questions. By doing so, it provides more robust insights, helping users understand automated decisions, especially in high-risk domains. Recovering an explicit directed causal structure, however, is often impractical in large-scale, hybrid cyber-physical systems with feedback loops and partial observability. This paper introduces a novel framework inspired by statistical mechanics that instead models variable dependencies through an undirected, energy-based representation of cyber-physical IoT systems. Our approach enables rigorous dependency-aware attribution by analysing how variations in the energy landscape reflect the influence of individual components, without recovering a directed causal graph. It also supports reasoning about perturbation effects across hybrid interactions, providing reliable explanations of abnormal behaviours. We empirically examined our framework through simulations on an industrial IoT testbed with hybrid continuous and discrete variables, demonstrating higher attribution accuracy, improved robustness and better scalability than state-of-the-art graph-based approaches. While the attributions are not intended to fully recover the system's generative dynamics, they provide valuable, dependency-aware explanations supporting both human interpretation and downstream predictive and diagnostic tasks. Although demonstrated in industrial IoT security, our framework also applies to other high-dimensional cyber-physical and socio-technical systems requiring principled, structural explanations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个受统计力学启发的框架，通过无向能量基表示对网络物理IoT系统进行依赖感知的属性归因，无需恢复有向因果图。在工业IoT测试床上验证了更高的归因准确率、鲁棒性和可扩展性。
Motivation: 传统可解释性方法主要强调输入输出相关性，而因果解释在具有反馈循环和部分可观测性的大规模混合系统中难以恢复有向因果结构。
Method: 引入基于统计力学的框架，用无向能量基表示变量依赖关系，通过分析能量景观变化来反映单个组件的影响，支持混合交互的扰动效应推理。
Result: 在工业IoT测试床（混合连续和离散变量）上，相比最先进的基于图的方法，实现了更高的归因准确率、更好的鲁棒性和可扩展性。
Conclusion: 虽然归因不旨在完全恢复系统的生成动力学，但提供了有价值的依赖感知解释，支持人类解释和下游预测诊断任务，也适用于其他高维网络物理和社会技术系统。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EquiFiLM: Charge-Conditioned Equivariant Force Fields via Feature-wise Linear Modulation
papers.abstract_en: Foundation machine learning force fields (MLFFs) such as MACE-MP-0 and UMA cover broad chemical space at near density functional theory (DFT) accuracy. However, they assume equilibrium ground-state physics and do not natively handle externally induced changes to the electronic state, such as charging, applied fields, or electronic excitation, which limits their use for driven processes such as photoexcitation and charge injection. We propose EquiFiLM, a lightweight extension that adds continuous external conditioning to any equivariant foundation MLFF via a per-layer Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) block, learning externally driven changes to the potential energy surface from minimal training data. The block modulates only scalar channels and preserves E(3)-equivariance exactly. We demonstrate the recipe on charged liquid water with the foundation model MACE-MatPES as the backbone, yielding E-MACE. On the four training charges, E-MACE delivers a $3.1\times$ reduction in force RMSE ($21.3$ to $6.96$ meV/$\mathring{A}$) and a $61\times$ reduction in per-atom energy RMSE ($6.1$ to $0.1$ meV/atom) over a baseline without EquiFiLM trained on the same data, at indistinguishable inference cost. Across seven held-out interpolation and extrapolation charges, force RMSE stays within $18-61$ meV/$\mathring{A}$ and energy RMSE within $0.7-5.4$ meV/atom. The model runs stable molecular dynamics across the full range tested and predicts the charge-dependent first-shell response of the reduced pair distribution function probed by ultrafast electron diffraction. Adding this conditioning axis to the foundation requires only a few thousand DFT-labeled frames, against the $\approx 10^8$ structures of a charge-aware foundation trained from scratch. The recipe is backbone- and conditioning-agnostic: it applies without architectural change to any equivariant MLFF with scalar interaction-layer channels.

TL;DR: EquiFiLM 是一种轻量级扩展，通过逐层特征线性调制 (FiLM) 为等变基础机器学习力场 (MLFF) 添加连续外部条件（如电荷），学习势能表面的外部驱动变化。在带电液态水上的实验表明，使用 MACE-MatPES 作为骨干，E-MACE 在训练电荷上将力 RMSE 降低 3.1 倍，能量 RMSE 降低 61 倍，并在插值和外推电荷上保持合理精度。该方法骨干无关且条件无关，可应用于任何具有标量通道的等变 MLFF。
Motivation: 现有基础 MLFF 假设平衡基态物理，无法原生处理外部诱导的电子状态变化（如充电、外加场或电子激发），限制了其在光激发、电荷注入等驱动过程中的应用。
Method: 提出 EquiFiLM，一个轻量级扩展，通过在每个等变层后添加 FiLM 块，仅调制标量通道，保持 E(3)-等变性，从而将连续外部条件注入任何等变基础 MLFF。

papers.title: Prompt Robustness Is Task-Dependent: Comparing Objective and Belief-Style Questions in LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Survey-style evaluations of large language models often treat a prompted response as a measure of a model's values or beliefs. This assumption is particularly fragile when responses are read as evidence of political values, social attitudes, or beliefs. We ask whether prompt robustness differs between objective questions with fixed answers and subjective questions that ask for opinions or values. We evaluate four instruction-tuned model families on three objective datasets (MMLU, ARC, and CulturalBench) and three subjective datasets (Political Compass Test, ValueBench, and World Values Survey). For each question/statement, we apply multiple types of prompt changes, such as variations in wording, framing, and format, and measure whether the model gives the same answer across variants. Using a binomial generalized estimating equation, we find significant effects of model, dataset, prompt category, and their interactions. The dataset type effect is also significant, and the interaction between dataset type and prompt category is large. These results show that prompt robustness depends on the question type, the prompt change, and the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型在客观问题和主观问题上的提示鲁棒性差异，通过对多个模型和数据集进行实验，发现提示鲁棒性依赖于问题类型、提示变化和模型本身。
Motivation: 现有研究将LLM的提示响应视为模型价值观或信念的度量，但这种假设在涉及政治态度等问题时可能不可靠。本文旨在探讨提示鲁棒性是否因问题类型（客观 vs. 主观）而异。
Method: 评估四个指令微调模型，使用三个客观数据集（MMLU, ARC, CulturalBench）和三个主观数据集（Political Compass Test, ValueBench, World Values Survey）。对每个问题应用多种提示变化（措辞、框架、格式），并用二项广义估计方程分析模型、数据集、提示类别及其交互效应。
Result: 模型、数据集、提示类别及其交互效应显著；数据集类型效应显著；数据集类型与提示类别的交互效应较大。表明提示鲁棒性依赖于问题类型、提示变化和模型。
Conclusion: 提示鲁棒性是任务相关的，评估LLM时需要根据问题类型谨慎解释提示响应。

papers.title: Federated Physics-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Distributed Stability Control in Smart Grids
papers.abstract_en: Transient stability control in smart grids requires rapid post-fault damping of generator frequency and rotor angle deviations to prevent cascading failures. This paper proposes FedPPO-PG, a Federated Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization framework with Physics-Grounded neighborhoods, which reformulates transient stability control as a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning problem optimized directly against closed-loop stability objectives. Each generator hosts an independent local actor augmented with the frequency deviations of its two most strongly coupled electrical neighbors, identified from the post-fault Kron-reduced susceptance matrix. A guided policy initialization phase warm-starts all actors from the classical decentralized controller, while a centralized critic guides advantage estimation under the centralized training--decentralized execution (CTDE) paradigm. Evaluated on a simulation of the IEEE 39-bus benchmark system across five training and three unseen fault contingencies, FedPPO-PG achieves 100% stabilization in all 24 trials, reduces mean stability time by 72.4%, and cuts the control power by 7-14 times compared to the centralized baseline. Each actor executes independently with no central coordinator at deployment, and the per-actor inference latency satisfies the IEEE/IEC 60255-118-1-2018 real-time reporting requirements.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE SmartGridComm 2026. This is the accepted manuscript version. The final published version will appear in IEEE Xplore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FedPPO-PG，一种联邦多近端策略优化框架，将暂态稳定控制转化为协作式多智能体强化学习问题，直接针对闭环稳定目标优化。每个生成器采用本地actor，利用最强耦合邻居的频率偏差，通过引导策略初始化和集中式critic进行优势估计。在IEEE 39节点系统仿真中，FedPPO-PG在24次试验中均实现100%稳定，平均稳定时间减少72.4%，控制功率降低7-14倍，且满足实时性要求。
Motivation: 智能电网中暂态稳定控制需要快速抑制发电机频率和转子角偏差以防止级联故障，现有方法在分布式场景下面临协调与实时性挑战。
Method: 提出联邦多智能体PPO框架（FedPPO-PG），基于物理接地邻域（利用Kron降阶导纳矩阵识别强耦合邻居），每个生成器独立运行本地actor，采用引导策略初始化（从经典分散控制器预热）和集中式critic（CTDE范式）指导优势估计。
Result: 在IEEE 39节点系统上，针对5种训练和3种未见故障，FedPPO-PG在24次试验中全部实现稳定，平均稳定时间减少72.4%，控制功率降低7-14倍，推理延迟满足IEEE/IEC 60255-118-1-2018实时要求。
Conclusion: FedPPO-PG在分布式场景下实现了高效的暂态稳定控制，无需中央协调，但仅在仿真环境验证，实际硬件部署需进一步研究。

papers.title: The yes-no bias of large language models reflects answer order and wording, not shifts in moral judgment
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly issue judgments read as binary verdicts, and a growing literature reports such judgments shifting under logically irrelevant changes of wording - among them an amplified yes-no bias on moral dilemmas, absent in humans. A single framing cannot say what such a shift is: in a yes/no question the word "no" is at once logical verdict, lexical token, and last-printed option. We introduce a psychometric battery that separates these: crossed symmetrization - every logically irrelevant factor flipped in balanced pairs - across a corpus of question forms. A graded rating across logically equivalent forms recovers a coherent internal moral scale: frontier models' stance $θ$ is nearly format-invariant (cross-form incoherence 0.12-0.21 on a $\pm 1$ axis); small open-weight models fail in model-specific ways. Forcing the verdict through yes/no overlays a decomposable artifact: an order bias toward the last-printed option - opposite to classic human primacy - plus a lexical pull toward the word "no"; the artifact is substantial only in the Claude models (story-averaged -0.32 to -0.86), $\approx 0$ for GPT-5.5 and Gemini, and shrinks under extended reasoning. The word and the verdict share one token; swapping the words for arbitrary labels separates them, and the verdict-attached logical bias proves $\approx 0$ for every frontier model, while model-specific label and order attachments remain: the models are not drawn toward rejecting - the pull follows the printed surface, not the verdict it carries. A minimal model, $P = σ((θ\pm m)/s)$, summarizes any such artifact by a framing susceptibility m and a moral decisiveness s, measurably distinct from sampling temperature. The battery applies unchanged to any dilemma set and binary format: measuring what a model values requires crossing the frames of the question, not asking once.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型在是非题中的回答偏差，通过交叉对称化心理测量方法分离出顺序偏差和词汇偏差。发现前沿模型的道德判断在格式间几乎不变，而Claude模型存在显著的人造偏差，GPT-5.5和Gemini接近零。
Motivation: 现有文献报告LLM对道德困境的二元判断在逻辑无关的措辞变化下发生偏移，但单一框架无法区分这种偏移是来自逻辑裁决、词汇标记还是选项顺序。
Method: 引入交叉对称化心理测量方法，对每个逻辑无关因素进行平衡配对翻转，通过分级评分恢复内部道德标尺；同时设计实验分离顺序偏差和词汇偏差，提出最小模型P=σ((θ±m)/s)来量化偏差。
Result: 前沿模型的立场θ几乎格式不变（跨格式不一致性0.12-0.21），小型开源模型有特定失败；Claude模型有显著的人造偏差（-0.32到-0.86），GPT-5.5和Gemini接近0；词汇偏差在移除标签后消失，表明偏差跟随表面印刷而非裁决本身。
Conclusion: 测量模型价值观需要交叉询问的框架，而非单一提问；该心理测量方法可适用于任何困境集和二元格式。

papers.title: Deep Neural Variation Spaces: A Unifying Perspective on Depth and Complexity
papers.abstract_en: We develop a unified function space theory of deep fully connected neural networks. Functions in our spaces are defined recursively as $\ell^1$-bounded linear combinations of activated functions from preceding layers, with a dictionary of affine functions at the first layer. Unlike existing theories that are largely specialized to homogeneous activations such as the ReLU, our framework provides a meaningful notion of functional complexity for deep networks with a broad range of homogeneous and non-homogeneous activation functions commonly used in practice. This simple construction unites several seemingly disparate ideas from the literature, including norm-based complexity bounds and variational characterizations of depth, and facilitates novel analyses of what kinds of functions deep norm-constrained networks can represent. To this end, we prove a novel representer theorem for our spaces and establish novel function-space complexity bounds showing that the associated function classes remain qualitatively small at arbitrary depth. In the univariate ReLU case, we prove a "depth saturation" result: depth in this setting yields only a small constant rescaling of the function class, with no added functional diversity. As a consequence, we show that deep norm-controlled ReLU functions in any dimension cannot exhibit high frequencies along any direction. This finding reveals that some commonly cited expressivity benefits of depth disappear once network complexity is controlled by an appropriate function space norm, rather than parameter count or other representational costs that permit compounded rescaling across layers. Overall, our results illustrate how a function space perspective yields new structural insights into the relationship between depth and complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了深度全连接神经网络的统一函数空间理论，将网络定义为前一层激活函数的ℓ1有界线性组合，首层为仿射函数字典。该框架适用于同质和非同质激活函数，统一了范数复杂度边界和深度变分刻画。主要理论结果包括：表示定理、深度任意时函数类保持小规模的复杂度界、以及单变量ReLU情况下的“深度饱和”结果——深度仅带来小的常数重缩放，不增加函数多样性。进而证明任意维度的范数控制ReLU网络无法沿任意方向产生高频。这表明深度在适当函数空间范数控制下并不带来常见的表达能力优势。
Motivation: 现有深度网络理论大多局限于ReLU等齐次激活函数，缺乏统一视角来理解深度与复杂性的关系，尤其是非齐次激活函数下的实质性刻画。
Method: 提出深度神经变分空间，函数通过递归的ℓ1有界线性组合构造，首层为仿射字典。在该空间内分析范数控制的深度网络的函数类性质。
Result: 证明表示定理；表明任意深度下函数类保持定性小；在单变量ReLU情形下证明深度饱和（仅常数重缩放）；并证明高维范数控制ReLU网络不能产生高频。
Conclusion: 摘要强调函数空间视角揭示了深度与复杂度之间的新结构洞见，表明当复杂度由适当的函数空间范数（而非参数数量）控制时，深度的常见表达能力优势消失。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Most LLM Conformity Needs No Speaker: Measuring the Speaker-Free Floor in Peer-Pressure Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: LLM conformity is often used to describe cases where a model changes a correct answer toward a peer or group response. We show that most of this apparent conformity survives even after the peer is removed. The reason is a confound: standard conformity prompts mix two cues at once, the presence of a speaker and the repeated wrong answer itself. Existing benchmarks vary these cues together, so they cannot tell how much of the revision actually depends on the speaker. We introduce a no-source condition: the same asserted answer with the explicit speaker removed. Across six open-weight LLMs and seven QA and reasoning datasets, this condition alone causes harmful revision in $66.5\%$ of initially correct cases, compared with $10.3\%$ under a plain re-ask. The effect also remains when the repeated answer is paraphrased and when answer options are hidden in an open-ended setting. Source framing mainly modulates this floor: expert-panel framing raises it, while minimal person labels do not reliably raise it. When models flip, they are usually confidently wrong, and simple recalibration does not recover the original answer. Source attribution still matters, but it should be measured as an increment above this speaker-free floor. The methodological lesson is that conformity benchmarks should first measure what remains after the speaker is removed; without this step, benchmarks may mistake repeated text for social influence.

papers.title: GEM-Occ: From Visual Geometry Evidence to Embodied Semantic Occupancy Memory
papers.abstract_en: Semantic occupancy provides a structured spatial memory for embodied indoor agents by jointly representing occupied regions, observed free space, unknown areas, and object semantics. However, existing indoor occupancy benchmarks and methods mainly focus on single-view prediction or room-level online perception, leaving long-horizon semantic mapping across connected indoor spaces underexplored. We introduce HIOcc, a hierarchical indoor occupancy benchmark that unifies ScanNet, ScanNet++, and Matterport3D under a common sparse semantic occupancy format while preserving their native observation geometries, including perspective RGB-D frames and pano-centric observation groups. HIOcc supports three complementary evaluation regimes: local semantic occupancy prediction, room-level online occupancy mapping, and building-level mapping across connected panoramic environments. We further propose GEM-Occ, a Gaussian Evidence Memory framework for semantic occupancy mapping. Rather than using pointmaps as persistent map states, GEM-Occ treats local visual geometry predictions as transient evidence, converts them into semantic Gaussian occupancy evidence and free-space ray evidence, and fuses them into a persistent hierarchical memory through visibility- and uncertainty-aware causal updates. The memory is organized into local caches, room-level submaps, and a building-level graph, and can be queried at any time through Gaussian-to-occupancy splatting. Experiments on HIOcc show that GEM-Occ improves local occupancy prediction, online map stability, free-space reasoning, revisit consistency, and building-level scalability over prior indoor occupancy and Gaussian-based mapping baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HIOcc基准和GEM-Occ框架用于室内语义占据映射。HIOcc统一了ScanNet、ScanNet++和Matterport3D数据集，支持局部预测、房间级在线映射和建筑级映射三种评估模式。GEM-Occ将局部视觉几何预测作为瞬态证据，转换为语义高斯占据证据和自由空间光线证据，通过可见性和不确定性感知的因果更新融合到层次化记忆中。实验表明GEM-Occ在局部占据预测、在线地图稳定性、自由空间推理、回环一致性和建筑级可扩展性方面优于先前的基线。
Motivation: 现有室内占据基准和方法主要关注单视图预测或房间级在线感知，缺乏跨连接室内空间的长时程语义映射。
Method: 提出GEM-Occ，一种高斯证据记忆框架。它将局部视觉几何预测视为瞬态证据，转换为语义高斯占据证据和自由空间光线证据，通过可见性和不确定性感知的因果更新融合到持久层次化记忆中，记忆组织为本地缓存、房间级子图和建筑级图，可通过高斯到占据的喷溅查询。
Result: 在HIOcc基准上，GEM-Occ在局部占据预测、在线地图稳定性、自由空间推理、回环一致性和建筑级可扩展性方面优于先前的室内占据和高斯映射基线。
Conclusion: GEM-Occ通过融合瞬态几何证据和层次化记忆实现了更好的室内语义占据映射，尤其适用于长时程和跨空间场景。

papers.title: Self-Review Reinforcement Learning (SRRL) with Cross-Episode Memory and Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning is commonly used to train large language models using environmental feedback. In applied settings, the environment usually provides sparse or delayed feedback. This makes it difficult for the model to pinpoint which actions in its reasoning led to success or failure. So, learning effectively from these signals is hard because the model must determine how each failure should inform meaningful behavioral corrections in subsequent iterations. We introduce a training framework, Self-Review Reinforcement Learning, that embeds an explicit self-review step into each RL episode. When a first-pass response fails, the model generates a self-review to identify what went wrong, which conditions an improved second attempt. Unlike inference-time reflection approaches, such as Reflexion, the framework optimizes self-review with policy gradients and internalizes improvements into the base policy via selective distillation, ensuring they persist across future episodes. A cross-episode memory keeps successful self-reviews for reuse when encountering similar tasks in future episodes during training. We evaluate SRRL against a standard RLVR baseline using the GRPO optimizer across two language models, Qwen 3-4B and OLMo-3- 7B, on GSM8K benchmark. SRRL consistently outperforms the RLVR in final reward performance and achieves greater learning efficiency by successfully transforming feedback into behavioral improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自审强化学习（Self-Review Reinforcement Learning, SRRL）框架，在RL episode中嵌入显式的自我审查步骤：首次响应失败后，模型生成自我审查以识别错误原因，并基于此改进第二次尝试。该框架通过策略梯度优化自我审查，并通过选择性蒸馏将改进内化到基础策略中，同时跨episode记忆保留成功的自我审查以在后续训练中复用。在GSM8K基准上使用GRPO优化器对Qwen 3-4B和OLMo-3-7B进行评估，SRRL在最终奖励和学习效率上均优于标准RLVR基线。
Motivation: 强化学习中环境反馈通常稀疏或延迟，模型难以确定推理中哪些动作导致成功或失败，从而难以从反馈中有效学习行为修正。
Method: 提出SRRL框架：每个RL episode包含首次响应、自我审查（识别错误并指导改进）、第二次响应；使用策略梯度优化自我审查，并通过选择性蒸馏将改进纳入基础策略；同时维护跨episode记忆以重用成功的自我审查。
Result: 在GSM8K基准上，SRRL使用GRPO优化器在Qwen 3-4B和OLMo-3-7B上均显著优于标准RLVR基线，获得更高的最终奖励和更高效的学习。
Conclusion: SRRL通过显式自我审查步骤和跨episode记忆、策略蒸馏，有效将反馈转化为行为改进，提升强化学习在语言模型训练中的效果。

papers.title: Higher-Order Certified Robustness for Regression
papers.abstract_en: Randomized smoothing has emerged as a scalable technique for certifying the adversarial robustness of classifiers. However, its application to regression remains under-explored and faces unique challenges. Existing regression certificates rely on probabilistic acceptance regions and fail to exploit the local geometry of the function. In this work, we present a novel framework for certified robust regression that addresses these limitations. We derive a prediction-centered certificate that guarantees the stability of the smoothed model's prediction and ensures practical computability at test time. We investigate several alternatives for constructing these certificates by explicitly incorporating means, variances, and gradients. In particular, we demonstrate on the MNIST rotation task that utilizing gradient information yields significantly tighter robustness certificates compared to the current state-of-the-art, alpha-smoothing.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向回归任务的认证鲁棒性框架，基于随机平滑（randomized smoothing）技术，并利用梯度信息构建更紧的鲁棒性证书。在MNIST旋转任务上，该方法相比现有最优的alpha-smoothing方法获得了显著更紧的鲁棒性保证。
Motivation: 现有随机平滑认证方法主要针对分类任务，回归场景下的应用尚不充分，且已有回归证书未能利用函数的局部几何信息，导致证书不够紧凑。
Method: 提出了一种预测中心型证书（prediction-centered certificate），显式地结合均值、方差和梯度信息来构建鲁棒性保证，并保证测试时的高效可计算性。
Result: 在MNIST旋转回归任务上，利用梯度信息获得的鲁棒性证书显著优于当前最先进的alpha-smoothing方法。
Conclusion: 该框架证明了在回归问题中利用局部几何信息（尤其是梯度）能够产生更紧的鲁棒性证书，为回归任务的认证鲁棒性提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Teacher Contrastive Distillation for Edge-Efficient Pathology Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Computational pathology foundation models (PFMs) have advanced whole-slide image analysis. However, their size and inference cost hinder local deployment in pathology departments. We propose MuCoDi, a pretraining framework that distills frozen tile embeddings from multiple PFMs into compact edge-oriented encoders. Instead of regressing individual teacher features, MuCoDi trains lightweight MobileOne and RepViT students with a contrastive distillation objective adapted from MoCo v3, where cached Virchow2, UNI2, and H-Optimus-1 embeddings replace momentum-encoder keys. We pretrain students on 14.3M TCGA tiles from only 11.8K WSIs and evaluate frozen encoders on 23 clinically curated downstream classification tasks. RepViT-based MuCoEdge students retain near-teacher performance while reducing model size by orders of magnitude: MuCoEdge-R2.3 and MuCoEdge-R1.5 reach 71.0% external AUROC, within 0.8 percentage points of the best teacher (Virchow2, 71.8%), while MuCoEdge-R2.3 obtains the best external F1 and the second-best AUPRC (51.8% and 53.3%). MuCoEdge-R1.0 reaches 70.9% AUROC with only 6.4M parameters and 1.12 GFLOPs. On a Raspberry Pi 5, sub-million-parameter MobileOne students achieve up to 605-fold single-tile speedup over Virchow2 while retaining 66.5% to 66.9% external AUROC, demonstrating that PFM-quality pathology representations can be moved toward practical edge deployment. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mucodi-6243.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MuCoDi 框架，通过多教师对比蒸馏将多个病理基础模型（Virchow2, UNI2, H-Optimus-1）的冻结图块嵌入蒸馏到轻量级学生编码器（MobileOne, RepViT）中。学生在 14.3M TCGA 图块上预训练，在 23 个临床下游分类任务上评估，RepViT 变体在参数和 FLOPs 大幅降低的情况下，外部 AUROC 仅比最佳教师低 0.8 个百分点。在树莓派 5 上，MobileOne 学生模型实现高达 605 倍的单图块加速，性能保持可观，展示了病理基础模型向边缘部署的可行性。
Motivation: 计算病理基础模型（PFM）规模大、推理成本高，阻碍了其在病理科室的本地部署，需要更高效的边缘端模型。
Method: 提出 MuCoDi 预训练框架，使用来自多个 PFM（Virchow2, UNI2, H-Optimus-1）的冻结图块嵌入作为目标，采用基于 MoCo v3 的对比蒸馏损失训练轻量级学生编码器（MobileOne, RepViT），由缓存的多教师嵌入替代动量编码器键。
Result: RepViT 学生 MuCoEdge-R2.3 和 R1.5 达到 71.0% 外部 AUROC，仅比最佳教师 Virchow2（71.8%）低 0.8 个百分点；MuCoEdge-R1.0 仅 6.4M 参数、1.12 GFLOPs 即达 70.9% AUROC。在树莓派 5 上，MobileOne 学生相比 Virchow2 实现至多 605 倍单图块加速，外部 AUROC 保持在 66.5%-66.9%。
Conclusion: 多教师对比蒸馏可有效压缩病理基础模型，使其在参数和计算量大幅减少的同时保持接近原模型性能，促进 PFM 的实际边缘端应用。

papers.title: $\mathbfλ$-VAE: Variance Equalization for Posterior Collapse
papers.abstract_en: Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) frequently suffer from posterior collapse, a failure mode in which the approximate posterior converges to the prior, rendering the latent code uninformative. Despite extensive research, a unified account of why collapse occurs has remained an open question. We identify and formalize two logically independent but coupled causes. \emph{Gradient imbalance} occurs when the decoder's reconstruction signal vanishes faster than the $\mathbb{KL}$ regularization pressure as the posterior widens. \emph{Information gap} occurs when the stochastic sampling step discards a substantial fraction of the encoder's computed representation, attenuating decoder sensitivity and making collapse inexpensive. Both causes share the same collapse trajectory, and we show that the information gap is algebraically equivalent to mismatch between the aggregate posterior and the prior, unifying two pathologies. Subsequently, we introduce $λ$-VAE, which resolves both causes through a single modification to the reparameterization step: the sampling noise is scaled by per-dimension exponent, while the $\mathbb{KL}$ penalty retains the original posterior variance. This asymmetry shifts the stable training attractor away from the degenerate collapsed state, driving all latent dimensions toward the same equilibrium -- a mechanism we term \emph{variance equalization}. A closed-form optimal exponent per dimension follows from a net information gain objective, with a single hyperparameter controlling the reconstruction-generation tradeoff. We validate on standard benchmarks (Binary MNIST, Binary Omniglot, CIFAR-10, CelebA-64), showing consistent reductions in collapsed dimensions, information capacity gains of up to $2.8\times$ nats, and reconstruction quality improvements of up to $+0.33$ BPD.

papers.title: Rendering-Aware Bayesian 3D Gaussian Splatting with Native Uncertainty and Adaptive Complexity Control
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) is a strong representation for real-time novel-view synthesis, but its standard training pipeline relies on point estimates and hand-tuned heuristics, providing no native uncertainty or principled complexity control. This is most limiting under sparse views or fixed acquisition budgets, where a model must identify weakly supported geometry and select informative views. We introduce a rendering-aware Bayesian 3DGS framework that tracks Gaussian geometry with a Normal-Inverse-Wishart posterior over means and covariances using renderer-derived surrogate summaries. An optional Dirichlet-process extension adds a probabilistic component-usage signal, and the training schedule makes the closed-form versus approximate inference boundary explicit. Re-rendering posterior geometry samples yields native predictive uncertainty for interval calibration and active view selection. In a fixed-budget 16-to-32 active-view task, native NIW acquisition improves PSNR by +0.453 dB and LPIPS by -0.0146 over a scoring-only 3-member standard-ensemble baseline, winning 29/39 scene-seed pairs and 10/13 scene means; it also improves over PPU-style (+0.355 dB) and NIW-proxy (+0.401 dB) acquisition. NIW native intervals reduce 95% coverage error by about 17x relative to a shared proxy (0.046 vs. 0.796) and are about 10x closer to nominal coverage than a 3-member deep ensemble (0.047 vs. 0.454) at roughly one-third the training cost. As a reconstruction compatibility check, paired NIW-vs-standard analysis over 39 scene-seed runs yields +0.030 dB PSNR with 1.6% additional training time. These results position Bayesian 3DGS as a practical probabilistic scene representation for decision-facing tasks such as active view selection.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 24 tables including appendix. Preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种渲染感知的贝叶斯3D高斯溅射（Bayesian 3DGS）框架，通过Normal-Inverse-Wishart后验跟踪高斯几何，并利用渲染器导出的代理摘要实现原生不确定性估计和自适应复杂度控制。在主动视图选择任务中，该方法在PSNR和LPIPS上优于标准集成基线，并将95%覆盖误差降低约17倍。
Motivation: 标准3DGS依赖于点估计和手工启发式，缺乏原生不确定性或复杂度控制，在稀疏视图或固定采集预算下难以识别弱支撑几何并选择信息量大的视图。
Method: 引入渲染感知的贝叶斯3DGS框架，对均值和协方差使用Normal-Inverse-Wishart后验，并可选地结合Dirichlet过程扩展提供概率化组件使用信号。训练方案明确区分闭式与近似推断边界，通过重渲染后验几何样本获得原生预测不确定性。
Result: 在16→32视图主动任务中，原生NIW采集将PSNR提升0.453 dB，LPIPS降低0.0146；NIW本征区间将95%覆盖误差从0.796降至0.046（约17倍），比3成员深度集成更接近名义覆盖（0.047 vs 0.454），训练成本约为后者的1/3。
Conclusion: 该方法将贝叶斯3DGS构建为面向决策任务（如主动视图选择）的实用概率场景表示。

papers.title: aiAuthZ: Off-Host, Identity-Bound Authorization for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents issue tool calls on the basis of text they cannot verify, so any party who controls part of the context can forge the appearance of authority. I evaluate 15 contemporary language models against eight attack scenarios derived from a published corpus of real agent incidents and find that refusal varies from 100% down to 38% across fully evaluated models; the most expensive model refused only half of the attacks despite a twentyfold price spread. I present aiAuthZ, an authorization gateway that moves the safety decision off the agent's host. Before a tool call executes, the gateway verifies caller identity with a per-message HMAC-SHA256 signature bound to a single-use nonce and a timestamp window, and it evaluates a role-based and argument-level policy that the agent can neither read nor modify. Every decision joins a SHA-256 hash-chained audit log, and each accepted message yields an HMAC-authenticated QR receipt that achieves 94% mean verification across eight transmission channels, with zero forgeries accepted in 25 wrong-key trials. With the gateway in place, residual attack success falls to 0% for all 15 models at no more than 0.03 ms of added decision latency. On the AgentDojo banking suite, aiAuthZ blocks all seven attacker-directed tool calls the evaluated agents emit, at the cost of one legitimate first-time payment, while a spotlighting baseline allows two injections to succeed. Across nine in-scope case studies from the same incident corpus, aiAuthZ blocks nine of nine, against four of nine for a policy baseline without identity binding. The gateway does not prevent a model from being deceived; it prevents a deceived model from acting beyond the verified user's authority on every call routed through it. The implementation and all experiments are released at https://github.com/Sports-Vision-Inc/aiAuthZ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 aiAuthZ，一种将授权决策移到 AI 代理宿主之外的网关。它通过 HMAC-SHA256 签名、一次性 nonce 和时间戳窗口验证调用者身份，并执行基于角色和参数级别的策略。实验表明，该网关可将 15 个语言模型的攻击成功率降至 0%，且仅增加不到 0.03ms 延迟。
Motivation: AI 代理根据不可验证的文本发出工具调用，任何控制上下文的一方都可伪造权限。现有模型对攻击的拒绝率最低仅 38%，需要更可靠的授权机制。
Method: 提出 aiAuthZ 网关：在工具调用执行前，用 per-message HMAC-SHA256 签名（绑定一次性 nonce 和时间戳）验证身份，并执行代理无法读取或修改的角色与参数级别策略。所有决策记录在 SHA-256 哈希链审计日志中，每条接受的消息生成 HMAC 认证的 QR 收据。
Result: 在 15 个模型上攻击成功率降至 0%，延迟增加 ≤0.03ms。在 AgentDojo 银行套件中，aiAuthZ 阻止所有 7 个攻击者导向的工具调用，但误阻了一次合法支付；9 个案例研究中全部阻止，而基线仅阻止 4 个。
Conclusion: aiAuthZ 无法防止模型被欺骗，但能防止被欺骗的模型超出已验证用户权限行动，使每次工具调用都受到身份绑定的授权约束。

papers.title: Statistical Adversaries: Natural Backdoor-like Features in Vision Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Model-specific adversarial attacks have been extensively studied. We study a different failure mode: naturally occurring statistical signals in vision data that can behave like backdoor-like triggers without being maliciously inserted. We call these signals statistical adversaries. We analyse Imagenet to find patterns that are strongly linked to certain labels. We then use statistical controls to remove random correlations from our candidate signals. Finally, we demonstrate that these signals directly and predictably alter model predictions. These statistical adversaries are more targeted than generic corruptions and transfer across different model architectures. This suggests that some vulnerabilities are driven by dataset structure and distribution rather than a single model's idiosyncrasies. We conclude that ordinary datasets can contain exploitable adversarial surfaces even in the absence of poisoning, and suggest that dataset audits should treat spurious structure not only as a source of bias or interpretability failure, but also as a latent attack surface for vision models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“统计对手”（Statistical Adversaries）概念，指视觉数据集中天然存在的、可像后门触发器一样影响模型预测的统计信号，无需恶意注入。通过分析ImageNet发现与标签强相关的模式，并使用统计控制去除随机相关，验证这些信号可直接且可预测地改变模型输出，且跨架构可迁移。结论认为普通数据集的伪结构可构成潜在攻击面，建议数据集审计除关注偏差和可解释性外，也应考虑此类安全风险。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注模型特定的对抗攻击，但忽视了数据集本身固有的统计信号可能引发的系统性漏洞。本文旨在揭示视觉数据集中自然存在的、类似后门的特征如何导致模型预测错误，而无需任何恶意注入。
Method: 对ImageNet数据集进行分析，寻找与特定标签强相关的统计模式，然后通过统计控制去除随机相关性，最终测试这些候选信号对模型预测的直接影响和可预测性。
Result: 发现的统计对手比通用噪声更具针对性，且能够在不同模型架构间迁移。这些信号直接且可预测地改变模型预测，表明部分漏洞源于数据集结构和分布而非单一模型特性。
Conclusion: 普通数据集即使在没有投毒的情况下也可能包含可被利用的对抗表面。建议数据集审计不仅将伪结构视为偏差或可解释性问题来源，还应将其视为视觉模型的潜在攻击面。

papers.title: Light-Omni: Reflex over Reasoning in Agentic Video Understanding with Long-Term Memory
papers.abstract_en: Agentic video understanding equips models with long-term memory to autonomously process and respond to continuous, long-horizon multimodal streams. However, advanced video agents often rely on ``detective-style'' iterative reasoning for action control (e.g., $\mathtt{search}$) and evidence aggregation, incurring prohibitive costs and latency. We argue that such heavy reasoning primarily compensates for the lack of global context and semantic misalignment in retrieval. This paper introduces Light-Omni, a multimodal agent framework for reflexive and lightweight video understanding. It achieves this through dual contextual states that instantly build the required context in a single forward pass. First, we maintain a global state, a finite-sized multimodal script continuously consolidated from episodic memory, serving as the global context for Light-Omni. Through hierarchical merging, it preserves recent details while summarizing past events. Second, conditioned on this global context, we generate a parametric latent state that directly drives autonomous actions and produces retrieval embeddings, with minimal latency. Benefiting from this coupled design, Light-Omni achieves semantically aligned retrieval and reflexive responses while avoiding iterative reasoning. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of Light-Omni across multiple video benchmarks. Notably, it outperforms M3-Agent with an average 2.4% accuracy gain, a 12.1$\times$ speedup, and a 2.6$\times$ improvement in GPU memory efficiency. Furthermore, it serves as a memory system to enhance both the performance and efficiency of existing MLLMs. Project page: https://clare-nie.github.io/Light-Omni.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Light-Omni，一种用于智能体视频理解的轻量级多模态框架，通过双上下文状态（全局状态和参数化潜在状态）实现反射式而非推理式的响应，避免了昂贵的迭代推理。在多个视频基准上，Light-Omni 以平均 2.4% 的准确率提升、12.1 倍速度提升和 2.6 倍 GPU 内存效率提升超越 M3-Agent，并可作为内存系统增强现有 MLLM 的性能和效率。
Motivation: 现有视频智能体依赖"侦探式"迭代推理进行动作控制和证据聚合，导致高昂成本和延迟。作者认为这种推理主要弥补了检索中全局上下文缺失和语义不对齐的问题。
Method: 提出双上下文状态：1) 全局状态，通过分层合并从情节记忆持续整合的有限大小多模态脚本，保留近期细节并总结过去事件；2) 参数化潜在状态，以全局状态为条件，直接驱动自主行为并生成检索嵌入，最小化延迟。
Result: 在多个视频基准上，Light-Omni 优于 M3-Agent：平均准确率提升 2.4%，速度提升 12.1 倍，GPU 内存效率提升 2.6 倍。
Conclusion: 耦合的全局和潜在状态设计实现了语义对齐的检索和反射式响应，避免迭代推理，同时提升性能与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ground3D-LMM: Fine-Grained 3D Point Grounding and Spatial Reasoning with LMM
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language queries about 3D environments become actionable when responses are verifiable and metric. Verifiability requires explicit grounding to the referred 3D region, while metric answers report physical measurements in real-world units (e.g., size, thickness, clearance, and distance). Existing 3D large multimodal models (LMMs) approaches remain limited: conversational systems typically respond without explicit 3D grounding, while 3D grounding models are not designed for interactive, metric-aware dialogue. In this paper, we present Ground3D-LMM, a unified model that takes a point cloud and an optional RGB image as input and supports 3D spatial conversation with (i) point-grounded responses and (ii) metric numeric outputs at both object and part granularity, including multi-object queries. To evaluate this intersection of grounding and measurement, we define the 3D Grounded Measurement task, which requires predicting the referred 3D region and the corresponding metric quantities in real-world units. We introduce a large-scale dataset built on ScanNet and ScanNet++ datasets with dense object and part annotations and roughly 2.5M question-answer pairs spanning eight tasks, along with a manually verified test set. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets and tasks show that our proposed Ground3D-LMM model provides a strong baseline for grounded, metric-aware 3D conversational understanding. Our dataset and model are publicly available.

Method: 构建统一模型Ground3D-LMM，以点云和可选RGB图像为输入，输出点级标定响应和公制数值（如尺寸、厚度、间距），支持物体和部件粒度及多物体查询。基于ScanNet和ScanNet++构建250万问答对数据集，定义3D公制标定任务。

papers.title: Lean-Quantum: Toward AI-Assisted Formalization of Quantum Information
papers.abstract_en: Quantum information theory is built on entropic quantities; among them, the sandwiched Rényi relative entropy is a fundamental divergence with various applications, and its data processing inequality (DPI) under quantum channels is a cornerstone result. In this work, we present a Lean 4 library for quantum information, designed as a reusable formal infrastructure for theoretical analysis. As a central demonstration of the library, we formalize the DPI for the sandwiched Rényi relative entropy for positive semidefinite operators on finite-dimensional quantum systems. The library provides a basis-independent operator-theoretic framework for finite-dimensional quantum mechanics compatible with the standard mathematical library Mathlib, including reusable interfaces for finite-dimensional systems, states, channels, tensor products, partial traces, Choi operators, Kraus representations, and Stinespring representations. It also builds infrastructure for noncommutative trace inequalities, including operator monotonicity and convexity via the real continuous functional calculus, block-operator positivity, Hilbert-Schmidt operator spaces, Jensen's operator inequality, generalized perspectives, operator power means, and Lieb-Ando trace inequalities. On top of this framework, we formalize entropy-specific ingredients for the DPI: variational formulas for the sandwiched quasi-entropy via Young and reverse-Young inequalities, tensor-product compatibility of real powers, and Haar measures on unitary groups. Together, these components yield a Lean formalization of the DPI, give strong subadditivity as a corollary, and provide the last missing component needed to complete the Lean formalization of the generalized quantum Stein's lemma. More broadly, the development provides machine-checkable foundations for future formalized and AI-assisted research in quantum information theory.
papers.comment: 34 pages, the Lean library is available at https://github.com/Hayata-Yamasaki-Group/lean-quantum
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了Lean 4中量子信息的形式化库，重点形式化了夹层Rényi相对熵在量子信道下的数据处理不等式（DPI），并提供了有限维量子系统的算子理论框架。
Motivation: 量子信息理论缺乏机器可验证的数学基础，夹层Rényi相对熵的DPI是核心结果，但之前未被形式化验证。
Method: 开发了基于Lean 4的量子信息库，建立在Mathlib之上，包括有限维系统、状态、信道、张量积、偏迹等基础设施，以及非交换迹不等式工具，最终形式化DPI。
Result: 成功形式化了夹层Rényi相对熵的DPI，并得到强次可加性作为推论，同时提供了广义量子Stein引理形式化所需的最后一个缺失组件。
Conclusion: 该工作为量子信息理论的未来形式化和AI辅助研究提供了机器可检查的基础。

papers.title: Black Hole Black Boxes: Numerical Black Hole Metrics via AInstein Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The AInstein architecture introduced an unsupervised neural method for solving the Riemannian Einstein equations on arbitrary manifolds. This Physics Informed Neural Network approach (PINN) is extended here to Lorentzian signature, validated by recovering the maximally extended Schwarzschild geometry, and tested as novel search method for arbitrary black hole solutions. The topology is built into the architecture by treating $S^{2}$ globally through its standard embedding, such that the network learns an ambient metric on the manifold $\mathbb{R}^{2} \times \mathbb{R}^{3}$, where Penrose coordinates are chosen for $\mathbb{R}^2$ and the metric on $S^{2}$ is obtained by pullback. The architecture is first trained with the objective of recovering the Schwarzschild metric via losses encoding the vacuum Einstein equation, a quadratic Weyl scalar constraint, and the $SO(3)$ symmetry of the resultant metric; directly motivated by the Birkhoff--Jebsen theorem. Following this, the objective is generalised to use the Petrov speciality index, a horizon curvature anchor, and a trapped-surface constraint, to allow search for algebraically general Petrov type I solutions, finding potentially novel general-type Lorentzian Einstein metrics with a genuinely trapped interior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了AInstein无监督神经网络架构，将其从黎曼几何推广到洛伦兹符号的时空几何，用于求解真空爱因斯坦方程。通过恢复最大延拓的Schwarzschild度规验证方法有效性，并进一步利用Petrov特殊指标、视界曲率锚和陷获面约束，搜索代数一般的Petrov I型黑洞解。网络架构将S²拓扑通过标准嵌入全局处理，学习R²×R³上的背景度规。
Motivation: 传统的数值相对论方法在搜索任意黑洞解时计算复杂且需先验假设，本文旨在提供一种无监督神经网络方法，直接通过损失函数编码爱因斯坦方程和对称性约束，自动发现新黑洞解。
Method: 采用物理学启发的神经网络（PINN）方法，将S²通过其标准嵌入全局处理，网络学习R²×R³上的度规。损失函数包括真空爱因斯坦方程、二次Weyl标量约束、SO(3)对称性约束，随后引入Petrov特殊指标、视界曲率锚和陷获面约束以搜索一般类型解。
Result: 成功恢复最大延拓Schwarzschild度规，验证方法有效性。初步测试显示能够找到代数一般的Petrov I型爱因斯坦度规，并具有真正的陷获内区。
Conclusion: 该方法为搜索任意黑洞解提供了新的数值工具，通过将拓扑直接内建于架构并利用多种约束，有望发现新的精确或数值黑洞度规。限于网络容量和训练策略，高精度解可能需要进一步优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SHARC: SHAP-Based Interpretability in Machine Learning Risk Models for Regulatory Capital under ICAAP and CCAR
papers.abstract_en: The adoption of non-parametric machine learning models for regulatory capital estimation introduces a fundamental governance challenge: the inability to explain model outputs in a manner auditable by supervisory bodies. This 'black box' problem remains a major barrier to the adoption of Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) and related ML architectures in ICAAP and CCAR workflows despite their predictive advantages over traditional parametric approaches. This paper addresses this barrier through SHARC (SHAP for Regulatory Capital), an explainability framework for the Hybrid GPR-HS architecture and its stress-testing extension. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP), derived from cooperative game theory and satisfying the properties of Local Accuracy, Missingness, Consistency, and Efficiency, are applied to Stressed Value-at-Risk (SVaR) outputs under three macro scenarios: West Asia War, Climate Risk, and AI Bubble/Regulatory Burden. SHARC decomposes SVaR into baseline, mean-driven, and volatility-driven components, enabling transparent linkage between scenario design and capital outcomes. Two findings emerge. First, SHARC consistently links non-linear SVaR outputs to underlying scenario inputs, confirming framework fidelity and providing auditable traceability of capital drivers. Second, under stress conditions, the mean return component (directional loss magnitude) dominates the variance component (volatility baseline) in determining capital levels, with implications for capital limit-setting, position management, and hedging strategy. The results establish SHARC as a regulator-aligned explainability layer that makes the Hybrid GPR-HS framework fully auditable and consistent with FRTB, ICAAP Pillar 2, and CCAR transparency requirements.
papers.comment: Builds on: Paper 1: arXiv:2605.17275, Paper 2: arXiv:2606.07575
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SHARC（SHAP for Regulatory Capital）框架，用于解释混合GPR-HS架构在ICAAP和CCAR监管资本估计中的输出。通过将Stressed VaR分解为基线、均值驱动和波动驱动分量，SHARC在西亚战争、气候风险和AI泡沫/监管负担三种宏观情景下提供了可审计的透明性。实验表明SHARC能一致地将非线性SVaR输出与情景输入关联，且压力条件下均值回报分量主导资本水平。
Motivation: 非参数机器学习模型在监管资本估计中面临‘黑箱’问题，无法向监管机构解释模型输出，阻碍了GPR等模型在ICAAP和CCAR流程中的采用。
Method: 提出SHARC框架，基于SHAP值将Stressed VaR分解为基线、均值驱动和波动驱动分量，并在三种宏观情景下应用，实现可审计的资本驱动因素溯源。
Result: SHARC一致地将非线性SVaR输出与情景输入关联，证实框架保真度；压力条件下均值回报分量（方向性损失幅度）主导波动率分量，影响资本限额和避险策略。
Conclusion: SHARC作为与监管对齐的可解释性层，使混合GPR-HS框架完全可审计，满足FRTB、ICAAP Pillar 2和CCAR透明度要求。

papers.title: PatchOptic for Shared-State LLM Workflows with Projected Views and Verified Structured Updates
papers.abstract_en: Agentic workflows often operate over shared, structured state. Because LLM context windows are limited, each model invocation is typically shown only the state fragment needed for the current workflow step, a pattern commonly known as progressive disclosure. Modern systems construct such model-facing views using grep-like keyword search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), abstract-syntax-tree (AST) queries, and task-specific agent skills. These methods make the read side manageable, but they do not define when a locally proposed rewrite is valid after it is applied back to the full state. The missing piece is a contract between local updates and global validity. We introduce PatchOptic, an optic-inspired interface for shared-state LLM workflows. Optics are compositional bidirectional accessors that describe how views of structured data are read and updated. PatchOptic borrows this view/update intuition and realizes it through projected reads and verified structured patches. Each workflow step declares a projected read view, an authorized write region, and a patch-source region. Beyond runtime enforcement, the same declaration yields a path-level footprint that supports delegation, sub-workflow composition, and static certificates for reordering independent steps within the same phase. We evaluate this design with PatchBench, a benchmark with 46 cases across domains. The results show that projected reads reduce reported leakage and token cost while preserving accepted-output quality under the strong actor. Runtime verification blocks declared workflow-contract violations before commit, and patch-read enforcement rejects compromised patch artifacts that use hidden sources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对LLM工作流中共享状态更新的全局一致性问题，本文提出PatchOptic——一种受光学（optic）启发的接口，通过投影读取（projected read）和验证的结构化补丁（verified structured patch）来定义局部更新与全局状态之间的契约。每个工作流步骤显式声明读取视图、授权写入区域和补丁来源区域，支持运行时验证和静态重排序证书。在46个跨领域案例的PatchBench上，投影读取降低了信息泄漏和token成本，同时保持输出质量，运行时验证能阻止违规更新。
Motivation: 现有LLM工作流通过关键词搜索、RAG、AST查询等方法实现了渐进式披露的读取侧，但未定义局部更新在写回全局状态后是否有效，缺乏局部更新与全局有效性之间的契约。
Method: 提出PatchOptic接口，将光学（optic）的组合双向访问思想应用于共享状态工作流：每个步骤声明投影读取视图、授权写入区域和补丁来源区域；通过运行时验证和路径级足迹支持子工作流组合与独立步骤的静态重排序证书。
Result: 在46个案例的PatchBench上，投影读取在强演员（strong actor）下减少了报告的信息泄漏和token成本，同时保持了可接受的输出质量；运行时验证在提交前阻止声明的工作流契约违规；补丁读取机制拒绝使用隐藏来源的受损补丁。
Conclusion: 该工作认为，投影读取和验证的结构化补丁为共享状态LLM工作流提供了可组合的局部更新全局有效性契约，兼顾效率与安全性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Full-range Binary Classifier Calibration for Stable Model Updates in Production
papers.abstract_en: Detection models running in adversarial environments face a malicious distribution that drifts rapidly while the benign distribution stays comparatively stable, so teams retrain and redeploy constantly to stay ahead of new threats. Retraining tends to change the output prediction scores, which breaks downstream users of the model. For these security-oriented models we need consistent false-positive rate (FPR) across all output values, whereas standard probability-calibration methods target class probability rather than an FPR contract. We introduce a method built on top of existing calibration primitives that targets the whole FPR curve, giving scores a consistent FPR meaning across deployments. On one held-out split, the observed relative FPR error was at most 2.3% from 10% down to 0.1% FPR and 7.2% at 0.01% FPR. The shipped artifact remains under 200 KB in measurements across calibration sets from 1K to 10M benign samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对对抗环境中检测模型因重训练导致输出分数变化的问题，提出一种基于现有校准原语的二分类器全范围校准方法，使输出分数的假阳性率（FPR）在不同部署间保持一致。实验表明，在保留集上，从10%到0.1% FPR的相对误差不超过2.3%，在0.01% FPR时误差为7.2%，且校准产物体积小于200 KB。
Motivation: 安全领域的检测模型需应对快速漂移的恶意分布，频繁重训练导致输出分数变化，破坏下游用户对FPR的依赖。现有概率校准方法无法满足FPR一致性需求。
Method: 在现有校准原语基础上，构建面向整个FPR曲线的校准方法，使不同部署版本中相同分数对应相同的FPR含义。
Result: 在保留集上，从10%到0.1% FPR的相对误差≤2.3%，0.01% FPR时误差为7.2%；校准产物（含校准集从1K到10M良性样本）体积小于200 KB。
Conclusion: 该方法可有效保证安全模型更新时FPR的一致性，且轻量实用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Privilege and confidentiality in generative AI workflows
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI (GenAI) systems store and process client data in three distinct ways: in the model's parameters through training and memorisation, in the context window during a live session, and in knowledge databases for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Each mode creates different and often counter-intuitive risks to confidentiality and legal professional privilege, and each calls for specific governance responses. Drawing on the first English and American decisions to address privilege and generative AI, UK and Munir v Secretary of State for the Home Department and United States v Heppner, on the orthodox privilege authorities against which those decisions must be read, and on recent computer science research, we explain the three modes of data storage and processing in terms accessible to practitioners and analyse the legal consequences of each. We then situate the analysis within the regulatory framework governing solicitors in England and Wales and within the ordinary principles of professional negligence, arguing that the standard of effective information governance (and with it the benchmark against which negligence and misconduct will be measured) is changing. Although we write primarily for SRA-regulated practitioners, our data-governance analysis is framed to extend to any jurisdiction in which the protection of privilege or professional secrecy depends on demonstrable confidentiality. The ultimate aim of this article is to help legal services professionals understand salient data leakage risks in GenAI systems and thereby facilitate a more responsible deployment of GenAI on client data and other sensitive material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨生成式AI系统中客户数据在三种存储和处理模式（模型参数、上下文窗口、知识库）下对保密性和法律职业特权的风险，结合英美早期判例（UK Munir案、US Heppner案）和传统特权原则，分析法律后果，并讨论英格兰和威尔士律师监管框架下的信息治理标准变化。
Motivation: 生成式AI系统以三种不同方式存储和处理客户数据，每种方式对保密性和法律特权产生不同且常反直觉的风险，需要针对性的治理措施。
Method: 通过分析英美早期判例、传统特权权威和最新计算机科学研究，以从业者易懂的方式解释三种数据处理模式，并分析其法律后果，最后将分析置于英格兰和威尔士监管框架及专业过失原则下。
Result: 文章认为有效信息治理的标准正在变化，疏忽和行为不当的评判基准也随之调整。
Conclusion: 旨在帮助法律服务专业人士理解GenAI系统中的数据泄露风险，促进更负责任地在客户数据和其他敏感材料上部署GenAI。

papers.title: InvWeaver: Deductive Feedback for Invariant Synthesis in Interacting-Loop Programs
papers.abstract_en: Loop invariant inference is a fundamental yet challenging problem in program verification. Recent LLM-aided guess-and-check techniques have shown strong performance on single-loop programs, but they often struggle with programs containing multiple interacting loops. This paper presents InvWeaver, a neuro-symbolic framework for synthesizing invariants for such programs. The key idea is to expose inter-loop dependencies and propagate proof obligations through a combination of loop-level abstraction, obligation-guided inference, and weakest-precondition-based refinement. We evaluate InvWeaver on a comprehensive benchmark suite, including a newly curated dataset derived from classic algorithms. Experimental results show that InvWeaver substantially outperforms existing invariant inference methods, solving 72 out of 82 multi-loop benchmark problems and maintaining strong performance on single-loop tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出InvWeaver，一种神经符号框架，用于合成包含多个交互循环的程序的不变式。通过循环级抽象、义务引导推理和最弱前置条件细化，暴露循环间依赖并传播证明义务。在包含82个多循环问题的基准上解决72个，并在单循环任务上保持强性能，大幅优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有的LLM辅助猜测-检查方法在单循环程序上表现良好，但在多交互循环程序中效果不佳，而这类程序在程序验证中普遍存在且更具挑战性。
Method: InvWeaver结合循环级抽象、义务引导推理和最弱前置条件细化，将多循环程序的证明义务分解并传播，利用神经符号方法生成候选不变式。
Result: 在包含82个多循环问题的基准上成功解决72个，显著超过现有不变式推理方法；同时在单循环任务上也保持强性能。
Conclusion: InvWeaver通过显式处理循环间交互，有效提升了多循环程序的不变式综合能力，但可能依赖程序结构的可分解性。

papers.title: Decision Protocols in Multi-Agent Large Language Model Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Improving the task performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential, yet scaling these models faces significant challenges such as diminishing returns and high costs. Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) offer a promising solution by distributing tasks among specialized agents to improve the overall task performance. This can reduce training costs at the expense of increased test time due to the discussion and decision-making process. The decision protocol is a critical component of MAS because it specifies how multiple agents collaborate to create a final solution. This thesis introduces the Multi-Agent LLM (MALLM) framework, which implements and evaluates various decision protocols, namely voting, consensus, and judge decision mechanisms, to simulate multi-agent discussions for conversational task solving. Unlike previous work that used a single decision protocol or tested them on limited datasets, this study systematically examines their impact on a diverse set of tasks, ranging from knowledge-based datasets (MMLU, MMLU-Pro, GPQA) and logic-based datasets (StrategyQA, MuSR, Math-lvl-5, SQuAD 2.0). The results indicate that consensus protocols excel in knowledge-intensive domains while voting and judge protocols are more effective for logic-based tasks. Increasing response diversity through independent solution generation improves decision quality, while changes in information access during the decision process have minimal impact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是Göttingen大学的硕士论文，系统研究了多智能体对话系统中的决策协议，包括投票、共识和法官机制，并在多种知识型和逻辑型数据集上评估了它们的性能。结果表明共识协议在知识密集型任务中表现较好，而投票和法官协议在逻辑型任务中更有效。
Motivation: 大规模语言模型在扩展时面临收益递减和高成本等问题，多智能体系统通过分配任务给专门智能体可以提升整体性能，但决策协议对协作效果的关键影响尚未被系统研究。
Method: 提出了MALLM框架，实现了投票、共识和法官三种决策协议，并在MMLU、MMLU-Pro、GPQA等知识型数据集和StrategyQA、MuSR等逻辑型数据集上进行了对比实验。
Result: 共识协议在知识密集型任务中表现优异，而投票和法官协议在逻辑型任务中更有效；通过独立生成答案增加回答多样性可提升决策质量，而改变信息访问方式影响较小。
Conclusion: 论文强调决策协议的选择应根据任务类型调整，共识适合知识型，投票和法官适合逻辑型，并指出多样性对决策质量的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Parameter-Free Encoders Remain Viable for RDB Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Given a relational database (RDB) storing heterogeneous tabular information, how can we predict missing (or future) values in some target column of interest? As the space of potential targets is vast across enterprise settings, it is preferable to avoid learning a new model from scratch each time there is a new prediction task. Frozen foundation models based on RDB-specific encoders provide a viable solution, but ideal design remains an open question. On the one hand, it has recently been argued that certain parameter-free subgraph encoders combined with single-table foundation models can achieve near SOTA performance, with no RDB-specific pre-training required. Meanwhile, other contemporary studies advocate for parameterized encoders pre-trained to exploit observable labels for learning task-specific representations. To address this ambiguity, we analyze RDB encoder properties specifically when labels are present as inputs, proving limitations on the potential efficacy of trainable encoder parameters. As empirical validation, we demonstrate that considerably simpler parameter-free encoders are still capable of strong performance across many relevant benchmarking tasks.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究关系数据库（RDB）基础模型中的编码器设计问题，针对在标签作为输入时参数化编码器的有效性进行理论分析，证明其存在局限性，并通过实验表明简单的无参数编码器（parameter-free encoders）仍能在多个基准任务上取得强性能，无需RDB特定的预训练。
Motivation: RDB基础模型需要处理异构表格数据中的缺失值预测任务，但每次新任务都从头训练模型不现实。现有工作对编码器设计存在分歧：一方主张无参数子图编码器结合单表基础模型可达近SOTA性能，另一方强调参数化编码器需预训练以利用标签学习任务特定表示，本文旨在澄清这一矛盾。
Method: 通过理论分析证明当标签作为输入时，可训练编码器参数的有效性受到限制，并通过大量基准实验验证无参数编码器的竞争力。
Result: 实验表明，简单的无参数编码器仍然能够在许多相关基准任务上取得强性能，挑战了参数化编码器必须预训练的观点。
Conclusion: 无参数编码器仍是RDB基础模型的有竞争力选择，无需依赖RDB特定的预训练即可实现接近SOTA的性能。

papers.title: Is Your NPU Ready for LLMs? Dissecting the Hidden Efficiency Bottlenecks in Mobile LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) on mobile devices enhances privacy and reduces latency, but is severely bottlenecked by hardware inefficiency. We present the first comprehensive, cross-layer measurement study of mobile LLM inference, uniquely spanning five mainstream frameworks (e.g., llama.cpp, GENIE) and three hardware backends (CPU, GPU, NPU). To enable this analysis, we develop PowerBench, a fine-grained profiling tool that provides the first backend-specific energy attribution, moving beyond traditional device-level measurements. Our study yields three critical insights: (1) Framework-induced performance gaps are substantially amplified on NPUs, reaching up to 10x using custom operators due to divergent offloading and quantization strategies. (2) We identify a distinct phase split where NPUs excel at compute-bound prefilling, while CPUs outperform all other backends in memory-bound decoding. This is driven by the NPU's preference for large, fixed-shape workloads, which conflicts with the small-kernel, dynamic nature of decoding. (3) Backend-specific profiling uncovers substantial scheduling headroom missed by prior work. Suboptimal thread configurations, uncoordinated NPU sleep latencies, and CPU polling intervals result in up to 40% energy waste. Leveraging these findings, we present an energy-oriented best-practice configuration for mobile LLM inference. We estimate that this configuration could reduce energy consumption by up to 54.8% on the NPU backend across three datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对移动端大语言模型推理进行跨层测量研究，涵盖五种主流框架和三种硬件后端（CPU、GPU、NPU），并开发了细粒度剖析工具PowerBench。研究发现框架在NPU上的性能差距可达10倍，NPU擅长计算密集型预填充但解码阶段效率低，以及后端特定配置导致高达40%的能源浪费，最终提出降低54.8%能耗的最佳实践配置。
Motivation: 移动端部署LLM面临硬件效率瓶颈，现有研究缺乏对NPU等硬件后端细粒度跨层剖析，无法准确诊断能耗和性能问题的根源。
Method: 开发PowerBench工具实现后端特定能耗归因，对llama.cpp、GENIE等框架在CPU/GPU/NPU上进行跨层测量，分析框架策略、硬件调度等对性能的影响。
Result: NPU上框架自定义算子导致性能差距达10倍；NPU在预填充阶段表现优异，但解码阶段由于小核动态负载不及CPU；次优配置导致高达40%能源浪费，优化后NPU能耗降低54.8%。
Conclusion: 移动端LLM推理应根据阶段（预填充/解码）选择最优后端并精细配置线程和睡眠策略，NPU在解码阶段效率不足，CPU仍是解码阶段的更优选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Binocular Gaze Estimation with Single Camera and Single Light Source
papers.abstract_en: According to commonly consented theories, the minimum hardware requirement for gaze tracker is one camera and two light sources to realize gaze estimation with free head movements. However, in some scenarios such as eye tracking on mobile devices, it is preferable to use less components, especially light sources. We propose a gaze estimation method with one camera and one light source. A "virtual light source" is introduced, which is geometrically placed symmetrically to the real light source with respect to the camera, and generates a "virtual glint" in the acquired image. We estimate the "virtual glint" by exploiting the relationship between the distance between two pupils and two glints in the captured image, and estimate the gaze with polynomial regression assuming two light sources are available. A new normalization factor for regression method is verified, which turns out to be practical for one-glint system. The performance is proved to be acceptable, while degradation is noticed compared to system with two actual light sources.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅使用单摄像头和单光源实现双眼注视估计的方法。通过引入“虚拟光源”和“虚拟光斑”，利用瞳孔与光斑距离的关系进行多项式回归，近似达到双光源系统的效果，在精度有所下降的前提下获得了可接受的性能。
Motivation: 传统注视估计至少需要两个光源才能允许头部自由运动（如手机等移动场景）。为减少硬件组件、尤其是光源数量，本文尝试只用单摄像头和单光源实现双眼注视估计。
Method: 引入几何上与真实光源关于摄像头对称的“虚拟光源”概念，并在图像中估算对应的“虚拟光斑”；利用单图像中双瞳孔与双光斑之间的距离关系推算虚拟光斑位置，再使用基于多项式回归的注视估计算法（假设有两个光源可用），并验证了一种适用于单光斑系统的归一化因子。
Result: 实验表明所提方法性能可接受，但与双实际光源系统相比存在精度下降。论文在VSIP 2019会议论文中报告了4张图和1张表的结果（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 单光源注视估计在移动设备等资源受限场景中具有实用价值，但精度低于双光源方案，未来需进一步缩小差距。

papers.title: KAT-Coder-V2.5 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We present KAT-Coder-V2.5, a coding-focused agentic model trained to act autonomously inside real, executable repositories rather than as a single-turn code generator. Its capability is bottlenecked less by model scale than by the scarcity of reproducible environments, verifiable rewards, and high-value trajectories, which we address with an end-to-end agentic post-training framework. AutoBuilder reconstructs multilingual repositories into sandboxed environments with fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass verification at scale, from which we regenerate self-contained task specifications, recover near-miss trajectories, and distill supervision through process-aware filtering, while KwaiClawEnv synthesizes large-scale tool-use trajectories from executable services and real task seeds. We further scale reinforcement learning with harness randomization, a reliability-hardened sandbox, an asymmetric actor--critic PPO with hindsight-augmented value estimation, and a harness-oriented reward framework, and unify SWE, Agent-Claw, and WebCoding experts via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Across six software-engineering and agentic benchmarks, KAT-Coder-V2.5 delivers the best agentic tool-use result on PinchBench and ranks second only to the frontier Opus 4.8 on repository-level software engineering. Our service is available at https://streamlake.com/product/kat-coder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了KAT-Coder-V2.5，一个面向编码的智能体模型，能够自主在真实可执行仓库中行动。通过端到端的智能体后训练框架，包括AutoBuilder和KwaiClawEnv等组件，以及强化学习扩展，在多个软件工程和智能体基准上取得了优秀结果。
Motivation: 现有代码生成模型受限于可复现环境、可验证奖励和高价值轨迹的稀缺性，而非模型规模本身。本文旨在解决这些问题。
Method: 提出端到端智能体后训练框架，包含AutoBuilder（重构多语言仓库为沙盒环境并生成验证、恢复近失轨迹）和KwaiClawEnv（从可执行服务和真实任务种子合成大规模工具使用轨迹）。扩展强化学习，包括装备随机化、可靠性沙盒、非对称actor-critic PPO、事后增强价值估计、装备导向奖励框架，并通过多教师在线策略蒸馏统一SWE、Agent-Claw和WebCoding专家。
Result: 在6个软件工程和智能体基准上，KAT-Coder-V2.5在PinchBench上取得最佳智能体工具使用结果，并在仓库级软件工程中仅次于前沿的Opus 4.8。
Conclusion: 本文展示了通过环境构建、轨迹合成和强化学习扩展可以显著提升代码智能体能力。

papers.title: Breaking Structural Isolation: Scalable Graph Clustering via Community-Aware Sampling and Structural Entropy
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised graph clustering is a fundamental technique for uncovering underlying semantic patterns in large-scale networks. Although Graph Contrastive Learning has demonstrated promising performance, existing methods often suffer from the "structural isolation" issue during mini-batch training, making it challenging to capture cohesive community structures that characterize the global topological distribution. To address these challenges, we propose SCISE, a Scalable unsupervised graph Clustering framework that preserves structural Integrity by synergizing community-aware sampling with constrained Structural Entropy. Specifically, we first introduce the Structural Entropy Community Constraint operator (SECC), which optimizes structural information within a constrained solution space to mitigate community fragmentation and enhance partition cohesion. Second, to prevent global information loss during batch training, we design a Community-Aware Sampling Expansion (CSampE) mechanism that incorporates the community context of target nodes into sampling batches, effectively breaking structural barriers and preserving topological integrity. Finally, we devise a Structural Contrastive Learning (StructCL) module that refines edge weights based on intra-batch structural similarity, guiding the encoder to learn representations in a higher-order structural space. Extensive experiments on six mainstream benchmark datasets demonstrate that SCISE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms, with ablation studies and robustness analyses further validating its effectiveness and reliability for real-world large-scale graphs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无监督图聚类中的'结构隔离'问题，提出SCISE框架，通过社区感知采样与结构熵约束来保持图的结构完整性。该框架包含三个模块：结构熵社区约束（SECC）优化社区划分，社区感知采样扩展（CSampE）打破结构隔离，以及结构对比学习（StructCL）增强表示学习。在六个基准数据集上的实验表明，SCISE显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有基于图对比学习的无监督聚类方法在mini-batch训练中遭受'结构隔离'问题，难以捕捉全局拓扑分布决定的凝聚社区结构。
Method: 提出SCISE框架，包括：(1) 结构熵社区约束（SECC）在受限解空间中优化结构信息，减轻社区碎片化；(2) 社区感知采样扩展（CSampE）将目标节点的社区上下文纳入采样批次，保持拓扑完整性；(3) 结构对比学习（StructCL）基于批次内结构相似性细化边权重，指导编码器学习高阶结构空间中的表示。
Result: 在六个主流基准数据集上，SCISE显著优于当前最优聚类算法；消融实验和鲁棒性分析进一步验证了其有效性和可靠性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SCISE通过协同社区感知采样和结构熵约束，能够有效处理大规模图的结构完整性，为无监督图聚类提供了可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: Learning 4D Geometric Priors for Inference-Efficient World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual future dynamics and executable action sequences. However, existing video-action co-training methods primarily optimize appearance-oriented video latents, which may insufficiently capture the temporally evolving geometry required for precise manipulation. We propose MECo-WAM, a Multi-Expert Co-Training World Action Model that injects action-relevant 4D geometric priors into video-action representations while preserving the original lightweight inference graph. During training, MECo-WAM combines video and action experts with a lightweight 4D expert supervised by relational targets from a frozen VGGT encoder. Asymmetric expert visibility prevents non-causal shortcuts from auxiliary geometry to action generation. To transfer geometric knowledge into the deployed video-action pathway, we introduce decayed 4D read-mask attention, which provides restricted current-frame geometric guidance early in training and progressively removes this dependency. We further propose action-aware temporal geometric distillation, which aligns within-frame geometric relations and their temporal evolution while emphasizing visual regions most relevant to robot actions. At deployment, all auxiliary 4D components are removed. Experiments on LIBERO (98.2%), RoboTwin 2.0 (92.6%), and challenging real-world manipulation tasks show that MECo-WAM improves manipulation performance without increasing inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MECo-WAM，一种多专家协同训练的世界动作模型，通过注入4D几何先验来提升视频-动作联合表征，从而改善机器人操控性能，且不增加推理成本。
Motivation: 现有方法只优化外观导向的视频隐变量，未能充分捕捉随时间演化的几何信息，限制了精确操控。
Method: MECo-WAM在训练时结合视频和动作专家，并使用带有衰减4D读掩码注意力和动作感知时间几何蒸馏的4D专家，从冻结的VGGT编码器提取关系目标。推理时移除所有辅助4D组件。
Result: 在LIBERO上达到98.2%，RoboTwin 2.0上92.6%，以及真实世界任务中性能提升，不增加推理成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在不增加推理成本的前提下通过几何先验提升操控性能，可部署于轻量级推理图。

papers.title: A Task-Driven Evaluation of UAV Detection and Tracking under Synthetic Fog
papers.abstract_en: Fog severely degrades the visibility of small unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in skydominant, long-range imagery, reducing the reliability of downstream detection and tracking. This paper presents a task-driven evaluation framework that links depth-aware synthetic fog generation, image restoration, object detection, and tracking within a unified pipeline. Given the practical difficulty of collecting and annotating foggy UAV scenes, synthetic fog is generated from real clear-weather outdoor images containing UAV targets using monocular depth estimation and the atmospheric scattering model. Representative restoration methods from classical, convolutional neural network (CNN)-based, and transformer-based families are first compared, after which the selected restoration model is integrated into the downstream perception pipeline. Detection is evaluated under both clean-only and fog-inclusive training regimes using multiple detector variants, while tracking-by-detection is assessed on clean, foggy, and restored video sequences. Beyond image-level restoration metrics, the study evaluates how fog and restoration affect detection robustness and tracking performance. The results show that fog substantially degrades both detection and tracking, primarily through increased missed detections. Fog-inclusive training provides the most consistent improvement in robustness, whereas test-time restoration is most beneficial when the detector has been trained only on clean imagery. These findings show that restoration quality does not necessarily translate into proportional gains in downstream perception and therefore should be evaluated jointly with detection and tracking performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种任务驱动的评估框架，将深度感知合成雾生成、图像恢复、目标检测和跟踪串联成一个统一管道。通过单目深度估计和大气散射模型从真实晴天无人机图像生成合成雾图像，比较经典、CNN和Transformer三类恢复方法，并集成到下游感知管道的检测和跟踪中。实验表明，雾会导致检测和跟踪性能显著下降，雾包含训练可提升鲁棒性，而测试时恢复仅在干净图像训练的检测器上有用。
Motivation: 雾严重降低小无人机在天空主导、远距离图像中的可见性，影响下游检测和跟踪的可靠性。由于采集和标注雾天无人机场景困难，需要一种合成雾评估框架。
Method: 基于单目深度估计和大气散射模型生成合成雾图像；比较三类恢复方法后选择最佳集成到下游感知管道；采用干净训练和雾包含训练两种模式评估多个检测器；追踪-by-检测在干净、雾和恢复视频序列上评估。
Result: 雾主要通过增加漏检来显著降低检测和跟踪性能。雾包含训练提供最一致的鲁棒性提升；测试时恢复仅在检测器只用干净图像训练时最有帮助。
Conclusion: 恢复质量并不一定转化为下游感知的等比例增益，因此恢复方法应与检测和跟踪性能联合评估。

papers.title: CanvasAgent: Enabling Complex Image Creation and Editing via Visual Tool Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Complex image creation and editing often require more than a single generation or editing model. A user request may involve synthesizing images, localizing objects, segmenting regions, editing selected content, compositing intermediate assets, reading text, and enhancing the final result. Such tasks shift multimodal agents from perception-augmented reasoning to manipulation-centered visual creation, where tools must actively transform visual states rather than merely inspect them. However, existing multimodal tool-use agents are mostly optimized for perception, search, or domain-specific editing, and lack large-scale supervision for executable image-creation trajectories. In this paper, we introduce CanvasCraft, a large-scale multimodal tool-use dataset for complex image creation and editing, and \textbf{CanvasAgent}, a tool-augmented multimodal agent that learns to orchestrate heterogeneous visual tools through multi-turn interaction. CanvasCraft contains 140K fully annotated executable trajectories and 10K RL task specifications. CanvasAgent is first trained with SFT to learn executable reasoning-action trajectories, and is then optimized with GRPO using a hybrid reward that combines outcome- and process-level signals. During rollout, CanvasAgent inspects intermediate results, tracks visual assets, and adapts tool decisions to the evolving visual state. Experiments evaluate both final image quality and trajectory behavior, demonstrating the effectiveness of CanvasAgent and the proposed dataset for complex multi-tool image creation workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CanvasCraft 大规模多模态工具使用数据集和 CanvasAgent 工具增强多模态智能体，通过学习编排异构视觉工具实现复杂图像创建和编辑。CanvasAgent 先通过监督微调学习可执行推理-动作轨迹，再使用 GRPO 结合结果和过程级奖励进行优化。实验评估了最终图像质量和轨迹行为，证明其在多工具图像创作流程中的有效性。
Motivation: 现有多模态工具使用智能体主要优化感知、搜索或领域特定编辑，缺乏大规模监督数据来学习可执行的图像创建轨迹，难以应对需要多步工具协作的复杂图像生成和编辑任务。
Method: 构建 CanvasCraft 数据集（含 140K 可执行轨迹和 10K 强化学习任务规范），提出 CanvasAgent 智能体：先通过监督微调学习推理-动作轨迹，再使用 GRPO 和混合奖励（结合结果和过程级信号）优化；在 rollout 中检查中间结果、跟踪视觉资产并适应演化视觉状态。
Result: 实验评估了最终图像质量和轨迹行为，表明 CanvasAgent 和数据集在复杂多工具图像创作工作流中有效。
Conclusion: CanvasAgent 通过学习编排异构视觉工具实现复杂图像创建和编辑，为多模态智能体在视觉创作方向提供了数据集和方法基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learnable Weighting of Intra-Attribute Distances for Categorical Data Clustering with Nominal and Ordinal Attributes
papers.abstract_en: The success of categorical data clustering generally much relies on the distance metric that measures the dissimilarity degree between two objects. However, most of the existing clustering methods treat the two categorical subtypes, i.e. nominal and ordinal attributes, in the same way when calculating the dissimilarity without considering the relative order information of the ordinal values. Moreover, there would exist interdependence among the nominal and ordinal attributes, which is worth exploring for indicating the dissimilarity. This paper will therefore study the intrinsic difference and connection of nominal and ordinal attribute values from a perspective akin to the graph. Accordingly, we propose a novel distance metric to measure the intra-attribute distances of nominal and ordinal attributes in a unified way, meanwhile preserving the order relationship among ordinal values. Subsequently, we propose a new clustering algorithm to make the learning of intra-attribute distance weights and partitions of data objects into a single learning paradigm rather than two separate steps, whereby circumventing a suboptimal solution. Experiments show the efficacy of the proposed algorithm in comparison with the existing counterparts.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, 2022
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可学习的距离度量方法，用于同时处理名义属性和序数属性的分类数据聚类，通过统一建模保留序数属性的顺序信息，并联合优化距离权重和聚类划分，避免了两阶段方法的次优解。实验表明该方法优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有聚类方法通常忽略名义属性与序数属性的区别，对二者采用相同处理，且未利用序数值的相对顺序信息，导致聚类质量受限。
Method: 提出一种基于图视角的统一距离度量，用于计算名义和序数属性的内部距离，并保留序数顺序；同时设计了一种聚类算法，将距离权重学习和数据划分整合到单一范式，避免两阶段优化的次优解。
Result: 实验表明所提算法在分类数据聚类任务上优于现有对比方法。
Conclusion: 论文强调了区分名义与序数属性进行距离度量的重要性，并展示了联合优化距离权重和聚类的有效性。
Relevance: 0
