papers.title: Evaluating calibrated refusal and safe usefulness in dual-use biology settings
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents are incorporated into life science workflows, the capabilities that speed discovery might also enable misuse. We present BioSecBench-Refusal, a benchmark for risk identification and refusal behavior for biological research tasks. The benchmark pairs 61 Routine tasks, legitimate analyses adapted from the published literature, with 46 Red-Team tasks, fictional scenarios that resemble real research but conceal a biosecurity hazard. Across 16 model-harness configurations, refusal rates ranged from 7\% to 74\% on Routine tasks and 1\% to 62\% on Red-Team tasks, with many configurations refusing legitimate Routine work at comparable or higher rates than concealed hazards. Refusals were most often triggered by provider API filters applied prior to agentic reasoning. However, models given room to reason showed the potential to identify more real threats. We release BioSecBench-Refusal as a tool for model developers to calibrate capability and caution for agentic biotech R\&D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BioSecBench-Refusal 基准，用于评估 AI 代理在生物学研究任务中的拒绝行为。基准包含 61 个常规任务和 46 个红队任务，覆盖从已发表文献中提取的合法分析与隐藏生物安全危害的虚构场景。在 16 种模型配置上，常规任务的拒绝率在 7% 到 74% 之间，红队任务在 1% 到 62% 之间；许多配置对常规任务的拒绝率高于或等于对隐藏危害的拒绝率。拒绝主要源于提供商的 API 过滤器，但给模型推理空间时能识别更多真实威胁。
Motivation: AI 代理融入生命科学流程时，加速发现的能力可能被滥用，需要评估模型识别风险并适当拒绝的能力。
Method: 构建配对基准：61 个常规任务（合法分析）与 46 个红队任务（虚构但含生物安全危害），测试 16 种模型-框架配置。
Result: 常规任务拒绝率 7%-74%，红队任务 1%-62%；常规任务拒绝率常高于或等于红队任务。拒绝多由 API 过滤器触发。
Conclusion: 基准可作为模型开发者校准能力与谨慎性的工具，并提示推理空间有助于识别真实威胁。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AdaStop: Cost-Aware Early Stopping for DNN Test Selection
papers.abstract_en: Existing methods for testing deep neural networks (DNNs) primarily prioritize test inputs likely to reveal model faults under a fixed labeling budget. In practice, choosing that budget is difficult: too little testing misses failures, while too much incurs unnecessary labeling costs. This work studies the stopping problem in DNN testing. We formulate testing as a cost--benefit decision process in which labeling an input incurs cost $c$ and discovering a fault yields value $v$. Based on this formulation, we introduce \textit{AdaStop}, a framework that estimates the marginal fault discovery rate during testing and stops labeling when the estimated rate falls below the threshold $τ= c/v$. Experiments across multiple datasets, architectures, and selection strategies show that $65$--$84\%$ of faults can be discovered using only $9$--$31\%$ of the labeling budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度神经网络测试中标注预算难以确定的问题，提出成本感知的早停框架AdaStop。该框架将测试建模为成本-收益决策过程，通过估计边际故障发现率并在其低于阈值时停止标注。实验表明，使用9%-31%的预算即可发现65%-84%的故障。
Motivation: 现有DNN测试方法通常需要预设标注预算，但预算过少会遗漏故障，过多则造成不必要的标注成本。
Method: 提出AdaStop框架，将测试视为成本-收益决策过程，每次标注需成本c，发现故障获得价值v。框架估计边际故障发现率，并在其低于阈值τ=c/v时停止标注。
Result: 在多个数据集、架构和选择策略上，使用9%-31%的标注预算即可发现65%-84%的故障。
Conclusion: AdaStop通过成本感知的早停策略有效平衡了测试成本与故障发现能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PHOENIX: Resilient LLM Training with Hot-Swapping via Zero-Overhead Checkpoint
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art large language model (LLM) training takes tens of thousands of graphics processing units (GPUs) for months and encounters failures across the software and hardware stack. Existing fault-tolerance mechanisms either impose non-trivial overhead during failure-free execution or suffer from prolonged recovery latency, particularly under scenarios where a small subset of compute nodes experience permanent failures. %The tradeoff between failure-free overhead and recovery latency forms a space forms a Pareto frontier We present PHOENIX to simultaneously address both optimization objectives. PHOENIX incorporates a fault-tolerance mechanism that restores LLM training via hot-swapping, namely by replacing failed nodes with spare nodes without terminating the complete job. The hot-swapping of PHOENIX is enabled by two ideas: First, it exploits an off-critical-path in-memory checkpointing mechanism for spatial redundancy. Second, it introduces a communicator reconstruction protocol that replaces failed nodes with spare nodes at runtime. PHOENIX efficiently overlaps the in-memory checkpointing with computation, thus introducing zero overhead during error-free execution. Upon permanent node failures, PHOENIX can rebuild memory states with minimal recomputation by leveraging in-memory checkpoints. We evaluate PHOENIX across scales (up to 512 NVIDIA A100 GPUs) and LLMs (up to 65B parameters), and observe zero checkpoint overhead with hot-swapping recovery completing in under 40 seconds. These results show that PHOENIX simultaneously achieves both zero-overhead error-free execution and extremely low recovery cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PHOENIX，一种通过热替换（hot-swapping）实现大语言模型（LLM）训练容错的机制。它利用非关键路径的内存检查点和运行时通信重构协议，在无故障时检查点零开销，永久节点故障时可在40秒内完成恢复。在512 NVIDIA A100 GPU和65B参数的实验上验证了效果。
Motivation: 现有LLM训练的容错机制要么在无故障时引入显著开销，要么恢复延迟较长，尤其当少量节点永久故障时。本文旨在同时消除无故障开销和降低恢复延迟。
Method: PHOENIX包含两个关键设计：一是利用非关键路径的内存检查点实现空间冗余，不干扰正常计算；二是运行时通信重构协议，将故障节点替换为备用节点，实现热替换。检查点与计算重叠，从而在无故障时零开销。
Result: 在多达512 NVIDIA A100 GPU和65B参数的LLM训练中，PHOENIX实现了无检查点开销，热替换恢复时间低于40秒。
Conclusion: PHOENIX证明了通过内存检查点和热替换可以同时实现无故障零开销和极低的恢复成本，为大规模LLM训练提供了高效的容错方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anti-Prompt: Image Protection against Text-Guided Image-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Image-to-Video generation allow a single image to be animated into a convincing video under text guidance, raising serious copyright and privacy risks. We propose Anti-Prompt, an image protection approach that injects imperceptible perturbations into an image, inducing visible inconsistencies and structural failures in text-guided I2V generation. Our method is motivated by a simple empirical observation. When text guidance is removed from modern I2V models, generation quality degrades markedly, not only in motion realism but also in subject preservation, structural coherence, and temporal consistency. Building on this insight, Anti-Prompt exploits the model reliance on textual guidance by attenuating text-conditioned interactions during denoising while strengthening visual-only pathways. To further systematically evaluate protection effectiveness, we introduce a Video-LLM-assisted evaluation protocol that provides interpretable, frame-grounded analyses of generation artifacts and inconsistencies. Experiments on two representative I2V architectures demonstrate that our method achieves strong protection performance while improving efficiency and cross-model transferability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Anti-Prompt 方法，通过向图像注入不易察觉的扰动，在文本引导的图像到视频生成中诱导可见不一致和结构故障，从而保护图像版权和隐私。方法基于去除文本引导时生成质量显著下降的观察，减弱文本条件交互并增强视觉通路，同时引入 Video-LLM 辅助评估协议。在两种代表性架构上取得强保护性能，并提升效率和跨模型迁移性。
Motivation: 文本引导的图像到视频生成带来版权和隐私风险，而现有保护方法不足。
Method: 向图像添加扰动，在去噪过程中削弱文本条件交互并强化视觉路径，使生成结果出现不稳定和结构问题。
Result: 在两个主流 I2V 架构上实现强保护效果，同时提高效率和跨模型迁移性。
Conclusion: 该方法有效利用模型对文本引导的依赖，结合 Video-LLM 评估，为图像保护提供新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Environment and Urbanization Shape Bird Diversity in Sri Lanka
papers.abstract_en: This study presents a comprehensive analysis of bird diversity across Sri Lanka by integrating spatial, temporal, and environmental data. Bird observation records were combined with environmental variables, including weather conditions, air pollution, the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), land cover, elevation, and Artificial Light At Night (ALAN), and rigorously preprocessed to ensure data quality. Spatial analyses were conducted on multiple grid scales (2 km, 5 km, 10 km) to evaluate patterns in species richness while minimizing sampling bias through spatial thinning. Temporal trends were assessed using effort-corrected metrics including rarefied richness and occupancy rates to account for variations in observation effort over time. Environmental drivers of bird diversity were examined using multivariate statistical models, including Poisson Generalized Linear Models (GLMs) and correlation analyses, to identify key associations between ecological factors and species richness. Additionally, community structure, dominance patterns, and beta diversity were analyzed to understand variations in species composition across regions and time. The study found that land-cover type is a stronger predictor of bird diversity than individual continuous variables such as NDVI or temperature alone. Urbanization, measured by ALAN, exhibits nuanced scale-dependent effects, supporting high abundances of a few generalist species while reducing overall richness. The findings provide actionable insights into the patterns and drivers of avian diversity in Sri Lanka, offering a scalable and reproducible framework for biodiversity research and conservation planning.
papers.comment: IEEE conference paper. Dept. of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka. Dataset and code publicly available on Hugging Face and GitHub
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文整合空间、时间和环境数据，对斯里兰卡鸟类多样性进行综合分析。研究发现土地覆盖类型是比NDVI或温度更强的多样性预测因子，而城市化（以人工夜间灯光衡量）具有尺度依赖效应，支持少数广布种的高丰度但降低整体丰富度。
Motivation: 理解环境因素和城市化对鸟类多样性的影响，为生物多样性研究和保护规划提供可复现的框架。
Method: 结合鸟类观测记录与环境变量（天气、污染、NDVI、土地覆盖、海拔、人工夜间灯光），使用空间稀疏化、努力校正指标（稀疏丰富度、占用率）、泊松广义线性模型和相关性分析。
Result: 土地覆盖类型是比连续变量更强的多样性预测因子；城市化降低整体丰富度但支持少数广布种的高丰度。
Conclusion: 研究提供了斯里兰卡鸟类多样性模式与驱动因素的见解，强调土地覆盖和城市化的作用，框架可扩展用于其他区域。

papers.title: When Prices Double in a Week: Forecasting of Agricultural Volatility in Import-Isolated Markets
papers.abstract_en: Vegetable prices in Sri Lanka are highly volatile because the market is largely import-isolated, so supply disruptions quickly drive prices up. This study develops a machine learning framework to forecast such volatility by incorporating supply-chain-aware features and explicitly modelling the country's two cultivation seasons, Maha (October-April) and Yala (May-September). An integrated dataset was constructed by combining retail and farmer-gate prices with origin-aligned weather variables, diesel costs, and exchange rates across 12 vegetable varieties and 14 market centres from 2013 to 2019. A gradient-boosted ensemble model (XGBoost and LightGBM) was trained and optimised using Optuna, and unified and season-specific configurations were compared. Results show that season-specific models improve within-season fit, with the Yala-specific model achieving the highest R2 of 0.9420 (95% CI [0.690, 1.000]), while the unified model delivers the best overall predictive accuracy of 90.84% (95% CI [88.34%, 91.52%]) and an R2 of 0.9281 (95% CI [0.760, 1.000]). Notably, the unified model maintains 85.96% accuracy on a completely unseen 2024 hyperinflationary period without retraining, successfully tracking major price surges. These findings suggest that agricultural price movements in import-constrained markets are meaningfully predictable when models capture supply-chain dynamics, offering practical value for early warning and decision making by farmers, traders, and policymakers. Existing studies on Sri Lankan vegetable prices are confined to Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) and Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (GARCH) applied to single markets, with no supply-chain features, seasonal segmentation, or cross-regime validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对斯里兰卡进口隔离市场导致的蔬菜价格剧烈波动问题，本文构建了集成零售价、农场价、天气变量、柴油成本和汇率的跨品种跨市场数据集（2013-2019年，12种蔬菜、14个市场），并基于XGBoost和LightGBM的梯度提升集成模型，结合该国Maha（10月-4月）和Yala（5月-9月）两个种植季节进行预测。结果发现，季节特定模型能更好地拟合季节内波动（Yala模型R²达0.942），而统一模型整体预测准确率为90.84%（R²=0.9281），且在未经重新训练的2024年高通胀时段仍保持85.96%的准确率，成功追踪了主要价格飙升事件。
Motivation: 现有斯里兰卡蔬菜价格预测研究仅使用ARIMA和GARCH模型处理单一市场，既未纳入供应链特征，也未考虑季节性分割或跨制度验证，导致预测能力有限。
Method: 提出一个包含供应链感知特征（产地匹配的天气变量、柴油成本、汇率）和双季节显式建模的机器学习框架，采用Optuna优化的XGBoost+LightGBM集成模型，并比较了统一训练与分季节训练两种配置。
Result: Yala季节特定模型取得最高R²=0.9420（95% CI [0.690, 1.000]），统一模型整体预测准确率90.84%（95% CI [88.34%, 91.52%]），R²=0.9281（95% CI [0.760, 1.000]），且在2024年高通胀无标签场景下准确率仍达85.96%。
Conclusion: 论文表明，在进口依赖度高的市场中，若模型能捕捉供应链动态（如季节、天气、成本），则农产品价格波动具有可预测性，为早期预警与决策提供实用价值。

papers.title: Categorizing Mathematical Concepts with LLM Voting Ensembles in Mathswitch
papers.abstract_en: Mathswitch is an open-source project that imports mathematical concept records from sources such as Wikidata, Wikipedia, MathWorld, Encyclopedia of Mathematics, nLab, ProofWiki, and Agda-Unimath, and links records that refer to the same concept. It does not reorganize or redefine the imported content; each source retains its own structure. The current focus is on importing concept data from Wikidata and the resources it links to, with plans to expand to further sources and better concept linking. Because the concept set is approximated through queries over Wikidata's collaboratively edited graph, the imported data is noisy: some items are non-mathematical, while others are ambiguous. In this paper, we test whether a voting ensemble of LLM judges can filter this noise. We evaluate it on Wikidata items with known MathWorld identifiers as a positive control, and examine how classification changes when database identifiers are removed from context. We then inspect the cases where the judges disagree with MathWorld and group these disagreements into three categories (degenerate descriptions, narrow scope bias, and editorial-scope mismatches) that suggest different remediation strategies.
papers.comment: Submitted (pre-peer-review) version. Accepted at CICM 2026; the Version of Record will appear in Springer LNAI. We'll add the DOI once the proceedings are published
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mathswitch 项目从多个来源导入数学概念记录并链接同一概念，但导入数据存在噪声。本文测试 LLM 投票集成 (voting ensemble of LLM judges) 作为分类器来过滤噪声，在已知 MathWorld 标识符的 Wikidata 条目上评估，并分析分类分歧的类型。
Motivation: Mathswitch 导入的数学概念数据因来自 Wikidata 等协作编辑源而含有噪声（非数学条目或歧义条目），需要自动过滤以提高数据质量。
Method: 使用多个 LLM 组成的投票集成 (voting ensemble) 作为法官，对 Wikidata 条目是否属于数学概念进行分类，并去除上下文中的数据库标识符以测试分类变化。
Result: 在已知 MathWorld 标识符的 Wikidata 条目（正对照）上评估分类性能，并检查当移除数据库标识符时分类的变化。将分类分歧归纳为三类：退化描述 (degenerate descriptions)、窄范围偏差 (narrow scope bias) 和编辑范围不匹配 (editorial-scope mismatches)。
Conclusion: LLM 投票集成可用于过滤 Mathswitch 导入的噪声数据，但存在若干分歧类型，需针对不同原因采取不同的修正策略。

papers.title: CARVE: Content-Aware Recurrent with Value Efficiency for Chunk-Parallel Linear Attention
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent delta-rule models keep a fixed-size state matrix S (d_v x d_k) that compresses all past context. The state of the art (GDN-2) gates this update with element-wise matrix erase/write masks. This is powerful but has two defects. First, both gates are computed from the incoming token alone, making the model memory-blind: it decides what to erase without seeing what it has stored. Second, value-axis coupling in the erase gate blocks the WY-form triangular chunk solver that drives efficient training -- the intra-chunk system splits into d_v independent solves, collapsing throughput to serial-recurrence cost. We introduce CARVE (Content-Aware Recurrent with Value Efficiency), which fixes both and, via a single-launch "megakernel" scheduling of the same WY-form math, trains faster than the matrix-gated baseline it replaces. The key idea is architectural: restricting all gating to the key axis makes the intra-chunk coupling independent of the value index, restoring one unmodified WY-form solve. Within this constraint, CARVE conditions both gates on a content signal read once per chunk from the chunk-boundary state and folded algebraically into each gate's low-rank projection (by associativity, U(Sq)=(US)q), giving memory-aware gating at negligible extra traffic. At init the content projections are zero, so CARVE is bit-identical to the baseline; we prove the one-chunk staleness perturbs gates by only O(1/sqrt(L)), matching a measured 0.18% deviation flat up to L=128. At 1.3B parameters / 100B FineWeb-Edu tokens on H100 (three seeds), CARVE improves every axis: WikiText perplexity 15.72 vs 15.90 (hybrid 15.41 vs 15.62), +0.63 pp average common-sense accuracy, and state-of-the-art RULER and real-world recall -- while training +1.4% faster at matched depth and +19.3% at iso-quality depth, at +13% peak memory. Backed by six formal guarantees.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables, 5 algorithms (incl. appendices with full proofs and Triton kernel pseudocode). Single-author preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARVE 针对循环 delta 规则模型记忆盲点与值轴耦合导致训练低效的问题，提出内容感知的键轴门控机制，恢复 WY 形式的三角块求解器，实现更快训练和更好性能。在 1.3B 参数模型上，多项指标改进。
Motivation: 现有 GDN-2 等循环 delta 规则模型存在两个缺陷：门控仅依赖输入 token，不考虑已存储状态（记忆盲点）；擦除门中的值轴耦合阻碍了高效的 WY 形式三角块求解，导致训练退化为串行。
Method: 将门控限制在键轴 (key axis)，使块内耦合与值索引无关，恢复单一的 WY 形式求解；同时通过从块边界状态读取内容信号并代数折叠到门控的低秩投影中，实现内存感知门控。
Result: 在 1.3B 参数、100B FineWeb-Edu token 上，WikiText 困惑度 15.72 vs 15.90（混合 15.41 vs 15.62），常识准确率提升 0.63 个百分点，RULER 和真实世界召回达到 SOTA，训练速度在匹配深度下快 1.4%，在等质量深度下快 19.3%，峰值内存增加 13%。
Conclusion: CARVE 通过架构改进修复了现有循环 delta 规则模型的关键缺陷，同时保持训练效率，并提供六个形式化保证。

papers.title: Accelerating Returns and the Qualitative Engine for Science
authors: The University of Texas at Arlington)
papers.abstract_en: Ray Kurzweil described a thesis of accelerating returns, which is the most influential narratives in discussions of technological progress. Its central claim is that advances in multiple technological fields, especially compute, artificial intelligence, brain science, and biotechnology, interact in such a way that progress becomes self-amplifying and approximately exponential. This paper gives a simple mathematical interpretation of that claim and then argues that, even if such acceleration is real, it does not by itself resolve the central problem of scientific discovery. The reason is that accelerating returns apply most naturally to executional and infrastructural capability, whereas genuine discovery often depends on a different capacity: qualitative reasoning about when a current framework is structurally inadequate and what conceptual move is needed next. Recent ARC-AGI-3 results sharpen this distinction: humans solve the benchmark at ceiling, whereas frontier AI systems remain below 1%, indicating that the gap between current AI and human flexible reasoning is still very large. At the same time, Demis Hassabis has emphasized that humans must retain their sense of meaning and what they choose to focus their lives on, a reminder that the future of AI is not only a technical forecast but also a question of what forms of human understanding are worth preserving and transmitting. This paper positions the Qualitative Engine for Science (QES) [3] as a response to that missing capacity. In this view, the Kurzweil theory helps explain why quantitative capability may accelerate, while QES addresses the central problem in scientific discovery that acceleration alone does not solve. Its value does not depend on when AGI arrives, but on the fact that the processes of scientific discovery themselves constitute a form of human wisdom worth preserving, organizing, and making accessible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对Ray Kurzweil的加速回报理论进行数学解释，指出该理论主要适用于执行性和基础设施能力的指数增长，而科学发现的核心在于定性推理能力——识别当前框架的结构性不足并提出概念性转变。作者基于ARC-AGI-3基准结果（人类完美解决，AI低于1%）说明差距，并引入定性引擎科学（QES）作为保存和组织人类科学发现智慧的手段。
Motivation: 加速回报理论无法解释科学发现中所需的定性推理能力，而当前AI在灵活推理上仍远落后于人类。
Method: 给出加速回报理论的数学解释，并引入定性引擎科学（QES）作为弥补人类定性推理缺失的框架。
Result: ARC-AGI-3基准中人类得分接近天花板，前沿AI系统低于1%，表明定性推理差距仍然巨大。
Conclusion: 加速回报理论未能解决科学发现的核心问题，而QES的价值在于保存和整理人类科学发现的过程性智慧。

papers.title: IUU+DB: Tracking Illegal, Unreported, and Unregulated Fishing, Seafood Fraud, and Labor Abuse through LLM-driven Information Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Illegal, unreported, and unregulated fishing (IUU) traditionally refers to fishing activities that violate applicable laws or occur in areas that lack applicable laws. We propose the term IUU+ to capture a broader suite of fisheries sector environmental and associated supply chain trade-related crimes and behaviors. Although IUU+ activity is widely recognized as a serious threat to marine ecosystems, markets, and livelihoods, a quantitative understanding of these incidents, e.g., their frequency, geography, species, actors, and patterns in the type of illicit activity, remains difficult to obtain. We propose IUU+DB, a large language model driven system for building a global incident database of IUU+ activity. The system ingests heterogeneous documents, classifies whether they describe relevant incidents, extracts key data elements such as actors, locations, species, vessels, violations, and enforcement outcomes, and supports deduplication and trend analysis. Case studies and validation results show that IUU+DB can help organize fragmented evidence, surface geographic and behavioral hotspots, support fisheries-domain specific research in academia and non-government organizations, assist source and species risk assessments for industry, and provide support for policy implementation and targeted enforcement efforts to government agencies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IUU+DB，一个基于大语言模型的信息提取系统，用于构建全球非法、不报告和不管制（IUU）渔业及相关供应链犯罪的事件数据库。系统可从异构文档中分类、提取关键数据（如行为者、地点、物种、船只等），并支持去重和趋势分析。案例验证表明该系统能组织碎片化证据、发现地理和行为热点，辅助学术研究、行业风险评估及政府执法。
Motivation: IUU渔业活动严重威胁海洋生态、市场和生计，但定量理解这些事件的频率、地理分布、物种、行为者及非法活动模式仍很困难，现有证据分散且难以整合。
Method: 提出IUU+DB系统，采用大语言模型驱动的信息提取流程：先对异构文档进行分类（是否描述相关事件），再提取结构化数据（如行为者、地点、物种、船只、违规类型、执法结果），最后进行去重和趋势分析。
Result: 案例研究和验证结果显示，IUU+DB能有效组织碎片化证据，揭示地理和行为热点，并支持学术机构、非政府组织、行业及政府部门的多种应用。
Conclusion: 该系统为IUU渔业及相关犯罪提供了可扩展的定量化数据基础设施，有助于政策实施和针对性执法，但摘要未提及具体性能数字或局限性。

papers.title: Your AI Travel Agent Would Book You a Bullfight: An Agentic Benchmark for Implicit Animal Welfare in Frontier AI Models
papers.abstract_en: Previous research has evaluated animal welfare using question-and-answer benchmarks. This study investigates whether these evaluations also hold in agentic settings. The agents may showcase different behaviors compared to stand-alone large language models, as demonstrated in prior studies. This work introduces \textit{TAC (Travel Agent Compassion)}: the first agentic benchmark for assessing animal exploitation. TAC evaluates AI agentic behavior in travel booking scenarios across six animal categories, using thirteen hand-authored scenarios that vary by price, rating, and position, expanded via four augmentation variants into $52$ prompts and run for three epochs, giving $156$ scored observations per model. Nine frontier models across five model families were evaluated.. The results indicate that models tend to prefer harmful scenarios, performing below the random chance rate of $65\%$ for selecting a neutral booking option, with Claude $4.8$ achieving the highest performance at $64.7\%$. To address this issue, the persona of an ethical-brand identity was infused into the system prompt, resulting in welfare rates increasing from $32$ to $80$ percentage points, with a mean of $53$ across all nine models. No evidence of evaluation awareness affecting the results was found, based on an Inspect Scout audit of $3,120$ transcripts. These findings are directly relevant to the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, which identifies non-human welfare as a systemic risk. TAC provides a practical method for measuring this risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TAC（Travel Agent Compassion）基准，用于评估AI代理在旅行预订场景中隐含的动物剥削行为。对9个前沿模型在13个手工场景中的表现进行测试，发现模型倾向于选择有害场景，性能低于随机基线。通过注入道德品牌身份的系统提示，可将福利提升率提高32至80个百分点。
Motivation: 现有动物福利评估主要基于问答基准，但代理（agent）设置下模型行为可能不同。本文旨在填补代理评估空白，并回应欧盟通用AI实践准则中非人类福利作为系统性风险的要求。
Method: 设计TAC基准，包含52个提示（13个手工场景×4种增强变体），每个模型运行3轮，共156次评分观察。场景涵盖6个动物类别，变化价格、评分和位置。注入道德品牌身份到系统提示以改善结果。
Result: 模型选择有害场景的性能低于随机机会率（65%），Claude 4.8最高为64.7%。注入道德身份后福利率提升32至80个百分点（平均53）。未发现评估意识影响（3120份转录审计）。
Conclusion: TAC可作为测量AI代理中动物福利风险的实用方法，直接适用于欧盟通用AI实践准则。

papers.title: Beyond Correctness: Enhancing Architectural Reasoning in Code LLMs via Scalable Labeling with Agentic Judgment
papers.abstract_en: LLMs have substantially improved software engineering yet real-world development requires architectural understanding. Such understanding is prohibitively expensive to label manually and impossible to verify through tests alone. We propose an agentic judging pipeline using a strong LLM as a scalable proxy for expert architectural evaluation, comprising two judges: the Architecture Complexity Judge (ACJ), which estimates codebase-specific architectural understanding a task demands, and the Architecture Quality Judge (AQJ), which evaluates patch conformance to repository-specific architectural conventions via source-grounded rubrics. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B/14B/32B on 3,360 curated instances achieves resolved rates of up to 27.2% on SWE-bench Verified - up to 540% over the base model and 256% over unfiltered fine-tuning. Meanwhile, the trained models achieve strong cross-language generalization and consistent improvements in architectural patch quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用强语言模型作为可扩展的代理判断，自动为代码LLM标注架构推理所需的训练数据。通过两个判断器（架构复杂度判断器和架构质量判断器）评估任务难度和补丁质量，并基于该标注数据微调Qwen3-8B/14B/32B模型。在SWE-bench Verified上，微调模型解决率达到27.2%，较基础模型提升540%，同时展现出跨语言泛化能力和架构补丁质量的持续改进。
Motivation: 现有代码LLM研究多关注功能性正确性，但软件架构理解是实际开发中的关键需求。架构理解人工标注成本极高，且无法仅通过测试验证。
Method: 提出一种可扩展的代理判断管道，使用强LLM作为专家评估的替代；包含两个判断器：架构复杂度判断器（ACJ）和架构质量判断器（AQJ），分别估计任务需要的架构理解深度和评估补丁是否符合仓库架构惯例。利用该管道生成3,360个带标注训练实例，微调Qwen3-8B/14B/32B。
Result: 微调模型在SWE-bench Verified上达到27.2%的解决率，较基础模型提升540%，较未经过滤的微调提升256%。同时模型展现强大的跨语言泛化能力，且架构补丁质量持续提升。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过代理判断管道自动标注架构理解数据可以显著提升代码LLM的架构推理能力，且在成本和效果之间取得良好平衡。

papers.title: SEVRA-BENCH: Social Engineering of Vulnerabilities in Review Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in automated code-review systems, where their approvals can determine which code is merged into shared repositories. However, it is unclear whether review agents can detect vulnerability-introducing code when an attacker controls both the code change and the persuasive Pull Request (PR) narrative designed to mask it. We introduce SEVRA-BENCH (Social Engineering of Vulnerabilities in Review Agents), a benchmark that measures how often a review agent approves such adversarial PR s. Each PR in SEVRA-BENCH is built from a historical commit that fixed a vulnerability. We automatically reverse that fix to extract the original vulnerable code, and submit the resulting code change as a PR wrapped in one of 15 social-engineering framings. To test review-agent resilience to narrative manipulation, these framings vary dimensions such as supporting evidence, conveyed urgency, signals of prior approval, and appeals to authority. SEVRA-BENCH evaluates a retained challenge split of roughly 1000 adversarial PRs drawn from publicly disclosed vulnerability fixes across the top 10 entries of the MITRE's 2025 most dangerous software weaknesses. Evaluating 8 review agents against this benchmark, we reveal that review agents are susceptible to narrative manipulation, exposing a significant gap in security capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SEVRA-BENCH基准，用于评估大型语言模型驱动的代码审查代理在攻击者控制代码更改并附加社会工程学叙事时的漏洞检测能力。该基准从MITRE 2025年最危险软件弱点的公开修复中逆向构造约1000个对抗性PR。评估8个审查代理发现，它们容易受到叙事操纵，安全能力存在显著差距。
Motivation: 目前不清楚当攻击者同时控制代码更改和旨在掩盖漏洞的说服性PR叙述时，代码审查代理能否检测出引入漏洞的代码。
Method: 从历史漏洞修复提交中自动逆向修复以提取原始漏洞代码，然后将代码更改作为PR提交，并应用15种社会工程框架（如支持证据、紧迫性、预先批准信号、权威诉求）之一，构建对抗性PR基准SEVRA-BENCH。
Result: 评估8个审查代理发现，它们容易受到叙事操纵，暴露出安全能力的显著差距。
Conclusion: 代码审查代理在面对社会工程学攻击时存在漏洞，需要增强其鲁棒性。

papers.title: A Three-Layer Framework for AI in Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Current discussions of AI in scientific discovery are often dominated by two visible capabilities: search over existing knowledge and execution through optimization, simulation, and automation. Both are important, but neither fully captures the central act of discovery: the formation and evolution of models. This paper proposes a three-layer view of AI in discovery. Layer 1 is search and retrieval by large language models. Layer 2, as the main innovation of this paper, is model formation through qualitative reasoning: the capacity to recognize when a current framework is structurally inadequate and to understand the problem within a broader representational space, not through trial and error, but through structural insight into what is missing and where it can be found. Layer 3 is execution, optimization, and refinement. The main claim is that Layer 2 is both the most important and the least developed. Search without model formation remains confined to inherited frameworks, while execution without conceptual revision only amplifies an existing formulation. We illustrate Layer 2 reasoning through three case studies: S. S. Chern's intrinsic proof of the Gauss-Bonnet theorem, the resolution of the Nesterov Accelerated Gradient convergence problem via Lyapunov functions, and the autonomous disproof of the Erdos unit distance conjecture by OpenAI in 2026. Each case exhibits the same structural signature: a framework that had become inadequate, a missing conceptual object, and a resolution found in an unexpected neighboring field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AI在科学发现中的三层框架：第一层是搜索与检索，第二层是通过定性推理形成模型，第三层是执行与优化。核心创新是第二层，强调通过结构洞察识别框架的不充分性，并在更广的表征空间中寻找缺失概念。通过陈省身对Gauss-Bonnet定理的内蕴证明、Nesterov加速梯度收敛问题的Lyapunov函数解法，以及OpenAI在2026年自动反驳Erdos单位距离猜想三个案例说明第二层推理的特征。
Motivation: 当前关于AI在科学发现中的讨论多集中在搜索和执行能力，但忽略了模型形成与演进这一核心环节。本文旨在填补这一空白，明确提出模型形成（第二层）是最重要但最不发达的环节。
Method: 提出一个三层框架，将科学发现过程分层：Layer 1为基于大语言模型的搜索与检索；Layer 2为通过定性推理形成模型，即识别当前框架的结构性不足并理解问题所在；Layer 3为执行、优化与细化。通过三个案例展示Layer 2的运作模式。
Result: 论文通过三个不同领域的案例（数学定理证明、优化算法收敛性分析、数学猜想反驳）展示了Layer 2推理的共同结构：框架变得不充分、缺失概念对象、在意外相邻领域找到解决方案。
Conclusion: 作者认为Layer 2（模型形成）是科学发现中最核心但最未被充分发展的部分，搜索和自动化执行都无法替代概念性修订的作用。

papers.title: SkillHone: A Harness for Continual Agent Skill Evolution Through Persistent Decision History
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills extend language-model agents with task-specific procedures, scripts, and references, but the tasks and environments they target continually change. Existing methods improve skills in bounded runs and retain only the final artifact, discarding the decision history that later agents need to interpret prior revisions, evaluations, and rejected alternatives. We introduce SkillHone, a harness for continual agent skill evolution grounded in persistent decision history. SkillHone pairs skill revisions with evaluation-side evidence that supplies practice feedback, recording structured histories of diagnoses, revisions, evidence, and outcomes. Role-separated subagents run candidate skills on practice probes with redacted reporting and propose revisions informed by prior decisions, enabling cross-session refinement without rediscovering past rationale. On deep-research benchmarks, SkillHone runs without a pre-integrated search stack and outperforms the commercially backed deep-research agent by 15.8 points on GAIA and 3.2 points on WebWalkerQA-EN, while also exceeding prior skill-evolution methods. We further deploy SkillHone on internal tool-mediated analysis scenarios, where it improves accuracy by an average of 18.8 points across seven settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillHone 是一个基于持久决策历史的持续代理技能演化框架。它通过记录诊断、修订、证据和结果的结构化历史，并使用角色分离的子代理在实践探针上运行候选技能并基于先前决策提出修订，实现跨会话改进。在深度研究基准上，无需预集成搜索栈，SkillHone 在 GAIA 上比商业支持的深度研究代理高 15.8 分，在 WebWalkerQA-EN 上高 3.2 分，并超过先前的技能演化方法。在内部工具介导的分析场景中，七个设置平均准确率提升 18.8 点。
Motivation: 现有代理技能改进方法仅在有限运行中优化，仅保留最终工件，丢弃了后续代理解释先前修订、评估和被拒绝方案所需的决策历史，阻碍了技能的持续演化。
Method: 提出 SkillHone，将技能修订与评估侧证据配对，记录诊断、修订、证据和结果的结构化历史，使用角色分离的子代理在实践探针上运行候选技能并基于先前决策提出修订。
Result: 在 GAIA 上比商业深度研究代理高 15.8 分，在 WebWalkerQA-EN 上高 3.2 分，超过先前技能演化方法；在内部工具场景中七个设置平均准确率提升 18.8 点。
Conclusion: SkillHone 通过持久决策历史实现代理技能的持续演化，无需预集成搜索栈，在多个基准上取得显著提升。

summary_sections.method: 提出 SkillHone，将技能修订与评估侧证据配对，记录诊断、修订、证据和结果的结构化历史，使用角色分离的子代理在实践探针上运行候选技能并基于先前决策提出修订。
summary_sections.result: 在 GAIA 上比商业深度研究代理高 15.8 分，在 WebWalkerQA-EN 上高 3.2 分，超过先前技能演化方法；在内部工具场景中七个设置平均准确率提升 18.8 点。
summary_sections.conclusion: SkillHone 通过持久决策历史实现代理技能的持续演化，无需预集成搜索栈，在多个基准上取得显著提升。

papers.title: Distribution-free changepoint localization after sequential change detection
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a distribution-free framework for constructing post-detection confidence sets for changepoints after stopping a sequential change detection procedure. It is well known that conformal test martingales can be used to sequentially detect changes in distribution, but by themselves provide no inference for the time at which a proclaimed change occurred. Past work on post-detection inference requires pre- and post-change classes of distributions to be known, but this paper accomplishes localization of the changepoint without any distributional assumptions. We establish finite-sample coverage guarantees (conditional on correct detection). We provide non-asymptotic bounds on the conditional expected size of the confidence sets. Under suitable asymptotic regimes, we prove that the conditional expected size of the confidence set remains uniformly bounded and demonstrate strong empirical performance on simulated and real data. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first general distribution-free framework for sequential changepoint localization with valid post-detection coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无分布假设的框架，用于在顺序变化检测停止后构建变点的置信集。作者利用适应检验鞅（conformal test martingales）实现检测，但现有方法需要已知分布类进行事后推断，而本文无需任何分布假设即可定位变点。文中给出了有限样本下的覆盖保证（条件于正确检测），并证明了条件期望置信集大小的非渐近界和渐近有界性，在模拟和真实数据上表现良好。
Motivation: 顺序变化检测中，已知的适应检验鞅只能检测变化发生，无法推断变化发生的具体时间；此前的事后推断需要预先知道变化前后分布类，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出一个无分布框架，通过在顺序检测过程停止后构建变点的置信集，使用适应检验鞅，不依赖任何分布假设，并推导有限样本覆盖保证和非渐近期望大小界。
Result: 提供了条件于正确检测下的有限样本覆盖保证；证明了条件期望置信集大小在渐近情况下一致有界；模拟和真实数据实验展示了强实证性能。
Conclusion: 该工作是第一个通用无分布框架，用于顺序变点定位且具有有效事后覆盖保证。

papers.title: Doing What They Say, Not What They Reason: Locating the Faithfulness Gap in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Do LLM agents act on the reasoning they state? This question of process fidelity is central to LLM-based social simulation, yet hard to measure where no reference for correct behavior exists. We study it in a controlled setting: a Texas Poker simulator with a verifiable reference action for every decision by splitting the faithfulness gap into two steps: reasoning-to-conclusion (does the stated decision follow from the agent's own reasoning?) and conclusion-to-action (does the agent execute what it states?). The two steps behave very differently. Conclusion-to-action is reliable: inconsistency is 0.7% for Claude Haiku 4.5 and 1.4% for DeepSeek-Reasoner once the conclusion is read from an explicit tag, whereas free-text conclusion extraction reports 22-26%. Reasoning-to-conclusion is where fidelity frays, but not through a single dominant failure. In a step-level diagnostic the agent's errors split roughly evenly between bad inputs, borderline cases, and rule misapplication deriving a conclusion that contradicts the agent's own restated rule from inputs it estimated correctly. This composition is model-dependent: rule misapplication accounts for a third of Haiku's interpretable errors but only 8% of DeepSeek's. The one robust signal is directional: when an agent does misapply its own stated rule, it almost always (99.5% for Haiku) errs in the risk-averse direction. The override is partly hedging behavior, not a capability limit: instructing the agent to apply the rule mechanically halves the misapplication rate (13.9% to 6.8% of decisions) and raises adherence by eight points. Process-fidelity evaluation should therefore elicit machine-checkable conclusions and probe for directional biases rather than assume a single upstream failure mode, lest it conflate measurement noise with model behavior.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过德州扑克模拟器将 LLM agent 的忠实性差距（faithfulness gap）分解为两个步骤：推理到结论（reasoning-to-conclusion）和结论到行动（conclusion-to-action）。实验发现结论到行动非常可靠（不一致率低于1.4%），而推理到结论是主要失效点，错误均匀分布在坏输入、边界情况和规则误用中，且规则误用几乎总是倾向风险规避（99.5%）。指示 agent 机械应用规则可将误用率减半。
Motivation: 现有方法难以测量 LLM agent 在社交模拟中是否按陈述的推理行动，缺乏可验证的参考行为。论文旨在量化过程忠实性并定位失效环节。
Method: 在具有可验证参考动作的德州扑克模拟器中，将 faithful gap 分解为 reasoning-to-conclusion 和 conclusion-to-action 两步，并设计逐步骤诊断。
Result: Conclusion-to-action 不一致率极低（Claude Haiku 0.7%, DeepSeek-Reasoner 1.4%）；reasoning-to-conclusion 错误分布均匀，其中规则误用占 Haiku 错误的三分之一、DeepSeek 的 8%，且误用时 99.5% 为风险规避方向；机械应用规则指令使误用率从 13.9% 降至 6.8%。
Conclusion: 过程忠实性评估应提取机器可检查的结论并探测方向性偏差，而非假设单一失效模式，以避免将测量噪声与模型行为混淆。

papers.title: Decomposing Queries into Tool Calls for Long-Video Keyframe Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Keyframe selection is a direct way to provide verifiable visual evidence for long-video question answering (QA). Queries differ in what they require, and finding the right frames depends on knowing what to look for. Existing keyframe selectors either score every frame against a single query, or decompose the query into a fixed schema evaluated by a single visual tool. We propose ToolMerge, a keyframe retrieval method based on decomposition and merging: an Large Language Model (LLM) based planner decomposes the query into tool calls and specifies how their per-tool rankings are merged using boolean operators. To evaluate retrieval directly, we construct Molmo-2 Moments (M2M), a benchmark in which every question is anchored to a specific time interval by construction. Across QA, question retrieval, and caption retrieval, ToolMerge is competitive with prior keyframe selectors, most notably on caption retrieval, outperforming other methods by 5%. Code and data can be found at https://github.com/michalsr/ToolMerge .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ToolMerge，一种基于查询分解与合并的长视频关键帧检索方法。LLM 规划器将查询拆解为多个工具调用，并通过布尔运算符合并各工具的排名结果。同时构建 M2M 基准，确保每个问题锚定到特定时间区间。在问答、问题检索和标题检索任务上，ToolMerge 与现有方法竞争力相当，尤其在标题检索上超出其他方法 5%。
Motivation: 现有关键帧选取器要么用单一查询对所有帧评分，要么将查询分解为固定模式并由单一视觉工具评估，缺乏灵活性，难以适应不同查询需求。
Method: 提出 ToolMerge：基于 LLM 的规划器将用户查询分解为多个工具调用（如视觉工具），并指定如何通过布尔运算符（AND/OR/NOT）合并各工具的输出排名，从而选出最相关的关键帧。
Result: 在自建的 M2M 基准上，ToolMerge 在标题检索任务中优于其他方法 5%，在问答和问题检索任务上与现有方法竞争力相当。
Conclusion: 实验证明查询分解与合并策略能有效提升长视频关键帧检索性能，尤其适用于检索条件明确的任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MambaGaze: Bidirectional Mamba with Explicit Missing Data Modeling for Cognitive Load Assessment from Eye-Gaze Tracking Data
papers.abstract_en: Real-time cognitive load assessment from eye-tracking signals could enable adaptive human-centered AI in safety-critical applications such as driver vigilance monitoring or automated flight deck assistance, yet two challenges persist: handling frequent data missingness from blinks and tracking failures, and efficiently modeling long-range temporal dependencies. We propose MambaGaze (Bi-Mamba), a framework that addresses these challenges through (1)~XMD encoding, which augments raw features with observation masks and time-deltas to explicitly model data uncertainty, and (2)~bidirectional Mamba-2, which captures temporal dependencies with linear computational complexity. Experiments on CLARE and CL-Drive datasets under leave-one-subject-out evaluation show that MambaGaze achieves 77.1\% accuracy and 59.2\% macro-F1 on CLARE, and 69.4\% accuracy and 51.5\% macro-F1 on CL-Drive, attaining the highest average LOSO macro-F1 (55.3\%) across all ten compared models. Input-stream ablation indicates that log-scaled time-deltas are the strongest single channel in our setting, and combining all three XMD streams provides consistent gains of 5--20\,pp macro-F1. Edge deployment benchmarks on three NVIDIA Jetson Orin platforms show real-time inference at 27--36\,FPS with power consumption below 6.6\,W, supporting feasibility for embedded cognitive load monitoring.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE-EMBS International Conference on Biomedical and Health Informatics (BHI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MambaGaze框架，用于从眼动追踪信号中实时评估认知负荷。该框架通过显式缺失数据建模（XMD编码）和双向Mamba-2模块，处理眨眼和追踪失败导致的数据缺失，并以线性复杂度捕捉长时程依赖。在CLARE和CL-Drive数据集上，MambaGaze在留一被试交叉验证下分别达到77.1%准确率（59.2%宏F1）和69.4%准确率（51.5%宏F1），平均宏F1（55.3%）优于十种对比模型。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin平台上的边缘部署测试显示实时推理速度为27–36 FPS，功耗低于6.6W。
Motivation: 实时认知负荷评估对安全关键型人机交互应用至关重要，但现有方法面临两个主要挑战：频繁的数据缺失（眨眼、追踪失败）和长时程时间依赖的高效建模。
Method: 提出MambaGaze框架，包含(1) XMD编码：将原始特征与观测掩码、时间增量拼接，显式建模数据不确定性；(2) 双向Mamba-2模块：以线性计算复杂度捕获双向时间依赖。
Result: 在CLARE和CL-Drive数据集上，LOSO评估下MambaGaze平均宏F1为55.3%，超过所有十种对比模型。消融实验表明，对数尺度时间增量是最强单一通道，组合所有XMD流带来5–20个百分点的宏F1提升。边缘部署实现27–36 FPS实时推理，功耗低于6.6W。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式缺失数据建模与高效序列建模的结合可以有效提升认知负荷评估性能，并支持边缘端实时部署。

papers.title: Registers Matter for Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are known to exhibit high-norm patch-token outliers that degrade feature map quality, a problem effectively mitigated by register tokens. As diffusion models increasingly adopt transformer architectures and move toward pixel-space training, they become closer in form to ViTs, raising the question of whether register tokens are also useful for Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). In this work, we show that DiTs differ from ViTs in a key respect: they do not exhibit patch-token outliers but still benefit from registers. Interestingly, registers are more effective in pixel-space DiTs than in latent-space DiTs. By analyzing intermediate representations, we find that register tokens produce cleaner feature maps at high noise levels, which may contribute to their effectiveness in pixel-space generation. We further observe that recent pixel-space DiT architectures implicitly incorporate register-like mechanisms, which may partially account for their strong empirical performance. Motivated by these observations, we propose Register Guidance, a technique that amplifies the contribution of register tokens responsible for improving visual structure and coherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 register tokens 对像素空间 Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) 的作用。与 ViTs 不同，DiTs 不存在 patch-token 异常值，但 register tokens 仍然有益，且在像素空间比潜在空间更有效。通过分析中间表示，发现 register tokens 在高噪声水平下产生更清晰的特征图。作者观察到最近像素空间 DiT 架构隐含类似 register 机制，并提出 Register Guidance 技术以增强视觉结构与连贯性。
Motivation: 尽管 register tokens 在 ViTs 中有效缓解了 patch-token 异常值问题，但 DiTs 是否适用尚不清楚，尤其随着扩散模型转向像素空间训练，需要明确 register tokens 的作用。
Method: 通过实验比较 DiTs 和 ViTs 中 register tokens 的效果，分析中间特征图，并提出 Register Guidance 技术来放大 register tokens 的贡献。
Result: 实验表明 DiTs 没有 patch-token 异常值，但 register tokens 仍然有益，尤其在像素空间 DiT 中更有效；高噪声水平下 register tokens 产生更清晰的特征图；最近像素空间 DiT 架构隐含类似 register 机制。
Conclusion: register tokens 对像素空间 DiT 有显著益处，Register Guidance 可进一步提升视觉结构连贯性。

papers.title: Dynamic Cluster Data Sampling for Efficient and Long-Tail-Aware Vision-Language Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: The computational cost of training a vision-language model (VLM) can be reduced by sampling the training data. Previous work on efficient VLM pre-training has pointed to the importance of semantic data balance, adjusting the distribution of topics in the data to improve VLM accuracy. However, existing efficient pre-training approaches may disproportionately remove rare concepts from the training corpus. As a result, long-tail concepts remain insufficiently represented in the training data and are not effectively captured during training. In this work, we introduce a dynamic cluster-based sampling approach (DynamiCS) that downsamples large clusters of data and upsamples small ones. We first demonstrate the advantage of our cluster-scaling approach, which maintains the relative order of semantic clusters in the data and emphasizes the long-tail. This approach contrasts with current work, which focuses only on flattening the semantic distribution of the data. Then, we show the importance of dynamic sampling, which applies sampling at each epoch to improve cross-epoch data diversity and make upsampling practical. Our experiments show that DynamiCS reduces the computational cost of VLM training and provides a performance advantage for long-tail concepts. Code available at https://github.com/MingliangLiang3/DynamiCS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态聚类数据采样方法（DynamiCS），通过下采样大数据簇和上采样小数据簇来降低视觉-语言模型（VLM）预训练的计算成本，同时保持长尾概念的表示。实验表明该方法减少了训练成本，并在长尾概念上获得性能优势。
Motivation: 现有高效的VLM预训练方法在采样时可能不成比例地移除稀有概念，导致长尾概念在训练数据中表示不足，模型无法有效学习这些概念。
Method: 提出动态聚类采样（DynamiCS），首先对数据进行聚类，然后根据簇大小进行缩放，下采样大簇、上采样小簇，保持语义簇的相对顺序并强调长尾。动态采样在每个epoch都应用采样以增加跨epoch数据多样性。
Result: 实验表明DynamiCS降低了VLM训练的计算成本，并在长尾概念上提供了性能优势。
Conclusion: 动态聚类采样方法能够在保持效率的同时改善长尾概念的学习，与仅关注平坦化语义分布的现有方法形成对比。

papers.title: Self-Routing: Parameter-Free Expert Routing from Hidden States
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity by activating only a small subset of experts per token, and typically rely on a learned router to map hidden states to expert assignments. In this work, we ask whether a dedicated learned router is strictly necessary for MoE routing. We propose Self-Routing, a parameter-free routing mechanism that uses a designated subspace of the token hidden state directly as expert logits, eliminating the router projection entirely while leaving the rest of the MoE layer unchanged. We evaluate Self-Routing on language modeling across different expert counts and model scales, and on ImageNet-1K classification by comparing it against a standard learned router, random-routing baselines, and dense non-MoE baselines. Our results show that Self-Routing remains competitive with the learned-router baseline while removing all dedicated routing parameters, and yields more balanced expert utilization, with about 17 % higher average normalized routing entropy and no explicit load-balancing loss. On ImageNet-1K with DeiT-S/16, Self-Routing also slightly improves over the corresponding learned-router MoE. These findings suggest that effective MoE routing can emerge from the hidden representation itself without requiring a separate learned router module.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Self-Routing，一种无参数的门控路由机制，直接利用Token隐藏状态中的指定子空间作为专家logits，从而移除传统MoE中的独立路由投影层。在语言建模和ImageNet-1K分类任务上，Self-Routing在消除所有路由参数的同时与标准学习路由保持竞争力，并实现更均衡的专家利用，平均归一化路由熵提高约17%，且无需显式负载平衡损失。
Motivation: 传统Mixture-of-Experts层依赖一个独立学习路由器来将隐藏状态映射到专家分配，本文探究该专用路由器是否严格必要。
Method: Self-Routing机制：从Token隐藏状态中划出一个指定子空间，直接将其作为专家logits，完全移除路由投影层，其余MoE层保持不变。
Result: 在语言建模（不同专家数量和模型规模）和ImageNet-1K分类上，Self-Routing与标准学习路由基线性能相当，且无需路由参数；专家利用率更均衡，平均归一化路由熵提高约17%；在DeiT-S/16上甚至略优于对应学习路由MoE。
Conclusion: 结论表明，有效的MoE路由可以从隐藏表示本身涌现，无需独立学习路由模块。

papers.title: Transformers converge to invariant algorithmic cores
papers.abstract_en: Training selects for behavior, not circuitry: many weight configurations can implement the same function. Studying any single trained neural network thus risks describing accidents of one training run rather than the computation itself. This work shifts focus from what transformers happen to do to what they must do by extracting algorithmic cores, compact subspaces that are necessary and sufficient for a task and that recur across independently trained models. Here, Algorithmic Core Extraction (ACE) is introduced to isolate these subspaces, causally validate them, and recover the algorithms they implement across settings ranging from synthetic tasks to large-scale pretrained models. Markov-chain transformers embed three-dimensional cores in nearly orthogonal subspaces yet recover identical transition spectra. Modular-addition transformers form compact cyclic cores at grokking that later inflate under continued regularization, redundantly distributing the same computation across many functionally equivalent modes. This functional redundancy is found to accelerate the transition from memorization to generalization, yielding an inverse scaling law for grokking time. In six language models spanning more than two orders of magnitude in scale (GPT-2 Small/Medium/Large, LLaMA-3.1, Gemma-2, and Qwen2.5), subject-verb agreement is governed by a single, steerable axis that aligns across architectures. Flipping this axis inverts grammatical number throughout open-ended generation. Together these results suggest that beneath the apparent complexity of trained transformers lies a simpler, shared computational structure, and that targeting invariants rather than parameterizations may offer a more tractable path to mechanistic understanding and control. Code: https://github.com/joshseth/cores
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出算法核心提取（ACE）方法，用于从独立训练的Transformer中提取必要且充分的算法子空间。在马尔可夫链任务中，不同模型的三维核心几乎正交但恢复相同转移谱；模加法任务中，循环核心在grokking后膨胀并分布到多个等价模式。在六个语言模型中，主语-动词一致由单一可操控轴控制，翻转该轴可逆整个生成中的语法数。结果表明Transformer底层存在共享的简单计算结构。
Motivation: 训练只选择行为而非电路，许多权重配置可实现相同功能，单独研究一个网络可能描述的是训练偶然性而非计算本身。需要找出跨模型共享的不变计算核心。
Method: 提出算法核心提取（ACE）方法，识别并因果验证神经网络中必要且充分的子空间，并恢复其实现的算法。
Result: 马尔可夫链Transformer中，不同模型的三维核心近乎正交但转移谱相同；模加法Transformer中，核心在grokking后从紧凑循环结构膨胀为冗余分布，加速了泛化；六个语言模型中主语-动词一致由单一可操控轴控制，且该轴跨架构对齐。
Conclusion: Transformer表面复杂性背后存在更简单、共享的计算结构，针对不变量而非参数化进行机械理解与控制可能更易实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Implementing Metric Temporal Answer Set Programming
papers.abstract_en: We develop a computational approach to Metric Answer Set Programming (ASP) to allow for expressing quantitative temporal constraints, like durations and deadlines. A central challenge is to maintain scalability when dealing with fine-grained timing constraints, which can significantly exacerbate ASP's grounding bottleneck. To address this issue, we leverage extensions of ASP with difference constraints, a simplified form of linear constraints, to handle time-related aspects externally. Our approach effectively decouples metric ASP from the granularity of time, resulting in a solution that is unaffected by time precision.
papers.comment: Under consideration in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种度量回答集编程（Metric ASP）的计算方法，支持表达持续时间、截止时间等定量时间约束。通过将ASP与差分约束（difference constraints）扩展相结合，在外部处理时间相关方面，从而将度量ASP与时间粒度解耦，避免因时间精度导致的计算瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有ASP在处理细粒度时间约束时面临可扩展性问题，尤其是时间精度会显著加剧ASP的grounding瓶颈。
Method: 利用带差分约束的ASP扩展（一种简化线性约束）来外部处理时间方面，实现度量ASP与时间粒度的解耦。
Result: 该方法不受时间精度影响，理论上可处理高精度时间约束而不增加计算负担（摘要未报告具体实验数值）。
Conclusion: 提出的解耦策略使得度量ASP能够有效处理定量时间约束，避免了传统ASP中因时间细粒度导致的瓶颈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Constrained Optimization Perspective of Unrolled Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a constrained optimization framework for training transformers that behave like optimization descent algorithms. Specifically, we enforce layerwise descent constraints on the objective function and replace standard empirical risk minimization (ERM) with a primal-dual training scheme. This approach yields models whose intermediate representations decrease the loss monotonically in expectation across layers. We apply our method to both unrolled transformer architectures and conventional pretrained transformers on tasks of video denoising and text classification. Across these settings, we observe constrained transformers achieve stronger robustness to perturbations and maintain higher out-of-distribution generalization, while preserving in-distribution performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个约束优化框架来训练Transformer，使其中间表示在层间单调地降低损失。通过强制逐层下降约束并用原始-对偶训练替代标准经验风险最小化，该方法在视频去噪和文本分类任务上提升了模型对扰动的鲁棒性和分布外泛化能力，同时保持了分布内性能。
Motivation: 标准Transformer训练缺乏对中间表示单调下降的约束，导致模型可能产生不稳定的表示，影响鲁棒性和泛化。
Method: 引入逐层下降约束，将训练转化为原始-对偶优化问题，确保每层输出相对于目标函数的损失在期望上单调递减。
Result: 在视频去噪和文本分类任务上，约束Transformer相比基线模型在保持分布内性能的同时，显著提高了对扰动的鲁棒性和分布外泛化。
Conclusion: 通过引入层间下降约束，Transformer可以获得类似优化算法的行为，从而改善鲁棒性和泛化，且方法适用于多种架构和任务。

papers.title: RayRoPE: Projective Ray Positional Encoding for Multi-view Attention
papers.abstract_en: We study positional encodings for multi-view transformers that process tokens from a set of posed input images, and seek a mechanism that encodes patches uniquely, allows SE(3)-invariant attention with multi-frequency similarity, and can adapt to the geometry of the underlying 3D scene. We find that prior (absolute or relative) encoding schemes for multi-view attention do not meet these desiderata, and present RayRoPE to address this gap. RayRoPE represents patch positions based on associated rays and computes query-frame projective coordinates to ensure SE(3) invariance. To adapt to scene geometry, RayRoPE predicts (without direct supervision) a per-token depth to obtain its position along the corresponding ray, while also modeling uncertainty and analytically computing the expected positional encoding. We validate our method on the tasks of novel-view synthesis, stereo depth estimation, and feed-forward 3DGS reconstruction. While remaining efficient, RayRoPE consistently improves over alternate position encoding schemes (e.g., 24% relative improvement on LPIPS in RE10K).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RayRoPE，一种用于多视图Transformer的投影射线位置编码，能够实现SE(3)不变性注意力并适应3D场景几何。该方法基于射线表示，通过预测每个token的深度（无监督）和不确定性，计算期望的位置编码。在新视角合成、立体深度估计和前馈3DGS重建任务上，相比其他位置编码方案（如LPIPS在RE10K上相对提升24%），RayRoPE表现一致提升。
Motivation: 现有绝对或相对位置编码方案无法同时满足多视图注意力的三个需求：唯一编码、SE(3)不变性、适应场景几何。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: RayRoPE将补丁位置表示为关联射线，计算查询帧投影坐标以实现SE(3)不变性；通过预测每个token的深度（无监督）和不确定性，沿射线获得位置，并解析计算期望位置编码。
Result: 在新视角合成、立体深度估计和前馈3DGS重建任务上，RayRoPE一致优于其他位置编码方案，例如在RE10K上的LPIPS相对提升24%。
Conclusion: RayRoPE提供了一种高效且几何自适应的方法，改进了多视图Transformer的位置编码。摘要未提限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Factorizable joint shift revisited
papers.abstract_en: Factorizable joint shift (FJS) represents a type of distribution shift (or dataset shift) that comprises both covariate and label shift. Recently, it has been observed that FJS actually arises from consecutive label and covariate (or vice versa) shifts. Research into FJS so far has been confined mostly to the case of categorical labels. We propose a framework for analysing distribution shift in the case of a general label space, thus covering both classification and regression models. Based on the framework, we generalise existing results on FJS to general label spaces and present and analyse a related extension to label distribution estimation of the expectation maximisation (EM) algorithm for class prior probabilities. We also take a fresh look at generalized label shift (GLS) in the case of a general label space.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了可分解联合移位（FJS），该移位同时包含协变量移位和标签移位。以往研究多限于分类标签，本文提出了一个适用于一般标签空间（包括分类和回归）的分布移位分析框架，并基于此推广了现有FJS结果，还分析了用于标签分布估计的EM算法的扩展。此外，文中重新审视了广义标签移位（GLS）在一般标签空间下的情况。
Motivation: 现有关于可分解联合移位（FJS）的研究主要局限于分类标签，缺乏对一般标签空间（如回归）的理论分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，为更广泛的分布移位场景提供统一框架。
Method: 提出了一个适用于一般标签空间的分布移位分析框架，基于此推广了FJS结果，并扩展了用于类先验概率估计的EM算法以处理标签分布估计。同时重新审视了广义标签移位（GLS）在一般标签空间下的定义和性质。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的数值实验结果，而是提供了理论推广和分析，包括FJS在一般标签空间下的定义、性质，以及EM算法扩展的可行性。
Conclusion: 本文通过理论分析表明，可分解联合移位（FJS）可以推广到一般标签空间，并可用于分类和回归模型。该工作为处理更广泛的分布移位提供了理论基础，但未涉及实际应用或实验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric Stability: The Missing Axis of Representations
papers.abstract_en: Representational similarity analysis and related methods compare the internal geometries of neural networks, but they measure only alignment between spaces, leaving a blind spot -- whether a representation's structure is reliably recoverable, not merely similar. We introduce geometric stability, a distinct axis, and \textit{Shesha}, a metric that quantifies it from a single representation by correlating dissimilarity matrices built from complementary random halves of the feature dimensions. Unlike CKA and Procrustes distance, Shesha is provably non-invariant to orthogonal rotations of the feature basis. This is by design: the basis is privileged for learned models, since probes, patching, and steering act on coordinates, and a rotation-invariant metric cannot see whether the targeted structure survives them. A double dissociation isolates the mechanism -- removing the top principal component collapses CKA while Shesha holds, whereas rotating a representation into its eigenbasis, which preserves the spectrum and CKA exactly, collapses Shesha. Across 2,463 encoder configurations in seven domains, the metrics are redundant under geometry-preserving transforms and anti-correlate under compression ($ρ=-0.47$). Across 170 vision models spanning 6 clean and 38 corruption-shifted datasets, DINOv2 ranks first or second in transferability on three of six clean datasets yet bottom-quartile in stability on five, an isolated dissociation rather than a trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出几何稳定性 (geometric stability) 作为表征分析的新维度，并设计指标 Shesha，通过比较特征维度的随机半样本构建的相异矩阵来量化稳定性。Shesha 对特征基的旋转变换不具不变性，这与 CKA 和 Procrustes 距离形成对比。实验表明，在 2,463 个编码器配置和 170 个视觉模型中，几何稳定性与现有指标存在解离，例如 DINOv2 在干净数据集上迁移性排名靠前但稳定性排名靠后。
Motivation: 现有表征相似性分析只测量空间之间的对齐，忽略了表征结构是否可可靠恢复这一盲点。
Method: 提出 Shesha 指标，从单一表征出发，将特征维度随机分成两半，计算两个相异矩阵之间的相关性，从而量化几何稳定性。
Result: Shesha 在理论上是非旋转不变的；实验显示，去除主成分会降低 CKA 但 Shesha 保持不变，而将表征旋转到特征基会降低 Shesha 但保留 CKA。在 2,463 个编码器上，两种指标在几何保持变换下冗余，在压缩下负相关 (ρ=-0.47)。在 170 个视觉模型上，DINOv2 在三个干净数据集上迁移性排名前二，但在五个数据集上稳定性位于后四分位。
Conclusion: 几何稳定性是与现有相似性度量不同的表征属性，对理解模型的可解释性、微调等下游应用有潜在意义。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: KernelEvolve: Scaling Agentic Kernel Coding for Heterogeneous AI Accelerators at Meta
papers.abstract_en: Making deep learning recommendation model (DLRM) training and inference fast and efficient is important. However, this presents three key system challenges - model architecture diversity, kernel primitive diversity, and hardware generation and architecture heterogeneity. This paper presents KernelEvolve-an agentic kernel coding framework-to tackle heterogeneity at-scale for DLRM. KernelEvolve is designed to take kernel specifications as input and automate the process of kernel generation and optimization for recommendation model across heterogeneous hardware architectures. KernelEvolve does so by operating at multiple programming abstractions, from Triton and CuTe DSL to low-level hardware agnostic languages, spanning the full hardware-software optimization stack. The kernel optimization process is described as graph-based search with selection policy, universal operator, fitness function, and termination rule, dynamically adapts to runtime execution context through retrieval-augmented prompt synthesis. We designed, implemented, and deployed KernelEvolve to optimize a wide variety of production recommendation models across generations of NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, as well as Meta's AI accelerators. We validate KernelEvolve on the publicly-available KernelBench suite, achieving 100% pass rate on all 250 problems across three difficulty levels, and 160 PyTorch ATen operators across three heterogeneous hardware platforms, demonstrating 100% correctness. KernelEvolve reduces development time from weeks to hours and achieves substantial performance improvements over PyTorch baselines across diverse production use cases and for heterogeneous AI systems at-scale. Beyond performance efficiency improvements, KernelEvolve significantly mitigates the programmability barrier for new AI hardware by enabling automated kernel generation for in-house developed AI hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KernelEvolve是一个面向异构AI加速器的自动化内核编码框架，专门用于优化深度学习推荐模型（DLRM）的内核生成与优化。它支持多种编程抽象（如Triton、CuTe DSL等），通过基于图的搜索和检索增强提示合成动态适应运行时上下文。在KernelBench上达到100%通过率，将开发时间从周级缩短到小时级，并在Meta的生产推荐模型中取得显著性能提升。
Motivation: 现有DLRM训练和推理面临模型架构多样性、内核原语多样性和硬件异构性三大系统挑战，需要自动化的内核生成和优化框架来应对大规模异构环境。
Method: 提出KernelEvolve框架，将内核规范作为输入，通过多种编程抽象（从Triton/CuTe到低级硬件无关语言）自动生成和优化内核。优化过程基于图的搜索，包含选择策略、通用算子、适应度函数和终止规则，并通过检索增强提示合成动态适应运行时执行上下文。
Result: 在KernelBench套件上达到所有250个问题（三个难度级别）100%通过率，在三个异构硬件平台上对160个PyTorch ATen算子实现100%正确性。开发时间从周级缩短到小时级，在Meta的生产使用案例中实现显著性能提升。
Conclusion: KernelEvolve通过自动化内核生成显著降低了新AI硬件的可编程性障碍，并实现了大规模异构AI系统的性能效率提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PGOT: A Physics-Geometry Operator Transformer for Complex PDEs
papers.abstract_en: While Transformers have demonstrated remarkable potential in modeling Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), modeling large-scale unstructured meshes with complex geometries remains a significant challenge. Existing efficient architectures often employ feature dimensionality reduction strategies, which inadvertently induces Geometric Aliasing, resulting in the loss of critical physical boundary information. To address this, we propose the Physics-Geometry Operator Transformer (PGOT), designed to reconstruct physical feature learning through explicit geometry awareness. Specifically, we propose Spectrum-Preserving Geometric Attention (SpecGeo-Attention). Utilizing a ``physics slicing-geometry injection" mechanism, this module incorporates multi-scale geometric encodings to explicitly preserve multi-scale geometric features while maintaining linear computational complexity $O(N)$. Furthermore, PGOT dynamically routes computations to low-order linear paths for smooth regions and high-order non-linear paths for shock waves and discontinuities based on spatial coordinates, enabling spatially adaptive and high-precision physical field modeling. PGOT achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance across four standard benchmarks and excels in large-scale industrial tasks including airfoil and car designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出物理几何算子Transformer（PGOT），用于解决复杂偏微分方程在大规模非结构化网格上的建模难题。PGOT通过谱保留几何注意力（SpecGeo-Attention）机制，利用“物理切片-几何注入”显式保留多尺度几何特征，并基于空间坐标动态路由到低阶线性或高阶非线性路径，实现空间自适应高精度建模。在四个标准基准和大规模工业任务（翼型、汽车设计）上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有Transformer在建模大规模非结构化网格上的复杂几何PDE时，特征降维导致几何混叠，丢失关键物理边界信息。
Method: 提出PGOT，核心为谱保留几何注意力（SpecGeo-Attention），通过“物理切片-几何注入”多尺度几何编码显式保留特征，并基于坐标动态路由：平滑区域走低阶线性路径，激波/间断走高阶非线性路径，保持线性复杂度$O(N)$。
Result: 在四个标准PDE基准上取得一致最优结果，并在大规模工业任务（翼型、汽车设计）中表现优异。
Conclusion: PGOT通过显式几何感知重建物理特征学习，有效消除几何混叠，实现高效精确的复杂PDE建模。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Pro-Pose: Unpaired Full-Body Portrait Synthesis via Canonical UV Maps
papers.abstract_en: Photographs of people taken by professional photographers typically present the person in beautiful lighting, with an interesting pose, and flattering quality. This is unlike common photos people take of themselves in uncontrolled conditions. In this paper, we explore how to canonicalize a person's 'in-the-wild' photograph into a controllable, high-fidelity avatar -- reposed in a simple environment with standardized minimal clothing. A key challenge is preserving the person's unique whole-body identity, facial features, and body shape while stripping away the complex occlusions of their original garments. While a large paired dataset of the same person in varied clothing and poses would simplify this, such data does not exist. To that end, we propose two key insights: 1) Our method transforms the input photo into a canonical full-body UV space, which we couple with a novel reposing methodology to model occlusions and synthesize novel views. Operating in UV space allows us to decouple pose from appearance and leverage massive unpaired datasets. 2) We personalize the output photo via multi-image finetuning to ensure robust identity preservation under extreme pose changes. Our approach yields high-quality, reposed portraits that achieve strong quantitative performance on real-world imagery, providing an ideal, clean biometric canvas that significantly improves the fidelity of downstream applications like Virtual Try-On (VTO).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文提出 Pro-Pose，将非受控环境下的全身照片转换为可控的、高保真度的虚拟化身（avatar），通过规范化的 UV 图（canonical UV maps）解耦姿态与外观，并利用多图像微调保留身份特征。摘要显示该方法在真实图像上取得良好量化结果，并为虚拟试穿等下游任务提供更干净的生物特征基底。
Motivation: 专业摄影照片与普通人自拍照之间存在巨大差距，现有方法缺乏配对数据来学习从随意照片到标准姿态和衣着的映射。
Method: 提出两步策略：首先将输入照片转换至规范化的全身 UV 空间，结合创新的重新姿态（reposing）方法来建模遮挡并合成新视角；然后通过多图像微调实现个性化，确保在极端姿态变化下仍能保持身份。
Result: 摘要报告在真实世界图像上取得了强的量化性能，并为下游任务（如虚拟试穿）提供了更逼真的生物特征基底，显著提升 fidelity。
Conclusion: 该方法利用 UV 空间和未配对数据，实现高质量、可重新姿态的全身肖像合成，具有广泛的下游应用潜力。但摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive digital twins for predictive decision-making: Online Bayesian learning of transition dynamics
papers.abstract_en: This work shows how adaptivity can enhance value realization of digital twins in civil engineering. We focus on adapting the state transition models within digital twins represented through probabilistic graphical models. The bi-directional interaction between the physical and virtual domains is modeled using dynamic Bayesian networks. By treating state transition probabilities as random variables endowed with conjugate priors, we enable hierarchical online learning of transition dynamics from a state to another through effortless Bayesian updates. We provide the mathematical framework to account for a larger class of distributions with respect to the current literature on digital twins. To compute dynamic policies with precision updates we solve parametric Markov decision processes through reinforcement learning. The proposed adaptive digital twin framework enjoys enhanced personalization, increased robustness, and improved cost-effectiveness. We assess our approach on a case study involving structural health monitoring and maintenance planning of a railway bridge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应数字孪生框架，通过在线贝叶斯学习动态更新状态转移模型，并利用强化学习制定维护决策。案例研究显示在铁路桥梁结构健康监测中提升了个性化、鲁棒性和成本效益。
Motivation: 现有数字孪生缺乏自适应能力，无法在运行中根据新数据更新模型，限制了其在土木工程中的价值实现。
Method: 使用动态贝叶斯网络建模物理-虚拟双向交互；将状态转移概率视为随机变量并赋予共轭先验，实现层次化在线贝叶斯更新；通过强化学习求解参数化马尔可夫决策过程以进行决策。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在铁路桥梁案例中增强了个性化、鲁棒性和成本效益，但未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 自适应数字孪生通过在线学习转移动力学可以提升土木工程中决策支持的效果和效率。

papers.title: A Comparative Study of EMG- and IMU-based Gesture Recognition at the Wrist and Forearm
papers.abstract_en: Gestures are an integral part of our daily interactions with the environment. Hand gesture recognition (HGR) is the process of interpreting human intent through various input modalities, such as visual data (images and videos) and bio-signals. Bio-signals are widely used in HGR due to their ability to be captured non-invasively via sensors placed on the arm. Among these, surface electromyography (sEMG), which measures the electrical activity of muscles, is the most extensively studied modality. However, less-explored alternatives such as inertial measurement units (IMUs) can provide complementary information on subtle muscle movements, which makes them valuable for gesture recognition. In this study, we investigate the potential of using IMU signals from different muscle groups to capture user intent. Our results demonstrate that IMU signals contain sufficient information to serve as the sole input sensor for static gesture recognition. Moreover, we compare different muscle groups and check the quality of pattern recognition on individual muscle groups. We further found that tendon-induced micro-movement captured by IMUs is a major contributor to static gesture recognition. We believe that leveraging muscle micro-movement information can enhance the usability of prosthetic arms for amputees. This approach also offers new possibilities for hand gesture recognition in fields such as robotics, teleoperation, sign language interpretation, and beyond.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了表面肌电图（sEMG）和惯性测量单元（IMU）在手腕和前臂手势识别中的性能。实验表明，IMU信号足以作为静态手势识别的唯一输入，且肌腱引起的微运动是主要贡献因素。该发现有望提升假肢控制、机器人遥操作等领域的应用。
Motivation: 现有手势识别主要依赖sEMG，但IMU可提供互补的肌肉微运动信息，其独立作为输入传感器的潜力尚未充分探索。
Method: 采集手腕和前臂不同肌肉群的IMU和sEMG信号，比较单模态及多模态手势识别表现，并分析各肌肉群对识别质量的贡献。
Result: IMU信号单独可用于静态手势识别，肌腱微运动是关键信息源；不同肌肉群的识别效果存在差异。
Conclusion: IMU可作为手势识别的替代或补充模态，特别适用于假肢控制等场景，但仍需动态手势验证。

papers.title: When Assisting One Disempowers Another
papers.abstract_en: Personal AI agents are increasingly deployed in shared environments, where their actions affect not just the primary user they are assisting, but bystanders who never consented to being affected by the system. We show that a well-meaning AI assistant optimizing for one user's benefit can unintentionally erode a bystander's agency, a phenomenon we formalize as bystander disempowerment. We theoretically characterize the conditions under which disempowerment arises, showing it emerges when an assistant systematically selects actions that increase user empowerment at the bystander's expense. We empirically demonstrate this in Disempower-Grid, a parameterized suite of multi-agent gridworld environments, finding that between 27-96% of procedurally generated environments exhibit disempowerment, and that the presence of disempowerment depends strongly on assistant objective and capability, not just environmental structure.
papers.comment: v2: Updated title, added a co-author, extended theoretical analysis of bystander disempowerment, and added new experimental results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究个人AI助手在共享环境中可能无意中削弱旁观者自主性的现象，形式化为“旁观者剥夺权力”。理论分析揭示了剥夺权力产生的条件，并在Disempower-Grid多智能体网格世界环境中进行实证验证，发现27%-96%的环境存在该现象。
Motivation: 个人AI代理在共享环境部署时，其行为不仅影响主要用户，还可能影响未同意的旁观者。现有研究未充分关注AI助手优化用户利益可能无意中损害旁观者权益的问题。
Method: 形式化定义“旁观者剥夺权力”，理论刻画其产生条件；设计Disempower-Grid参数化多智能体网格世界环境，系统评估不同助手目标和能力下的剥夺权力现象。
Result: 在程序生成的27%-96%的环境中观察到旁观者剥夺权力现象，且该现象强烈依赖于助手的目标和能力，而非仅环境结构。
Conclusion: AI助手优化用户利益时可能意外剥夺旁观者自主性，需在设计时考虑多主体影响。

papers.title: Medix: Out-of-Distribution Detection from Unlabeled Wild Data via Robust Gradient Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection plays a crucial role in ensuring the robustness of machine learning systems deployed in real-world applications. Recent approaches have explored the use of unlabeled data, showing potential for enhancing OOD detection capabilities. However, effectively utilizing unlabeled in-the-wild data remains challenging due to the mixed nature of both in-distribution (InD) and OOD samples. The lack of a distinct set of OOD samples complicates the task of training an optimal OOD classifier. In this work, we introduce Medix, a novel framework designed to identify potential outliers from unlabeled data using the median-based robust gradient statistics. We use the median because it provides a stable estimate of the central tendency, as an OOD detection mechanism, due to its robustness against noise and outliers. Using these identified outliers, along with labeled InD data, we train a robust OOD classifier. From a theoretical perspective, we derive error bounds that demonstrate Medix achieves a low error rate. Empirical results further substantiate our claims, as Medix outperforms existing methods across the board in open-world settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Medix框架，利用未标注的野外数据通过基于中位数的鲁棒梯度统计识别潜在离群点，并训练鲁棒OOD分类器。理论推导了低误差界，实验表明在开放世界设置中优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法利用未标注数据增强OOD检测，但由于数据中混合了分布内（InD）和分布外（OOD）样本，缺乏明确的OOD样本集使得训练最优OOD分类器困难。
Method: 提出Medix框架，使用基于中位数的鲁棒梯度统计从未标注数据中识别潜在离群点，结合标注的分布内数据训练鲁棒OOD分类器。
Result: 理论推导了低误差界，实验在开放世界设置中全面优于现有方法。
Conclusion: Medix在利用未标注数据提升OOD检测方面有效，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Social 3D Scene Graphs: Modeling Human Actions and Relations for Interactive Service Robots
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how people interact with their surroundings and each other is essential for enabling robots to act in socially compliant and context-aware ways. While 3D Scene Graphs have emerged as a powerful semantic representation for scene understanding, existing approaches largely ignore humans in the scene, also due to the lack of annotated human-environment relationships. Moreover, existing methods typically capture only open-vocabulary relations from single image frames, which limits their ability to model long-range interactions beyond the observed content. We introduce Social 3D Scene Graphs, an augmented 3D Scene Graph representation that captures humans, their attributes, activities and relationships in the environment, both local and remote, using an open-vocabulary framework. Furthermore, we introduce a new benchmark consisting of synthetic environments with comprehensive human-scene relationship annotations and diverse types of queries for evaluating social scene understanding in 3D. The experiments demonstrate that our representation improves human activity prediction and reasoning about human-environment relations, paving the way toward socially intelligent robots.
papers.comment: Equal contribution from E. Bartoli and D. Rotondi. Paper accepted at IROS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出社交3D场景图（Social 3D Scene Graphs），一种扩展的3D场景图表示，能够捕捉环境中的人类、属性、活动和关系（包括局部和远程），使用开放词汇框架。同时引入一个包含合成环境及全面人-场景关系标注的新基准，用于评估3D社交场景理解。实验表明该表示改进了人类活动预测和人-环境关系推理，为社交智能机器人铺平道路。
Motivation: 现有3D场景图大多忽略人类或仅捕捉单帧的开放词汇关系，缺乏对人-环境关系的标注，且难以建模超出观察内容的远程交互。
Method: 提出社交3D场景图表示，集成人类及其属性、活动和环境中的关系（局部和远程），使用开放词汇框架。构建了一个包含合成环境和多种查询类型的新基准用于评估。
Result: 实验表明该表示在人类活动预测和人-环境关系推理任务上性能提升。
Conclusion: 本文方法为社交智能机器人的场景理解提供了更丰富的表示，但局限在于使用合成数据，未来需扩展到真实场景。

papers.title: FedDAF: Federated Domain Adaptation Using Model Functional Distance
papers.abstract_en: Federated Domain Adaptation (FDA) is a federated learning (FL) approach that improves model performance at the target client by collaborating with source clients while preserving data privacy. FDA faces two primary challenges: domain shifts between source and target data and limited labeled data at the target. Most existing FDA methods focus on domain shifts, assuming ample target data, yet often neglect the combined challenges of both domain shifts and data scarcity. Moreover, approaches that address both challenges fail to prioritize sharing relevant information from source clients according to the target's objective. In this paper, we propose FedDAF, a novel approach addressing both challenges in FDA. FedDAF uses similarity-based aggregation of the global source model and target model by calculating model functional distance from their mean gradient fields computed on target data. This enables effective model aggregation based on the target objective, constructed using target data, even with limited data. While computing model functional distance between these two models, FedDAF computes the angle between their mean gradient fields and then normalizes with the Gompertz function. To construct the global source model, all the local source models are aggregated using simple average in the server. Experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate FedDAF's superiority over existing FL, PFL, and FDA methods in terms of achieving better test accuracy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FedDAF，一种联邦域适应方法，同时处理源-目标域偏移和目标客户端标签稀缺问题。FedDAF通过计算模型在目标数据上的均值梯度场之间的函数距离（角度并用Gompertz函数归一化）来聚合全局源模型和目标模型。实验表明FedDAF在测试准确率上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有联邦域适应方法要么只关注域偏移而忽略数据稀缺，要么同时处理两者但未能根据目标目标优先共享源客户端的相关信息。
Method: 提出FedDAF，利用基于相似性的聚合，通过计算全局源模型和目标模型在目标数据上的均值梯度场之间的函数距离（角度并用Gompertz函数归一化）来实现根据目标目标的模型聚合。
Result: 在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，FedDAF在测试准确率上优于现有联邦学习、个性化联邦学习和联邦域适应方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调FedDAF通过结合域偏移和数据稀缺挑战并基于目标目标进行模型聚合，实现了更好的性能。

papers.title: MASCA: LLM based-Multi Agents System for Credit Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in financial problem-solving have leveraged LLMs and agent-based systems, with a primary focus on trading and financial modeling. However, credit assessment remains an underexplored challenge, traditionally dependent on rule-based methods and statistical models. In this paper, we introduce MASCA, an LLM-driven multi-agent system designed to enhance credit evaluation by mirroring real-world decision-making processes. The framework employs a layered architecture where specialized LLM-based agents collaboratively tackle sub-tasks. Additionally, we integrate contrastive learning for risk and reward assessment to optimize decision-making. We further present a signaling game theory perspective on hierarchical multi-agent systems, offering theoretical insights into their structure and interactions. Our paper also includes a detailed bias analysis in credit assessment, addressing fairness concerns. Experimental results demonstrate that MASCA outperforms baseline approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of hierarchical LLM-based multi-agent systems in financial applications, particularly in credit scoring.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS GenAI In Finance Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了MASCA，一个基于LLM的多智能体系统，用于信用评估。系统采用分层架构，多个专业化LLM智能体协作处理子任务，并整合对比学习进行风险与回报评估。还从信号博弈理论角度提供了对分层多智能体系统的理论见解，并进行了偏差分析。实验表明MASCA优于基线方法。

Result: 实验表明MASCA在信用评分上优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 分层LLM多智能体系统在金融应用特别是信用评估中有效。

papers.title: Variational Learning of Disentangled Representations
papers.abstract_en: Disentangled representations separate factors that are shared across conditions from those that are condition-specific. Such separation is needed for generalization to new domains, treatments, patients, or species. A dominant line of work pursues this goal through variational formulations. While these approaches achieve partial disentanglement, they often exhibit three common limitations: they either do not remove all condition-specific information from the condition-specific representation, allow the condition-specific representation to become uninformative, or impose independence assumptions that do not reflect the underlying generative process. In this work, we introduce DisCoVR, a variational framework that addresses these limitations. Its objective is aligned with the probabilistic structure of the data-generating process, and includes an adversarial term that prevents condition-specific information from being encoded in the condition-specific representation.DisCoVR reconstructs the data from both shared and condition-specific representations, ensuring that each remains informative, and uses a structured prior that further reinforces the informativeness of both representations. We show that across synthetic, image, and single-cell RNA-sequencing datasets, DisCoVR achieves stronger disentanglement compared to previous approaches.

papers.title: Narrative-Centered Emotional Reflection: An Early Prototype for AI-Supported Emotional Self-Reflection
papers.abstract_en: Reflexion is an AI-powered prototype designed to explore structured emotional self-reflection. By integrating emotion detection, layered reflective prompting, and metaphorical storytelling generation, Reflexion was intended to support users in autonomous emotional exploration beyond basic sentiment categorization. Grounded primarily in expressive writing, cognitive restructuring, and self-determination theory, the system was designed to organize reflection as a progressive pathway from surface-level emotional recognition toward value-aligned action planning. Its final action-planning layer is additionally informed by broader questions of agency and empowerment, which remain future directions rather than fully implemented mechanisms in the current prototype. Informal design feedback indicated that some reviewers found the layered interaction model understandable and potentially useful; no empirical efficacy claims are made. As an early prototype, Reflexion documents one direction in theory-informed affective computing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Reflexion，一个用于探索结构化情感自我反思的AI原型，结合情绪检测、分层反思提示和隐喻故事生成，旨在支持用户进行自主情感探索。系统基于表达性写作、认知重构和自我决定理论，设计从表层情绪识别到价值导向行动规划的渐进路径。当前原型仅收集了非正式设计反馈，未进行实证有效性评估。
Motivation: 现有情感计算多停留在基础情感分类，缺乏支持用户进行更深层次、结构化情感反思的工具。
Method: 构建一个包含情绪检测、分层反思提示和隐喻故事生成的原型系统，Reflexion，以渐进式引导用户从情绪识别走向行动规划。
Result: 非正式设计反馈表明部分评审认为分层交互模型可理解且有潜在用途；未报告任何实证结果。
Conclusion: 作为早期原型，Reflexion记录了理论驱动的情感计算的一个方向，但行动规划层中的代理与赋能问题尚待未来实现。
